title: Disentangling Models from Personas in Heterogeneous LLM Simulations
comment: Presented as a Spotlight Paper at the Second Workshop on Social Simulation with LLMS, Third Conference on Language Modeling, 2026
summary: Multi-agent simulations with large language models (LLMs) often operate networks of agents with a single base model. This overlooks the inter-model effects which may dominate engagement dynamics in real-world deployments. To show this, we simulate a heterogeneous social network powered by several different base models and show that the amount of engagement an agent receives depends more on its base model than on its assigned persona. The attraction or repulsion effects of a base model strengthen dramatically when more models are added in the mix, suggesting that networks dynamics may converge to base model effects at scale. To help explain this effect, we conduct a series of content-mediating analyses, showing the predictability of base models across contexts as well as the relationship between a model's lexical patterns and an engagement-maximizing style. In light of recent developments in mass multi-agent interaction, this work underscores the relevance of heterogeneous compositions in driving the outcomes of those networks

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建由多个不同基础模型驱动的异构多智能体社交网络，发现智能体获得的互动量更多取决于其基础模型而非设定人格，且随着模型数量增加，基础模型的吸引/排斥效应会显著增强，表明网络动态在规模化时可能收敛于基础模型效应。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM仿真通常使用单一基础模型构建智能体网络，忽略了真实部署中可能主导互动动态的跨模型（inter-model）效应。作者希望揭示异构基础模型构成对网络结果的关键影响。
AI.method: 构建由多个不同基础模型驱动的异构社交网络仿真；对比智能体互动量与基础模型、设定人格的关系；通过增加混合模型数量考察效应变化；并开展一系列内容中介分析（content-mediating analyses），检验基础模型跨情境的可预测性及其词汇模式与"互动最大化风格"之间的关系。
AI.result: 智能体获得的互动量更多取决于其基础模型而非被赋予的人格；当更多模型加入混合时，基础模型的吸引或排斥效应显著增强；基础模型在不同情境下具有可预测性，且其词汇模式与互动最大化的表达风格存在关联。
AI.conclusion: 在近期大规模多智能体互动发展的背景下，异构模型构成对网络结果具有重要驱动作用，单模型仿真可能低估或误判真实互动动态，研究应重视异构组合的影响。

title: Quality-Aware Self-Correcting Speech Translation on an Edge Device
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Full paper submitted to the Convergence 2026 proceedings; poster presented at Convergence 2026, University of Surrey. Code: https://github.com/juebae/speech-translation_edge_device
summary: We present a fully offline speech-to-speech translation pipeline that runs on a Jetson Nano (4 GB) and corrects its own weak translations without retraining. A Whisper-tiny ASR feeds an Opus-MT translator; multilingual BERT cosine similarity acts as a Quality Estimation (QE) gate, triggering a secondary-pass correction when confidence falls below a pre-defined threshold $τ$. We compare three correction methods: QE reranking (M1), Minimum Bayes-Risk decoding (M2), and constrained beam search (M3). On 1,012 FLORES-200 sentences (English-Spanish), M2 at $τ=0.90$ produces statistically significant improvements over greedy decoding on BLEU (+0.67, p<0.001), ChrF (+0.51, p<0.001), and COMET (+0.0020 at N=3, p=0.002); M1 yields no significant gains, and M3 is significantly worse than baseline (p>0.99). Our central finding is that QE functions effectively as a gate but poorly as a ranker: removing the QE model from candidate selection (M1$\to$M2) does not hurt quality and frees 680 MB from the critical path. Using a gain-to-edit ratio adapted from the post-editing-effort literature, we further show that smaller candidate pools (N=3) yield more surgical corrections with better semantic adequacy, while larger pools (N=10) maximise lexical reward. We release the system and demonstrate live translation across six language pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可在Jetson Nano(4GB)上完全离线运行的自校正语音到语音翻译流水线：Whisper-tiny ASR + Opus-MT + 多语言BERT余弦相似度作为质量估计(QE)门控，在置信度低于阈值τ时触发第二遍纠正。比较三种纠正方法(M1 QE重排、M2 MBR解码、M3约束束搜索)。核心发现：QE适合作门控而非排序器，M1→M2不损失质量并释放680MB关键路径内存。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的边缘设备上实现离线语音翻译，且希望在不重新训练模型的前提下提升弱翻译质量。需要评估质量估计在自校正流水线中的最佳作用方式，以及候选池规模对纠正效果的影响。
AI.method: 流水线：Whisper-tiny ASR → Opus-MT翻译器，多语言BERT余弦相似度作为QE门控，置信度低于阈值τ时触发第二遍纠正。对比三种纠正方法：M1 QE重排、M2最小贝叶斯风险(MBR)解码、M3约束束搜索。在1012条FLORES-200英西句子上评估BLEU、ChrF、COMET，并提出源自后编辑努力文献的增益-编辑比(gain-to-edit ratio)指标分析候选池规模。
AI.result: τ=0.90时M2相对贪婪解码取得统计显著提升：BLEU +0.67 (p<0.001)、ChrF +0.51 (p<0.001)、COMET +0.0020 (N=3, p=0.002)；M1无显著增益；M3显著劣于基线(p>0.99)。移除QE模型(M1→M2)不损害质量且释放680MB关键路径内存。小候选池(N=3)纠正更精准、语义充分性更好；大候选池(N=10)最大化词法奖励。
AI.conclusion: QE适合作为门控而非排序器。MBR解码(M2)在τ=0.90下是最优纠正策略。候选池规模存在权衡：N=3偏向语义充分性的精准纠正，N=10偏向词法奖励。系统已开源并在六种语言对上实现实时翻译。

title: LARK: A Low-Cost, Accurate, Occlusion-Resilient, Kalman Filter-Assisted Tracking System for Image-Guided Surgery
comment: 24 pages, 15 figures, including appendices. Supplementary document included as an ancillary file. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/ApZ8q9DjB-4
summary: Image-guided surgery (IGS) depends on accurate tracking of surgical instruments to provide real-time navigation relative to anatomical structures. Commercial stereo infrared trackers are accurate but prone to occlusion and cost-prohibitive for many settings. This work presents LARK, a multi-camera optical tracking system using commodity RGB hardware and multi-view redundancy and fusion. We develop and evaluate two complete tracking methods: multi-view monocular pose fusion and multi-view triangulation. Both methods are assessed under varying occlusion levels using a precision-machined grid and an anatomical head phantom, and compared against a gold-standard stereo infrared system. With five cameras and adaptive Kalman filtering, LARK achieves median target registration errors of 0.64 mm for point localization with triangulation and 0.73 mm for trajectory tracking with pose fusion on the machined grid. Camera-subset experiments show graceful degradation in adaptive pose-fusion accuracy as fewer views remain available. With tracking hardware costing under $1,000 USD, LARK provides a low-cost platform for image-guided surgery research. Hardware designs and software are publicly available at https://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/software/ , and datasets at https://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/data/ .

AI.tldr: 提出低成本多相机光学追踪系统LARK，采用商用RGB硬件与多视角冗余融合，在遮挡条件下实现亚毫米级精度，成本低于1000美元。
AI.motivation: 商用立体红外追踪系统精度高但易受遮挡影响，且价格昂贵，许多应用场景难以承担。需要一种低成本、抗遮挡的光学追踪方案用于图像引导手术。
AI.method: LARK采用多相机光学追踪系统，基于商用RGB硬件，利用多视角冗余与融合。开发并评估两种完整追踪方法：多视角单目位姿融合与多视角三角测量，均结合自适应卡尔曼滤波，并支持相机子集灵活配置。
AI.result: 在五相机与自适应卡尔曼滤波下，于精密加工网格上：三角测量点定位中位目标配准误差0.64 mm，位姿融合轨迹追踪误差0.73 mm。相机子集实验显示随可用视角减少呈现平滑退化。硬件成本低于1000美元。
AI.conclusion: LARK为图像引导手术研究提供了低成本平台，硬件与软件已公开，数据集亦开放获取。

title: HouseholdBench: Evaluating Large Language Models as Predictors of Household Economic Behavior
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to meet a key goal in economics: a quantitative model of household decision making, across a variety of settings. Yet existing evaluations cover few surveys and outcomes, and do not study how households adjust to changing economic conditions. We introduce a new evaluation, HouseholdBench, which unites 6 U.S. household surveys and 32 prediction tasks spanning numeric, categorical and probabilistic outcomes, related to consumption, income, labor, expectations, and housing. Using past behavior, demographics and macroeconomic conditions, the tasks test whether LLMs predict behavior, including how households adjust to changes in various policies. We evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight LLMs against a no-change baseline and a gradient-boosted tree model. Most LLMs outperform the no-change baseline, including for policy response tasks -- with the best model lowering error for numeric outcomes by 12.2%. Across most tasks, gradient-boosted trees rank first; leading proprietary LLMs approach their performance, but open-weight models lag. LLMs exhibit systematic over- and underprediction across different tasks. We identify methods that enable a 4 billion parameter open-weight model to match proprietary models' performance: fine-tuning and aggregating 16 predictions per observation. Improvements generalize to policy-response tasks, which are excluded from fine-tuning. We release our datasets, code, and leaderboard on our website: https://jn-huang.github.io/householdbench

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HouseholdBench，一个整合 6 项美国家庭调查、32 个预测任务的家庭决策评测基准，用于检验 LLM 能否借助历史行为、人口统计与宏观条件预测家庭行为及其对政策变化的调整，并发现梯度提升树普遍最优、专有模型接近其表现、开源模型落后，而微调加 16 次预测聚合可使 40 亿参数开源模型追平专有模型。
AI.motivation: 经济学的一个关键目标是建立能覆盖多种情境的家庭决策定量模型，LLM 具备实现该目标的潜力。但现有评测仅覆盖少量调查与结果变量，且未研究家庭如何随经济条件变化而调整，因此无法判断 LLM 是否真正具备刻画家庭决策的能力。
AI.method: 提出 HouseholdBench 评测基准：整合 6 项美国家庭调查，构建 32 个预测任务，覆盖数值、分类与概率三类结果，涉及消费、收入、劳动、预期和住房。任务输入为历史行为、人口统计特征与宏观经济条件。评测 13 个专有与开源权重 LLM，基线为"无变化"基准与梯度提升树模型；并提出两种提升方法——微调，以及每条观测聚合 16 次预测。
AI.result: 多数 LLM 优于无变化基线，在政策响应任务上亦然，最优模型的数值结果误差降低 12.2%。在大多数任务上梯度提升树排名第一，头部专有 LLM 接近其表现，而开源权重模型明显落后。LLM 在不同任务上呈现系统性的高估与低估。微调加 16 次预测聚合可使 40 亿参数开源模型达到专有模型水平，且该改进可泛化到未参与微调的政策响应任务。
AI.conclusion: HouseholdBench 表明 LLM 在家庭决策预测上已超越简单基线并能部分捕捉政策响应，但仍未超越梯度提升树；通过微调与预测聚合可显著缩小开源与专有模型的差距，且改进可泛化至未见任务。数据集、代码与排行榜已公开发布，为后续家庭决策建模研究提供统一评测平台。

title: AIMS: Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis for Scalable Novel View Rendering
summary: Feed-forward novel view synthesis methods achieve strong generalization from posed multi-view inputs, but scaling them to large input view sets remains challenging. Transformer-based approaches that jointly process all input-view tokens incur rapidly increasing computation and memory as the number of views grows, while simple view subsampling discards potentially useful observations. We introduce Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis (AIMS), a scalable framework that decouples the number of available observations from the number of views processed by the global synthesis model. AIMS selects a fixed set of spatially distributed anchor views using farthest point sampling, groups nearby observations around each anchor, and uses a lightweight learnable integrator to fuse their information into enriched anchor representations. This allows additional observations to contribute to synthesis while keeping the downstream global view budget fixed. Evaluations on RealEstate10K and ScanNet demonstrate a favorable quality--efficiency trade-off against transformer-based and Gaussian-based baselines. AIMS achieves 29.41 dB and 17.73 dB PSNR on the two datasets, respectively, with rendering averaging 7.24 ms per view.

AI.tldr: AIMS提出一种可扩展的前馈新视角合成框架，通过解耦可用观测数量与全局合成模型处理的视角数量，在大规模输入视角下实现质量与效率的平衡。
AI.motivation: 前馈新视角合成虽能从多视角输入中良好泛化，但扩展到大规模输入视角集合困难：基于Transformer的方法联合处理所有输入视角token，计算与内存随视角数急剧增长；而简单视角子采样又会丢弃有用观测。
AI.method: AIMS使用最远点采样选取固定数量的空间分布锚点视角，将邻近观测按锚点分组，并用轻量可学习整合器将其信息融合为增强的锚点表示，从而让额外观测参与合成，同时保持下游全局视角预算固定。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K和ScanNet上，AIMS相比基于Transformer和高斯的方法取得更优的质量-效率权衡，分别达到29.41 dB和17.73 dB PSNR，渲染平均每视角7.24 ms。
AI.conclusion: AIMS通过在锚点视角上整合邻近观测，将观测规模与全局模型视角预算解耦，有效兼顾合成质量与计算效率，适用于大规模输入视角场景。

title: OpenSplatGraph: From Dense Semantic Maps to Structured Scene Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Robot Perception
summary: Dense 3D mapping with semantic understanding is essential for robotic perception in complex environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting-based mapping approaches enable high-fidelity geometry and efficient open-vocabulary perception, but typically represent semantics as unstructured feature fields that limit object-centric reasoning. In contrast, 3D scene graphs explicitly model objects and their relationships for structured reasoning, but are commonly constructed from sparse geometric representations that do not fully exploit dense semantic maps. In this work, we present OpenSplatGraph, a unified framework that constructs persistent 3D scene graphs directly from an online Gaussian-based open-vocabulary semantic map. The proposed framework augments the dense semantic map with a reliability-aware semantic field that maintains lightweight observation statistics for confidence-aware, query-conditioned object extraction. Extracted object instances are associated with persistent graph nodes, allowing object attributes and relationships to be incrementally updated across observations and queries. By tightly coupling dense semantic mapping with persistent object-centric representations, our framework supports both language-guided object grounding and structured relational reasoning while preserving the geometric fidelity of Gaussian-based mapping. Comprehensive evaluations on standard 3D scene understanding benchmarks and real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that OpenSplatGraph achieves competitive performance for online open-vocabulary perception and downstream robotic tasks. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/OpenSplatGraph.

AI.tldr: OpenSplatGraph：从在线高斯开放词汇语义地图直接构建持久3D场景图的统一框架，实现语言引导的目标定位与结构化关系推理。
AI.motivation: 密集3D建图需兼具语义理解以支撑复杂环境中的机器人感知。现有3D高斯泼溅建图虽具备高保真几何与高效开放词汇感知，但语义以非结构化特征场表示，限制对象级推理；而3D场景图虽显式建模对象及关系以支持结构化推理，却多基于稀疏几何表示构建，未充分利用密集语义地图。
AI.method: 提出OpenSplatGraph统一框架：在高斯在线开放词汇语义地图上引入可靠性感知语义场，维护轻量级观测统计以支持置信度感知、查询条件化的对象提取；将提取的对象实例与持久图节点关联，使对象属性与关系能随观测和查询增量更新，从而紧耦合密集语义建图与持久对象中心表示。
AI.result: 在标准3D场景理解基准与真实机器人实验中，该框架在在线开放词汇感知及下游机器人任务上取得具有竞争力的性能，同时保持高斯建图的几何保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过将密集语义建图与持久对象中心表示紧密结合，OpenSplatGraph同时支持语言引导的目标定位与结构化关系推理，验证了统一建图与场景图构建的有效性。

title: Two Vectors Replace In-Context Demos: Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings
summary: In-context learning (ICL) adapts frozen large multimodal models (LMMs) to new tasks from a few demonstrations (demos), but re-encodes them at every query, where each demo image adds up to hundreds of visual tokens. Demo-free methods remove this cost with a compact task state. However, they add it at locations searched per task or at every decoder layer, where task parameters grow with depth. Moreover, inserted tokens or keys cannot change how the original prompt divides its attention within a layer. To address these issues, we propose Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings (STAVE), which replaces demos with two task-specific vectors added to existing input embeddings. Specifically, a readout vector updates the answer-producing tokens and a context vector updates the other structural token groups. Both are trained with answer labels on prompts with and without demos. We justify these design choices theoretically using a first-order analysis of the loss and a margin bound. Extensive experiments on six LMMs and five large language models show that STAVE matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multimodal tasks with far fewer task parameters and surpasses 15-shot ICL and prior task vectors on 18 text tasks, all at zero-shot inference cost.

AI.tldr: 论文提出STAVE方法，通过学习两个任务特定的嵌入向量（readout向量和context向量）替代演示样例，实现零样本推理成本下的多模态和文本任务适配，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 上下文学习（ICL）虽能让冻结的大型多模态模型（LMM）通过少量演示样例适配新任务，但每次查询都需重新编码演示，每张演示图像可增加数百个视觉token，开销巨大。现有的无演示方法虽用紧凑任务状态降低成本，但存在将任务参数添加到每个任务搜索的位置或每个解码器层（参数随深度增长）的问题，且插入的token或键无法改变原始提示在层内的注意力分配方式。
AI.method: 提出STAVE（Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings），用两个任务特定向量添加到现有输入嵌入中替代演示样例：一个readout向量更新产生答案的token，一个context向量更新其他结构token组。两者通过在有/无演示的提示上使用答案标签进行训练。作者利用损失的一阶分析和边界裕度（margin bound）为这些设计选择提供理论依据。
AI.result: 在六个LMM和五个大型语言模型上的大量实验表明，STAVE在多模态任务上达到或超越最先进方法，且任务参数远少于前者；在18个文本任务上超越15-shot ICL和先前任务向量方法，同时保持零样本推理成本。
AI.conclusion: STAVE通过结构化嵌入适配，以极少任务参数和零样本推理成本实现了对多模态及文本任务的有效适配，兼具性能与效率优势，并通过理论分析支持了设计合理性。

title: CETUS: How Far Do Representations Trained on Earth Transfer to Cassini SAR of Titan?
comment: Research work at NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Available at: https://github.com/magnaprog/CETUS
summary: Cassini synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images reveal the dunes, plains, and lake basins of Titan, providing an instance of representations learned from Earth imagery for planetary terrain classification. Cross-domain Evaluation of Earth-to-Titan Transfer Using SAR (CETUS) compares features from DINOv2, DOFA and CROMA with classical image measurements and features from an untrained vision transformer on the U.S. Geological Survey's Cassini SAR mosaic. The classifiers learn terrain labels from an expert geomorphological map and predict those labels in geographically separate Titan regions. Under logistic regression settings, pretrained encoders achieve higher mean macro F1 than the combined classical features. Encoder rankings change when feature scaling, optimization, and regularization change together. Further training on Titan improves DINOv2 performance, degrades DOFA performance, and leads to mixed results for CROMA under the tested settings. Architectural and input processing differences prevent these comparisons from isolating the effect of pretraining. Classifier fitting and performance on individual terrain classes matter when assessing representation transfer for planetary mapping. Since the map draws partly on the same radar observations, the scores measure agreement with expert interpretation.

AI.tldr: CETUS 在 Cassini SAR 影像上评估地球预训练表征向土卫六地形分类的跨域迁移，比较 DINOv2、DOFA、CROMA 与经典影像特征及未训练 ViT；预训练编码器在逻辑回归下宏观 F1 更高，但排序随缩放、优化与正则化变化，且在 Titan 上继续训练效果因模型而异。
AI.motivation: 验证地球影像学到的表征能否迁移到行星地形分类任务，并系统比较不同预训练编码器与经典特征的跨域表现，为行星制图中的表征迁移评估提供依据。
AI.method: 基于美国地质调查局 Cassini SAR 镶嵌图，将 DINOv2、DOFA、CROMA 的特征与经典影像量测特征及未训练 ViT 特征进行对比；分类器从专家地貌图中学习地形标签，并在土卫六地理上分离的区域进行预测；采用逻辑回归设置，并考察特征缩放、优化与正则化共同变化时编码器排序的变化；部分模型进一步在 Titan 数据上继续训练。
AI.result: 在逻辑回归设置下，预训练编码器的平均宏观 F1 高于经典特征组合；当特征缩放、优化和正则化一起改变时，编码器排名发生变化。继续在 Titan 上训练可提升 DINOv2 性能、降低 DOFA 性能，对 CROMA 结果不一。架构与输入处理差异使得比较无法单独分离预训练的作用；各类地形上的分类器拟合与表现对表征迁移评估很重要。
AI.conclusion: 预训练表征在行星地形分类中总体优于经典特征，但其优势受训练配置、模型架构与输入处理影响，难以归因于预训练本身；由于标签图部分源于同一雷达观测，所得分数衡量的是与专家解释的一致性，而非独立真值。

title: LOGIC: An LLM Benchmark for Intent-Grounded Change Impact in Aerospace Electrical Systems
summary: Aerospace electrical-design revisions can contain multiple genuine changes, although an engineering request may authorize only a subset. Propagating every detected difference can therefore produce overly broad impact reports. We present LOGIC, a controlled benchmark and evaluation framework in which locally deployable language models ground a request in a deterministic candidate-change inventory before selected changes are propagated through a typed electrical traceability graph. This separation permits candidate-selection errors to be distinguished from downstream propagation errors. LOGIC contains 168 scenarios, including 144 selection and 24 abstention cases. We evaluate three 7--8B models against intent-agnostic, lexical, and structured-evidence methods, with an oracle-root upper bound. On 96 explicitly anchored selection cases, gate-only structured evidence achieves candidate F1 of 1.0000, compared with 0.9677 for token-lexical matching. On 12 relational-paraphrase cases, token-lexical F1 is 0.1772 and gate-only F1 is 0.0000, compared with 0.5000--0.6400 for the large language models. Model grounding degrades as candidate inventories grow from 4 to 64 changes, while affected-element and typed-path accuracy remain comparatively stable when frozen selections are replayed over graphs of approximately 1K to 100K nodes. Strict evidence gating suppresses false positives but can remove correct semantic selections. An exploratory evidence-empty abstention policy raises strict abstention accuracy to 0.6667 for all three models and reduces unsafe-report rates to 0.1667, while decreasing answerable-case coverage by 16.0--27.1 percentage points. Four of six conflicting requests remain unsafe for each model. These findings support combining literal evidence and language-model reasoning with engineering review when intent cannot be established reliably.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LOGIC 基准与评估框架，将工程请求中的"候选变更选择"与"沿类型化电气追溯图传播"两阶段解耦，用本地部署语言模型结合确定性证据门控完成选择，从而区分选择错误与传播错误。168 个场景（144 选择+24 弃答）上的实验表明：显式锚定场景下结构化门控 F1 达 1.0000，但语义改写与冲突请求仍是难点。
AI.motivation: 航天电气设计修订往往包含多个真实变更，而工程请求可能只授权其中一部分子集。若把检测到的所有差异一律传播，会产生范围过宽的影​​响报告。核心难点在于"意图未明"：难以可靠判定请求授权了哪些变更，且错误来源（选错候选 vs 传播出错）混杂在一起，难以诊断。
AI.method: 提出 LOGIC：一个可控基准与评估框架。流程上先用本地可部署语言模型将请求 ground 到确定性的候选变更清单（candidate-change inventory），完成候选选择；再将被选中的变更沿类型化电气追溯图（typed electrical traceability graph）传播。该两阶段解耦使候选选择错误与下游传播错误可分离。基准含 168 个场景（144 选择、24 弃答），并以 oracle-root 作为上界。对比三类方法：意图无关法、词法匹配、结构化证据法，并评估三个 7–8B 模型。
AI.result: 在 96 个显式锚定选择用例上，仅门控的结构化证据取得候选 F1=1.0000，词法匹配为 0.9677。在 12 个关系型改述用例上，词法 F1=0.1772、仅门控 F1=0.0000，而大模型为 0.5000–0.6400。候选清单从 4 增至 64 项时，模型 grounding 能力下降；但选择冻结后回放于约 1K–100K 节点图上，受影响元件与类型化路径准确率相对稳定。严格证据门控抑制假阳性，却会剔除正确的语义选择。探索性的"证据为空即弃答"策略将严格弃答准确率提升至 0.6667、不安全报告率降至 0.1667，但可答用例覆盖率下降 16.0–27.1 个百分点。六个冲突请求中每个模型仍有四个保持不安全。
AI.conclusion: 当意图无法被可靠判定时，应当将字面证据与语言模型推理相结合，并引入工程人工审核。证据门控在字面锚定场景下近乎完美但缺乏语义泛化，冲突请求尤其危险，说明纯自动化传播存在风险，需人机协同的验证机制。

title: REViT-v2: Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViT for Equivariant Feature Extraction
comment: 7 pages, Accepted for presentation at NeurIPS NeurREPS workshop 2026
summary: We propose a scalable roto-reflection-group-equivariant vision transformer based on windowed group-convolutional self-attention and a hierarchical feature architecture. We demonstrate that our approach can be scaled to group-equivariant vision transformers (ViTs) with millions of parameters and large datasets with practically sized images, i.e., ImageNet. The code and pretrained weights for the proposed Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViTs (REViT-v2) are available at https://github.com/kc-ml2/revit.

AI.tldr: 提出可扩展的旋转-反射群等变视觉Transformer（REViT-v2），基于窗口化群卷积自注意力与层次化特征架构，可扩展至百万参数级并在ImageNet规模数据上训练。
AI.motivation: 群等变视觉Transformer此前难以扩展到百万级参数和ImageNet规模图像数据，缺乏实用可扩展性。
AI.method: 窗口化群卷积自注意力（windowed group-convolutional self-attention）结合层次化特征架构，构建旋转-反射群（p4m）等变的ViT。
AI.result: 成功将群等变ViT扩展到百万参数级别，并在实用尺寸图像（ImageNet）上完成训练；代码与预训练权重已开源。
AI.conclusion: REViT-v2验证了群等变视觉Transformer的可扩展性，为等变架构在大规模视觉任务中的应用提供了可行方案。

title: Large Language Model Orchestration under Heterogeneous Preferences via Explicit Persona Inference
comment: There are confusions on the preferences and personas in the introductions and also misunderstanding in the title
summary: LLM orchestration investigates how an orchestrator coordinates a group of autonomous agents to achieve common goals or maximize collective welfare. The agents are typically heterogeneous, each holding a private preference that it pursues but does not reveal. Inferring such hidden preferences from behavior has been a subject of long-standing research in game theory and multi-agent systems. The core challenge lies in maintaining a belief over every agent's preference and updating it from the agents' observed actions. Existing LLM orchestrators carry that belief as prompt text with no explicit update rule. This lets early errors persist and propagate rather than be corrected. We therefore propose \textbf{HARP} (Heterogeneous-preference Agent oRchestration via Preference inference), a novel framework that moves the belief out of the prompt. Specifically, HARP maintains one numeric posterior per agent over a finite set of candidate preferences and updates it in closed form by Bayes' rule. The language model supplies only actions and per-candidate likelihoods, so estimation is decoupled from its reasoning. We prove that HARP attains the same $\tilde O(\sqrt K)$ Bayesian regret as explicit joint inference when the factorization is exact. Furthermore, HARP\textsuperscript{+} augments planning with a bonus for actions that distinguish the candidates, so inference continues even when the optimal action is uninformative. Empirical results on three substrates, ranging from payoffs the preferences fully determine, through payoffs that depend on more than them, to scales where explicit joint inference is infeasible, demonstrate that HARP\textsuperscript{+} is the strongest non-oracle method across the class our theory identifies.

AI.tldr: 提出HARP框架，将LLM编排中隐藏偏好的信念从提示文本中分离，用贝叶斯规则闭式维护数值后验，并给出HARP+信息性动作奖励，实现与显式联合推断同阶的贝叶斯遗憾。
AI.motivation: LLM编排需协调异构自主智能体，各智能体持有不公开的私有偏好。从行为推断隐藏偏好是博弈论与多智能体系统的长期难题，核心在于维护并更新每个智能体的偏好信念。现有LLM编排器仅将信念以提示文本形式携带，缺乏显式更新规则，导致早期错误持续并传播而非被纠正。
AI.method: HARP将信念移出提示文本，为每个智能体在有限候选偏好集上维护一个数值后验，并由贝叶斯规则以闭式形式更新；语言模型仅提供动作与各候选偏好的似然，使估计与模型推理解耦。HARP+在此基础上为规划加入奖励项，鼓励选择能区分候选偏好的动作，使推断在最优动作无信息时仍持续。
AI.result: 理论上证明，在因子分解精确时HARP达到与显式联合推断相同的Õ(√K)贝叶斯遗憾。在三个实验基底（收益完全决定偏好、收益依赖多于偏好、显式联合推断不可行的规模）上，HARP+在理论刻画的该类方法中均为最强的非预言机方法。
AI.conclusion: 将偏好信念从提示文本中解耦并采用显式贝叶斯数值更新，可在保持理论遗憾保证的同时提升异构偏好编排的鲁棒性与可扩展性；主动信息性动作选择进一步维持推断有效性。

title: Recurrent Looped Transformer
summary: State tracking requires an update at every input, but the depth a Transformer applies to each token is fixed regardless of sequence length. We introduce the Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT), which splits its layers between a parallel causal encoder and a recurrent decoder. At each token, the decoder merges the encoder output with the previous token's final decoder state, so the computation path grows with sequence length at a fixed per-token cost. On six algorithmic tasks, we compare five splits of eight layers with an eight-layer Transformer over three seeds. Trained on at most 40 bits, two RLT splits generalize parity to 256 bits with 100% accuracy in every seed, while the Transformer stays at chance. On swap-based $S_5$ permutation tracking at eight times the training length, RLT reaches 97% final-state accuracy versus under 1% for the Transformer, and accuracy increases with decoder depth. On modular arithmetic beyond the training lengths, RLT reaches up to 93% versus 33\% for the Transformer. Ablations show that these gains depend on the feedback: removing it drops parity and swap-based $S_5$ to chance at every split. Updating the feedback once per four-token chunk lets known tokens in a chunk run in parallel and keeps 64-bit parity at 99%, while permutation tracking depends on per-token feedback: chunking lowers length-64 swap-based $S_5$ from 100% to 20%.

AI.tldr: 该文提出循环环状Transformer（RLT），将层分为并行因果编码器与循环解码器，使每token的计算路径随序列长度增长而单token成本固定，在算法任务上显著优于标准Transformer的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 状态跟踪要求每步输入都进行更新，但标准Transformer对每个token施加的深度固定，不随序列长度增加而变化，限制了其在长序列状态跟踪与长度泛化上的表现。
AI.method: RLT将八层划分为并行因果编码器与循环解码器；解码器在每个token处将编码器输出与前一token的最终解码状态合并，从而在固定单token成本下使计算路径随序列长度增长。在六个算法任务上，用三种随机种子比较五种八层切分方式与八层Transformer；并设置去除反馈、以及每四token块更新一次反馈的消融实验。
AI.result: 训练至多40比特时，两种RLT切分在每个种子下将奇偶校验泛化到256比特并达100%准确率，而Transformer停留在随机水平。基于交换的S_5置换跟踪在八倍训练长度下，RLT最终状态准确率达97%，Transformer低于1%，且准确率随解码器深度增加。模算术超出训练长度时，RLT最高达93%，Transformer为33%。消融显示收益依赖反馈：去除反馈使奇偶校验与交换S_5在所有切分下降至随机水平。每四token块更新反馈可在块内并行已知token，保持64比特奇偶校验99%，但置换跟踪依赖逐token反馈，分块使长度64的交换S_5从100%降至20%。
AI.conclusion: RLT通过编码器-循环解码器结构及逐token反馈，在固定单token成本下实现随序列长度增长的计算深度，从而在奇偶校验、置换跟踪与模算术等算法任务上获得显著的长度泛化优势；该优势依赖反馈机制，且不同任务对反馈粒度（逐token vs 分块）需求不同。

title: Emoception: Selective Affective Layer Fine-Tuning of Video Vision Transformers for Player Arousal Change Recognition From Gameplay Footage
summary: This article proposes Selective Affective Layer Fine-Tuning (SALFT), an efficient adaptation framework for Video Vision Transformers in player arousal recognition from gameplay. To bypass computationally expensive full fine-tuning, SALFT introduces a selection criterion based on the L2-norm change in layer parameters after brief adaptation, directly measuring representational shifts and providing a more stable basis than gradient-based alternatives. Evaluated via five-fold cross-validation on the Arousal Video Game AnnotatIoN dataset, SALFT achieves performance comparable to full fine-tuning across all games without statistically significant degradation ($p>0.05$), while updating only $\approx$8% of parameters (over 92% reduction). Notably, in one game, SALFT consistently outperforms both full fine-tuning and the best baseline across all metrics and folds, reaching the theoretical minimum p-value (p=0.0625, exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test). In addition, we introduce an interpretability method to trace attention patterns, enhancing model transparency. These results establish SALFT as an effective and efficient approach for affective game computing.

AI.tldr: 提出SALFT方法，仅微调约8%参数即可在游戏玩家唤醒度识别中达到与全量微调相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 全量微调Video Vision Transformer计算开销昂贵，需要一种高效的自适应微调方案以降低训练成本，同时保持性能。
AI.method: SALFT基于短暂适应后层参数L2范数变化作为选择准则，直接度量表征偏移，比基于梯度的方案更稳定，仅选择性微调部分层。
AI.result: 在Arousal Video Game AnnotatIoN数据集上五折交叉验证，性能与全量微调相当且无统计显著退化(p>0.05)，仅更新约8%参数（减少超92%）；某游戏中在所有指标和折上均优于全量微调和最佳基线，达到理论最小p值(p=0.0625)。
AI.conclusion: SALFT是情感游戏计算中高效有效的适配方法，并提供注意力模式追踪的可解释性方法。

title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
summary: Neural simulation of high-fidelity deformable bodies is a foundational challenge in computer graphics and physical AI. Long-horizon prediction for high-resolution 3D volumetric meshes is difficult: autoregressive methods are susceptible to error accumulation, while direct multi-frame prediction at native resolution is computationally prohibitive. This motivates a compact spatiotemporal latent representation, which is largely unexplored for mesh-based volumetric physics. Meanwhile, it remains unclear whether deterministic regression or generative diffusion is the more appropriate predictive paradigm. To address these coupled challenges, we introduce PhysLDM, a unified latent-diffusion paradigm for one-shot volumetric deformable simulation. Its core is a holistic spatiotemporal VAE that avoids the "staircase" artifacts of standard temporal compression (as in common video VAEs), achieving ~2.48 mm reconstruction precision on meter-scale scenes at up to 78x token compression. Based on this reliable latent space, we systematically compare regression and diffusion methods. Our experiments uncover a key modeling insight: complex deformable dynamics are often chaotic, and in this regime deterministic regression tends to produce non-physical averages, whereas diffusion better models their distribution. Accordingly, we employ a latent diffusion model that effectively learns from the chaotic data to generate physically plausible trajectories. Trained purely kinematically on an Objaverse-scale dataset, a single PhysLDM generalizes zero-shot to unseen OOD datasets (GSO and Toys4K). Its differentiability further enables efficient solution of inverse problems and higher-order design optimization. To our knowledge, PhysLDM is the first high-fidelity spatiotemporal autoencoder and latent-diffusion paradigm for volumetric deformable dynamics, offering a scalable and robust approach to neural simulation.

AI.tldr: PhysLDM：面向体素可变形动力学的高保真时空自编码器与潜在扩散范式，实现一次性长时程预测。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率3D体素网格的长时程预测困难：自回归方法易累积误差，原生分辨率下直接多帧预测计算代价过高；同时，网格体物理缺乏紧凑时空潜在表示，且确定性回归与生成式扩散哪种范式更合适尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出统一潜在扩散范式PhysLDM。核心为整体式时空VAE，避免标准时间压缩（如视频VAE）的"阶梯"伪影，在米级场景达约2.48 mm重建精度、最高78倍token压缩。基于该潜空间系统比较回归与扩散，采用潜在扩散模型学习混沌形变数据以生成物理合理轨迹。
AI.result: 时空VAE重建精度约2.48 mm、压缩达78倍；实验发现混沌形变下确定性回归倾向产生非物理平均，扩散更能建模其分布；仅运动学训练于Objaverse规模数据集，单一模型可零样本泛化至OOD数据集（GSO、Toys4K）；可微性支持逆问题求解与高阶设计优化。
AI.conclusion: PhysLDM是首个面向体素可变形动力学的高保真时空自编码器与潜在扩散范式，为神经仿真提供可扩展且鲁棒的方法。

title: Stateless Language Agents: Scaling Long-Horizon Automated Research
summary: Automated research systems increasingly run LLM agents over long horizons, but more inference does not by itself produce more progress: agents replay growing histories, duplicate one another's work, or stop experimenting while token consumption continues. Yet most evaluations use short budgets or benchmarks that saturate early, leaving these failure modes untested. We trace these failures to two choices: where research state lives and who decides what to try next. We introduce Stateless Language Agents (SLAs), built on the principle of stateful search with stateless agents: no agent carries its conversation across invocations; instead, the harness owns the research state (candidate solutions and measured outcomes) and reconstructs a fresh and role-specific context for every invocation. What each agent sees becomes an explicit design choice rather than a history that grows with the run. We implement this principle in the SLA framework, where a stateless Advisor reads harness-summarized evidence across search directions and assigns concrete experiments to parallel Workers. We evaluate SLA against three recent frameworks on software engineering, kernel optimization, and algorithm design at budgets of up to one billion tokens. SLA achieves the best final result on every task and reaches the strongest kernel baseline's final performance with over 84% fewer tokens. Ablations from shared checkpoints show that focused contexts and explicit assignments each contribute to SLA's progress, with effects that can compound over full runs, while the Advisor consumes less than 0.6% of tokens. These results argue for SLAs, which keep durable research state out of agent conversations, and show that short evaluation horizons can misjudge research systems and their components.

AI.tldr: 提出无状态语言智能体（SLA）框架：智能体不跨调用携带对话，由执行框架持有研究状态并为每次调用重建角色特定上下文，以"有状态搜索+无状态智能体"解决长周期自动化研究中的推理浪费问题。
AI.motivation: 自动化研究系统在长周期运行LLM智能体时，更多推理并不等于更多进展：智能体重复回放不断增长的历史、彼此重复工作、或停止实验但token消耗持续增加。而归因于两个设计选择：研究状态存放位置，以及由谁决定下一步尝试什么。现有评测多使用短预算或早期就饱和的基准，无法暴露这些失效模式。
AI.method: 提出无状态语言智能体（SLA），基于"有状态搜索、无状态智能体"原则：智能体不在调用间保留对话，由harness持有研究状态（候选解与实测结果），并为每次调用重建全新的、角色特定的上下文，使智能体所见内容成为显式设计选择而非随运行增长的历史。在SLA框架中实现：无状态Advisor读取由harness汇总的跨搜索方向证据，向并行的Worker分配具体实验。
AI.result: 在软件工程、内核优化和算法设计任务上，与三个近期框架对比，预算最高达十亿token。SLA在每个任务上取得最佳最终结果；在达到最强内核基线最终性能时，token用量减少超过84%。共享检查点的消融实验显示，聚焦上下文与显式任务分配各自对进展有贡献，且效果可在完整运行中复利叠加；Advisor消耗的token不足0.6%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用SLA——将持久研究状态置于智能体对话之外；同时表明短评测周期会误判研究系统及其组件。

title: A Novel Sentence Stress Detection Framework Leveraging Auxiliary Word-Stress Modeling and Loss Optimization
summary: Prosodic stress is a crucial aspect of automatic pronunciation assessment (APA), encompassing both sentence stress detection (SSD) and word stress detection (WSD). SSD highlights semantically salient words that shape discourse meaning, while WSD identifies the primary stressed syllable within each word to ensure lexical clarity. However, most prior work treats SSD and WSD as independent tasks, overlooking their shared reliance on prosodic cues such as pitch, duration, and intensity. To address this gap, we propose an effective SSD approach combining SSD with auxiliary WSD via a novel modeling paradigm. In addition, we introduce a word-span stress regularizer (WSR) that concentrates token-level SSD probabilities within each stressed word span. Experiments on the TinyStress-15K benchmark show that the proposed method outperforms strong baselines, with the complete configuration achieving the best SSD result.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将句子重音检测（SSD）与词重音检测（WSD）联合建模的方法，并引入词跨度重音正则化器（WSR），在TinyStress-15K基准上取得最优SSD性能。
AI.motivation: SSD与WSD共享音高、时长、强度等韵律线索，但以往工作多将二者视为独立任务，忽略了其内在关联。
AI.method: 提出一种新的建模范式，在SSD任务中引入辅助WSD进行联合建模；同时设计词跨度重音正则化器（WSR），将token级的SSD概率集中到每个重音词的跨度内。
AI.result: 在TinyStress-15K基准上，所提方法优于强基线，且完整配置取得最佳SSD结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过SSD与WSD的联合建模及WSR正则化，可有效利用共享韵律线索提升句子重音检测性能。

title: Monte Carlo Estimation for KV Cache Eviction
summary: Most KV-cache eviction methods ask, in effect, which memory appeared important while reading the prompt? We instead ask, which memory will matter while answering? Since decoding queries are unavailable at eviction time, prior future-aware methods rely on pseudo-responses or synthetic future-query estimates. We cast fixed-budget future-aware eviction as distributional estimation over plausible model-conditional query trajectories and introduce LORE-KV (Lookahead Output-perturbation with Reliability-weighted Ensembles for Key-Value caches), a training-free method that samples short autoregressive continuations from the frozen target model and uses their response-side query states to estimate prompt-token utility. Tokens are scored by projected leave-one-out attention-output deletion cost and aggregated across sampled futures with optional trajectory weighting. The temporary continuations are discarded before final decoding, requiring no auxiliary model or training. Ablations isolate the mechanism: at B=128, a single response-side continuation recovers about 89% of the gain over the prompt-window control, while additional futures provide smaller improvements. At B=128, LORE-KV raises the LongBench average on Qwen2.5-14B from 45.49 to 48.24 (+2.75) and the 16K RULER average on Mistral-7B from 45.20 to 51.05 (+5.85). Gains diminish at larger cache budgets and coexist with task-level regressions. LORE-KV incurs 1.46-2.77x AnDPro's per-sample wall-clock time as a one-time compression overhead across six dense and hybrid-attention backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LORE-KV，一种免训练的 KV-cache 驱逐方法，通过采样短自回归续写并用响应侧查询状态估计提示词元效用，在 B=128 时提升 LongBench 与 RULER 表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 KV-cache 驱逐方法多基于"阅读提示时哪些记忆显得重要"，而本文关注"回答时哪些记忆将会重要"。由于驱逐时无法获得解码查询，已有未来感知方法依赖伪响应或合成未来查询估计，存在不足。
AI.method: 将固定预算的未来感知驱逐建模为对模型条件查询轨迹分布上的分布式估计；提出 LORE-KV，从冻结目标模型采样短自回归续写，利用其响应侧查询状态估计提示词元效用；词元评分基于投影式留一注意力输出删除代价，并在采样未来轨迹上可选加权聚合；临时续写在最终解码前丢弃，无需辅助模型或训练。
AI.result: B=128 时，单条响应侧续写即恢复相对提示窗口对照约 89% 的增益，更多未来轨迹带来较小提升；B=128 时 Qwen2.5-14B 的 LongBench 平均分从 45.49 升至 48.24（+2.75），Mistral-7B 的 16K RULER 平均分从 45.20 升至 51.05（+5.85）；更大缓存预算下增益递减，且存在任务级回退；作为一次性压缩开销，在六种稠密与混合注意力骨干上耗时为 AnDPro 的 1.46-2.77 倍。
AI.conclusion: LORE-KV 通过响应侧未来轨迹估计实现免训练、无需辅助模型的未来感知 KV-cache 驱逐，在有限预算下有效提升长上下文性能，但增益随预算增大而递减并伴随部分任务回退，且引入额外压缩开销。

title: Loud and Clear: Dynamic Activation Steering for Improving Speech Intelligibility in Noisy Environments
summary: Speech becomes less intelligible in noisy environments, and humans naturally adapt their voice to compensate. Inspired by this behavior, we investigate whether a text-to-speech (TTS) model can be guided to produce more intelligible speech using activation steering, without retraining. We focus on two characteristics of the Lombard effect: increased vocal effort and hyper-articulation. We introduce a prompt-relative steering mechanism that prevents steering effects from accumulating during generation while allowing their strength to be adjusted dynamically. Across seen and unseen speakers and multiple languages, our method produces systematic changes in Lombard-related acoustic features, preserves speaker similarity (89-95%), and reduces WER under background noise by 7-22% at 1 dB SNR. These results show that pretrained TTS models can be dynamically controlled to generate more intelligible speech without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于激活引导（activation steering）的方法，无需重训练即可引导预训练TTS模型生成更清晰可懂的语音，模拟Lombard效应。
AI.motivation: 人在噪声环境中说话会自然调整发声以提升可懂度（Lombard效应），作者希望借鉴这一行为，让TTS模型在不重训练的前提下生成更具可懂度的语音。
AI.method: 聚焦Lombard效应的两个特征：发声努力增加（increased vocal effort）与超清晰发音（hyper-articulation）。提出一种"prompt-relative steering"机制，防止引导效应在生成过程中累积，同时支持动态调整引导强度。
AI.result: 在已见与未见说话人及多种语言上，方法使Lombard相关声学特征发生系统性变化，保持89-95%的说话人相似度，并在1 dB SNR背景噪声下将WER降低7-22%。
AI.conclusion: 预训练TTS模型可被动态控制以生成更清晰可懂的语音，且无需重训练。

title: Where Rules End and Judges Begin: Measuring the Judgment Boundary in Multi-Agent Systems Security
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) engage tools, share memory, and delegate tasks, often encountering adversarial content. Current defenses for MAS are typically evaluated in isolation, focusing on one attack type at a time, which can lead to costly and hard-to-audit outcomes. This study organizes defenses into five principles, implementing them as DEFER1 (DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment), which includes a cascade of 28 checks that blocks what it can and refers the rest to a panel of four judges. In independent testing across four domains, attack success rates drop from about 30.0% to approximately 3.0%, with 78% of blocked attacks handled by deterministic checks. Only a quarter of proposals reach the judges in the security-operations domain, illustrating that the rules provide security for attacks violating clear policies, while judges manage those that only misrepresent intent. Both systems have weaknesses, such as a risk-score approval gate that inaccurately approves most attack proposals but few legitimate ones, highlighting the challenges in assessing threats accurately.

AI.tldr: 该研究将多智能体系统（MAS）的防御归纳为五项原则，并实现为DEFER架构（确定性优先执行+残余判断），包含28项检查级联，将无法拦截的请求交给四名评审组成的评审团。在四个领域的独立测试中，攻击成功率从约30.0%降至约3.0%，其中78%的拦截由确定性检查完成，安全运营领域仅四分之一提案进入评审环节。作者同时指出两类机制的弱点，如风险评分审批门会错误放行多数攻击提案却拒绝多数合法提案。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统需要调用工具、共享记忆并委派任务，因而经常接触对抗性内容。现有MAS防御通常在孤立条件下评估，一次只针对一种攻击类型，导致成本高昂且难以审计，缺乏对多类攻击的统一、可审计防护框架。
AI.method: 将防御组织为五项原则，并实现为DEFER（DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment）：先由确定性检查构成的级联（共28项检查）尽可能拦截，将剩余请求转交由四名评审组成的评审团进行判断，形成"规则优先、判断兜底"的两级架构。
AI.result: 在四个领域的独立测试中，攻击成功率从约30.0%降至约3.0%；78%被拦截的攻击由确定性检查处理；在安全运营领域，仅约四分之一的提案会进入评审团环节。确定性规则对违反明确策略的攻击提供安全保障，评审则处理仅体现意图误导的攻击。两类机制均存在弱点，例如风险评分审批门会不准确地放行大多数攻击提案，却只放行少数合法提案。
AI.conclusion: 确定性检查与评审团互补，可显著降低MAS攻击成功率并减少评审负担，但二者并非无懈可击；风险评分审批门等组件的误判表明，准确评估威胁仍是待解决的挑战。

title: DLoop: Looped Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation in large language models. In each drafting stage, a lightweight draft model proposes tokens that the target model subsequently verifies. With increasingly capable draft models, we find that the target model frequently accepts all tokens produced in a drafting stage. A verification nevertheless follows each drafting stage, resulting in unnecessary target-model forward passes even when drafting could have continued. Adaptive draft length methods decide during decoding how many draft tokens precede a verification, but they raise the speedup only for autoregressive draft models. For a parallel draft model, drafting further requires target-model hidden states for draft tokens that have not been verified. We propose DLoop, a looped form of speculative decoding that adaptively performs multiple drafting stages before verification. DLoop continues drafting while the draft model remains confident and verifies all accumulated draft tokens together. Loop-aware training keeps the draft model reliable in the additional drafting stages by exposing it to its own hidden states for unverified draft tokens. By spending additional draft-model forward passes, DLoop reduces the number of target-model forward passes required for verification. Across diverse speculative decoding methods including EAGLE-3, DFlash, Domino, DSpark, and multi-token prediction modules, DLoop improves the wall-clock speedup by 5 to 41 percent while preserving lossless decoding. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/DLoop.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 DLoop，一种循环式投机解码方法，在验证前自适应地进行多轮草稿生成，通过循环感知训练提升草稿模型在额外草稿阶段的可靠性，从而减少目标模型前向次数，提升 5%–41% 的墙钟加速比且保持无损解码。
AI.motivation: 草稿模型能力不断增强，导致目标模型在一次草稿阶段经常接受全部草稿 token，但每个草稿阶段后仍会执行一次验证，造成不必要的目标模型前向传播。现有的自适应草稿长度方法主要只对自回归草稿模型提升加速；对于并行草稿模型，继续草稿需要未验证草稿 token 对应的目标模型隐藏状态。
AI.method: DLoop 采用循环式投机解码：在验证之前自适应地执行多个草稿阶段，当草稿模型保持高置信度时持续草稿，并将累积的所有草稿 token 一起送入验证。为支撑额外草稿阶段，提出循环感知训练（loop-aware training），将草稿模型暴露于其自身对未验证草稿 token 产生的隐藏状态，从而保持其可靠性。
AI.result: 在 EAGLE-3、DFlash、Domino、DSpark 以及多 token 预测模块等多种投机解码方法上，DLoop 在保持无损解码的前提下，将墙钟加速比提升 5% 至 41%。
AI.conclusion: DLoop 通过以额外草稿模型前向换减少目标模型前向次数，打破了并行草稿模型难以自适应延长草稿阶段的限制，为投机解码提供了一种通用且无损的加速方案。

title: Disentangling Dual Image References in Frequency Aware Diffusion Models for Personalized Generation
comment: 28 pages, 14 figures, to appear at NeurIPS 2026, Sydney, Australia
summary: Personalized image generation aims to synthesize text-driven images conditioned on reference images, while mainly casting the generation as image customization for foreground and style transfer for background. Previous arts of diffusion models suffers from the text misalignment with background for image customization and foreground for style transfer during the denoising process. Such facts, as we observed, rooted from the entanglement among hybrid frequency bands during the denoising process. To address such salient limitation, in this paper, we study personalized generation based on dual references - customization and color and style reference - and propose a paradigm to disentangle these Dual image references within Frequency-aware Diffusion Models, dubbed Dual-FDM, to simultaneously tackle two crucial personalized image generation tasks: customization style transfer and color style transfer, by disentangling different frequency bands via mask strategy within frequency domain. For customization style transfer, we replace the mid-frequency band of the background in the style reference with that from the foreground of the customized reference. For color style transfer, we substitute the low-frequency band of the background in the style reference with that from both the foreground and background of the color reference. Both the substituted frequency bands are used as the key and value to reconstruct the query foreground and background of the denoised personalized image.Extensive experiments validate the superiority of Dual-FDM over the state-of-the-art diffusion models for personalized image generation. Our code can be accessed from https://github.com/htyjers/Dual-FDM.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Dual-FDM，一种基于双参考图像（定制参考与颜色/风格参考）的频率感知扩散模型范式，通过掩码策略在频域解耦不同频带，同时处理定制风格迁移与颜色风格迁移两类个性化图像生成任务，实验优于现有扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化图像生成（定制化针对前景、风格迁移针对背景）中，扩散模型去噪过程存在文本与背景（图像定制时）或文本与前景（风格迁移时）的错位问题。作者观察到，该问题的根源在于去噪过程中混合频带之间的纠缠。为缓解这一显著局限，本文研究基于双参考的个性化生成，并提出解耦双参考的范式。
AI.method: 提出 Dual-FDM，在频率感知扩散模型中通过频域掩码策略解耦双图像参考。对定制风格迁移：用定制参考前景的中频带替换风格参考背景的中频带；对颜色风格迁移：用颜色参考的前景与背景替换风格参考背景的低频带。被替换的频带作为 key 与 value，用于重建去噪后个性化图像的前景与背景 query。
AI.result: 大量实验验证 Dual-FDM 在个性化图像生成上优于当前最先进的扩散模型，代码开源于 https://github.com/htyjers/Dual-FDM。
AI.conclusion: 通过频域掩码显式解耦双参考的不同频带，可有效缓解扩散去噪中的文本错位问题，统一支持定制风格迁移与颜色风格迁移两类个性化生成任务。

title: Unlocking Fine-Grained Perception in CLIP via Structurally-Aware Latent Masked Modeling
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP excel in global semantic alignment but often lack fine-grained perceptual capabilities. This hinders dense prediction tasks and bottlenecks the visual potential of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing research has attempted to enhance CLIP's visual representations by incorporating geometric priors from vision-centric models. However, these strategies often struggle to achieve deep alignment for both local spatial structures and global semantics, potentially even distorting the original image-text space. To address these limitations, we propose SALM, an unsupervised embedding alignment framework based on structurally-aware latent mask modeling. SALM effectively synergizes local and global alignment via a dual-path design combining explicit and implicit mechanisms, without requiring any image-text pairs. First, we introduce a dual-matrix alignment strategy that explicitly calibrates intra-sample spatial correlations and activation intensities, thereby effectively injecting local geometric priors. Based on this, we further design a latent mask modeling mechanism to guide CLIP to restore the missing semantic details of the target model, thereby implicitly aggregating fine-grained structures into the global semantic space. Furthermore, driven by the empirical observations that CLIP's shallow features inherently possess strong spatial observational capabilities, we naturally extend SALM to a highly efficient self-distillation paradigm, SALM-Self. This unlocks CLIP's intrinsic fine-grained potential without relying on any external models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SALM not only significantly improves performance in dense prediction tasks but also boosts CLIP's zero-shot accuracy, effectively enhancing the fine-grained understanding capabilities of MLLMs. Project page at https://qzfm.github.io/salm_project_page/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SALM，一种基于结构感知潜在掩码建模的无监督嵌入对齐框架，通过双路径显隐机制协同局部与全局对齐，无需图文对即可增强CLIP的细粒度感知能力，并扩展出自蒸馏版本SALM-Self。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉语言模型擅长全局语义对齐，但缺乏细粒度感知能力，制约了密集预测任务及多模态大模型的视觉潜力。现有通过引入视觉模型几何先验的方法难以同时实现局部空间结构与全局语义的深度对齐，甚至可能扭曲原始图文空间。
AI.method: 提出SALM无监督嵌入对齐框架，采用显式与隐式机制结合的双路径设计，无需图文对。其一为双矩阵对齐策略，显式校准样本内空间相关性与激活强度以注入局部几何先验；其二为潜在掩码建模机制，引导CLIP恢复目标模型缺失的语义细节，将细粒度结构隐式聚合进全局语义空间。基于CLIP浅层特征本身具备强空间观测能力的发现，进一步将SALM扩展为高效自蒸馏范式SALM-Self，无需外部模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SALM不仅在密集预测任务上显著提升性能，还提高了CLIP的零样本准确率，有效增强了多模态大模型的细粒度理解能力。
AI.conclusion: SALM通过结构感知潜在掩码建模实现了局部与全局的有效对齐，既能提升密集预测与零样本性能，也可作为自蒸馏范式挖掘CLIP内在细粒度潜力，为增强MLLMs的细粒度视觉理解提供了有效途径。

title: Anchor-driven Multi-modal Multi-scale Expert Selection for Survival Prediction
summary: The integrative analysis of histopathological Whole-Slide Images (WSIs) and transcriptomic profiles holds significant promise for cancer survival prediction. However, existing methods typically project multi-modal features directly into a shared latent space without explicit alignment, leading to the entanglement of mismatched morphological cues and molecular signals. Furthermore, current fusion strategies often treat the extreme spatial heterogeneity of WSIs uniformly, lacking mechanisms to adaptively prioritize clinically relevant tissue scales for individual patients. To address these limitations, we propose an Anchor-driven Multi-modal Multi-scale Expert Selection (AM$^2$ES) framework for survival prediction. Specifically, we present an Anchor-driven Multi-modal Fusion (AMF) module, which introduces learnable semantic anchors as cross-modal mediators to bridge the semantic gap by enforcing a structurally regularized alignment between transcriptomic features and multi-scale pathology representations. Built upon this aligned semantic space, we further design a Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts (H-MoE) selection module to decouple the hierarchical prognostic selection process. Mimicking the pathologist's diagnostic workflow, H-MoE performs (i) Intra-scale Expert Filtering to discriminatively identify salient tumor regions within each magnification, and (ii) Inter-scale Hierarchy Routing to dynamically weight and select the most informative resolution levels. Extensive experiments on multiple TCGA cancer cohorts demonstrate that our AM$^2$ES achieves state-of-the-art performance while offering fine-grained interpretability by visualizing how specific molecular pathways drive the expert routing decisions across tissue scales. The code will be released at https://github.com/taozh2017/AM2ES.

AI.tldr: 提出AM²ES框架，通过锚点驱动的多模态对齐与层级专家选择实现病理图像与转录组整合的生存预测。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将多模态特征直接投影到共享潜空间而缺乏显式对齐，导致形态学线索与分子信号错配纠缠；同时融合策略对WSI极端空间异质性一视同仁，缺乏为个体患者自适应地优先关注临床相关组织尺度的机制。
AI.method: AM²ES框架包含两个核心模块：(1) Anchor-driven Multi-modal Fusion (AMF)，引入可学习语义锚点作为跨模态中介，通过结构化正则化对齐转录组特征与多尺度病理表征，弥合语义鸿沟；(2) Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts (H-MoE) 选择模块，解耦层级预后选择过程，模拟病理学家诊断流程，包含尺度内专家过滤（识别各放大倍数下的显著肿瘤区域）与跨尺度层级路由（动态加权并选择最具信息量的分辨率）。
AI.result: 在多个TCGA癌症队列上的大量实验表明，AM²ES达到最先进性能，并可通过可视化特定分子通路如何驱动跨组织尺度的专家路由决策，提供细粒度可解释性。
AI.conclusion: AMF的有效性与H-MoE的层级路由共同提升了多模态生存预测的准确性与可解释性；代码将在 https://github.com/taozh2017/AM2ES 发布。

title: RBMatch: Dual-Level Class Rebalancing for Semi-Supervised Building Footprint Extraction
summary: Accurate building footprint extraction from high-resolution remote sensing imagery is essential for urban planning, disaster response, and environmental monitoring. However, obtaining dense pixel-level annotations is costly, motivating the use of semi-supervised learning (SSL) to leverage unlabeled imagery. In remote sensing, severe foreground--background imbalance poses a particular challenge for self-training, as it can bias pseudo-label generation and the resulting unsupervised optimization toward the majority background class. We show that addressing this imbalance at only one stage is insufficient: balancing pseudo-label selection alone does not prevent background bias from re-emerging during unsupervised loss optimization, a failure mode we term \emph{imbalance leak}. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{RBMatch}, a dual-level class-rebalancing framework that jointly regulates pseudo-label generation and unsupervised optimization. RBMatch combines a supervised learning pathway with a self-training module comprising three components: adaptive class-specific thresholding (ACT) for balanced pseudo-label selection, confidence-aware class-balanced reweighting (CACBR) for mitigating class bias in the unsupervised loss, and distribution alignment (DAL) for matching the predicted unlabeled-data distribution to the labeled-data prior. Experiments on the WHU, INRIA, and Massachusetts building footprint datasets across labeled ratios of 1%--10% show that RBMatch consistently achieves the best building IoU and F1-score among the evaluated methods. The improvement is most pronounced on the highly imbalanced Massachusetts dataset, where RBMatch improves IoU by 1.37 points over the strongest baseline at a 1% labeling ratio and is the only method to outperform the fully supervised baseline across all twelve dataset--ratio settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RBMatch 半监督建筑物提取框架，通过在伪标签生成和无监督优化两个层面同时进行类别重平衡，解决遥感影像中的前景-背景不平衡问题，在 WHU、INRIA、Massachusetts 数据集上取得最优 IoU 与 F1。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率遥感影像的建筑物轮廓提取对城市规划、灾害响应和环境监测至关重要，但像素级标注成本高昂，促使采用半监督学习利用无标签影像。然而遥感场景中严重的前景-背景不平衡给自训练带来困难：会使伪标签生成产生偏差，并使无监督优化偏向背景类。作者发现仅在单一阶段处理该不平衡是不够的——只平衡伪标签选择无法阻止背景偏差在无监督损失优化中重新出现，作者将此失效模式称为"imbalance leak"（不平衡泄漏）。
AI.method: 提出 RBMatch，一个双层类别重平衡框架，同时调控伪标签生成与无监督优化。RBMatch 结合监督学习路径与自训练模块，后者包含三个组件：自适应类别特定阈值（ACT），用于平衡的伪标签选择；置信度感知的类别平衡重加权（CACBR），用于减轻无监督损失中的类别偏差；分布对齐（DAL），用于将无标签数据的预测分布匹配到有标签数据的先验分布。
AI.result: 在 WHU、INRIA 和 Massachusetts 建筑物轮廓数据集上，于 1%–10% 的标注比例下进行实验，RBMatch 在所评估方法中始终取得最佳的建筑物 IoU 和 F1 分数。改进在高度不平衡的 Massachusetts 数据集上最为显著：在 1% 标注比例下，RBMatch 相比最强基线将 IoU 提升 1.37 个点，并且是唯一在全部十二个"数据集-比例"设置中均优于全监督基线的方法。
AI.conclusion: 在遥感建筑物提取任务中，前景-背景不平衡必须在伪标签生成和无监督优化两个阶段同时处理，才能避免"不平衡泄漏"。RBMatch 的双层重平衡设计有效缓解了背景偏差，在低标注比例下稳定超越强基线，并在高度不平衡数据上展现出最强鲁棒性。

title: Improving Synthetic Data Generation for Argument Mining via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
summary: Argument Mining (AM) is fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of high-quality structure-annotated datasets. While LLMs have shown promise in synthetic data generation, producing synthetic AM data that is both structurally accurate and sufficiently diverse remains a challenging problem. To address this problem, we revisit synthetic data generation for AM from a new perspective and propose a novel adversarial reinforcement learning framework for data synthesis. The proposed framework jointly optimizes the generator and the discriminator in an adversarial loop, in which the generator produces structured AM instances, and the discriminator provides learning signals by distinguishing real data from synthetic candidates. This enables the generator to progressively improve both the structural accuracy of generated argument data while maintaining diversity through adversarial feedback. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves AM performance on three benchmark datasets in both full-data and low-resource settings, validating its effectiveness and scalability.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对论辩挖掘（AM）中结构标注数据稀缺的问题，提出一种对抗式强化学习数据合成框架，通过生成器与判别器的对抗循环联合优化，同时提升合成论辩数据的结构准确性与多样性，在三个基准数据集的全数据与低资源设定下均一致提升AM性能。
AI.motivation: 论辩挖掘（AM）受限于高质量、带结构标注的数据集稀缺。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在合成数据生成方面展现出潜力，但生成同时具备结构准确性和足够多样性的合成论辩数据仍是难题。
AI.method: 作者从新视角重新审视AM合成数据生成，提出一种新颖的对抗式强化学习（adversarial reinforcement learning）数据合成框架。该框架在对抗循环中联合优化生成器与判别器：生成器产生结构化论辩实例，判别器通过区分真实数据与合成候选样本提供学习信号。借助对抗反馈，生成器逐步提升所生成论辩数据的结构准确性，同时保持多样性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该框架在三个基准数据集上，无论在全数据（full-data）设定还是低资源（low-resource）设定下，都能一致地提升AM性能，验证了其有效性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 所提对抗式强化学习数据合成框架可有效缓解AM领域结构标注数据稀缺的问题，在多种数据规模设定下稳定提升下游AM任务表现，具有良好的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Detecting LLM-Assisted Vietnamese Writing via Keystrokes under Behavioral Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Thanh Dong and An Ngo contributted equally. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
summary: We study the robustness of keystroke dynamics for detecting large language model (LLM)-assisted writing. We introduce a Vietnamese keystroke dataset capturing realistic writing modes, including bona fide composition, transcription, and paraphrasing. We also define a behaviorally grounded threat model in which users deliberately alter typing patterns. To implement the threat model, we create behaviorally manipulated variants of the data designed to evade keystroke-based detection. We evaluate four keystroke modeling approaches: temporal and rhythmic representations, and sequential representations modeled with a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) and TypeNet, under user-independent and context-independent settings. The results show that sequential models outperform feature-based approaches in most cases and that keystroke signals encode discriminative information about the writing process. However, detection is not uniformly robust: transcription is reliably identified, while paraphrasing and adversarially manipulated samples are frequently misclassified as bona fide when not explicitly modeled. To address this, we incorporate adversarial training using behaviorally manipulated data, which substantially improves separability and robustness. These results suggest that keystroke-based detection depends critically on exposure to diverse writing behaviors, and that strong performance under limited conditions does not generalize to realistic or adversarial settings without targeted modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究键盘动力学（keystroke dynamics）在检测LLM辅助写作中的鲁棒性，构建了包含真实写作模式与行为对抗变体的越南语键盘数据集，并在独立于用户与上下文的设置下评估四类建模方法，发现序列模型总体更优，但转写可稳定识别而改写与对抗样本易被误判，引入对抗训练可显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM辅助写作日益普遍，需要可靠的检测手段；键盘动力学作为一种行为生物特征被寄予期望，但已有研究多限于理想条件，缺乏对真实写作模式（如转写、改写）以及用户刻意改变打字行为的鲁棒性考察，尤其在资源较少语言上缺乏数据集与系统性评测。
AI.method: 构建越南语键盘动力学数据集，覆盖真实写作模式：真实原创写作（bona fide）、转写、改写；定义基于行为的人类威胁模型（用户刻意改变打字模式），并生成行为操纵的数据变体以模拟规避攻击；采用四类建模方法：时序与节奏特征表示（feature-based）、1D-CNN 与 TypeNet 的序列表示；在用户无关（user-independent）与上下文无关（context-independent）设置下评测；并引入基于行为操纵数据的对抗训练。
AI.result: 序列模型（1D-CNN、TypeNet）在多数情形下优于基于特征的方法，表明键盘信号携带关于写作过程的判别性信息；但检测鲁棒性不均衡：转写可被稳定识别，而改写与对抗操纵样本在未被显式建模时常被误判为真实原创；引入对抗训练后，可分性与鲁棒性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 键盘动力学检测的效果关键取决于是否覆盖多样的写作行为；在有限条件下取得的高性能无法直接泛化到真实或对抗场景，必须进行针对性建模（如对抗训练），否则难以应对改写与刻意规避行为。

title: What Frame-Level Labels Can and Cannot Do for Small-UAV Point Detection in Thermal Video
summary: The growing use of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has increased the importance of image-based UAV detection. Learning-based detectors are trained on imagery and annotations, with annotation type determining the information available during training. We focus on learning localization from frame-level target presence/absence labels when sensor or scene changes make spatial annotations for additional training burdensome. We analyze the detection capability, learning behavior, and potential applications of an existing architecture for point detection of small UAVs, trained with presence/absence labels and requiring no external detector. The architecture freezes spatial features learned through classification and trains a readout with the same frame labels to produce spatial score maps and point detections. On two thermal infrared datasets, CST Anti-UAV and Anti-UAV410, we evaluate localization hit rates and detection rates under false-alarm constraints, analyze the effects of training stages, label allocation, synthesis, and model configuration, and compare with bounding-box detectors. We also explore potential applications on Airborne Object Tracking (AOT) using its visible-light imagery and frame labels. Classification training strengthened target-related spatial responses, while readout training helped extract them consistently. Distributing similar label counts across more videos yielded higher localization hit rates, while synthesis effects varied by dataset and evaluation criterion. Higher localization hit rates did not always improve detection under false-alarm constraints, and failures remained when target signals were weak relative to background variation and under cross-dataset transfer. These findings provide guidance on label allocation, spatial representations and readouts, synthesis, and false-alarm control.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了一种仅用"帧级目标有无"标签训练的小型无人机点检测架构，在保持分类阶段学到的空间特征不变的情况下训练读出层生成空间分数图与点检测，并在两个红外数据集上评估定位命中率与误报约束下的检测率。
AI.motivation: 无人机使用日益广泛，基于图像的无人机检测愈发重要。基于学习的检测器依赖影像与标注，而标注类型决定训练可用信息。当传感器或场景变化使得获取空间标注（如边界框）成本过高时，仅用帧级"存在/不存在"标签进行定位学习具有现实需求。
AI.method: 采用现有点检测架构：冻结通过分类学习到的空间特征，用相同的帧级标签训练读出层以产生空间分数图与点检测，无需外部检测器。在CST Anti-UAV与Anti-UAV410两个热红外数据集上评估定位命中率及误报约束下的检测率，分析训练阶段、标签分配、合成数据与模型配置的影响，并与边界框检测器对比；同时在AOT可见光影像与帧标签上探索应用。
AI.result: 分类训练增强了与目标相关的空间响应，读出训练有助于稳定提取这些响应。将相近数量的标签分散到更多视频中可获得更高定位命中率；合成数据的效果因数据集与评价标准而异。更高的定位命中率并不总能改善误报约束下的检测性能；当目标信号相对背景变化较弱以及跨数据集迁移时仍存在失败案例。
AI.conclusion: 研究为标签分配、空间表征与读出设计、数据合成及误报控制提供了指导，表明弱监督（帧级标签）点检测在小型无人机检测中可行但仍有局限。

title: Comprehensive Evaluation and Fine-Tuning of Foundational Cell Nuclei Segmentation Models in Renal Pathology
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to SPIE Medical Imaging 2027
summary: Accurate nuclei instance segmentation is essential for quantitative renal pathology, yet general-purpose models often struggle with low contrast, dense nuclei, complex morphology, and strong background staining. In this work, we extended a human-in-the-loop framework by combining 5,901 foundation-model-generated pseudo-labels from well-segmented cases (Easy), 860 newly expert-annotated unresolved challenging cases (Medium), and 198 expert-annotated consensus failure cases (Hard). These annotations, spanning different levels of segmentation difficulty, enabled the systematic evaluation of seven single-source and mixed-source fine-tuning strategies across nine cell segmentation model configurations. Fine-tuning improved all models, with Medium data included in seven of the nine best-performing strategies. LSP-DETR achieved the highest F1 score of 0.8725 with Hard-only fine-tuning, while StarDist showed the largest improvement, increasing from 0.7380 to 0.8332 with Medium-only fine-tuning. These findings show that annotations spanning multiple difficulty levels support effective model adaptation, although the optimal annotation composition remains model dependent.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过人机协同框架构建易/中/难三级标注数据，系统评估七种微调策略在九种细胞分割模型上的效果，发现多难度标注能有效提升模型性能，但最优组合因模型而异。
AI.motivation: 肾脏病理中的细胞核实例分割对定量分析至关重要，但通用模型在低对比度、密集细胞核、复杂形态和强背景染色条件下表现不佳，需要针对性适配策略。
AI.method: 扩展人机协同框架，组合来自分割良好病例的5901个基础模型生成伪标签（Easy）、860个新专家标注的未解决疑难病例（Medium）和198个专家标注的共识失败病例（Hard）；基于跨难度标注，对九种细胞分割模型配置系统评估七种单源与混合源微调策略。
AI.result: 微调提升了所有模型；Medium数据出现在九种最佳策略中的七种；LSP-DETR在Hard-only微调下取得最高F1分数0.8725；StarDist提升最大，Medium-only微调下从0.7380提升至0.8332。
AI.conclusion: 跨多个难度级别的标注能有效支持模型适配，但最优标注组成仍依赖具体模型，需按模型进行策略选择。

title: When Old Facts Return: Re-Reads, Reverts, and the Limits of Temporal Memory
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Ancillary files contain retained aggregate evidence, derived scenario and annotation exports, reference code, and an offline verifier
summary: A memory system can retire an obsolete value and later restore it merely because the same old statement appears again. A re-read of an old source and a genuine revert can produce the same observed sequence of values while requiring opposite current answers. We study this ambiguity on 130 extractor-selected atomic transitions derived from software fixes. In the ordinary transition condition, identity-based temporal memory reaches 98.5% model-judged accuracy with zero observed errors under a literal stale-value proxy. Appending a verbatim re-read of the old statement reduces accuracy to 10.8% and raises the stale-value rate to 88.5%. A guard that refuses to reactivate a previously retired value restores accuracy to 97.7% and reduces that rate to 0.8% in this constructed re-read condition. The guard cannot also recognize a legitimate revert without additional change provenance. Two supporting studies examine exposing retired history to the answer model and supplying current source for changed behavior. An exploratory extraction study over 707 software fixes provides scope context, not a universal coverage estimate. The design implication is to distinguish an observation of a value from evidence that the value changed. Selected inputs, aggregate-only answer records, related-family judges and a post-failure guard evaluation limit the conclusions to the retained experiments.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了基于身份的时间记忆系统存在"重读旧语句"与"真实回退"不可区分的歧义，并提出拒绝重新激活已退役值的防护机制，在构造的重读条件下将准确率从10.8%恢复到97.7%。
AI.motivation: 记忆系统在遇到再次出现的旧语句时，可能错误地重新激活已退役的值，而"重读旧源"与"真实回退"会产生相同的观测序列却需要相反的当前答案，这一歧义前人未系统研究。
AI.method: 基于软件修复抽取130个原子转换进行实验；设置普通转换条件与追加逐字重读旧语句条件对比；引入拒绝重新激活已退役值的防护机制；另设两项辅助研究（向答案模型暴露退役历史、提供变更行为的当前源），并对707个软件修复做探索性抽取以界定适用范围。
AI.result: 普通条件下身份时间记忆达98.5%准确率、陈旧值率0%，重读条件下降至10.8%准确率、88.5%陈旧值率；防护机制在重读条件下恢复至97.7%准确率、陈旧值率降至0.8%，但无法在缺少变更来源信息时识别合法回退。
AI.conclusion: 设计启示是须区分"对某值的观测"与"该值发生变化的证据"；结论受限于选定输入、仅聚合答案记录、同族判定器及事后防护评估，仅适用于所保留实验。

title: JevCascade: Readout Stability and Inference-Time Compute Allocation for Prefill-Only Decision Models
summary: We present JevCascade, an inference-time compute allocation framework for prefill-only decision models, built on readout stability and zero-label restricted readout prediction. Prefill-only decision models score every candidate in a menu in a single forward pass and never decode, which makes one call one to two orders of magnitude cheaper than a same-scale generative language model. We show that this read-out structure carries a testable property. When an intervention changes only the menu and leaves the input text fixed, the post-intervention accuracy is already determined by the cached first-pass distribution. The restriction predictor restricts the pass-1 probabilities to the menu, renormalizes and reads off the argmax, with no labels and no second pass. Across six model families, ten core datasets (sixteen in total) and two task types, menu-only interventions are predicted to within 4.2 points, exactly for one family. The property is ordinal, not probabilistic, since a probability-level variant of the same estimator errs by 21.0 points, and class-specific, since same-scale generative models err by 1.6 to 15.8 points and degrade as they grow. It makes inference-time compute decidable before deployment. Uniform extra passes buy calibration but almost no accuracy; at matched cost a confidence cascade beats every scheme that re-asks the same model, and curating the menu beats enlarging the model, a 0.8B model on a curated 5-candidate menu reaching 95.4% on CLINC150 against 80.0% for a 4B model on the full 150-label menu.

AI.tldr: 提出 JevCascade 推理期算力分配框架，基于“读出稳定性”与“零标签受限读出预测”：仅变更菜单时，首遍缓存分布即可预测后干预准确率，误差≤4.2 分，使推理期算力可在部署前判定。
AI.motivation: Prefill-only 决策模型每次前向即可为整个菜单打分且无需解码，单次调用比同规模生成模型便宜 1–2 个数量级，但其算力分配与干预后行为缺乏可预测性，需要一套不依赖标签、无需二次前向的判定机制。
AI.method: 提出受限读出预测器：将第 1 遍概率限制在菜单内、重归一化后取 argmax，零标签、零二次前向；在 6 个模型族、10 个核心数据集（共 16 个）、2 类任务上验证。设计置信度级联（confidence cascade）分配额外算力，与“同模型重问”方案在等成本下对比，并进行菜单精修（curating menu）与模型扩容的对照。
AI.result: 菜单-only 干预的准确率预测误差在 4.2 分以内，其中一个模型族完全精确；该性质是序数性而非概率性的（概率级变体误差 21.0 分），且具有类别特异性（同规模生成模型误差 1.6–15.8 分并随规模增大而恶化）。均匀增加前向遍数只带来校准改善、几乎不提升准确率；等成本下置信度级联优于所有同模型重问方案；菜单精修优于扩容：0.8B 模型在精选 5 候选菜单上 CLINC150 达 95.4%，而 4B 模型在完整 150 标签菜单上仅 80.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该读出结构使推理期算力可在部署前被判定；opt 级联与菜单精修是更高效的算力/性能分配方式，为 prefill-only 决策模型的算力预算提供可测试、可预测的依据。

title: RefRoute: Decoupling Conditioning Cost from References via Compact Residual Conditioning and Spatial Routing
comment: 19 pages. Wanning He and Yuyao Zhang contributed equally and share first authorship
summary: Multi-reference image generation requires preserving the appearance of multiple subjects while composing them into a coherent scene. However, existing diffusion transformers commonly encode references as dense visual token grids and jointly process them with global attention, making conditioning increasingly expensive as the number and resolution of references grow. We present RefRoute, a framework that addresses both reference representation cost and attention overhead through two complementary mechanisms. Compact residual conditioning combines low-resolution latent tokens with lightweight residual features extracted from full-resolution pixels, reducing reference token counts while retaining fine-grained appearance cues. Condition routing and attention routing align reference tokens with their assigned target regions and restrict cross-reference interactions, while allowing selective reference access beyond region boundaries for scene integration. We further introduce RefRoute-Data for training many-reference generation models and ManyRef100, a benchmark spanning human, object, and mixed compositions with 10-17 references. After many-reference fine-tuning, RefRoute achieves an overall Weighted-Ref-VIEScore of 36.06 on ManyRef100, compared with 8.88 for FLUX.2-Klein-9B. Separate inference-cost evaluations show substantially slower latency growth as the reference count increases: at 16 references, our 50-step and 4-step configurations achieve $18.3\times$ and $14.2\times$ speedups over their corresponding FLUX baselines, respectively. These results establish compact reference representations and spatially routed attention as an effective approach to scalable many-reference image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RefRoute框架，通过紧凑残差条件化与条件/注意力路由，降低多参考图像生成中的参考表示与注意力开销，并配套RefRoute-Data训练数据与ManyRef100基准，在10-17个参考下显著优于FLUX.2-Klein-9B且推理加速明显。
AI.motivation: 多参考图像生成需在保持多个主体外观的同时将其合成到一致场景中。现有扩散Transformer将参考编码为稠密的视觉token网格并用全局注意力联合处理，导致随着参考数量与分辨率增加，条件化成本与注意力开销急剧上升，难以扩展到多参考场景。
AI.method: 提出RefRoute，含两个互补机制：（1）紧凑残差条件化，将低分辨率隐token与从全分辨率像素提取的轻量残差特征结合，减少参考token数同时保留细粒度外观线索；（2）条件路由与注意力路由，将参考token与其分配的目标区域对齐并限制跨参考交互，同时允许在区域边界外选择性访问参考以实现场景整合。此外构建RefRoute-Data用于训练多参考生成模型，并提出ManyRef100基准，覆盖人物、物体及混合组合，含10-17个参考。
AI.result: 经多参考微调后，RefRoute在ManyRef100上取得总体Weighted-Ref-VIEScore为36.06，而FLUX.2-Klein-9B为8.88。推理成本评估显示，随参考数增加延迟增长显著放缓：在16个参考时，50步与4步配置分别相对对应FLUX基线实现18.3倍与14.2倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，紧凑参考表示与空间路由注意力是面向可扩展多参考图像生成的有效方案。

title: Does Steering Break Your Model? A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Suite for LLM Steering Methods
summary: Activation steering provides a lightweight and flexible way to control large language model (LLM) behavior. However, effective steering requires more than inducing the intended behavior: it should also limit unintended changes and remain robust across inputs and training data. Existing evaluations cover these dimensions only in fragments. As a result, the trade-offs between efficacy and side effects have not been systematically characterized. We introduce SteerScope, a two-axis, multi-dimensional evaluation suite that jointly characterizes steering outcomes and method properties through 15 metrics. We score target efficacy and side effects on language quality, task capabilities, and safety and reliability, and further assess generalization and data dependence through steering-specific metrics for sample efficiency and sample sensitivity. Rather than comparing methods at a single operating point, we characterize the trade-offs between efficacy and side effects. Under matched models, tasks, and evaluation protocols, we benchmark 23 methods spanning 4 families, including prompting, LoRA, and SFT as baseline methods, and release the suite as an extensible codebase. We find that current activation steering methods do not yet surpass the Prompt Steering baseline in their overall balance between steering efficacy and side effects: across both model scales, no evaluated activation steering method achieves higher efficacy without incurring greater composite side effects. We further uncover a consistent coupling between steering efficacy and side effects. Under OOD prompts, target efficacy is often preserved, whereas side effects tend to become more pronounced, particularly through declines in instruction relevance and fluency. Methods also exhibit sharply different sample-efficiency profiles.

AI.tldr: 提出 SteerScope——一个双轴、多维度的激活引导评测套件，用 15 项指标同时刻画引导效果与方法属性，并据此对 23 种方法进行基准测试。
AI.motivation: 激活引导是控制大语言模型行为的轻量灵活手段，但有效引导不只要求诱发出目标行为，还需限制非预期改动，并在不同输入与训练数据上保持稳健。现有评测仅零散覆盖这些维度，导致"有效性—副作用"之间的权衡未被系统刻画。
AI.method: SteerScope 采用双轴、多维度设计，共 15 项指标：在语言质量、任务能力、安全与可靠性上分别对目标有效性与副作用打分，并通过引导专用指标（样本效率、样本敏感性）评估泛化性与数据依赖性；不止在单一工作点比较方法，而是刻画有效性与副作用间的权衡。在匹配的模型、任务与评测协议下，对涵盖 4 个家族的 23 种方法进行基准测试，包含 prompting、LoRA 和 SFT 作为基线方法，并将套件以可扩展代码库形式发布。
AI.result: 当前激活引导方法在有效性与副作用的总体平衡上尚未超越 Prompt Steering 基线：在两种模型规模下，没有任何被评测的激活引导方法能在不带来更大综合副作用的情况下取得更高有效性。研究还发现引导有效性与副作用之间存在一致的耦合关系；在分布外（OOD）提示下，目标有效性通常得以保持，但副作用趋于加剧，尤其表现为指令相关性与流畅度下降。各方法的样本效率曲线差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明激活引导方法目前难以在综合权衡上优于提示基线，有效性—副作用存在耦合关系且 OOD 场景下副作用放大；SteerScope 为后续系统化评测与改进提供了统一、可扩展的评测框架。

title: Structure-aware Keypoint Localization for Videofluoroscopic Swallowing Study
summary: Videofluoroscopic Swallowing Study (VFSS) is one of the gold standard for diagnosing swallowing disorders, providing dynamic X-ray imaging of the swallowing process. Automated kinematic analysis in VFSS relies fundamentally on precise anatomical keypoint localization. However, existing studies focus on limited keypoints (e.g., cervical vertebrae or the hyoid) and overlook critical regions such as the soft palate, while annotating only active swallowing segments and ignoring abundant non-swallowing data, resulting in poor data efficiency. Moreover, leveraging this unlabeled data via standard semi-supervised learning is suboptimal, as generic methods are prone to spatial bias. In medical X-rays with fixed layouts, models tend to memorize absolute coordinates rather than understanding anatomical structures. To tackle these challenges, we introduce VFSSKep, a novel dataset that extends annotations to the soft palate and incorporates large-scale unlabeled data. We further propose S$^3$KL, a Structure-aware Semi-Supervised Keypoint Localization framework designed to overcome spatial bias. It integrates a Structure-Aware Learning strategy to extract high-resolution structural cues for structure-aware representation learning, and a Structural Representation Consistency Learning strategy with block shuffling to enforce invariant structural recognition. Experiments show our method achieves state-of-the-art semi-supervised performance, even with unlabeled and 25% labeled data surpassing fully supervised learning with 100% labeled data. Code and data will be made publicly available at: https://github.com/kaai520/S3KL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VFSSKep数据集（扩展软腭标注并纳入大规模无标注数据）与S³KL半监督关键点定位框架（结构感知学习+结构表示一致性学习），缓解医学X射线中的空间偏置问题，在半监督设置下达到SOTA，用25%标注+无标注数据即可超越100%全监督。
AI.motivation: VFSS吞咽障碍诊断依赖精确的解剖关键点定位，但现有研究仅关注有限关键点（如颈椎、舌骨）而忽略软腭等重要区域，且只标注吞咽活动片段、浪费大量非吞咽数据，数据效率低。直接用通用半监督方法利用无标注数据效果不佳，因为在布局固定的医学X光中模型易记忆绝对坐标而非理解解剖结构，存在空间偏置。
AI.method: 1) 构建VFSSKep数据集：将标注扩展至软腭并纳入大规模无标注数据；2) 提出S³KL结构感知半监督关键点定位框架，包含：结构感知学习策略，提取高分辨率结构线索进行结构感知表示学习；结构表示一致性学习策略，结合块打乱（block shuffling）以强制不变的结构识别，从而克服空间偏置。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法取得半监督最优性能，即使仅用无标注数据加25%标注数据，也超过使用100%标注数据的全监督学习效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过扩展关键点标注与无标注数据、并以结构感知与结构一致性约束抑制空间偏置，可显著提升VFSS关键点定位的数据效率与性能，代码与数据将公开。

title: Foveated Compression: Selective High-Resolution Preservation for Token-Efficient VLMs
summary: Visual tokens are a major source of inference cost in vision-language models, yet simple image downsampling remains a surprisingly strong compression baseline. This raises a complementary question: under a fixed token budget, where should visual fidelity be preserved? We introduce Foveated Compression, which encodes a full-resolution image once and represents it with a mixture of native- and compressed-resolution visual tokens. A behaviorally self-distilled Foveated Merger compresses local visual tokens while preserving compatibility with their native counterparts, and a lightweight Foveated Selector chooses one of nine spatial cells to retain at native resolution using exhaustive budget-matched intervention supervision. At 11.11% visual tokens, uniform Foveated Compression shows no significant paired difference from iso-token downsampling. At 20.99%, the learned selector significantly outperforms random and fixed allocation, but remains below strong whole-image resizing, showing that localized fidelity is not universally preferable. A budget-matched region-choice oracle reaches 82.73 macro accuracy versus 69.61 for the learned selector, revealing substantial headroom within the same spatial action space. Matched probing further shows that signals predicting when compression breaks the answer are substantially more accessible after language-model computation than to the lightweight prefill-free selector. These results expose complementary bottlenecks in region selection and compressed-region fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出Foveated Compression：对整图仅编码一次，用原生+压缩分辨率视觉token的混合表示；在固定token预算下研究视觉保真度应保留在何处。结果显示局部保真并非普遍更优。
AI.motivation: 视觉token是视觉语言模型推理开销的主要来源，而简单的图像下采样仍是强基线。由此提出互补问题：在固定token预算下，视觉保真度应保留在何处？
AI.method: Foveated Compression将全分辨率图像编码一次，通过行为自蒸馏训练的Foveated Merger压缩局部视觉token并保持与原生token的兼容性；轻量Foveated Selector在9个空间单元中选择1个以原生分辨率保留，使用穷举式、预算匹配的干预监督。
AI.result: 11.11% token时，均匀Foveated Compression与等token下采样无显著配对差异；20.99%时，学习到的选择器显著优于随机与固定分配，但仍低于强整图缩放基线。预算匹配的区域选择oracle达82.73 macro accuracy，而学习选择器为69.61，显示同一空间动作空间内存在显著提升空间。匹配探测显示，预测压缩何时破坏答案的信号在语言模型计算后更易获得。
AI.conclusion: 局部保真并非普遍更优；瓶颈在于区域选择与压缩区域保真度两方面，二者互补。

title: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking
comment: 51 pages, 20 figures, 47 tables. Project page: https://minnesotanlp.github.io/Sansi/
summary: Typed decision models answer a declared question without generating text: a decision head returns a probability for each of the declared options in a single forward pass. A single pass is fast, intuitive System 1 thinking. We study what lies between one pass and generated reasoning: looping, in which the same layers are recursively applied several times before one typed readout. Each loop lets the model revise its hidden state before it commits to an answer, without generating a token; we call this System 1.5 thinking. We propose SanSi, which turns a pre-trained looped language model into a typed decision model. The option probabilities are read after every loop, and every loop is trained with a proper scoring rule, so that one model serves every budget from one loop to eight in a single run. On 10,027 test decisions from 59 sources, SanSi reaches 72.0% accuracy: 13.5 points above a non-looped model of the same shape trained with the same recipe, 5.3 points above a newer non-looped model of its size, and 1.8 points below one with three times the parameters. On two depth-controlled tasks, loops extend the solvable depth beyond the depths seen in training, where the larger single-pass model fails. Used as the judge for policy optimization with reinforcement learning, without gold answers, SanSi raises the share of the generator's correct answers from 37% to 52%.

AI.tldr: 提出SanSi，将预训练循环语言模型改造为类型化决策模型，在单次前向中多次循环层并逐次读出选项概率，一个模型覆盖1到8次循环预算，准确率72.0%。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型单次前向即给出选项概率，速度快但属于直觉式System 1；生成式推理又太慢。作者想探究二者之间的中间形态——在不生成token的前提下，让模型通过循环反复修正隐状态，称之为System 1.5。
AI.method: SanSi基于预训练循环语言模型，在每次循环后读取选项概率，并用proper scoring rule对每个循环步进行训练，使单一模型在单次运行中即可服务从1次到8次循环的不同计算预算。
AI.result: 在59个来源的10,027个测试决策上达到72.0%准确率：比同规模、同训练配方的非循环模型高13.5个百分点，比同尺寸的更新非循环模型高5.3个百分点，仅比参数量三倍的模型低1.8个百分点；在两个深度控制任务上，循环可超出训练所见的深度，而更大的单次前向模型失败；作为无金标准答案的RL策略优化评判者，将生成器正确答案占比从37%提升到52%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在类型化读出前引入递归循环，SanSi以非生成的方式实现可控的隐式推理，在准确率、深度泛化与RL评判任务上均优于同规模单次前向模型，验证了System 1.5范式的有效性。

title: Learning to Retrieve via Reinforcement Learning in Embedding Space
summary: Dense retrieval models are typically trained with contrastive objectives that learn effective representations but do not directly optimize retrieval metrics or downstream task performance. To address this problem, we introduce RELER (REinforcement LEarning for Retrieval), a reinforcement learning framework that enables existing embedding models to learn to retrieve directly in embedding space and align to task-specific rewards. We train RELER by sampling unit-length query and document embedding actions from von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distributions centered on normalized encoder outputs, scoring the resulting retrieval or downstream outcomes as rewards, and updating the encoder with REINFORCE using a leave-one-out baseline (RLOO). As exploration in the high-dimensional embedding space is prone to sampling noise, we further propose conditional-mean projection (CMP), which projects each sampled embedding onto the low-dimensional subspace spanned by its encoder output and the candidate embeddings it is compared against, reducing noise in the policy gradient while preserving its expectation. We evaluate RELER on BRIGHT, a benchmark with reasoning-intensive queries that remain challenging for existing embedding models. RELER consistently outperforms InfoNCE and LambdaLoss in average nDCG@10 when post-training BGE-M3 and Qwen3-Embedding backbones.
