We further evaluate downstream utility through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where we adapt only the query encoder while keeping the document index and generator fixed. Across seven QA datasets, jointly optimizing retrieval and answer rewards improves both average retrieval performance and answer quality in RAG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RELER，一个基于强化学习的检索训练框架，使现有嵌入模型可在嵌入空间中直接优化检索指标与任务奖励；并结合 vMF 采样、RLOO 与条件均值投影（CMP）降低高维探索噪声，在 BRIGHT 与 RAG 场景中优于 InfoNCE 和 LambdaLoss。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索模型通常采用对比学习目标训练，虽能学到有效表示，但并不直接优化检索指标或下游任务性能。作者希望弥合表示学习目标与最终检索/任务效果之间的差距，让嵌入模型直接在嵌入空间中"学会检索"并与任务特定奖励对齐。
AI.method: 提出 RELER（REinforcement LEarning for Retrieval）强化学习框架：以归一化编码器输出为中心构造 von Mises-Fisher（vMF）分布，从中采样单位长度的查询与文档嵌入动作；将检索或下游结果作为奖励，使用 REINFORCE 配合留一法基线（RLOO）更新编码器。针对高维嵌入空间探索易受采样噪声影响的问题，进一步提出条件均值投影（CMP），将每个采样嵌入投影到由编码器输出与其比较的候选嵌入所张成的低维子空间，在保持策略梯度期望不变的同时降低方差。
AI.result: 在推理密集型查询基准 BRIGHT 上，对 BGE-M3 与 Qwen3-Embedding 骨干进行后训练时，RELER 在平均 nDCG@10 上稳定优于 InfoNCE 与 LambdaLoss。在检索增强生成（RAG）评估中，仅适配查询编码器并固定文档索引与生成器，在七个 QA 数据集上联合优化检索奖励与答案奖励，同时提升了平均检索性能与答案质量。
AI.conclusion: RELER 表明可以通过强化学习让嵌入模型直接优化检索指标与下游任务奖励，且 CMP 能有效抑制高维嵌入空间探索的梯度噪声；该方法在检索基准与 RAG 下游任务中均取得一致的性能提升，为面向任务对齐的稠密检索训练提供了新思路。

title: From Evidence to Action: How Tool-Using Agents Fail
summary: Tool-using agents make consequential changes to external state, yet correct outcomes do not guarantee that their actions were supported by evidence established beforehand. We study where this evidence-to-action chain breaks as agents move from deciding whether to act to executing single actions and dependent workflows. Across ten model-harness configurations, strong static action assessment can coexist with much weaker interactive execution. Failures often begin before execution: agents stop with incomplete investigation or act before required evidence is established. Once required evidence is obtained, single-action execution is usually reliable, while multi-action workflows additionally expose unresolved prerequisites and incomplete execution. For this analysis, we introduce SafeActBench, comprising 656 cases across six operational domains and five protocols that progress from static action judgment and investigated non-action to single- and multi-action workflows. A provenance-bound Evidence Ledger and deterministic trajectory evaluator track what information was established, when actions occurred, and whether downstream dependencies were satisfied. These results show that failures arise not only from missing information, but also from how agents use established evidence when deciding and executing actions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究工具使用型智能体从"是否行动"到"执行单个动作及依赖工作流"的证据到行动链条断裂问题，提出SafeActBench基准及证据账本机制。
AI.motivation: 工具使用型智能体会对外部状态产生实质影响，但正确结果并不能保证其行动建立在事前已确立的证据之上，需要定位证据到行动链条在何处断裂。
AI.method: 构建SafeActBench，包含六个操作领域、五种协议的656个案例，覆盖静态动作判断、经调查后的不行动、单动作与多动作工作流；采用溯源绑定的Evidence Ledger与确定性轨迹评估器，追踪已确立的信息、行动发生时机及下游依赖是否满足。
AI.result: 在十种模型-框架配置中，强静态动作评估可与显著较弱的交互式执行并存；失败常始于执行之前（调查不完整即停止或证据未确立即行动）；一旦获得所需证据，单动作执行通常可靠，而多动作工作流额外暴露未解决的前置条件与不完整执行。
AI.conclusion: 失败不仅源于信息缺失，也源于智能体在决策与执行时如何使用已确立的证据。

title: Adversarially Trained Linear Transformers Are Optimal Robust In-Context Learners for Gaussian Mixtures
summary: Adversarial training is one of the most reliable defenses against adversarial attacks, but its high computational cost must generally be paid anew for each task. Robust foundation models offer a promising alternative: adversarially pretrain a model once and then transfer its robustness to downstream tasks through lightweight adaptation. However, a fundamental question remains open: can robustness acquired during pretraining transfer to unseen tasks without further adversarial training? In this study, we answer this question affirmatively. A single model adversarially pretrained at scale can achieve optimal robustness on new tasks without additional task-specific training. Specifically, we show that, for a family of Gaussian-mixture classification tasks, a sufficiently deep linear transformer adversarially trained across tasks can asymptotically attain the robust Bayes error on previously unseen tasks through in-context learning from clean demonstrations. By contrast, a standardly trained model cannot. We further analyze convergence under gradient flow, an accuracy--robustness trade-off, and demonstration complexity.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究对抗预训练的鲁棒性是否能在不进行额外对抗训练的情况下迁移到未见任务，并在高斯混合分类任务族上给出了肯定回答：足够深的线性Transformer经跨任务对抗预训练后，可借助干净示例的上下文学习渐近达到未见任务的鲁棒贝叶斯误差，而标准训练模型无法做到。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练虽是最可靠的防御手段，但需为每个任务重新付出高昂计算代价。鲁棒基础模型提供了替代思路：一次性对抗预训练，再通过轻量适配迁移鲁棒性。然而一个根本问题尚未解决：预训练阶段获得的鲁棒性能否在不再进行对抗训练的情况下迁移到未见任务。
AI.method: 针对一族高斯混合分类任务，采用足够深的线性Transformer进行跨任务对抗预训练，并在下游通过干净示例进行上下文学习；从理论上分析其渐近行为，包括梯度流下的收敛性、精度—鲁棒性权衡以及示例复杂度。
AI.result: 经跨任务对抗预训练的线性Transformer可通过上下文学习渐近达到未见任务的鲁棒贝叶斯误差；而标准训练的模型则无法达到该结果。论文进一步刻画了梯度流下的收敛性、精度与鲁棒性之间的权衡关系以及所需的示例复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性可以在预训练阶段获得并迁移至未见任务，无需任务特定的额外对抗训练，从而为构建鲁棒基础模型、降低下游对抗训练成本提供了理论支持。

title: Later Is Better: Token Reduction for ViTs Under Distribution Shift
summary: Training-free token reduction accelerates vision transformers by removing redundant tokens across layers, recovering most of the original accuracy at a fraction of the compute. These methods, however, are designed and evaluated primarily on clean data, and under real-world distribution shift their accuracy gap to the uncompressed model widens with the removal rate. We show that this gap is governed by the reduction schedule, the depth profile of removal, usually left fixed as an implementation detail. Concretely, we introduce a one-parameter late-concentrated power-law schedule that consistently improves out-of-distribution accuracy over flat at no extra inference cost. On ImageNet-C with DeiT-S, the late schedule closes 83% of that gap at a 26% compute reduction (+1.17pp), and 99% of it at a lighter 7% reduction (+0.26pp). The gain cannot be attributed to retaining more tokens or using extra compute: held to flat's compute, the late schedule removes more tokens in total and leaves fewer tokens at the end, yet still wins. Single-layer probes point to a mechanism: earlier reductions perturb features that pass through more remaining layers, front-loading reduction error in depth. The effect is broad, holding across five token-reduction methods (ToMe, EViT, ATS, ATC, PiToMe), nine backbones, all ImageNet-C corruption types, eight further shift suites, and two further modalities, video and vision-language QA. It is also specific to shift, still positive on clean and rising monotonically to ~4x that at the highest severity 5. The schedule keeps its gain under six test-time adaptation methods, and needs no per-input or per-domain tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文发现免训练Token缩减方法在分布偏移下的精度差距主要由"缩减调度"（各层移除量的深度分布）决定，并提出一种单参数的"后置集中幂律调度"，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升分布外精度。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练Token缩减方法（如ToMe等）主要在干净数据上设计与评测，在真实分布偏移下其相对未压缩模型的精度差距随移除率增大而扩大，亟需一种不增加成本即可缩小该差距的方案。
AI.method: 提出单参数的后置集中幂律调度（late-concentrated power-law schedule），将Token移除更多集中于网络深层；在固定计算量下与平坦（flat）调度对比，并通过单层探针分析机制。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-C + DeiT-S上，后置调度在26%计算缩减下弥补83%的精度差距（+1.17pp），在7%缩减下弥补99%（+0.26pp）；该增益不能归因于保留更多Token或额外计算——在与flat同等计算量下其总移除量更多、末端Token更少仍占优。结论在5种Token缩减方法、9个骨干、所有ImageNet-C损坏类型、8个其他偏移套件及视频与视觉-语言QA两种额外模态上均成立，且在干净数据上仍为正增益，随严重度升高单调增至约4倍。
AI.conclusion: 缩减调度是决定分布偏移下Token缩减精度的关键实现细节；后置集中幂律调度是一种通用、无需逐输入或逐域调参、与六种测试时自适应方法兼容的即插即用改进。

title: No Transformer Beats Six Covariates: Long-Horizon Prediction of Depressive Symptoms from Childhood Essays
summary: Natural language processing (NLP) models can detect depression-related language in text written near the time symptoms are measured, but whether pretrained transformers can predict depressive symptoms from text written twelve years earlier is largely untested. In the National Child Development Study, a British birth cohort, we predict probable depressive symptoms at age 23 from essays the same people wrote at age 11. Our baseline, a logistic regression on six childhood covariates, outperforms every text model that sees only the essay: seven fine-tuned transformers, a bag-of-words model, frozen embeddings and four zero-shot large language models. Its area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) is 0.737 against 0.670 for the best transformer on the primary seed, and no added text score detectably raises the baseline's AUC-ROC. None of the five domain-pretrained transformers detectably beats its general-domain control after Bonferroni correction. For long-horizon prediction, the baseline remains the model to beat.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用英国出生队列（National Child Development Study），用11岁作文预测23岁可能的抑郁症状；结果显示仅含六项童年协变量的逻辑回归基线（AUC-ROC 0.737）优于所有仅看文本的模型（最佳Transformer为0.670），且加入文本分数未能显著提升基线，领域预训练Transformer在Bonferroni校正后也未显著优于通用领域对照。
AI.motivation: 现有NLP模型多能识别与症状测量时间接近的文本中的抑郁相关语言，但预训练Transformer能否从早约十二年的文本中预测抑郁症状尚缺乏检验，因此需要评估其在长时程预测上的有效性。
AI.method: 在英国出生队列National Child Development Study中，以同一批人11岁所写作文预测其23岁时可能存在的抑郁症状；对比对象包括仅使用作文文本的七种微调Transformer、词袋模型、冻结嵌入和四种零样本大语言模型，并以六项童年协变量的逻辑回归作为基线；采用AUC-ROC评估，并作多重比较的Bonferroni校正，同时检验文本分数对基线的增量价值。
AI.result: 逻辑回归基线优于所有仅看作文的文本模型：主种子下基线AUC-ROC为0.737，而最佳Transformer为0.670；未发现任何新增文本分数能可检测地提升基线AUC-ROC；五种领域预训练Transformer在Bonferroni校正后均未可检测地优于其通用领域对照。
AI.conclusion: 在长时程预测场景下，简单协变量基线仍是需要超越的模型，当前文本模型的附加价值有限。

title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个面向MoE语言模型RL训练的FP4量化框架，通过rollout引导的量化感知训练对齐训练与rollout两条量化执行路径，在保持BF16级别RL性能的同时实现最高5.4倍rollout加速。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型RL后训练在rollout生成阶段带来巨大的计算与显存开销，促使采用低精度rollout以提升效率。但现有FP4 RL方法主要独立优化训练路径与rollout路径各自的量化精度，未直接减小两条量化执行路径之间的差异，成为关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出TRACE（Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE）FP4量化框架。其一，引入rollout引导的量化感知训练，利用rollout侧量化结果指导训练侧FP4舍入决策，直接降低训练-rollout差异；其二，设计高效的量化信息缓存机制，选择性保留深层网络的尾数与缩放因子信息，以降低rollout引导带来的存储与通信开销。
AI.result: 在四个大规模MoE语言模型上，围绕推理、代码与长时程RL任务进行评估。结果表明，TRACE支持FP4权重/激活与FP4 KV-cache联合rollout，RL性能可与BF16 rollout相当，rollout加速最高达5.4倍，且最终FP4性能显著优于对BF16训练策略的事后FP4量化。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式对齐训练与rollout的量化执行路径，TRACE在不损失RL性能的前提下实现了高效FP4 rollout，为MoE语言模型RL训练的低精度化提供了可行方案。

title: Reading, Not Manipulating: Leveraging Router Logits for Multimodal Safety in MoE Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) face compositional safety risks where harmful intent emerges from the interaction between visual and textual inputs. As mixture-of-experts (MoE) VLMs become increasingly common, recent work has explored various safety interventions, including prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and routing-based expert steering. However, these methods show inconsistent improvements across models and evaluation distributions, and the intervention into model behavior or internal states introduce safety-utility tradeoffs by over-refusal. Rather than manipulating internal states to steer model behavior, we instead ask whether routing states can serve as diagnostic signals for multimodal safety. We find that router logits indeed provide highly predictive signals of whether a multimodal input is safe or not. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a lightweight router-logit safety detector that reads out routing signals during prompt prefill and identifies unsafe requests before generation, without modifying model parameters or expert routing. Across Qwen3-VL and Kimi-VL, the proposed detector substantially reduces safety errors on the HoliSafe benchmark and resoundingly generalizes to out-of-distribution safety benchmarks featuring different safety patterns, including MISHard and MM-SafetyBench. The success of the proposed router-logit detector also suggests a broader perspective on model internals: rather than focusing only on manipulating internal components to steer behavior, simply reading naturally emerging signals and linking them to an external safety mechanism can provide a simple, effective, and non-intrusive complement to existing safety interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级的"路由 logits 安全检测器"：不修改 MoE 视觉语言模型的参数或专家路由，而是在提示预填充阶段读取路由器 logits 作为诊断信号，在生成前判别多模态输入是否安全。
AI.motivation: MoE 视觉语言模型存在组合式安全风险：有害意图来自视觉与文本输入的交互而非单一模态。已有干预手段（提示工程、监督微调、基于路由的专家操控）在不同模型与评测分布上提升不稳定，且因改动模型行为或内部状态而带来过度拒答导致的安全—可用性权衡。
AI.method: 作者转向"诊断"而非"操控"的视角，验证路由器 logits 是否可作为多模态安全性的预测信号。基于该观察，设计了一个轻量级路由 logits 安全检测器：在 prompt prefill（提示预填充）阶段读取路由信号，在生成前识别不安全请求；全程不修改模型参数，也不干预专家路由。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL 与 Kimi-VL 上，该检测器在 HoliSafe 基准上大幅降低安全错误率；并稳健泛化到安全模式不同的分布外基准，包括 MISHard 与 MM-SafetyBench。
AI.conclusion: 路由 logits 是有效的多模态安全诊断信号。该工作提示一种更广泛的模型内部视角：不必只通过操控内部组件来引导行为，直接读取自然涌现的内部信号并将其接入外部安全机制，可为现有安全干预提供简单、有效且非侵入式的补充。

title: APEX: Speculate smarter, not deeper
summary: Speculative decoding reduces large language model inference latency by drafting multiple tokens before target-model verification, but its effectiveness depends on both the proposal mechanism and draft depth. Fixed configurations cannot respond to changes in predictability, repetition, and acceptance during generation, so deeper drafting can increase wasted computation without proportional speedup. We introduce APEX, a learned controller that balances decoding speed and draft-token waste through request-level expert selection and block-level depth adaptation. APEX-Router selects among EAGLE-3, n-gram, and draft-model speculation for each request, while APEX-Depth adjusts draft length at each verification block using causal decoding signals and recent verifier feedback. APEX models accepted draft length as censored survival feedback, learning position-wise rejection hazards, block execution costs, and an action utility that balances throughput, accepted progress, and wasted tokens. This allows the controller to adapt speculation while retaining the target model's verification procedure. We integrate APEX into vLLM and evaluate it with Qwen3-8B across six workloads, achieving up to 5.24X speedup over autoregressive decoding. Across the aggregate evaluation, APEX-S achieves 4.27X speedup, while APEX-B achieves 3.27X speedup with a 41.0% relative reduction in wasted-token percentage compared with fixed n-gram speculation at k=16, providing distinct operating points for balancing acceleration and draft-token utilization.

AI.tldr: 提出 APEX，一种学习型控制器，通过请求级专家选择与块级草稿深度自适应，在保持目标模型验证流程的前提下动态调整推测解码配置，兼顾加速与草稿令牌浪费的平衡。
AI.motivation: 推测解码的加速效果依赖提议机制与草稿深度，但生成过程中可预测性、重复性和接受率会动态变化。固定配置无法响应这些变化：草稿过深会带来大量无效计算，且无法获得成比例的加速。
AI.method: APEX 包含两个组件：APEX-Router 在请求级从 EAGLE-3、n-gram 与草稿模型推测中选择专家；APEX-Depth 在块级依据因果解码信号与近期验证器反馈调整草稿长度。方法将接受草稿长度建模为删失生存反馈，学习逐位置拒绝风险、块执行代价，以及兼顾吞吐、接受进展与浪费令牌的动作效用，并保留目标模型的验证过程。
AI.result: 将 APEX 集成到 vLLM，并以 Qwen3-8B 在六个工作负载上评估：最高相对自回归解码实现 5.24X 加速；整体评估中 APEX-S 达到 4.27X 加速，APEX-B 达到 3.27X 加速，同时相比 k=16 的固定 n-gram 推测，浪费令牌占比相对下降 41.0%。
AI.conclusion: APEX 通过可学习的双层控制策略，使推测解码能够随生成动态自适应，提供加速与草稿令牌利用之间的不同操作点，从而突破固定配置的局限。

title: Quantization Effects on Tool-Failure Recovery Vary Across Prompts and Evaluation Designs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Small Language Models for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents). 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, plus appendix
summary: Post-training quantization reduces the cost of deploying language-model agents, but its effect on recovery from temporary tool failures can depend on how recovery is evaluated. We compare 8-bit and 4-bit variants of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on twenty deterministic tool-use tasks and five prompts. The 8-bit-4-bit recovery comparison changes direction across prompts and evaluation targets. On tasks that both variants complete without faults under the same prompt, the difference ranges from 0 to +20.2 percentage points for Llama and from -50.0 to +35.0 points for Qwen. Full-pipeline point estimates favor 8-bit Llama under all five prompts, whereas the Qwen comparison changes direction across prompts. The evaluation target can also reverse the result. For Llama under one prompt, scoring each variant only on its own clean-passing tasks favors 4-bit by 17.5 points; scoring the same tasks for both variants gives no difference, while scoring the full pipeline favors 8-bit by 28.3 points. Executor leniency is a third such choice. Rescoring the same logs with strict output parsing, which 8-bit Llama violates far more often than 4-bit Llama under that prompt, turns that +28.3 into -15.0 while leaving Qwen essentially unchanged. These findings show that one prompt, one screened task set, and one scoring policy do not establish a stable conclusion about quantized-agent robustness. Evaluations should compare variants on matched tasks, report full-pipeline success for deployment decisions, state the scoring policy, and quantify uncertainty across tasks rather than injected fault sites.

AI.tldr: 8位与4位量化模型在工具失败恢复上的比较结论会随提示、评估目标与评分口径的方向性变化而反转，单一设置无法得出稳定结论。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化可降低语言模型智能体部署成本，但量化对"临时工具故障恢复能力"的影响结论不稳定，且此前的评估方式可能掩盖这种不稳定性，因此需要系统检验评估设计对结论的影响。
AI.method: 在20个确定性工具使用任务与5个提示上，比较Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct与Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的8位与4位变体；变化三个评估维度：提示、评估目标（仅在本变体干净通过的任务上评分／对两变体在相同任务集评分／全流程评分）、执行器宽松度（严格输出解析重打分），并跨任务而非注入故障点量化不确定性。
AI.result: 8位-4位恢复比较随提示与评估目标反向：同一提示下两变体均无故障完成的任务上，差值Llama为0至+20.2个百分点，Qwen为-50.0至+35.0个百分点。全流程点估计在全部5个提示下均支持8位Llama，而Qwen随提示反向。评估目标亦可反转结论：Llama某一提示下，仅按各自干净通过任务评分时4位领先17.5点；同一任务集对两变体评分则无差异；全流程评分则8位领先28.3点。执行器宽松度是第三个反转因素：严格输出解析重打分（该提示下8位Llama违规远多于4位）将+28.3变为-15.0，而Qwen基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 单一提示、单一筛选任务集与单一评分策略不足以确立关于量化智能体鲁棒性的稳定结论。评估应在匹配任务上比较变体、为部署决策报告全流程成功率、明确说明评分策略，并跨任务而非注入故障点量化不确定性。

title: Persistent Memory in Multi-Agent LLM Inference: What It Costs, What It Buys, and When You Can Tell
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the Machine Learning for Systems Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Decomposing long-context inference across cooperating agents bounds the active KV cache per call rather than total evidence, which matters when KV-cache memory binds. Many such systems add a persistent tier storing and recalling reasoning traces, usually validated by an ablation reporting an accuracy gain. We measure both on one three-tier agent architecture. Decomposition delivers: peak KV working set of 14.3 MiB per query against 35.5 and 35.3 MiB for single-pass and retrieval-augmented baselines. The persistent tier does not: across eight controlled dataset pairs at n=100 per arm it costs +0.368 MiB [+0.167, +0.590] of peak cache and produces no detectable accuracy change (+0.015, 95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]). We argue the null is structural: single-question benchmarks supply each item with its own evidence and score it independently, and correctness requires resetting stored traces between conditions, so recall has nothing informative to retrieve. Reaching it took four measurement corrections -- three inflating the apparent benefit, the fourth making an effect that size look resolvable -- none visible in the results table. We give the conditions an agent-memory ablation must satisfy and detection procedures that need no knowledge of the specific defect.

AI.tldr: 在一个三层智能体架构上系统测量长上下文推理分解与持久记忆层的实际收益：分解有效降低了峰值KV缓存，而持久记忆层在八组对照数据集上既不带来可检测的准确率提升，还增加了峰值缓存占用，其效应为零是结构性的。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中KV缓存内存常成为瓶颈，将推理分解到多个协作智能体可限制单次调用的活跃KV缓存；许多此类系统还附加持久记忆层来存储与召回推理轨迹，但通常仅凭消融实验中报告的准确率增益来证明其价值，缺乏对内存成本与统计显著性的严格测量。
AI.method: 在同一三层智能体架构上同时测量两项要素：协作分解带来的峰值KV工作集，以及持久记忆层带来的峰值缓存开销与准确率变化。实验采用八组受控数据集配对、每组每臂n=100的设计，并配以统计置信区间与四种测量校正，以检验消融结论的稳健性。
AI.result: 分解式推理将每查询峰值KV工作集降至14.3 MiB，而单遍与检索增强基线分别为35.5 MiB和35.3 MiB。持久记忆层反而增加+0.368 MiB峰值缓存（95%置信区间[+0.167, +0.590]），准确率无检测到的变化（+0.015，95%置信区间[-0.011, +0.046]）。
AI.conclusion: 持久记忆层的零效应具有结构性原因：单问题基准为每项自带证据并独立评分，且条件间需重置存储轨迹，召回无从检索到有用信息。研究经历了四次测量校正（三次夸大表观收益，第四次使该量级的效应看似可分辨），均未在结果表中显现，并据此给出智能体记忆消融须满足的条件与无需预先知道具体缺陷的检测程序。

title: From Laboratory to Road: Evaluating Wearable Gaze Accuracy for Driving
comment: Peer-reviewed and accepted as an Extended Abstract at the German Conference on Pattern Recognition (GCPR 2026). Presented as a poster at GCPR 2026
summary: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations have become a widely used interface between perception and planning in autonomous driving, but they encode what is in a scene, not what is behaviorally relevant to a human driver. Gaze offers a compelling behavioral signal for this gap, yet wearable eye trackers are routinely deployed as if their spatial output were ground truth, despite known sensitivity to head motion, illumination, and calibration drift. We present, to our knowledge, the first unified framework for quantifying wearable gaze accuracy under real driving conditions. Our on-road study contains 41 validated scenes in which one driver fixated a vehicle's license plate. Gaze error is measured as the angular difference between the plate center and the gaze direction estimated by the glasses. Separate indoor studies with the same driver and device systematically analyze how distance, illumination, head motion, target motion, and gaze eccentricity affect both systematic bias and gaze precision. The mean on-road error was 4.58 degrees. Applying an offset estimated from the indoor recordings reduced it to 1.10 degrees and improved all 41 scenes. Because this offset varied between sessions, reliable BEV supervision may require online recalibration and condition-dependent estimates of gaze uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次提出统一框架，在真实道路条件下量化可穿戴眼动仪的注视精度，并系统分析多因素对注视偏差与精度的影响，为BEV行为监管提供可靠性依据。
AI.motivation: BEV表示编码场景内容而非对驾驶员行为重要的信息，而注视是填补该缺口的行为信号；但可穿戴眼动仪常被当作空间真值使用，却对头部运动、光照和标定漂移敏感，缺乏精度量化。
AI.method: 开展真实道路研究，含41个有效场景，驾驶员注视车辆车牌；以车牌中心与眼镜估计注视方向间的角差度量注视误差。另用同驾驶员、同设备的室内实验，系统考察距离、光照、头部运动、目标运动和注视偏心对系统偏差与注视精度的影响。
AI.result: 道路场景平均误差为4.58度；应用室内记录估计的偏移后降至1.10度，并改善全部41个场景；该偏移在不同会话间变化。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的BEV监督可能需要在线重标定，以及依赖条件的注视不确定性估计。

title: Image-Space Refraction Correction for Underwater 3D Reconstruction: Warping Flat-Port Views into Pinhole Perspective
summary: Consumer-grade cameras in flat-port housings are widely used for underwater exploration and mapping of coral reefs and seafloor habitats due to their low cost and accessibility. However, refraction at flat-port interfaces causes bowl-shaped deformation in reconstructed scenes and camera trajectories, compromising the metric accuracy required for mapping and navigation. To remove the dominant refractive distortion before reconstruction, we introduce a physics-based refraction correction in image space. Our method is downstream-agnostic: the refraction-corrected images can be directly used as input to existing reconstruction and SLAM algorithms. We characterize the refractive distortion through ray-tracing simulations and validate our correction on two real underwater datasets with differing scene structures. Compared with conventional and refractive Structure-from-Motion (SfM), our approach removes reconstruction deformation while registering more frames and maintaining low reprojection error. The correction further generalizes across diverse reconstruction and VSLAM backends, demonstrating its broad applicability to downstream vision pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于物理的、图像空间的水下折射校正方法，可在重建前消除平窗外壳相机的折射畸变，且与下游算法无关。
AI.motivation: 消费级相机配平窗（flat-port）外壳因低成本、易获取而被广泛用于珊瑚礁与海底栖息地的水下探索与建图。但平窗界面的折射会导致重建场景和相机轨迹出现碗状（bowl-shaped）变形，破坏建图与导航所需的度量精度。因此需要在重建前消除主导性的折射畸变。
AI.method: 在图像空间引入基于物理（physics-based）的折射校正。方法通过光线追踪（ray-tracing）仿真刻画折射畸变特性，且与下游任务无关（downstream-agnostic）：校正后的图像可直接作为现有重建与SLAM算法的输入。
AI.result: 在两个具有不同场景结构的真实水下数据集上验证了校正效果。与传统SfM和折射SfM相比，该方法在消除重建变形的同时配准了更多帧，并保持较低的重投影误差。该校正还可跨多种重建与VSLAM后端泛化。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的物理折射校正能有效去除平窗相机的重建变形，提升帧配准数量并维持低重投影误差，且广泛适用于各类下游视觉流水线，具有良好的通用性。

title: Geometry-Constrained Bidirectional Point Cloud Registration for Thin, Sheet-Like Heritage Artifacts
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for publication in ACM Journal on Computing and Cultural Heritage
summary: Non-contact three-dimensional reconstruction of thin, sheet-like heritage artifacts poses significant geometric and registration challenges. Due to their fragility, these artifacts cannot be suspended or equipped with artificial markers, necessitating independent acquisition of their front and back surfaces. Subsequent registration proves difficult due to the limited number of shared geometric features and the scarcity of explicit physical constraints, which may result in rotational ambiguity, instability, and structural collapse during iterative optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a geometry-constrained bidirectional point cloud registration method specifically tailored for thin, sheet-like heritage artifacts. The method integrates semantic-guided preprocessing, Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-based geometric normalization, and a thickness-aware registration strategy. The estimated physical thickness is incorporated as a geometric constraint to preserve structural integrity during registration. Rotational ambiguity is resolved by evaluating a finite set of global rotation hypotheses, each refined using the point-to-plane Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm, with the optimal transformation selected via a geometry-aware fitness criterion consistent with the thickness scale. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves competitive or improved performance in most cases, particularly in projected area consistency and physically plausible front-back alignment. In addition, the thickness-aware constraint and rotation hypothesis evaluation reduce the risk of degenerate configurations in which the two surfaces are incorrectly flipped while still yielding deceptively acceptable numerical scores, supporting reliable non-contact digitization of delicate and thin heritage artifacts. Implementation details are available at https://zyz-nwpu.github.io/GCBPCR/.

AI.tldr: 提出一种几何约束的双向点云配准方法，用于薄片状文物正反面点云的高精度无接触配准。
AI.motivation: 薄片状文物易碎，无法悬吊或贴标记，需分别采集正反面点云后配准；但共享几何特征少、显式物理约束稀缺，易出现旋转歧义、不稳定与结构塌陷。
AI.method: 方法融合语义引导预处理、基于PCA的几何归一化和厚度感知配准策略；将估计的物理厚度作为几何约束以保持结构完整性；通过评估有限全局旋转假设解决旋转歧义，每个假设用点到平面ICP精化，并以与厚度尺度一致的几何感知适应度准则选择最优变换。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在多数情况下达到竞争性或更优性能，尤其在投影面积一致性和物理合理的正-背对齐方面表现突出；厚度感知约束与旋转假设评估降低了退化配置风险，避免两面错误翻转却产生虚假可接受数值评分。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为脆弱薄片文物的可靠无接触数字化提供支持，实现细节见项目主页。

title: Efficient Gaussian Splatting Sequence Compression with Standard Video Codecs
summary: This paper presents a novel effective Gaussian Splatting (GS) sequence Compression method that utilizes the Video codec (GSCV). Existing video-based GS sequence compression relies on the Parallel Linear Assignment Sorting (PLAS) and tracked primitive information to convert GS into smooth 2D videos. However, tracked information is not available for most practical applications, and without it, using the vanilla PLAS can generate images exhibiting weak inter-frame correlation, due to its stochastic nature. GSCV incorporates a simple yet efficient Inter-PLAS method to produce close images between the I- and P-frames of GS, enhancing the inter-frame performance of video codec greatly. GSCV also realizes a new pipeline based on the state-of-the-art video codecs with high bit-depth GS images, achieving higher compressibility while simultaneously providing a higher quality upper bound. Experimental results show that the proposed GSCV exhibits obviously improved performance over MPEG video and point cloud-based anchors in GS sequence compression. The code is available at https://github.com/Qi-Yangsjtu/GSCV.

AI.tldr: 提出GSCV，一种利用视频编解码器的高效高斯泼溅序列压缩方法，通过Inter-PLAS提升帧间相关性并采用高位深图像管线，性能显著优于MPEG视频与点云基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视频的GS序列压缩依赖PLAS与跟踪的基元信息将GS转为平滑2D视频，但跟踪信息在多数实际应用中不可得；缺失跟踪信息时，原始PLAS因其随机性导致帧间相关性弱，压缩效率下降。因此需要一种不依赖跟踪信息、且能增强帧间相关性的压缩方案。
AI.method: GSCV提出简单高效的Inter-PLAS方法，使GS的I帧与P帧图像相互接近，从而大幅提升视频编解码器的帧间性能；同时基于最先进视频编解码器构建新管线，采用高位深GS图像，兼顾更高可压缩性与更高的质量上界。
AI.result: 实验表明，GSCV在GS序列压缩上相比MPEG视频基线及基于点云的基线均有明显性能提升。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: GSCV通过Inter-PLAS与高位深视频编码管线，在无需跟踪信息的前提下有效提升GS序列的压缩性能，验证了视频编解码器用于GS序列压缩的可行性。

title: Towards benchmarking Western Bluebird detection in the wild
summary: Bird monitoring in natural environments is challenging due to the small size of some species of birds relative to the scene, background clutter, variability in illumination, and the observers' viewpoint. Progress is further limited by the scarcity of large-scale, realistic datasets, which are essential for understanding behavioral patterns. To address this gap, we introduce a new benchmark dataset for the detection and segmentation of Western bluebirds (Sialia Mexicana), comprising over 6,000 labeled images from 41 recording sessions. The dataset features high-resolution (4K) in-the-wild images in which birds occupy only a small fraction of the image. We evaluated supervised detectors, open-vocabulary models under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings, and segmentation approaches. Supervised detectors remain the most reliable overall, with Faster R-CNN achieving the highest detection mAP and RT-DETR offering the best precision-recall trade-off. Open-vocabulary models perform poorly in zero-shot settings; however, fine-tuning substantially improves their performance, with YOLO-World becoming competitive with supervised methods and achieving the highest precision, F1-score, and mAP@0.5. For segmentation, supervised methods significantly outperform Grounded-SAM and SAM 3: Mask R-CNN achieves the highest mask mAP, while YOLOv8-Seg provides the best precision and fastest inference. A diagnostic analysis further shows that failures are not explained by object size alone, but by a combination of apparent scale, brightness, contrast, clutter, blur, crowding, and recording-session variation. Overall, our findings highlight the difficulty of zero-shot bird detection in cluttered ecological scenes and underscore the importance of domain adaptation in small-object settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了包含6000余张4K野外图像的西蓝鸲检测与分割基准数据集，系统评测监督检测器、开放词汇模型与分割方法，发现监督方法整体最可靠，开放词汇模型零样本表现差但微调后可媲美监督方法。
AI.motivation: 自然环境鸟类监测面临目标相对场景过小、背景杂乱、光照变化与视角差异等挑战，且缺乏大规模真实数据集，限制了行为模式研究。
AI.method: 发布含41个录制会话、6000余张4K野外图像的西蓝鸲（Sialia Mexicana）检测与分割基准数据集，图像中鸟类仅占很小比例；评测监督检测器、开放词汇模型（零样本与微调）及分割方法，并进行失败原因诊断分析。
AI.result: 监督检测器整体最可靠：Faster R-CNN取得最高检测mAP，RT-DETR精度-召回权衡最优；开放词汇模型零样本表现差，微调后YOLO-World可媲美监督方法并取得最高精度、F1与mAP@0.5。分割方面监督方法显著优于Grounded-SAM与SAM 3：Mask R-CNN掩码mAP最高，YOLOv8-Seg精度最高且推理最快。失败原因并非仅由目标尺寸决定，而是表观尺度、亮度、对比度、杂乱、模糊、拥挤及录制会话差异共同作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究凸显杂乱生态场景中零样本鸟类检测的困难，强调小目标场景下域自适应的重要性。

title: ThinkFuse: Trajectory-Aware Test-Time Fusion for Small Reasoning Models
summary: Small reasoning models (SRMs) have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought trajectories, but they often fail to recover once their reasoning enters an erroneous path. Existing test-time fusion methods rely on local fusion signals to determine when to trigger fusion, which can be misled by transient uncertainty fluctuations and may reinforce unstable reasoning trajectories. We propose ThinkFuse, a training-free test-time fusion framework that selectively intervenes in unreliable reasoning segments. ThinkFuse compares segment-level uncertainty shifts with trajectory-level uncertainty trends to identify unstable reasoning points and fuse auxiliary reasoning paths into the primary model's trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ThinkFuse outperforms baselines on mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks, with consistent gains across model-family combinations, and remains robust with a smaller primary model. Our analysis shows that ThinkFuse requires fewer fusion triggers and generates fewer tokens, highlighting the efficiency of selective triggering. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ThinkFuse.

AI.tldr: ThinkFuse：一种免训练、选择性的测试时融合框架，通过对比片段级不确定性与轨迹级不确定性趋势识别不稳定推理点，从而触发辅助推理路径融合。在数学与知识密集型推理基准上超越基线，且触发更少、生成token更少、对小模型主模型也鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 小型推理模型（SRM）虽能通过长链思维在复杂推理任务上表现优异，但一旦推理走入错误路径便难以恢复。现有测试时融合方法依赖局部融合信号决定触发时机，易受瞬时不确定性波动误导，反而强化不稳定的推理轨迹。
AI.method: 提出ThinkFuse，一种免训练的测试时融合框架，选择性干预不可靠的推理片段。它将片段级不确定性变化与轨迹级不确定性趋势进行比较，以识别不稳定推理点，并将辅助推理路径融合进主模型的推理轨迹中。
AI.result: 在数学与知识密集型推理基准上优于基线；在不同模型家族组合中取得一致增益；在较小的主模型下仍保持鲁棒；需要更少的融合触发次数并生成更少的token。
AI.conclusion: ThinkFuse通过选择性触发实现高效融合，验证了以轨迹级不确定性趋势为参照进行干预的有效性，提升了SRM在复杂推理任务中的鲁棒性与效率。

title: One Step at a Time: Trading LLM Autonomy for Process Predictability
summary: Organizations automating operational processes need more than a correct outcome: they need to predict how a process will run, know which one actually ran, and inspect it step by step. When an agent is the executor that predictability is normally lost: the prescribed procedure goes into the system prompt, and only a final answer comes back. We deliver the procedure step by step over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) instead: a server releases one step at a time, the agent executes it, and each step returns a structured step_output. This trades autonomy for predictability, and two properties then follow by construction, independent of the executor. The execution path is prescribed before the run, so the process is predictable in advance rather than reconstructed afterwards; and the completed step records form a machine-readable execution log that downstream tooling can audit and optimize step by step. Evaluating 15,475 trials across 13 SOP-Bench domains and four open-weight executors from frontier (Kimi K2.5) to lightweight (Ministral 3 8B), we find step-level delivery makes the executed process predictable and inspectable for every executor, and additionally raises accuracy when the executor is small. Across all four, process adherence rises significantly (76-95% to 95-99%) and ungrounded answers (correct outputs produced without executing the SOP) near-vanish, falling from 2.1-4.5% to 0.2-0.3% of trials (all 95% CIs exclude zero); under prompt-based delivery, 31-49% of correct answers on know_your_business bypass the SOP entirely, even for the frontier executor. Accuracy is where the executor's capability enters: the lightweight executor gains +6.5pp grounded accuracy because supplying the process externally removes a reconstruction burden it cannot carry, while capable ones trade a small raw-accuracy decrement for a predictable, auditable process.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过MCP（模型上下文协议）逐步下发操作流程（SOP）给智能体执行：服务器一次释放一个步骤，智能体执行后返回结构化step_output。在13个SOP-Bench域、15,475次试验、4个开源权重的执行器上评估发现，这种方式牺牲自主性换取可预测性，流程遵循率从76-95%升至95-99%，无依据答案从2.1-4.5%降至0.2-0.3%，且对轻量执行器提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 组织在自动化运营流程时不仅需要正确结果，还需要提前预测流程如何运行、知道实际运行了哪条路径，并可逐步检查。而当前以智能体作为执行器时，规定流程被写入系统提示词，仅返回最终答案，导致可预测性丧失，过程无法预先获知，事后才被重构，且难以审计。作者希望在不依赖执行器本身能力的前提下，使流程具有可预测性和可检查性。
AI.method: 将SOP通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）逐步下发：服务器每次释放一个步骤，智能体执行该步骤，每一步返回结构化的step_output。由此在执行器之外、由构造保证两个性质：执行路径在运行前即被规定（可预先预测而非事后重构），以及完整的步骤记录形成机器可读的执行日志，供下游工具逐步审计与优化。评估覆盖13个SOP-Bench域、15,475次试验、4个开源权重执行器（从前沿的Kimi K2.5到轻量的Ministral 3 8B）。
AI.result: 对所有四个执行器，步骤级下发都使流程可预测、可检查；流程遵循率显著上升（76-95%→95-99%），无依据答案（未执行SOP却产出正确输出）从2.1-4.5%降至0.2-0.3%（所有95%置信区间均不含零）。在基于提示词的下发方式下，即便前沿执行器，在know_your_business任务上仍有31-49%的正确答案完全绕过SOP。准确率方面体现执行器能力差异：轻量执行器因外部提供流程、消除了其无法承担的"重构负担"，基于依据的准确率提升+6.5pp；而能力强的执行器则以小幅原始准确率下降换取可预测、可审计的流程。
AI.conclusion: 步骤级流程下发将以自主性换取可预测性，并在构造上保证流程可预先预测、可逐步审计，该性质与执行器无关。它显著提升流程遵循率、近乎消除无依据答案，并能提升轻量执行器的准确率；对能力强的执行器则以极小准确率代价换取可预测、可审计的流程。

title: $α$Transfer: Coefficient Transfer for Efficient Model Merging
summary: Model merging offers a promising solution for combining multiple fine-tuned checkpoints into a single model through parameter arithmetic. However, finding optimal merging coefficients requires an extensive search that becomes prohibitively expensive as models scale in both size and number, due to high memory requirements and combinatorial growth in the search space. We show that, within the same model family, models exhibit highly congruent performance distributions over merging coefficients across different model sizes. This distributional similarity enables a practical paradigm we call \textit{$α$Transfer}: searching for optimal coefficients on a small proxy model, then directly transfer them to larger target models. We verify $α$Transfer across multiple merging methods, model families, and tasks. Experimental results demonstrate a 6$\times$ speedup and 70\% memory reduction on vision transformers, and a 20$\times$ speedup and 85\% memory reduction on large language models, while maintaining comparable performance. Our findings establish $α$Transfer as an efficient and generalizable approach to scaling model merging.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 αTransfer 范式：在同一模型族内，合并系数上的性能分布高度一致，因此可在小规模代理模型上搜索最优合并系数，再直接迁移到大规模目标模型，从而大幅降低模型合并的搜索成本。
AI.motivation: 模型合并通过参数算术将多个微调检查点整合为单一模型，但寻找最优合并系数需要大量搜索；随着模型规模与数量增长，高内存需求与搜索空间组合爆炸使搜索代价过高，亟需一种可扩展的高效寻优方法。
AI.method: 作者发现同一模型族内不同规模模型在合并系数上的性能分布高度相似（分布同质性），据此提出 αTransfer：先在小规模代理模型上搜索最优合并系数，再将其直接迁移至大规模目标模型。该方法在多种合并方法、模型族与任务上进行了验证。
AI.result: 在视觉 Transformer 上实现 6 倍加速与 70% 内存降低；在大语言模型上实现 20 倍加速与 85% 内存降低，同时保持相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: αTransfer 是一种高效且具泛化性的模型合并扩展方法，为降低模型合并的搜索成本提供了实用范式。

title: Nucleus Speculative Decoding: Plausibility-Aware Verification Beyond Exact Distribution
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive generation by letting a lightweight draft model propose tokens that a target model verifies in parallel. However, its standard acceptance rule, designed for exact distribution correction, rejects tokens to which the draft assigns excess probability, even when the target finds them highly plausible: over half of the rejected tokens lie inside the target's own nucleus. Since verification dominates the cost of SD, these rejections waste its most expensive operation. We introduce Nucleus Speculative Decoding (NSD), a plausibility-aware verification rule that accepts a draft token if it passes the standard test or belongs to the target nucleus, while keeping SD's residual correction and bonus sampling unchanged. NSD requires no training or extra forward passes and is compatible with any drafting mechanism. Because it preserves SD's recovery rule, its deviation from the target distribution can be characterized exactly: we prove that the single-step total variation error equals the draft's excess probability inside the target nucleus, which is precisely NSD's gain in acceptance probability. NSD thus trades fidelity for acceptance at an exact one-to-one rate, and we further derive sequence-level fidelity bounds. Across six target models and five mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, NSD achieves the highest throughput among all compared methods, with speedups of up to $5.16\times$ over autoregressive decoding and $3.15\times$ over standard SD, while improving accuracy over SD on five of the six models and nearly halving verification time per output token. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Nucleus-Speculative-Decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Nucleus Speculative Decoding (NSD)，一种基于合理性感知的验证规则，允许草稿模型生成的token若落入目标模型的nucleus集合则被接受，无需训练或额外前向传播，在保持残差校正机制的同时实现接受率与分布保真度的精确权衡。
AI.motivation: 标准推测解码(SD)的接受规则为精确分布校正而设计，会拒绝草稿赋予超额概率的token，即使目标模型认为这些token高度合理——超过半数的被拒token其实位于目标模型自身的nucleus内。由于验证是SD开销的主要来源，这些拒绝浪费了最昂贵的操作。
AI.method: NSD采用合理性感知的验证规则：若草稿token通过标准检验或属于目标模型的nucleus，则接受该token；同时保持SD原有的残差校正和bonus采样不变。该方法无需训练或额外前向传播，兼容任意草稿机制。
AI.result: 在六个目标模型和五个数学推理与代码生成基准上，NSD在所有对比方法中吞吐量最高，相比自回归解码提速最高达5.16倍，相比标准SD提速最高达3.15倍；在六个模型中的五个上准确率优于SD，并将每输出token的验证时间几乎减半。
AI.conclusion: NSD以精确的一对一比率在保真度与接受率之间进行权衡：单步总变分误差等于草稿在目标nucleus内的超额概率，即NSD接受概率的增量，并进一步推导出序列级保真度界。

title: Harness Engineering for Software Engineering via Modular Executable Dev-Primitives
summary: Large language models (LLMs) equipped with terminal access have demonstrated strong capabilities in automating software engineering tasks. However, existing agents remain brittle on long-horizon workflows, where they must repeatedly reconstruct program state scattered across source files, configurations, tests, dependencies, and runtime behavior, leading to increasingly long interaction histories, context explosion, and semantic drift. Large repositories further complicate the identification of task-relevant components. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{Dev-Primitives} (\emph{Development Primitives}), a modular and executable abstraction that transforms repository components from passive software artifacts into active participants in software engineering. Each Dev-Primitive pairs a repository artifact with a resident LLM, which gives the artifact an agent-native interface grounded in its own implementation and dependencies, enabling natural-language reasoning, inter-component communication, and localized self-modification. Building on Dev-Primitives, we propose \textbf{HERMES}, a Harness Engineering framework for software engineeRing via Modular Executable Dev-PrimitiveS, which instantiates these primitives at repository scale through a dependency-aware dynamic activation mechanism and a bug diagnosis mechanism that maps execution evidence back to the components that must be revised. Extensive experiments on four software engineering benchmarks demonstrate that HERMES outperforms matched baseline harnesses by 12.4\% on average. Moreover, when paired with strong activation and diagnosis models, HERMES, even with Qwen3-8B Dev-Primitives, remains within 4.5\% of the homogeneous GPT-5.6 Sol configuration across all four benchmarks, while reducing inference cost by 26.2\% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, highlighting the importance of harness design in software engineering agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Dev-Primitives（开发原语）与HERMES框架，将仓库组件（源码、配置、测试、依赖等）与常驻LLM配对，使其成为可执行、可自然语言交互的主动参与者，从而缓解长程软件工程任务中的上下文爆炸与语义漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 具备终端访问能力的大语言模型在自动化软件工程任务上表现强劲，但现有智能体在长程工作流中十分脆弱：需反复重建分散于源文件、配置、测试、依赖与运行时行为中的程序状态，导致交互历史过长、上下文爆炸与语义漂移；大型仓库更使任务相关组件的识别变得困难。因此需要一种模块化、可执行的抽象来改变仓库组件被动性的问题。
AI.method: 提出Dev-Primitives：每个原语将一个仓库制品与一个常驻LLM配对，赋予该制品基于其自身实现与依赖的"智能体原生"接口，支持自然语言推理、组件间通信与局部自我修改。在此基础上构建HERMES框架（面向软件工程的、基于模块化可执行开发原语的开采工程harness），通过依赖感知的动态激活机制在仓库规模上实例化原语，并借助缺陷诊断机制将执行证据回溯映射到需修改的组件。
AI.result: 在四个软件工程基准上，HERMES平均比匹配的基线harness高出12.4%。当搭配强激活与诊断模型时，即使使用Qwen3-8B作为Dev-Primitives，HERMES在四个基准上均与同质GPT-5.6 Sol配置相差不超过4.5%，同时在Terminal-Bench 4.0上将推理成本降低26.2%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，harness设计对软件工程智能体的性能与成本效率具有关键作用；将仓库组件转化为LLM驱动的可执行原语，是应对长程软件工程任务中状态重建与上下文管理难题的有效途径。

title: CHARTER: Auditing Reference Substitution in Hierarchical Compact-Evidence Evaluation for Computational Pathology
summary: In digital pathology, compact evidence is often used to explain or audit predictions made by whole-slide image multiple instance learning models. In hierarchical compact-evidence pipelines, candidate filtering introduces a strategy-specific candidate-conditioned prediction alongside the original full-bag prediction. If the evaluation reference changes while the intended target remains the original full-bag prediction, however, not only can the measured fidelity of the same compact evidence change, but comparisons between competing candidate strategies can also change. To make this dependence explicit, we introduce CHARTER, a reference-aware evaluation charter that asks researchers to DECLARE the intended target and reference, QUANTIFY candidate-induced prediction shift, and AUDIT the stability of comparative conclusions. Across the 15 comparisons in our main five-seed Random-K audit, 4 showed determinate reversals; in a matched native-ranking stress test, the ACMIL comparison changed from REVERSED to PRESERVED. CHARTER turns otherwise implicit candidate-filtering and reference choices into an auditable evaluation specification, helping distinguish genuine preservation of the intended prediction from apparent gains induced by changing the prediction being explained.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CHARTER，一个参考感知的评估章程，用于规范数字病理中紧凑证据（compact evidence）评估时的目标与参考基准选择，揭示候选筛选导致的预测漂移对保真度测量与策略比较结论的干扰。
AI.motivation: 在层次化紧凑证据流程中，候选筛选会引入一个"候选条件下的预测"，与原始全切片图像的 full-bag 预测并存。若评估参考发生变化而意图解释的目标仍是原始 full-bag 预测，则同一紧凑证据的保真度测量值会改变，候选策略之间的比较结论也可能随之反转。这种隐性依赖此前未被显式刻画。
AI.method: 提出 CHARTER 评估章程，包含三个步骤：DECLARE（声明意图目标与评估参考）、QUANTIFY（量化候选筛选引起的预测漂移）、AUDIT（审计比较结论的稳定性）。并在五种子 Random-K 审计与匹配的 native-ranking 压力测试中验证其必要性。
AI.result: 在主实验的五种子 Random-K 审计的 15 组比较中，有 4 组出现确定性反转；在匹配的 native-ranking 压力测试中，ACMIL 比较的结论由 REVERSED 变为 PRESERVED。
AI.conclusion: CHARTER 将原本隐式的候选筛选与参考基准选择转化为可审计的评估规范，有助于区分"对意图预测的真实保持"与"因更换被解释预测而产生的表观增益"。

title: OMIT the Action: Measuring Framing-Invariant Omission Bias under Philosophical Disagreement
summary: As LLMs increasingly assist in moral reasoning, omission bias, the tendency to prefer inaction even when equivalent framings reverse substantive outcomes, poses a significant risk of skewed decision-making. Yet omission bias remains underexplored in LLM evaluation, with the few existing studies limited in scale and focused largely on utilitarian-deontological conflicts. To address this gap, we introduce OMIT, a benchmark consisting of 218 paired-frame scenarios across 10 conflict types, constructed by leveraging disagreement patterns from an LLM-based, five-perspective philosophical persona panel (utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics, care ethics, and contractualism). Evaluating eight LLMs, we find that omission bias is pervasive but inversely correlates with model size within families. We further evaluate four inference-time interventions and find that interventions encouraging models to consider moral principles before committing to a yes/no answer reduce omission bias and increase frame-consistent responses, although lower omission bias rates can also coincide with shifts toward action-biased responses. Ultimately, this work contributes not only the OMIT benchmark, but also a methodology for using diverse philosophical disagreement signals to evaluate framing-sensitive inaction preferences and the distributional effects of mitigation attempts in LLMs under complex moral conflicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OMIT基准（218对配对框架场景、10类道德冲突），揭示LLM普遍存在省略偏差，且与模型规模在族内负相关；还评估四种推理期干预，发现"先思原则再作答"可降低偏差但可能偏向行动。
AI.motivation: LLM日益参与道德推理，而省略偏差（偏好不作为，即便框架等效却导致实质结果反转）会造成决策偏斜。但该偏差在LLM评测中研究不足：现有研究规模小，且多聚焦功利主义—义务论冲突。
AI.method: 构建OMIT基准：借助基于LLM的五视角哲学人格小组（功利主义、义务论、美德伦理、关怀伦理、契约论）的分歧模式，生成218个配对框架场景，覆盖10类冲突。评测8个LLM，并评估4种推理期干预。
AI.result: 省略偏差普遍存在，但在同一模型族内与模型规模负相关。鼓励模型在给出是/否答案前先考虑道德原则的干预，可降低省略偏差并提高框架一致性回答；然而更低的省略偏差率也可能伴随向行动偏向回答的转变。
AI.conclusion: 本文不仅贡献OMIT基准，还提供一种方法论：利用多元哲学分歧信号来评估LLM对框架敏感的不作为偏好，以及复杂道德冲突下缓解尝试的分布效应。

title: Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a standard approach for adapting large language models to downstream tasks. However, most existing PEFT methods rely on uniform and static adaptations, without accounting for the structured heterogeneity of attention across dimensions, heads, layers, and input tokens. In practice, attention representations exhibit non-uniform behavior, and positional encoding mechanisms such as rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) induce dimension-dependent positional structure, making uniform adaptation suboptimal. In this work, we propose DyPAM (Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation), a PEFT method that adapts how positional information contributes to attention by operating directly on the query and key representations. DyPAM combines input-conditioned, dimension-wise modulation with head-wise and layer-wise structural modulation, performing fine-grained adaptation of positional attention aligned with the RoPE-induced structure without modifying the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks across multiple backbone models demonstrate that DyPAM consistently outperforms existing strong PEFT baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出DyPAM，一种参数高效微调方法，通过在query/key表示上进行输入条件化、维度级、头级与层级的位置注意力调制，适配RoPE诱导的结构异质性，在数学与常识推理任务上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法多采用均匀、静态的适配方式，未考虑注意力在维度、头、层和输入token上的结构化异质性；实际注意力表示呈非均匀行为，且RoPE等位置编码机制引入维度相关的位置结构，使均匀适配并非最优。
AI.method: DyPAM直接在query与key表示上操作，调制位置信息对注意力的贡献。方法融合两类机制：一是输入条件化的维度级调制，二是头级与层级的结构性调制，从而在不修改预训练主干的前提下，实现与RoPE诱导结构对齐的细粒度位置注意力适配。
AI.result: 在多个主干模型上，于数学推理与常识推理基准进行大量实验，DyPAM一致优于现有强PEFT基线。
AI.conclusion: 针对注意力的结构化异质性与RoPE位置结构进行细粒度、动态的位置注意力调制，是提升PEFT效果的有效方向，且无需改动预训练骨干即可实现。

title: Lost in the bf16 Cast: Exporting Ternary Language Models Can Revert Most Low-Learning-Rate Code Changes
summary: Ternary language models such as BitNet b1.58, Falcon-E and BitCPM are fine-tuned with higher-precision latent weights and deployed as ternary codes produced by an export step that, in the labs' documented pipelines, first casts the latents to bf16. We audit those pipelines across three labs. In released checkpoints, fp32 quantization of the shipped latents disagrees with the deployed codes on 0.83-1.77% of codes in Falcon-E and BitCPM and on 1.530% in BitNet 2B-4T; for Falcon-E and BitCPM most disagreements are products that bf16 rounding lands exactly on the threshold, which ties-to-even maps to zero, and the unmodified onebitllms exporter reproduces all four Falcon-E releases byte for byte. At fine-tuned endpoints, with learning rates selected to match a nominal learning-rate-to-bf16-ULP ratio, the documented export lowers greedy GSM8K strict accuracy from 58.79% to 0.78% for Falcon-E-1B-Base and from 36.13% to 0.39% for BitCPM-CANN-0.5B, and a bf16 save and reload lowers BitNet 2B-4T's strict accuracy by 27.54 points while its last-number accuracy rises. Two compatibility remedies, writing the training quantizer's codes directly or adjusting the bf16 inputs until the unchanged tools emit them, each met a 4-point strict-accuracy non-inferiority criterion against online evaluation in all three models. In two model families, randomized interventions on the initial distance from the threshold support distance-dependent selection of the codes that fine-tuning changes.

AI.tldr: 审计三个实验室的三值语言模型（BitNet b1.58、Falcon-E、BitCPM）导出流程发现：文档化的 bf16 中转导出会改变部署码，导致微调模型严格准确率大幅崩塌；两种兼容性补救方案均可通过 4 点非劣性检验。
AI.motivation: 三值语言模型以高精度潜权重微调、再经导出步骤转为三值码部署，而各实验室文档化流程会先将潜权重转为 bf16。本文旨在审计这些流程，检验该 bf16 中转是否与真实部署码不一致，并量化其对微调端点性能的破坏程度。
AI.method: 审计三实验室发布检查点：用 fp32 量化已发布潜权重，与部署码逐码比对（Falcon-E、BitCPM 为 0.83–1.77%，BitNet 2B-4T 为 1.530%）；分析分歧来源（多为 bf16 舍入恰落阈值、ties-to-even 归零），并用未改动的 onebitllms 导出器复现 Falcon-E 四个版本。在微调端点按名义学习率与 bf16-ULP 比率选取学习率，比较文档化导出前后的贪心 GSM8K 严格准确率；测试两种补救方案（直接写入训练量化器码、调整 bf16 输入使原工具输出目标码），以在线评测为基准做 4 点严格准确率非劣性检验。另在两个模型族上用随机化初始阈值距离干预，检验码选择的距离依赖性。
AI.result: 文档化导出使 Falcon-E-1B-Base 贪心 GSM8K 严格准确率从 58.79% 降至 0.78%，BitCPM-CANN-0.5B 从 36.13% 降至 0.39%；bf16 保存再加载使 BitNet 2B-4T 严格准确率下降 27.54 点，而末位数字准确率反而上升。两种兼容性补救在所有三个模型上均满足 4 点严格准确率非劣性标准。随机化干预在两个模型族中支持微调所改码的选择依赖初始阈值距离。
AI.conclusion: 文档化的 bf16 中转导出会系统性地改变三值部署码并严重损害微调端点的严格准确率；直接写入训练量化器码或调整 bf16 输入使未改动工具输出目标码，均可消除该不兼容而保持性能，且码的变更具有阈值距离依赖性。

title: ReFold: Training-Free Reversible Inter-Turn Context Folding for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents act on an append-only interaction history that is re-sent to the model at every step, so the context and its cost grow with steps until the sessions exceed the context window. Existing methods manage the context through context requirement prediction, relying on additional model calls, heuristic rules, or trained policies. However, these predictive approaches introduce runtime overhead, invalidate prefix caches, and permanently discard content with no guarantee of recovery. To overcome these limitations, we introduce ReFold: a training-free rendering layer that preserves the underlying interaction history while compressing only the model's rendered context. It removes two kinds of inter-turn redundancy without an auxiliary predictor: content an earlier turn already displayed, replaced by a stub, and turns the agent itself reports finished, folded into a one-line note. Both operators use chunked rendering, rewriting the cached prefix once every few steps rather than at every step. Every removal is strictly reversible, a wrong removal costs one restore from the history rather than permanent content loss. Because it operates at the rendering layer, ReFold is plug-and-play across standard ReAct-style harnesses. Evaluations across five long-horizon benchmarks and two frontier LLMs demonstrate that ReFold reduces token consumption by up to 2.5x and halves the KV-cache memory per session without degrading task success rates. Under capped context budgets, it avoids up to 92% of forced compactions. Under concurrent serving workloads, it reduces request queuing delays by up to 100%, accelerating inference by up to 1.7x, while cutting inference costs by up to 3.4x.

AI.tldr: ReFold是一种免训练的渲染层方法，通过可逆地折叠交互历史中的冗余内容来压缩LLM智能体的上下文，在保持任务成功率的同时显著降低token消耗、KV缓存占用与推理成本。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体在追加式交互历史上行动，每步都重传历史，导致上下文与成本随步数增长直至超出上下文窗口。现有方法依赖上下文需求预测（额外模型调用、启发式规则或训练策略），带来运行时开销、使前缀缓存失效，并永久丢弃内容且无法保证恢复。
AI.method: ReFold是一种免训练的渲染层，保留底层交互历史，仅压缩模型渲染的上下文。无需辅助预测器即可消除两类轮间冗余：（1）早期轮次已展示的内容，用占位符（stub）替换；（2）智能体自报已完成的轮次，折叠为一行注释。两种操作均采用分块渲染，每数步重写一次缓存前缀而非每步重写。所有删除严格可逆，误删只需从历史恢复一次而非永久丢失。由于作用于渲染层，可即插即用于标准ReAct式框架。
AI.result: 在五个长时程基准和两个前沿LLM上评估，ReFold将token消耗最多降低2.5倍，每会话KV缓存内存减半，且不降低任务成功率。在受限上下文预算下，避免最多92%的强制压缩。在并发服务负载下，请求排队延迟最多降低100%，推理加速最多1.7倍，同时推理成本最多降低3.4倍。
AI.conclusion: ReFold通过渲染层的可逆冗余折叠，无需额外预测器或训练即可高效压缩长时程智能体上下文，在保持任务性能的同时大幅降低计算与内存成本，并提升高并发场景下的服务效率，具备良好的通用性与即插即用特性。

title: CueRator: Agentic Search for Symbolic Rules to Adapt Frozen Multimodal Encoders
summary: Large language model agents have been used to search over symbolic structures such as programs and equations. We propose CueRator, an agentic framework for policy-aware decision-rule discovery, which adapts frozen contrastive multimodal encoders by searching for the decision rule that converts their cross-modal similarities into predictions. We validate it on open-vocabulary audio-visual event perception, where existing methods involve a trade-off between adaptivity and generalization to unseen categories: trained modules adapt at the cost of generalization, and fixed rules the reverse. The framework pairs a symbolic formulation for generalization with a lightweight policy that predicts its parameters per video for adaptivity. A report-guided multi-agent loop discovers the formulation offline, evaluating each candidate on its expressive ceiling and on whether a trained policy can realize it. On OV-AVEBench, CueRator raises the total average from 57.8 to 60.2 and unseen-category performance from 55.8 to 59.9 over the best existing method, reducing the seen-unseen gap from 7.1 to 1.2. Ablations attribute the gains to both the formulation and the policy and show that both feedback signals are necessary for effective search. CueRator also improves over the respective baselines on two further audio-visual event perception tasks, and the discovered rule remains competitive across encoders with only the policy retrained. Code is available at https://github.com/cvsp-lab/cuerator.

AI.tldr: 提出 CueRator 智能体框架，通过搜索决策规则来适配冻结的对比多模态编码器，在开放词汇音视频事件感知任务上兼顾自适应性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在自适应性与对未见类别的泛化之间存在权衡：训练模块可自适应但泛化差，固定规则泛化好但自适应差。需要一种能同时兼顾两者的方法。
AI.method: CueRator 将决策规则表示为符号形式以保证泛化，并配以轻量策略网络为每个视频预测规则参数以实现自适应。通过报告引导的多智能体循环离线搜索规则，每个候选规则在表达能力上限与训练策略可实现性两方面评估。
AI.result: 在 OV-AVEBench 上总平均从 57.8 提升至 60.2，未见类别性能从 55.8 提升至 59.9，seen-unseen 差距由 7.1 缩小至 1.2。消融表明规则形式与策略均有贡献，两种反馈信号对有效搜索均必要。在另两个音视频事件感知任务上也优于基线，且规则跨编码器保持竞争力，仅需重训策略。
AI.conclusion: CueRator 通过符号规则搜索与策略预测相结合，有效缓解自适应性与泛化的权衡，具备良好的可迁移性与可复现性（代码已开源）。

title: Revar3r: gauge-aware perturbation uncertainty for feed-forward 3d reconstruction
summary: A correctly reconstructed distant point appears uncertain even when a frozen 3D model processes equivalent inputs because its output frame rotates fractionally. This exposes a weakness of trainingfree perturbation uncertainty: when outputs contain an unobserved symmetry, run-to-run variation potentially reflects symmetry rather than error. Existing alternatives have trade-offs: built-in confidence is outperformed in most evaluated conditions, while trained evidential heads require modelspecific supervision. For point maps, this research derives a closed-form, error-independent variance term that grows with scene extent and potentially overwhelms the desired signal. Simulation reproduces the effect; all 30 real VGGT view-sets tested exhibit its predicted $\|x_p\|^2$ signature. ReVar3R robustly registers predictions to a common similarity frame before computing per-point variance, without retraining or modifying the frozen model. Optional calibration and fusion use a held-out split. Across VGGT, π3, and MASt3R on six datasets, the same estimator on every backbone lowers AUSE below built-in confidence in 15 of 18 conditions. The staged evaluation yields 11 of 18 wins for the label-free core, 12/18 for label-free equal-weight fusion, 14/18 with held-out weights, and 15/18 when the built-in signal is included. Against a trained evidential head, the result is a trade-off: the head calibrates magnitude better and leads in its training domain, whereas ReVar3R transfers across backbones without adaptation. Its ranking improves point filtering, but it does not detect stable systematic bias, aid novel-view synthesis, or transfer calibration across domains.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示冻结3D模型输出帧存在未观测对称性，导致免训练扰动不确定性混入与误差无关的方差项（∝‖x_p‖²）；提出ReVar3R，先对预测做相似变换对齐再计算逐点方差，无需重训练即可降低风险。
AI.motivation: 冻结3D模型对等价输入会产生微旋转的输出帧，使得重投影正确的远点也显得不确定。此时run-to-run variation反映的是未观测对称性而非真实误差，这是免训练扰动不确定性估计的一个根本缺陷。已有替代方案各有代价：内置置信度多数条件下表现更差；训练式evidential head需要特定模型的监督。因此需要一种与误差无关、可跨backbone迁移的不确定性估计方法。
AI.method: 首先为point map推导出闭式、与误差无关的方差项，该方差随场景范围增大（呈‖x_p‖²特征）并可能淹没所需信号，经仿真复现并在全部30组真实VGGT view-set上验证该特征。随后提出ReVar3R：在计算逐点方差之前，先将预测稳健地配准到共同相似变换帧，从而消除对称性带来的虚假变化；整个过程不重训练、不修改冻结模型。可选校准与融合使用held-out split。
AI.result: 在VGGT、π3、MASt3R三个backbone与六个数据集上，同一估计器在18种条件中的15种将AUSE降至低于内置置信度。分阶段评估：免标签核心11/18胜出，免标签等权融合12/18，held-out权重14/18，加入内置信号后15/18。与训练式evidential head相比存在权衡：evidential head的幅值校准更好且在其训练域领先，而ReVar3R无需适配即可跨backbone迁移。
AI.conclusion: ReVar3R通过相似变换对齐消除了未观测对称性引起的伪方差，是一种无需重训练、可跨backbone迁移的不确定性估计方法，其排序能改善点过滤。但有明确局限：无法检测稳定的系统性偏差，无助于novel-view synthesis，也不能跨域迁移校准。

title: Tiny-Scale Chinese BERT Pretraining: A Controlled Comparison of MLM, WWM, and MacBERT Strategies
summary: Pretraining strategies significantly impact the quality of language models, yet existing comparisons of Masked Language Modeling (MLM), Whole Word Masking (WWM), and MacBERT-style replacement have focused primarily on base-scale models (>=110M parameters). This paper presents a controlled comparison of these three strategies on a tiny-scale Chinese BERT model (4 layers, 256 hidden dimensions, 8.7M parameters). Under identical architecture, corpus (1.29M sentences from Chinese Wikipedia), and hyperparameters, we train three models from scratch and evaluate them across five intrinsic dimensions: perplexity, MLM hit rate, semantic discrimination, grammatical judgment, and contextual sensitivity. At tiny scale, MLM achieves the best overall intrinsic performance (winning 3 of 5 dimensions), while WWM excels in both perplexity (1.27 vs. 2.10, a 39.5% improvement) and MLM hit rate (22% vs. 16%). Notably, MacBERT under a severely limited synonym dictionary (222 entries, 3.3% coverage) exhibits severe perplexity degradation (47.23, 22x higher than MLM), yielding a ranking (MLM > WWM >> MacBERT) that differs markedly from the established base-scale conclusion (MacBERT > WWM > MLM). We further identify a critical evaluation pitfall: MacBERT achieves the lowest training loss (2.17) yet the highest perplexity (47.23), revealing that training loss alone is unreliable under mixed replacement strategies. All models and corpus are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/eebyp.

AI.tldr: 本文在微型中文BERT（4层、256维、8.7M参数）上控制变量比较MLM、WWM与MacBERT式替换三种预训练策略，发现微型规模下的排序（MLM > WWM >> MacBERT）与基座规模结论（MacBERT > WWM > MLM）显著不同，并揭示训练损失在混合替换策略下不可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有MLM、WWM与MacBERT式替换策略的比较主要集中于基座规模模型（≥110M参数），缺乏对微型规模模型的系统研究，因此其结论能否推广到小规模模型尚不明确。论文旨在填补这一空白，考察不同掩码策略在极小参数量下是否仍保持相同的优劣排序。
AI.method: 在相同架构（4层、隐藏维度256、8.7M参数）、相同语料（中文维基百科129万句）和相同超参数下，从头训练三个中文BERT模型，分别采用MLM、WWM和MacBERT式替换策略；从五个内在维度进行评估：困惑度、MLM命中率、语义区分、语法判断和上下文敏感性。
AI.result: 在微型规模下，MLM总体内在表现最佳（在5个维度中胜出3个）；WWM在困惑度（1.27 vs. 2.10，提升39.5%）和MLM命中率（22% vs. 16%）上表现最优。MacBERT在极大受限的同义词词典（222条、覆盖率3.3%）下困惑度严重退化（47.23，为MLM的22倍），形成MLM > WWM >> MacBERT的排序，与基座规模结论MacBERT > WWM > MLM明显不同。此外，MacBERT训练损失最低（2.17）但困惑度最高（47.23），表明混合替换策略下仅凭训练损失评估模型不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 掩码预训练策略的最优选择具有规模依赖性，基座规模下的结论不能直接外推到微型模型；在资源受限或词典覆盖不足时，简单MLM可能优于MacBERT式替换。研究同时提示，混合替换策略下训练损失不能作为可靠的评估指标，需结合困惑度等内在指标综合判断。所有模型与语料已公开。

title: Label-Efficient Deep Learning for ECG Delineation: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark against Widely Used Delineation Tools
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. First two authors contributed equally
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) delineation, the identification of waveform boundaries, is a foundational step that translates raw ECG signals into clinically interpretable measurements. Deep learning has advanced this task but remains dependent on costly expert annotations. Label-efficient strategies such as self-supervised pretraining and semi-supervised learning are expected to ease this burden, yet it remains unclear whether they yield reliable delineation and whether the deep models they produce outperform the delineation tools used in practice. We address this in two stages. First, comparing self-supervised objectives with supervised or semi-supervised fine-tuning across one internal and four external datasets, we find that pretraining helps but the objective matters, and that the value of semi-supervised fine-tuning depends on the pretraining objective. Second, we benchmark the selected deep learning model against widely used open-source (NeuroKit2, Prominence, ECGdeli) and commercial (CalECG) tools using three complementary metrics. The model ranks best on every metric and dataset, outperforming the strongest tool by a clear margin on the rhythm-diverse set (mIoU 71.3 vs. 54.8%; averaged point-wise sensitivity 92.6 vs. 76.4%), and degrades the least from sinus to arrhythmia. A rhythm-stratified and point-wise analysis further characterizes the distinctive behavior of each tool, yielding practical guidance for tool selection. These results provide systematic, multi-dataset evidence that self-supervised pretraining is effective for ECG delineation and enables a label-efficiently trained deep learning model to outperform widely used delineation tools by leveraging abundant unlabeled data. This supports adopting such models in diverse, real-world clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了自监督预训练在半监督微调下对心电波形边界分割(delineation)的效果，并将所得深度学习模型与主流开源及商业工具进行基准对比，证明其可借助大量无标签数据在标签高效条件下超越现有工具。
AI.motivation: ECG波形边界分割是将原始心电信号转化为可临床解读测量指标的基础步骤。深度学习虽已推动该任务，但依赖昂贵的专家标注。自监督预训练与半监督学习等标签高效策略有望缓解标注负担，但这些策略能否产生可靠的delineation结果、其模型能否胜过临床实际使用的工具尚不明确。
AI.method: 研究分两阶段：(1) 在1个内部数据集与4个外部数据集上，比较不同自监督目标配合监督或半监督微调的表现；(2) 将筛选出的深度学习模型与常用开源工具(NeuroKit2、Prominence、ECGdeli)及商业工具(CalECG)进行基准对比，采用三种互补指标，并做节律分层与逐点分析。
AI.result: 预训练有帮助但目标函数选择很关键，半监督微调的价值取决于预训练目标。在与工具的基准对比中，该模型在所有指标与数据集上均排名第一，在节律多样集上明显优于最强工具(mIoU 71.3% vs. 54.8%；平均逐点敏感度92.6% vs. 76.4%)，且从窦性心律到心律失常的性能下降最小。节律分层与逐点分析刻画了各工具的独特行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了系统性的多数据集证据，表明自监督预训练对ECG delineation有效，使标签高效训练的深度学习模型能借助大量无标签数据超越广泛使用的delineation工具，支持此类模型在多样的真实临床场景中应用。

title: Visual Abstention in Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://visual-abstention.github.io
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate understanding and generation, yet their generative behavior is rarely governed by what they understand about the task. We formalize visual abstention: when a requested visual transformation is impossible under the task's rules, the model should recognize that no valid solution exists, state this, and decline to generate. We introduce Draw-or-Decline (DoD), a benchmark of 1,050 feasible-infeasible request pairs across 7 task categories that jointly measures editing success and the refusal of infeasible requests. Evaluating 8 UMMs, we find that editing ability and abstention are distinct capabilities: even the strongest editor, at 68.4% editing accuracy, refuses only 0.4% of infeasible requests under ordinary instructions. Their reasoning shows why: the models rarely notice the conflict, and instead plan the edit as if the request were possible, often describing objects that are not in the image, or quietly change the request into one they can complete. Explicitly prompting these UMMs to report infeasibility increases textual refusals but reduces editing accuracy. We propose VisTA (Visual Transformation and Abstention), a training method that pairs feasible and infeasible examples so that a model judges feasibility before deciding whether to generate. We train VisTA-BAGEL to perform feasible edits and decline infeasible requests. Without any reminder, it refuses 93.0% of infeasible requests, up from 0.4% for the strongest editor, while falsely refusing only 0.8% of feasible ones. Unlike a reminder, this does not cost editing accuracy: VisTA-BAGEL completes 74.3% of feasible edits, more than any of the 8 evaluated UMMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"视觉弃权"概念与Draw-or-Decline (DoD)基准，揭示统一多模态模型的编辑能力与弃权能力相互独立，并提出VisTA训练方法使模型在生成前判断可行性，从而大幅提升对不可行请求的拒绝率且不损失编辑精度。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）整合了理解与生成能力，但其生成行为很少受到"对任务的理解"的约束。当请求的视觉变换在任务规则下不可能实现时，模型本应识别无解、说明原因并拒绝生成，但现有模型往往并未如此。作者因此希望形式化"视觉弃权"问题，并检验UMMs是否具备这一能力。
AI.method: 1）提出Draw-or-Decline (DoD)基准，包含7个任务类别、1,050对"可行-不可行"请求，同时衡量编辑成功率与对不可行请求的拒绝率；2）评估8个UMMs，分析其推理过程；3）提出VisTA（Visual Transformation and Abstention）训练方法，将可行与不可行样本配对，使模型在决定是否生成前先判断可行性；4）训练VisTA-BAGEL进行可行编辑并拒绝不可行请求。
AI.result: 编辑能力与弃权能力是两种不同的能力：最强的编辑模型编辑准确率为68.4%，但在普通指令下仅拒绝0.4%的不可行请求。其推理显示模型很少察觉冲突，而是按请求可行的假设去规划编辑，常描述图中不存在的物体，或悄悄把请求改成自己能完成的任务。显式提示模型报告不可行性可提高文本拒绝率，但会降低编辑准确率。VisTA-BAGEL在无提示下拒绝93.0%的不可行请求（相比最强编辑器的0.4%），对可行请求的误拒率仅0.8%，且完成74.3%的可行编辑，超过所评估的8个UMMs。
AI.conclusion: UMMs的编辑能力与弃权能力相互独立，仅靠提示无法兼顾二者。通过配对可行与不可行样本进行训练（VisTA），可让模型在生成前进行可行性判断，从而在不损失编辑精度的前提下实现高拒绝率，兼顾编辑成功与合理弃权。

title: Rethinking Faithfulness in LLMs: A Pairwise Context-Sensitive Perspective
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer questions faithfully based on the provided context, abstaining when the context information is insufficient to answer the questions. Existing faithfulness evaluations typically assess each question-context instance in isolation; however, such instance-level evaluation fails to capture a fundamental requirement of faithful behavior: the ability to adapt model responses to changes in available contexts. In particular, a model should provide correct answers when sufficient evidence is present and abstain when it is not. In this work, we propose a Pairwise Faithfulness Benchmark (PFaithBench) that evaluates whether a model can switch between answering and abstaining for the same question under supporting versus non-supporting contexts. Our evaluations across thirty-nine models with seven model families demonstrate that faithfulness fundamentally involves a trade-off between answering and abstaining, and that most current models exhibit a strong bias toward answering, with most faithfulness errors arising from over-answering, i.e., models tend to fabricate a response even when the provided context is insufficient. We further conduct a series of studies on faithfulness training under different data constructions. Our results show that training outcomes are highly sensitive to the specific composition of answering and abstaining data. Constructing answering and abstaining data from mismatched sources can cause models to rely on dataset-specific shortcuts rather than actual context sufficiency. Moreover, increasing answer-supervised data improves answering performance but exacerbates over-answering, while increasing abstaining data reduces hallucination but leads to over-abstention. The code and data are released at https://github.com/tmlr-group/PFaithBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出配对式忠实性基准PFaithBench，评估模型能否在同一问题的支持性/非支持性上下文中切换"回答"与"弃答"，发现忠实性本质是回答与弃答的权衡，多数模型偏向过度回答。
AI.motivation: 现有忠实性评估多为孤立地考察单个"问题-上下文"实例，无法捕捉忠实行为的核心要求——根据上下文是否充分灵活调整回答或弃答，即对上下文变化的适应能力。
AI.method: 提出PFaithBench：针对同一问题，构造支持性与非支持性上下文配对，检验模型能否在"作答"与"弃答"之间正确切换。对39个模型、7个模型家族进行评测，并开展不同数据构造方式下的忠实性训练研究。
AI.result: 评测显示忠实性本质上是"回答"与"弃答"之间的权衡，多数现有模型存在强烈的"作答偏向"，忠实性错误主要来自过度回答（上下文不足时仍编造答案）。训练实验表明：训练结果对回答/弃答数据的构成高度敏感；用不匹配来源构造两类数据会诱导模型依赖数据集特定捷径而非真实的上下文充分性；增加答案监督数据提升作答表现但加剧过度回答，增加弃答数据减少幻觉却导致过度弃答。
AI.conclusion: 忠实性应被理解为回答与弃答之间的权衡，而非孤立实例上的正确率；构建忠实模型需谨慎设计回答与弃答数据的组成，避免捷径与单侧偏置，代码与数据已开源。

title: ARIA: Audio-Driven Melody-Tone Relation Modeling for Cantonese Lyric Authoring
comment: Accepted for publication in Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, including references and appendices. Author-prepared version
summary: Cantonese lyric writing requires close alignment between lexical tones and melodic pitch. Existing melody-guided lyric generation methods typically rely on symbolic melody to generate lyrics. However, in real songwriting scenarios, melodies are often expressed as raw singing audio or hummed recordings, where pitch is implicit, noisy, and unstructured, making these methods difficult to apply directly. To address this limitation, we propose ARIA, a two-stage audio-driven melody-tone relation modeling framework for Cantonese lyric authoring that generates Cantonese lyrics from singing recordings with provided character-level timestamps. Specifically, we first design a Tri-Stream Relation-Aware Tone Estimator (TRATE) to predict 0243 sequences from timestamped singing audio by modeling multi-stream acoustic cues and relational tonal structure. We then propose a Decoupled Retrieval-Augmented Tone-Conditioned Lyric Generator (DRA-TCLG) to generate fluent lyrics conditioned on predicted tonal plans with retrieval-enhanced lexical guidance. Moreover, we construct a large-scale aligned audio-Jyutping-0243 dataset from real Cantonese singing recordings to support this new task. Experimental results demonstrate that ARIA achieves strong performance in both 0243 prediction and tone-consistent lyric generation, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出ARIA两阶段音频驱动框架，从带时间戳的演唱音频生成粤语歌词，通过TRATE预测0243声调序列，再用DRA-TCLG生成声调一致的歌词，并构建了大规模对齐数据集。
AI.motivation: 粤语作词要求字调与旋律音高紧密对齐。现有旋律引导的歌词生成方法依赖符号化旋律，而真实创作场景中旋律常以原始演唱音频或哼唱录音形式存在，其音高隐含、含噪且非结构化，导致已有方法难以直接应用。
AI.method: ARIA为两阶段音频驱动旋律-声调关系建模框架。第一阶段设计三流关系感知声调估计器（TRATE），通过建模多流声学线索与关系型声调结构，从带时间戳的演唱音频预测0243序列；第二阶段提出解耦检索增强声调条件歌词生成器（DRA-TCLG），以预测的声调规划为条件，结合检索增强的词汇引导生成流畅歌词。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ARIA在0243声调预测与声调一致的歌词生成两项任务上均取得强劲性能，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将粤语歌词生成从符号旋律扩展到真实演唱音频输入，构建了大规模对齐的音频-Jyutping-0243数据集以支撑新任务，证明了音频驱动声调建模与检索增强生成结合的可行性。

title: Unsupervised Long-Tailed Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary: Adapting vision-language models to downstream tasks has achieved remarkable success by leveraging pseudo-labels generated from unlabeled data. Existing methods typically assume a uniform unlabeled data distribution, and thus the resulting pseudo-label distribution is likewise uniform. However, real-world data distributions are often long-tailed. To tackle this, we formalize a new scenario termed Unsupervised Long-Tailed Adaptation (ULTA). Under this scenario, existing methods exhibit a contrasting phenomenon: head-class performance drops sharply, which is distinct from supervised long-tailed learning where tail classes suffer the most. In particular, we uncover that the distributional mismatch not only erodes head-class boundaries, but also pushes head samples into confusable classes, reinforcing the model's inherent bias. To address these issues, we propose a novel model called Margin-Aware Refinement with Structural alignment (MARS). Specifically, we mitigate head-class boundary erosion via Boundary-Preserving Alignment, which takes the zero-shot VLM as a fixed visual reference to suppress probability increases that lack visual support in the training targets. Building upon this, we introduce Margin-aware Self-Refinement, which employs a dynamic adjustment strategy to refine tail and confusable classes while preventing prediction bias. Extensive experiments on nine benchmark datasets demonstrate that MARS outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 4.71 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无监督长尾适配（ULTA）新场景，并设计MARS模型，通过边界保持对齐与边缘感知自精炼解决头类边界侵蚀与混淆问题，在九个数据集上平均提升4.71个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型的下游适配方法通常假设无标签数据为均匀分布，从而伪标签分布也均匀；但真实数据往往呈长尾分布。该分布失配导致头类性能急剧下降，且分布错配会侵蚀头类决策边界、将头类样本推入易混淆类别，进一步强化模型固有偏差。
AI.method: 提出MARS（Margin-Aware Refinement with Structural alignment）模型，包含两个核心组件：一是Boundary-Preserving Alignment，以零样本VLM作为固定视觉参照，抑制训练目标中缺乏视觉支持的概率上升，缓解头类边界侵蚀；二是Margin-aware Self-Refinement，采用动态调整策略精炼尾部类与易混淆类，同时防止预测偏差。
AI.result: 在九个基准数据集上，MARS优于当前最先进方法，平均准确率提升4.71个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过形式化无监督长尾适配场景并针对分布失配问题设计结构对齐与边缘感知精炼机制，可有效缓解头类边界侵蚀与混淆偏差，显著提升长尾适配性能。

title: Isotropic Yet Undecodable: The Sequential Content-Sufficiency Gap in Latent-Predictive Text Representations
summary: We study sequential content sufficiency by investigating whether a representation retains the ordered target information available in its input. An information-theoretic decomposition separates input ambiguity, representation loss, and readout mismatch. We construct recoverable views where perfect agreement and joint isotropic Gaussianity coexist with zero target information, and establish limits imposed by deterministic canonical anchors. Token log-loss provides a one-sided information-loss bound; a fixed-penalty ridge analysis shows why rank alone cannot determine prediction risk. These results motivate CANOPE, a nonautoregressive framework with ordered latent canvases, canonical-token supervision, and geometric regularization. On 40,000 validation sequences, latent-agreement (PL0) and token-grounded (PL2) have nearly identical pooled ranks but reach 13.5% and 98.8% positional Recall@1, respectively, under strong natural corruption when the correct target length is provided. On 3,930 LJSpeech validation utterances, frozen PL2 with a trained MatchaTTS readout yields 21.54% word error rate (WER) on corrupted text, versus 99.22% for frozen PL0, while end-to-end MatchaTTS reaches 10.93%. These results show that geometric regularity alone does not guarantee recoverable sequential content or effective downstream access in the text settings studied here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息论分解框架研究序列内容充分性，揭示表示几何正则不等价于目标信息可恢复，并提出CANOPE非自回归框架验证该结论。
AI.motivation: 探究表示是否保留了输入中有序的目标信息，澄清"表示一致性/几何正则"与"序列内容可恢复性"之间的区别。
AI.method: 通过信息论分解将输入歧义、表示损失与读出失配分离；构造可恢复视图证明完美一致性与联合各向同性高斯性可与零目标信息共存；用确定性规范锚点给出限制；采用token log-loss作为单侧信息损失界；用固定惩罚岭分析说明秩无法决定预测风险；据此提出CANOPE（有序潜画布、规范token监督、几何正则化的非自回归框架）。
AI.result: 40,000条验证序列上，PL0与PL2池化秩几乎相同，但位置Recall@1分别为13.5%与98.8%；3,930条LJSpeech验证语音上，冻结PL2配合训练好的MatchaTTS读出得到21.54% WER，冻结PL0为99.22%，端到端MatchaTTS为10.93%。
AI.conclusion: 几何正则性本身并不能保证序列内容可恢复，也不能保证在文本场景下有效下游访问。

title: Diverse Motion Customization via Control-based Dynamic Optimization
summary: Despite recent advances in video generation, motion customization remains challenging due to content leakage, where appearance attributes from the reference video unintentionally propagate into the generated output. We identify this issue as a consequence of the generative process collapsing toward the reference video, which arises from formulating the learning objective as a direct regression on the reference. To address this, we propose Control-based Motion Customization (CMC), a principled training framework that is structurally robust to content leakage. Our key idea is to steer generative dynamics toward desired motion while avoiding collapse toward the reference video, which we formalize using Stochastic Optimal Control (SOC). Under this formulation, customized videos acquire the target motion yet remain within the pre-trained model's prompt-conditional distribution, where appearance is determined by the text prompt rather than the reference video. Furthermore, to improve efficiency, we tailor the SOC formulation to motion customization by eliminating the need for an explicit reward and introducing a timestep-adaptive motion cost that focuses only on early generative stages, accelerating training by 2.5 times. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CMC effectively mitigates content leakage and achieves competitive motion fidelity while preserving the diversity of the base model across diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于控制的运动定制框架CMC，将运动定制建模为随机最优控制问题，从结构上解决参考视频内容泄漏问题，并在效率上提升2.5倍。
AI.motivation: 视频生成中的运动定制存在内容泄漏问题：参考视频的外观属性会意外传播到生成结果中。作者将此归因于生成过程向参考视频坍塌，根源在于把学习目标直接表述为对参考视频的回归。
AI.method: 提出Control-based Motion Customization（CMC）训练框架。核心是用随机最优控制（SOC）形式化问题，引导生成动力学朝向目标运动，同时避免向参考视频坍塌，使定制视频获得目标运动但保持在预训练模型的提示条件分布内。为提高效率，进一步将SOC适配到运动定制，省去显式奖励，并引入仅关注早期生成阶段的时间步自适应运动代价。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CMC有效缓解内容泄漏，在多种场景下取得有竞争力的运动保真度，同时保持基模型的多样性；训练加速2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将运动定制形式化为随机最优控制问题，CMC在结构上对内容泄漏具有鲁棒性，实现了运动保真度与基模型多样性的良好平衡，并显著提升训练效率。

title: Multimodal Knowledge Distillation for Gastric Adenocarcinoma Classification from Whole-Slide Images
summary: Gastric adenocarcinoma (GA) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and accurate histopathological subtype classification from whole-slide images (WSIs) is essential for effective treatment planning. While multimodal approaches that integrate pathology report text with WSIs can improve classification, existing methods often depend on computationally expensive transformer architectures and large language models. We propose a multimodal knowledge distillation (MKD) framework that combines a pretrained WSI image encoder and a clinical text encoder using Low-Rank Multimodal Fusion (LMF) to efficiently model cross-modal interactions during training. Each WSI is represented as a bag of patches paired with a slide-level diagnostic caption. The teacher model learns fused image-text representations for subtype classification, while the student model distills this knowledge to enable accurate image-only inference. We evaluate our method on the PatchGastric benchmark dataset and achieve at least 3.35% higher mean accuracy than state-of-the-art approaches, without relying on transformer-based fusion, multi-task learning, or large language models. The source code is available at https://github.com/helomelo1/MKD-LMF.

AI.tldr: 提出MKD框架，用低秩多模态融合结合图像与文本编码器，在训练中建模跨模态交互，使学生模型仅用图像即可实现胃腺癌亚型分类，精度超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 胃腺癌（GA）是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因，从全切片图像（WSI）中准确分类组织病理学亚型对治疗规划至关重要。现有多模态方法虽整合病理报告文本与WSI以提升分类性能，但往往依赖计算昂贵的Transformer架构和大语言模型。
AI.method: 提出多模态知识蒸馏（MKD）框架：结合预训练WSI图像编码器与临床文本编码器，采用低秩多模态融合（LMF）在训练中高效建模跨模态交互。每张WSI表示为配对的图块包（bag of patches）及切片级诊断描述。教师模型学习融合的图像-文本表示用于亚型分类，学生模型蒸馏该知识以实现仅图像推理。
AI.result: 在PatchGastric基准数据集上，平均准确率比现有最优方法至少高出3.35%，且不依赖基于Transformer的融合、多任务学习或大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: MKD-LMF以轻量高效的方式实现多模态知识迁移，在仅图像推理场景下取得领先的分类精度，代码已开源。

title: Can We Model the Artifacts Explicitly? Disentangle Artifacts via Pairwise Edit Relations for Image Manipulation Localization
summary: Image Manipulation Localization (IML) is commonly formulated as a fully supervised learning task that estimates the optimal manipulation mask $y$ for a given image $x$.
