In this work, we first reveal the latent nature of artifacts and thus reinterpret IML as a latent-variable problem, $P(y|x)=\int P(y|z)\,P(z|x)\,dz$, where $z$ denotes the artifacts. Following this interpretation, we pinpoint the cause for the current IML models' insufficiency as their implicit artifacts modeling strategy, highlighting the necessity of modeling $z$ in an explicit manner. Without direct labels, feature disentanglement is the most appropriate solution for this explicit modeling. Accordingly, we propose a two-stage learning paradigm with the Pairwise Artifacts Learning (PAL) and Standard Localization (SL) phases to estimate $P(z|x)$ and $P(y|z)$ via edit relations. To support our edit-relation-based learning, we further curate EditGroup-45K, a source-anchored dataset organized into edit groups for pair construction. Extensive experiments show that our PAL paradigm yields consistent improvements across diverse IML architectures, and empirical analyses further verify that PAL does capture artifacts explicitly through feature disentanglement. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/venus-guangjian/PAL

AI.tldr: 本文将图像篡改定位(IML)重新解释为隐变量问题，指出传统模型隐式建模伪影的不足，提出显式建模伪影的两阶段学习范式PAL与SL，并构建EditGroup-45K数据集，实验证明其在多种IML架构上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有IML方法普遍采用全监督学习直接估计篡改掩码y，但作者揭示伪影具有潜在(隐变量)特性，现有模型对伪影(z)采用隐式建模策略，导致建模不足、定位能力受限，因此有必要以显式方式建模伪影z。
AI.method: 将IML重述为隐变量问题P(y|x)=∫P(y|z)P(z|x)dz，z表示伪影；由于缺乏伪影直接标签，采用特征解耦进行显式建模。提出两阶段范式：Pairwise Artifacts Learning (PAL)阶段通过编辑关系估计P(z|x)，Standard Localization (SL)阶段估计P(y|z)。同时构建源锚定、按编辑组组织以便配对构造的数据集EditGroup-45K。
AI.result: 在多种IML架构上，PAL范式均带来一致的性能提升；实证分析进一步验证PAL确实通过特征解耦显式捕获了伪影。代码与数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过将IML解释为隐变量问题并显式建模伪影，所提PAL范式具备通用性，可跨架构提升篡改定位性能，且特征解耦能有效实现伪影的显式表征。

title: OpenWAM: An Open Framework for Composable World-Action Models
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://openwam.stanford.edu ; Code: https://github.com/OpenWAM/OpenWAM ; Code and project page released June 4, 2026. Equal contribution: Heng Yu, David D. Yuan, Juze Zhang
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple future prediction with robot control, yet existing systems often vary the video backbone, interaction structure, supervision, and inference procedure simultaneously, making their design choices difficult to compare. We introduce OPENWAM, an open world-action modeling framework built around a common causal robot-video foundation and configurable video-action interaction. Starting from Wan2.2-5B, we perform causal robot-video pretraining on over 10,000 hours of video, then integrate an action expert through a shared Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports joint, video-then-action, action-then-video, and decoupled generation. OPENWAM achieves high success rates on four LIBERO suites and real-world bimanual tasks; robot-video training with causal adaptation improves VTA success on LIBERO-Long from 68.4% to 97.8%. The same configurable architecture naturally extends to inverse and forward dynamics, allowing us to study how counterfactual transitions improve independently trained dynamics models beyond demonstrations alone. When only the video predictor is adapted to a new task, a frozen local-context inverse dynamics model trained on counterfactual data and demonstrations achieves 84.0% mean success across four held-out LIBERO-90 tasks, compared with 47.0% for a full-context inverse model and 21.5% for a local-context model trained only on demonstrations. For forward dynamics, counterfactual supervision reduces RGB prediction error by 34.5% and raises outcome identification from 21.1% to 71.3% among 16 same-state outcomes. OPENWAM provides a common testbed for comparing WAM interaction designs and for studying dynamics learning from video data beyond successful demonstrations.

AI.tldr: OPENWAM 是一个开放式世界-动作建模范式，基于统一因果机器人视频底座与可配置的视频-动作交互结构，系统比较不同 WAM 设计并研究超越成功演示的动力学学习。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）同时改变视频骨干、交互结构、监督方式与推理流程，导致设计选择难以公平比较；本文旨在提供统一测试平台以拆解并对比这些设计维度。
AI.method: 以 Wan2.2-5B 为起点，在超 10,000 小时视频上进行因果机器人视频预训练；通过共享 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构集成动作专家，支持联合、先视频后动作、先动作后视频及解耦四种生成模式，并可自然扩展到逆动力学与前向动力学。
AI.result: 在四个 LIBERO 套件与真实双臂任务上取得高成功率；因果适配的机器人视频训练将 LIBERO-Long 的 VTA 成功率从 68.4% 提升至 97.8%。在四个留出 LIBERO-90 任务上，冻结局部上下文逆动力学模型结合反事实数据与演示达到 84.0% 平均成功率（全上下文 47.0%，仅演示局部上下文 21.5%）。前向动力学中，反事实监督将 RGB 预测误差降低 34.5%，16 个同状态结果识别率从 21.1% 提升至 71.3%。
AI.conclusion: OPENWAM 为比较 WAM 交互设计提供了通用测试平台，并证明反事实监督可显著提升逆/前向动力学学习，使模型能够利用成功演示之外的视频数据。

title: TF-PRVR: Training-Free Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
summary: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) aims to retrieve untrimmed videos containing moments relevant to a given text query. Despite recent progress, existing PRVR methods suffer from two key limitations: a fixed video decomposition scheme that causes semantic dilution, and source-domain overfitting induced by task-specific training. In this paper, we propose TF-PRVR, the first training-free framework for PRVR. TF-PRVR leverages frozen vision-language features to construct video-specific hierarchical representations. It derives temporal semantic signals from frame-level features and applies frequency-based multi-scale analysis to identify adaptive temporal boundaries, producing hierarchical segments with coherent event-level semantics. Built on these segments, TF-PRVR constructs a unified multi-scale graph and propagates query relevance across temporally and semantically related nodes. A moment-aware scoring strategy then aggregates temporally aligned relevance across scales, emphasizing consistently supported moments while suppressing isolated false responses. Without task-specific training, TF-PRVR preserves the general-purpose alignment capability of pre-trained vision-language models and avoids dataset-specific overfitting. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance across datasets with diverse visual and temporal characteristics, suggesting a practical direction for training-free PRVR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TF-PRVR，首个面向部分相关视频检索（PRVR）的免训练框架，利用冻结的视觉-语言特征构建视频特有的层次化表示，通过频率多尺度分析生成自适应时序边界，并在统一多尺度图上传播查询相关性，实现跨数据集的一致性能，避免源域过拟合。
AI.motivation: 现有 PRVR 方法存在两大局限：（1）固定的视频分解方案导致语义稀释；（2）任务特定的训练引发源域过拟合。作者希望在不进行任务特定训练的前提下，保留预训练视觉-语言模型的通用对齐能力，并适应不同视觉与时序特性的数据集。
AI.method: TF-PRVR 首先基于冻结的视觉-语言特征提取帧级特征中的时序语义信号，采用基于频率的多尺度分析识别自适应时序边界，生成具有连贯事件级语义的层次化片段；随后在这些片段上构建统一的多尺度图，并在时序与语义相关的节点间传播查询相关性；最后采用时刻感知的评分策略，跨尺度聚合时序对齐的相关性，强化持续被支持的时刻并抑制孤立的虚假响应。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TF-PRVR 在具有多样视觉与时序特性的多个数据集上均取得一致的性能表现，验证了免训练 PRVR 方向的实用性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TF-PRVR 作为首个免训练 PRVR 框架，通过层次化时序建模与多尺度图传播克服了语义稀释和源域过拟合问题，为免训练 PRVR 提供了可行且实用的研究方向。

title: Dynamic Alignment and Calibration for Multimodal Learning
summary: Dynamic multimodal learning aims to learn robust representations by adaptively modeling information discrepancies across modalities. However, existing methods still suffer from two limitations: (i) static cross-modal alignment strategies usually impose uniform constraints on all samples while overlooking sample-wise variations, potentially leading to unreasonable over-alignment; and (ii) confidence- or uncertainty-aware fusion methods often fail to adequately account for feature magnitude and confidence differences across modalities. For modality pairs with significant feature magnitude differences or small confidence gaps, it might be unreliable to strictly align fusion weights according to confidence. To address these issues, we propose an Alignment- and Calibration-driven Multimodal Learning framework (ACML). Specifically, ACML incorporates a dynamic cross-modal triplet alignment module, which enforces strong semantic consistency for high-confidence positive pairs while encouraging diverse representation learning between high- and low-confidence positive pairs according to their confidence gaps. Additionally, ACML introduces a difference-aware attention calibration strategy that adaptively adjusts attention regularization based on feature magnitude and confidence differences across modalities, thereby mitigating biases caused by unreasonable fusion constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal benchmark datasets demonstrate that ACML consistently achieves superior performance and robustness over recent state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对齐-校准驱动的多模态学习框架ACML，通过动态三元组对齐与差异感知注意力校准解决静态对齐与融合偏差问题，在多个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态学习方法存在两点不足：(i) 静态跨模态对齐策略对所有样本施加统一约束，忽略样本间差异，可能导致不合理的过度对齐；(ii) 基于置信度或不确定性的融合方法未能充分考虑模态间的特征幅度与置信度差异，当特征幅度差异大或置信度差距小时，严格按置信度分配融合权重并不可靠。
AI.method: 提出ACML框架，包含两个核心模块：一是动态跨模态三元组对齐模块，对高置信度正样本对强制强语义一致性，同时依据置信度差距鼓励高、低置信度正样本对之间的多样化表征学习；二是差异感知注意力校准策略，根据模态间特征幅度与置信度差异自适应调整注意力正则化，缓解不合理融合约束带来的偏差。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ACML在性能与鲁棒性上持续优于近期最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: ACML通过样本级动态对齐与差异感知的注意力校准，有效缓解了过度对齐和融合偏差问题，验证了自适应建模模态差异对鲁棒多模态表征学习的有效性。

title: Pseudowords as probes: Large Language Models show little of the sublexical sensitivity that governs human pseudoword processing
summary: Systematicity, the probabilistic mapping of form to meaning, permeates language at all levels, and sublexical cues have been shown to govern human pseudoword processing. Yet whether LLMs exhibit comparable sensitivity to these cues remains unclear. We tested five LLMs on two Italian two-alternative forced-choice pseudoword experiments and compared their responses with a human behavioural baseline. LLMs aligned more reliably with humans when real-word options provided a lexical familiarity cue than in the pseudoword-only condition, where they fell substantially below fastText, a character-n-gram model. In addition, the sublexical cosine-similarity cue that reliably drove human--fastText agreement did not consistently transfer to human--LLM alignment, and reasoning-token expenditure bore no consistent relation to human processing difficulty. These findings suggest that LLMs do not necessarily share the sublexical cues that govern human pseudoword processing; we discuss tokenization and training-data coverage as candidate explanations.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了五个大语言模型（LLM）与人类在意大利语假词加工任务中的表现，发现LLM只有在真实词提供词汇熟悉度线索时才与人类对齐更可靠；在纯假词条件下，其表现显著低于字符n-gram模型fastText，且驱动人类—fastText一致性的亚词汇余弦相似度线索未能稳定迁移至人类—LLM对齐，推理token消耗也与人类加工难度无稳定关系。
AI.motivation: 系统性（形式与意义的概率映射）普遍存在于语言各层面，亚词汇线索已被证明支配人类假词加工；但LLM是否对这类线索具有类似敏感性尚不清楚。本文旨在检验LLM是否共享支配人类假词加工的亚词汇线索。
AI.method: 对五个LLM实施两项意大利语二选一强制选择假词实验，并将其反应与人类行为基线进行比较；同时以字符n-gram模型fastText作为对照，考察亚词汇余弦相似度线索在人类—fastText一致性中的作用能否迁移到人类—LLM对齐，并分析推理token消耗与人类加工难度的关系。
AI.result: 当真实词选项提供词汇熟悉度线索时，LLM与人类对齐更可靠；在纯假词条件下，LLM表现显著低于fastText。可靠驱动人类—fastText一致性的亚词汇余弦相似度线索并未稳定迁移至人类—LLM对齐，推理token消耗与人类加工难度之间也无一致关系。
AI.conclusion: LLM未必共享支配人类假词加工的亚词汇线索；作者将分词方式与训练数据覆盖度作为候选解释进行讨论。

title: Leveraging a four-quadrant approach for evaluating Redpine Science
summary: Redpine Science gives models and agents a single access point to a wide range of peer-reviewed literature, queried directly through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and an API. This report evaluates Redpine Science on two levels: the relevance of the retrieved chunks, and a model's answer when it has access to Redpine Science compared to web search. Both public and expert-validated benchmarks are used. Public benchmarks are a widely accepted way to test model development and are comparable across labs, but risk saturation and memorization. To address this, we complement them with an expert-validated question set. In total, this report presents four evaluations. On ScholarQABench SciFact, the public answer-quality benchmark reported here, an agent with Redpine Science answers 94.4% of claims correctly against 87.6% with no retrieval. On the expert-validated question set, an agent with Redpine Science states 80.1% of the required claims against 70.2% for an agent restricted to web search. On the 668 queries of a public retrieval benchmark whose gold paper Redpine holds, stripped of any model reasoning, Redpine Science places the correct source paper in its top ten results for 83.1% of queries (Recall@10), against 79.3% for the benchmark's creator. A blinded expert relevance panel places Redpine Science's Precision@5 at 75.2% against 39.8% for the PubMed search tool. We release the expert-validated question set and instructions to reproduce every headline result above, at https://github.com/redpine-ai/benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Redpine Science 通过 MCP 与 API 提供单一入口检索同行评审文献。本报告从检索片段相关性与模型答题表现两个层面评估，结合公开基准与专家验证题集，共四项评测，并开源专家题集与复现说明。
AI.motivation: 公开基准虽便于跨实验室比较，但存在饱和与记忆化风险，因此需补充专家验证题集以更可靠地检验检索系统与模型答题能力的真实增益。
AI.method: 采用两类评测：一是检索片段相关性评测（Recall@10、Precision@5），二是模型在接入 Redpine Science 与仅用网页搜索时的答案质量对比；数据上同时使用公开基准（ScholarQABench SciFact、公开检索基准 668 条查询）与专家验证题集，并设置无检索基线、基准创建者及 PubMed 搜索工具作对照。
AI.result: ScholarQABench SciFact 上接入 Redpine Science 的 agent 正确答题率 94.4%，无检索为 87.6%；专家验证题集上陈述必要主张比例 80.1%，仅网页搜索为 70.2%；公开检索基准 668 条查询中 Recall@10 达 83.1%，基准创建者为 79.3%；盲评专家相关性面板 Precision@5 为 75.2%，PubMed 搜索工具为 39.8%。
AI.conclusion: Redpine Science 在检索相关性与模型答题表现上均优于对照基线，检索片段质量与答案质量均获提升；专家验证题集与复现指令已公开，便于后续验证与比较。

title: CCDF: A Benchmark Dataset for Deepfake Detection in Real-World Surveillance Footage
summary: Due to rapid advances in Generative AI, commercial video generation tools can be used to produce fabricated surveillance footage that can fool both human viewers and automated synthetic video detectors. Since these tools are so widely accessible, a malicious user can create a harmful video clip at minimal cost. The production and dissemination of such videos in high-stakes settings, such as crime reporting and elections, can misdirect emergency response efforts or distort political discourse. Existing deepfake video datasets, used by the research community to develop deepfake detection algorithms, exhibit two limitations: (1) they emphasize benign web content rather than footage of possibly malicious activity, and (2) they rely on older or open-source generators that do not represent recent advances in generative systems. We assemble CCtv DeepFakes (CCDF), a video deepfake dataset, to address both gaps. CCDF contains 1840 videos (460 real and 1380 generated) spanning 16 crime and accident categories, with generated content produced using three leading commercial systems: Grok Imagine, Google VEO 3.1, and OpenAI Sora 2. CCDF is a highly realistic, small-scale, manually annotated dataset targeting evaluation of detection models. We release three versions of the dataset: the raw generated data, a cleaned version in which video metadata are standardized between real and synthetic samples to prevent detectors from exploiting trivial cues, and an altered version simulating low-effort post-processing attacks. We evaluate CCDF with ten recent state-of-the-art detectors covering different detection approaches. Our results suggest that these approaches do not reliably distinguish CCDF's generated videos from real ones, despite their strong reported performance on existing datasets. These results further confirm that existing datasets are not well-suited to evaluating certain threats.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了 CCtv DeepFakes（CCDF）数据集，含1840个视频（460真实、1380生成），覆盖16类犯罪与事故场景，由 Grok Imagine、Google VEO 3.1 和 OpenAI Sora 2 生成，并提供原始、元数据标准化清洗版和模拟低强度后处理攻击版；十种最新检测器在其上表现不可靠，表明现有数据集不适于评估此类威胁。
AI.motivation: 商业视频生成工具的普及使恶意者可低成本伪造监控视频，在犯罪举报、选举等高风险场景中误导应急响应或舆论；而现有深伪视频数据集存在两点不足：（1）偏重良性网络内容，缺少疑似恶意活动的影像；（2）依赖较旧或开源生成器，未反映近期生成系统进展。
AI.method: 构建 CCDF 数据集：共1840个视频（460真实、1380生成），涵盖16个犯罪与事故类别，生成内容来自三个领先商业系统 Grok Imagine、Google VEO 3.1、OpenAI Sora 2；数据集为高度逼真、小规模、人工标注，面向检测模型评估。发布三个版本：原始生成数据、清洗版（统一真实与合成样本的视频元数据，防止检测器利用琐碎线索）、以及模拟低成本后处理攻击的改版。使用十种近期最先进检测器（覆盖不同检测思路）进行评测。
AI.result: 十种先进检测方法难以可靠区分 CCDF 中的生成视频与真实视频，尽管它们在既有数据集上报告了强劲性能；结果进一步证实现有数据集不适合评估特定威胁。
AI.conclusion: 现有深伪检测器在面对商业生成系统产出的、贴近高风险场景的伪造监控视频时泛化能力不足；CCDF 填补了内容主题与生成器代际两方面的空白，可作为评估相关威胁的更合适基准，并提示需发展更鲁棒的检测方法。

title: Hybrid Latent Attention for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models apply the same stack of layers T times to each token, which deepens the model without adding parameters but multiplies its key-value (KV) cache by T. The larger cache limits how many sequences a GPU can decode at once and slows each decoding step, which reads the whole cache. We propose Hybrid Latent Attention (HLA), which keeps exact keys and values within a sliding window of W recent tokens and stores each older token as a compact latent that the query of each loop reads directly, without reconstructing keys and values. We uptrain HLA on Ouro looped models (T=4) with 1.4B and 2.6B parameters, keeping the pretrained weights frozen and training only the added parameters to reproduce the original attention. The cache shrinks by 10.7x per token, fitting 4.0-8.8x as many concurrent sequences per GPU, and decoding throughput improves by 2.5x at 1K-token contexts and by up to 7.4x at 16K. HLA retains over 97% of the original accuracy on math, knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, and 96-100% on long-context retrieval up to 16K tokens. After supervised fine-tuning, it performs on par with the fine-tuned original model on competition-level math.

AI.tldr: 提出混合潜在注意力(HLA),将滑窗外的历史token压缩为潜在表示供查询直接读取,在Ouro循环模型(T=4)上缓存缩小10.7倍,吞吐提升2.5-7.4倍,精度保持97%以上。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型对每个token重复应用同一层堆栈T次,在不增加参数的情况下加深模型,但KV缓存随之扩大T倍。更大的缓存限制了GPU可同时解码的序列数,并使每步解码(需读取整个缓存)变慢,因此需要一种能在循环模型中压缩缓存、同时保持注意力效果的方法。
AI.method: 提出混合潜在注意力(HLA):对最近W个token保留精确的键和值(滑窗),对更早的每个token存储紧凑的潜在表示,每个循环的查询直接读取该潜在表示,而无需重建键和值。在Ouro循环模型(T=4,1.4B与2.6B参数)上进行uptrain,冻结预训练权重,仅训练新增参数以复现原始注意力。
AI.result: 每token缓存缩小10.7倍,单GPU可容纳4.0-8.8倍的并发序列;解码吞吐在1K上下文提升2.5倍,16K上下文最高提升7.4倍。在数学、知识和推理基准上保留原模型97%以上精度,16K以内长上下文检索保留96-100%。监督微调后在竞赛级数学任务上与微调后的原模型持平。
AI.conclusion: HLA通过滑窗精确KV与窗口外潜在表示的结合,有效缓解了循环模型KV缓存随T倍增的问题,在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅提升缓存容量与解码吞吐,是一种面向循环语言模型的高效注意力方案。

title: UltraDiff: Differentiable Ray Tracing in Ultrasound for Shape Optimization
comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted at SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: Physically-based differentiable rendering enables gradient-based optimization of scene parameters by matching rendered images to measurements, but has so far mainly focused on light transport. We extend this paradigm to medical ultrasound, where image formation resembles transient rendering: echoes are binned by time-of-flight rather than projected onto an image plane. We present UltraDiff, a modular framework for differentiable ultrasound ray tracing. UltraDiff formulates ultrasound image formation as a path-space integral, gated by travel time between the transducer and tissue interfaces, and derives a Monte Carlo estimator of both the forward model and its gradients with respect to scene parameters. We demonstrate this on an inverse geometry estimation: starting from a sphere, an SDF is optimized until simulated echoes match measured ones, recovering vertebral surfaces from simulated B-mode sweeps and from a real robotic acquisition of a spine phantom. Unlike state-of-the-art ultrasound shape reconstruction methods, which rely on pre-segmented images, our approach operates unsupervised on B-mode images through analysis-by-synthesis, while achieving competitive geometric accuracy. Implemented on top of Mitsuba 3, UltraDiff brings differentiable path tracing to a new sensing modality and provides a foundation for inverse problems in acoustic imaging.

AI.tldr: 提出UltraDiff，一个基于可微路径追踪的超声射线追踪模块化框架，将超声成像建模为受飞行时间门控的路径空间积分，推导前向与梯度的蒙特卡洛估计器，并在脊椎表面几何反演任务上实现无监督的B模式图像分析-合成重建。
AI.motivation: 可微渲染已通过图像与测量匹配实现场景参数的梯度优化，但此前主要集中于光传输（光学成像）。作者希望将该范式扩展到医学超声成像：超声图像形成类似瞬态渲染——回波按飞行时间分箱而非投影到像平面。同时，现有超声形状重建方法依赖预分割图像，缺乏端到端、无监督的可微反演框架。
AI.method: 将超声图像形成表述为路径空间积分，由换能器与组织界面之间的传播时间进行门控（gating），并推导出前向模型及其关于场景参数梯度的蒙特卡洛估计器。基于Mitsuba 3实现可微超声路径追踪。在逆几何估计任务中，从球体初始化的SDF出发进行优化，使模拟回波与实测回波匹配，从而恢复脊椎表面。
AI.result: 在模拟B模式扫描以及真实机器人采集的脊柱体模数据上成功恢复脊椎表面几何。与依赖预分割图像的现有超声形状重建方法相比，本方法在B模式图像上以分析-合成方式无监督运行，并取得具有竞争力的几何精度。
AI.conclusion: UltraDiff将可微路径追踪引入超声这一新的感知模态，为声学成像中的逆问题提供了可微框架基础。

title: Confidence Reasoning Graphs: Structured Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
summary: When using an LLM agent in a consequential domain, making an informed decision about whether to trust its output or intervene requires calibrated confidence in the agent's success. Confidence estimation for agents is difficult because evidence about success is distributed across heterogeneous, interdependent steps of an agent's trajectory. Practical agentic deployments introduce further challenges: frontier LLMs often provide limited access to internal signals, agent roll-outs are costly, and training data may be unavailable or quickly become outdated. To address these challenges, we introduce Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs), an inference-time framework that estimates the probability an agent accomplished its task from a single trajectory, without privileged model access or training data. Rather than compressing an execution into a single holistic judgment, a CRG begins with the claim that the agent accomplished its task, decomposes it into contextualized sub-claims grounded in trajectory evidence, estimates confidence for each terminal claim, and finally aggregates these into an overall confidence estimate. Across three agentic benchmarks, three backbone models, and three agent frameworks, CRGs yield better-calibrated confidence and stronger risk-aware decision making than verbalized, sampling-based, and white-box surrogate baselines. We further find that calibration error alone can be misleading: a white-box surrogate baseline appears well calibrated while providing near-chance discrimination. Ablations attribute CRG's improvements to claim-level confidence estimation and aggregation rather than graph construction alone. Finally, a CRG exposes the claims and trajectory evidence underlying each confidence estimate, enabling it to be audited at decision time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs)，一种推理时置信度估计框架，从单条轨迹中估计智能体任务成功概率，无需特权模型访问或训练数据，通过将成功声明分解为基于轨迹证据的子声明并逐层聚合置信度，在多个基准上实现更优校准与风险决策。
AI.motivation: 在关键领域使用 LLM 智能体时，判断是否信任其输出或介入需要校准良好的成功置信度。然而智能体置信度估计困难：成功证据分散在异构、相互依赖的轨迹步骤中；实际部署还面临前沿 LLM 内部信号访问受限、轨迹 rollout 成本高、训练数据不可用或迅速过时等挑战。
AI.method: 提出 Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRG)，一种推理时框架。它以"智能体完成了任务"这一声明为起点，将其分解为基于轨迹证据的上下文子声明，对每个终端声明估计置信度，最后聚合成整体置信度估计。该方法不依赖特权模型访问或训练数据，也不将执行压缩为单一整体判断。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准、三种骨干模型和三种智能体框架上，CRG 比言语化、基于采样和白盒代理基线具有更好的校准置信度和更强的风险感知决策能力。研究还发现仅看校准误差可能具有误导性：白盒代理基线看似校准良好，但区分能力接近随机。消融实验表明 CRG 的提升来自声明级置信度估计与聚合，而非仅图构建。CRG 还暴露了每个置信度估计背后的声明与轨迹证据，便于决策时审计。
AI.conclusion: CRG 提供了一种无需特权访问和训练数据的推理时置信度估计方案，在多种设置下优于现有基线，并具备可审计性，为智能体部署中的信任决策提供了实用支持。

title: Revisiting Numerical Forecasting Models for Language-Based Trajectory Prediction
summary: Language-based trajectory predictors represent coordinates as discrete tokens and learn auxiliary tasks such as destination and group reasoning. This formulation enables the model to capture behavioral intent and social context beyond coordinate dynamics alone. However, token-level objectives provide only indirect guidance for continuous coordinate-space dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce MoRE (Mixture of Reward Experts), a refinement framework that transfers numerical forecasting priors into a pretrained language-based predictor through reinforcement learning. Five frozen numerical predictors provide complementary coordinate-level knowledge of motion and interactions. Their predictions are converted into expert rewards and combined through an uncertainty-weighted consensus that penalizes disagreement. A ground-truth reward anchors the prediction to the target trajectory. To focus refinement on difficult cases, MoRE refines the policy using the top 1% of training samples ranked by predictive entropy. Expert predictions are computed once and cached before PPO training, so the experts are not run during policy updates or inference. In this way, MoRE combines the contextual modeling of the language-based predictor with coordinate-level feedback from numerical experts. On ETH-UCY, MoRE reduces ADE from 0.22 to 0.20 m and FDE from 0.32 to 0.29 m. Relative to the base policy, ADE decreases by 17.9% on SDD and 12.7% on NBA. On ETH-UCY, MoRE also reduces collision rates and better matches ground-truth pedestrian spacing, without increasing measured inference memory or latency. The project page is available at https://jungyu0413.github.io/MoRE/.

AI.tldr: MoRE提出一种基于强化学习的精炼框架，将多个数值预测器的坐标级先验通过奖励专家机制迁移到预训练的语言轨迹预测器中，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升预测精度与社交合理性。
AI.motivation: 语言基轨迹预测器以离散token建模坐标并学习目的地、群体推理等辅助任务，能捕捉行为意图与社交语境，但token级目标只能为连续坐标空间动力学提供间接指导，缺乏坐标级的直接监督信号。
AI.method: MoRE使用五个冻结的数值预测器提供互补的坐标级运动与交互知识，将其预测转化为专家奖励，并通过不确定性加权共识（对分歧进行惩罚）进行组合；同时引入真实轨迹奖励作为锚定。精炼仅针对由预测熵排序的前1%困难样本进行。专家预测在PPO训练前一次性计算并缓存，因此策略更新与推理阶段均不运行专家，最终实现语言预测器的语境建模能力与数值专家的坐标级反馈相融合。
AI.result: 在ETH-UCY上，ADE由0.22 m降至0.20 m，FDE由0.32 m降至0.29 m；相对基础策略，SDD上ADE降低17.9%，NBA上降低12.7%。在ETH-UCY上还降低了碰撞率，并更贴近真实行人间距，且未增加实测推理内存或延迟。
AI.conclusion: MoRE通过不确定性加权的专家奖励共识与困难样本聚焦的强化学习精炼，有效将数值预测先验注入语言基轨迹预测器，在多个数据集上提升精度与社交合理性，同时保持推理效率不变。

title: DensiTok: Making Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting See More Views Than It Is Given
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene in a single forward pass, replacing per-scene optimization with a network trained across many scenes. Its quality, however, degrades sharply as the number of input images drops. The bottleneck is upstream of the reconstruction heads: from a few unposed views, the internal representation they read carries no evidence for unobserved regions, leaving holes, floaters, and blur. The common remedy supplies that evidence as pixels, synthesizing extra views with an image or video generator and re-encoding them, which is costly and not 3D-consistent by construction. We instead densify the evidence itself. We present DensiTok, a plug-in module for pretrained feed-forward 3DGS models that densifies their internal geometry tokens directly, making a frozen backbone behave as though it had observed many more views than it was given. DensiTok compresses those tokens into a compact latent space, completes the latents of the unobserved viewpoints in a single flow-matching step conditioned on camera geometry, and decodes them back into tokens that the original reconstruction heads. The same module design can be integrated into different pretrained predictors while keeping each backbone and its reconstruction heads frozen. Completion in a low-dimensional latent space requires no image synthesis or additional encoder passes. Across three pretrained backbones and two benchmarks, DensiTok consistently improves sparse-view reconstruction and recovers much of the gap to dense-view reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用模块 DensiTok，直接在隐空间稠密化前馈 3DGS 模型的内部几何 token，实现稀疏视角重建的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 前馈 3DGS 的稀疏视角性能瓶颈在于上游内部表征缺乏未观测区域的证据，导致空洞、悬浮物与模糊；常用补救方案依赖图像/视频生成器合成像素，成本高且本身不具备 3D 一致性。
AI.method: DensiTok 将冻结骨干网络中的几何 token 压缩到紧凑隐空间，以相机几何为条件，通过单步 flow matching 补全未观测视角的隐变量，再解码回 token 供原重建头使用；无需图像合成或额外编码器前向，且骨干与重建头均保持冻结。
AI.result: 在 3 个预训练骨干和 2 个基准上，DensiTok 一致提升稀疏视角重建质量，并缩小了与稠密视角重建之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过稠密化内部证据而非合成像素，DensiTok 使冻结骨干表现为观测了更多视角，验证了隐空间生成式补全作为通用增强模块的有效性。

title: EmbodiedSmith: Scaling Embodied Data through Recursive Self-Improvement Flywheel in Simulation
summary: Scaling robotic foundation models requires diverse training data and reliable evaluation environments. Simulation offers a scalable solution, yet existing generation pipelines remain constrained by predefined assets and skills, a disconnect between scene generation and task generation, and limited support for complex embodiments and physics. We introduce EmbodiedSmith, a framework for scalable embodied data generation through recursive self-improvement (RSI). EmbodiedSmith unifies asset, scene, and task generation in a pipeline that supports autonomous creation and language-driven customization. Its core is an agentic refinement loop: scene generation anticipates downstream task requirements, while task generation guides targeted scene edits, allowing scenes and tasks to iteratively improve one another. This joint refinement improves task generation success, including for long-horizon tasks. The framework further supports mobile manipulators, humanoids, and dexterous hands, as well as interactions involving deformable objects and fluids, broadening the range of behaviors and physical phenomena represented in generated data. Together, these capabilities provide a flexible simulation engine for both robot pretraining and evaluation. Extensive experiments validate the quality, diversity, and generation efficiency of the resulting data, while downstream policy experiments demonstrate that increased data diversity improves generalization.

AI.tldr: EmbodiedSmith：通过递归自我改进（RSI）统一资产、场景与任务生成，支持复杂本体与物理交互的可扩展具身数据生成框架。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型扩展依赖多样化训练数据与可靠评测环境。仿真可扩展，但现有生成流水线受限于预设资产与技能、场景生成与任务生成脱节、以及对复杂本体与物理支持不足。
AI.method: 提出 EmbodiedSmith 框架，将资产、场景与任务生成统一于同一流水线，支持自主创建与语言驱动定制。核心为智能体式精炼循环：场景生成预判下游任务需求，任务生成指导针对性场景编辑，实现场景与任务相互迭代改进。
AI.result: 提升任务生成成功率（含长时程任务）；支持移动操作机器人、人形与灵巧手，以及可变形物体与流体交互。大量实验验证数据质量、多样性与生成效率；下游策略实验表明数据多样性提升泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EmbodiedSmith 为机器人预训练与评测提供灵活仿真引擎，通过递归自我改进实现可扩展具身数据生成。

title: M3SunAgent: Monocular 3D Spatial Understanding Agent for Metric Depth Estimation and 3D Visual Grounding
comment: 13 pages. 7 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT)
summary: Monocular metric depth estimation and 3D visual grounding represent the two complementary cornerstones of monocular 3D spatial understanding (M3Sun), from which the fundamental 3D spatial information required by M3Sun can be acquired. However, these complementary tasks are generally conducted by separate frameworks, which pose challenges of inflexible and unaligned spatial information access for embodied intelligence systems. In this paper, we propose a unified agent for monocular 3D spatial understanding (M3SunAgent) that leverages a large language model (LLM) as a task planner for spatial visual programming, which flexibly generate structured programs and coordinate tools. For instance-level metric depth estimation task, M3SunAgent invokes an object detector tool to locate the target, estimates depth at selected points with a depth estimation tool, and aggregates these predictions into an instance-level depth estimate. We also construct the M3Sun Instance (M3SI) dataset, a benchmark with 2,910 samples for evaluation. For monocular 3D visual grounding task, M3SunAgent uses a vision-language model (VLM) tool to locate the target and output basic spatial attributes, then combines back-projection tool with a dimension-lifting tool to predict its 3D bounding box. Experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of M3SunAgent. Specifically, in evaluations of instance-level monocular metric depth estimation, M3SunAgent achieves the best performance among all compared models, 52.61% of predicted instances are distributed below depth error 0.25 ($δ< 0.25$). In evaluations of monocular 3D visual grounding, M3SunAgent demonstrates overall competitive performance than vision and VLM models, reaching a 3D mean intersection over union (mIoU) of 41.73% and exceeding the state-of-the-art MonoVLM model by 3.62%.

AI.tldr: 提出统一智能体M3SunAgent，用LLM作任务规划器协调工具，统一完成单目度量深度估计与3D视觉定位，并构建M3SI基准（2,910样本），性能优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 单目度量深度估计与3D视觉定位是单目3D空间理解（M3Sun）的两大互补基石，但通常由独立框架分别处理，导致具身智能系统难以灵活、对齐地获取空间信息。
AI.method: 以LLM作为任务规划器进行空间视觉编程，灵活生成结构化程序并协调工具。实例级深度估计：调用目标检测器定位目标，用深度估计工具在采样点估计深度并聚合为实例级深度。3D视觉定位：用VLM工具定位目标并输出基本空间属性，再结合反投影工具与维度提升工具预测3D边界框。同时构建M3SI基准（2,910样本）用于评测。
AI.result: 实例级单目度量深度估计中M3SunAgent在对比模型中表现最佳，52.61%的预测实例深度误差低于0.25（δ<0.25）；单目3D视觉定位中达到41.73%的3D mIoU，超越SOTA模型MonoVLM 3.62%，整体性能与视觉及VLM模型相比具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: M3SunAgent通过LLM驱动的工具编排实现了两项互补任务的统一处理，验证了统一智能体在单目3D空间理解上的有效性与优越性，为具身智能提供更灵活、对齐的空间信息获取方式。

title: Decide Before You Look: Learning Which Retrieved Memories Deserve Pixels
summary: Multimodal assistants answer questions from long-term memories that contain images. After retrieval, each retrieved image reaches the answering model either as pixels, at about a thousand visual tokens per image, or as a stored text proxy that often misses the detail the question asks about. We find that the benefit of pixels usually comes from one or two retrieved memories, and that it can be predicted before the answering model runs, without reading any full-resolution image. In PixelTriage, a plug-in placed after retrieval, a small model that does not generate text reads the dialogue, a short note and a thumbnail of each retrieved memory and predicts how much its pixels would add. It is trained on synthetic memory episodes labeled by a frozen 27B model that answers each question with and without each memory's pixels. With a 7B answering model, PixelTriage lies on the accuracy--cost frontier of M$^3$Exam, DMV and MemEye and uses 11--23\% of the visual tokens without a significant loss of accuracy. On DMV it answers 2.9 times faster than opening all images. It outperforms retrieval order and uniform down-sizing at equal budgets and transfers to other memory systems and to a 397B answering model.

AI.tldr: PixelTriage 是一种检索后插件，通过小模型读取对话、短笔记和缩略图来预测每张检索图像的像素对回答的增益，从而仅对少数高价值图像使用全分辨率视觉标记，显著降低视觉 token 消耗并提升推理速度。
AI.motivation: 多模态助手需基于包含图像的长期记忆回答问题。检索后，图像以像素形式输入会消耗约每图千个视觉 token，而文本代理又常丢失问题所需的细节。作者发现像素带来的收益通常仅来自一到两张检索记忆，且可在不读取全分辨率图像的情况下预先预测，因此需要一种按需分配视觉 token 的机制。
AI.method: 提出 PixelTriage，置于检索之后的插件。它使用一个不生成文本的小模型，读取对话、短笔记和每张检索记忆的缩略图，预测该记忆的像素能带来多少增益。训练数据为合成记忆片段，由冻结的 27B 模型分别在有、无该记忆像素的条件下回答每个问题进行标注。
AI.result: 在 7B 回答模型下，PixelTriage 位于 M³Exam、DMV 和 MemEye 的精度—成本前沿，仅使用 11–23% 的视觉 token 而无显著精度损失；在 DMV 上比打开全部图像快 2.9 倍；在相同预算下优于检索顺序和均匀降采样；并可迁移到其他记忆系统和 397B 回答模型。
AI.conclusion: 像素级视觉信息的收益高度集中在少数检索记忆上且可事前预测，PixelTriage 通过预测性、按需的视觉 token 分配，实现了精度与成本的良好权衡，并具备跨系统与跨模型规模的泛化能力。

title: VisionWeave: Weaving Elastic Visual Representations as a Native Capability of MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models have become the dominant paradigm for visual understanding, but incur substantial costs by encoding inputs into dense, fixed-size patch tokens. However, visual information is unevenly distributed: some regions require fine-grained detail, while others admit compact representations. Downsampling sacrifices this detail, while existing token pruning and adaptive approaches remain limited in content-adaptive granularity, task generalization, and integration with modern MLLMs and serving infrastructure. Overcoming these limitations calls for foundation models that learn, end to end, where-and at what granularity-to allocate visual representations, a native capability we term elastic visual representation weaving. We introduce VisionWeave, establishing this capability in frontier-level MLLMs through large-scale training. It combines two components: a gated spatial pooler constructs coarse-grained representations alongside native fine-grained representations within a shared MRoPE coordinate, while a granularity router learns their content-adaptive allocation. Through self-distillation alone, we validate this capability on Qwen3.5-4B and scale to Qwen3.8-27B with over 30K A100 GPU-hours. Based on Qwen3.8-27B, VisionWeave adaptively adjusts token savings to visual content, saving 43.0% tokens on average while retaining 98.9% native performance across eight benchmarks, versus only 88% performance preserved for token pruning baselines with a fixed 50% savings target. Extensive evaluations confirm robust efficiency-quality trade-offs across diverse tasks, resolutions and video frames. When deployed on SGLang serving engine, our method achieves a 2.3x throughput gain while reducing mean TTFT by 54.4% and mean TPOT by 60.6%. Together, we believe these results position elastic visual weaving as a promising capability for next-generation multimodal models.

AI.tldr: 提出 VisionWeave，通过门控空间池化器与粒度路由器实现"弹性视觉表征编织"，在 Qwen3.8-27B 上自适应分配视觉 token 粒度，平均节省 43.0% token 且保留 98.9% 原生性能，服务端吞吐提升 2.3 倍。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型依赖稠密固定尺寸 patch token，成本高昂；而视觉信息分布不均，部分区域需细粒度、部分可压缩。下采样会丢失细节，现有 token 剪枝与自适应方法在内容自适应粒度、任务泛化性以及与前沿 MLLM/服务基础设施的集成上均有局限，因此需要端到端学习"在何处、以何种粒度"分配视觉表征的基础能力。
AI.method: VisionWeave 通过大规模训练在前沿级 MLLM 中建立该能力，包含两个组件：(1) 门控空间池化器（gated spatial pooler），在共享 MRoPE 坐标下构建粗粒度表征并与原生细粒度表征共存；(2) 粒度路由器（granularity router），学习内容自适应的表征分配。仅通过自蒸馏在 Qwen3.5-4B 上验证，并扩展至 Qwen3.8-27B，消耗超 3 万 A100 GPU 小时。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3.8-27B，模型随视觉内容自适应调整 token 节省比例，在八个基准上平均节省 43.0% token 同时保留 98.9% 原生性能；对比之下，固定 50% 节省目标的 token 剪枝基线仅保留约 88% 性能。在分辨率与视频帧等多种任务上均表现出稳健的效率-质量权衡。部署于 SGLang 服务引擎时，吞吐提升 2.3 倍，平均 TTFT 降低 54.4%，平均 TPOT 降低 60.6%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式学习端到端的弹性视觉表征编织可有效缓解多模态大模型的视觉 token 冗余问题，在效率与质量间取得良好平衡，并可与现代服务基础设施无缝集成，有望成为下一代多模态模型的核心能力。

title: A Broader Look at Model Merging: Rethinking Implicit Regularization Induced by Task Arithmetic
summary: Model merging aims to build a multi-task model cheaply by combining the weights of individual task-specific models. To perform well across multiple tasks, most existing merging methods use an additional dataset to find the coefficients for the best linear combination of task-specific weight updates. However, we identify an implicit regularization in this standard practice: searching over coefficients restricts the candidate models to a subspace spanned by task-specific weight updates. In this work, we investigate whether this regularization is actually useful. Surprisingly, empirical results show that optimizing merged-model weights without this regularization significantly boosts the performance of common merging methods across multiple architectures, domains, and even in an extremely data-limited scenario where only one instance is available per class. Moreover, directly optimizing the pretrained model weights even outperforms some existing merging methods. Analysis shows that better multi-task weights exist outside the subspace and can be found using multiple methods. We study different strategies for using the additional dataset, discussing their practical use and implications for model merging. Overall, this work calls for revisiting the existing model-merging pipeline, motivating a broader exploration of the weight space and a reconsideration of the implicit regularization induced by task arithmetic.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑模型合并中"搜索任务向量线性组合系数"这一标准做法隐含的正则化，发现直接优化合并模型权重可显著超越常见合并方法。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法多依赖额外数据集搜索任务特定权重更新的线性组合系数，这无形中将候选模型限制在任务向量张成的子空间内，形成一种隐式正则化。作者想探究这种正则化是否真的有益。
AI.method: 对比"带正则化"（仅搜索组合系数）与"无正则化"（直接在权重空间中优化合并模型权重）两种做法；在多种架构、领域以及每类仅一个样本的极端数据受限场景下进行实验；并分析子空间外是否存在更优的多任务权重，以及额外数据集的不同使用策略。
AI.result: 去掉该隐式正则化后，常见合并方法性能显著提升；直接优化预训练模型权重甚至优于部分现有合并方法；分析表明更优的多任务权重存在于任务向量子空间之外，且可由多种方法找到。
AI.conclusion: 该工作呼吁重新审视现有模型合并流程，主张更广泛地探索权重空间，并重新思考任务算术所诱导的隐式正则化。

title: Structured but Silent: Probing Capability Requirements in LLM Hidden States
summary: Reliable tool use requires more than triggering a mechanism or matching a query to an API description. Before selecting a specific tool, an agent must first infer the capability requirements implied by the user query. In this paper, we investigate whether these query-side capability requirements are linearly decodable from LLM hidden representations prior to generation, and how this hidden-state accessibility compares with explicit verbal classification. We introduce TACIT, a framework that decomposes external requirements along three fundamental axes: Source, Transformation, and World Effect, defining eight structurally distinct capability classes. Using 1,600 balanced training queries from benchmarks, synthetic examples, and new domain scenarios, we train linear probes on pre-generation hidden states from four open-weight LLM families. Our empirical results demonstrate that fine-grained capability structures are linearly decodable with high accuracy across all models. Crucially, however, we expose a representation-to-verbalization gap: these same models are significantly less reliable when asked to explicitly classify the same queries in natural language. This disconnect indicates that information about required external capabilities is linearly accessible in LLM hidden representations but not reliably expressed, a phenomenon we define as "structured but silent."

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TACIT框架，将工具使用前的查询侧能力需求分解为Source、Transformation、World Effect三个轴、八个能力类别，并验证LLM在生成前的隐藏状态中可线性解码这些细粒度能力结构，但模型在显式语言分类上表现显著更差，揭示了"结构化但沉默"的表征—言语化鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 可靠的工具使用不仅是触发机制或将查询匹配到API描述，智能体需先推断用户查询所隐含的能力需求。论文关注一个基础问题：查询侧能力需求能否在生成前的LLM隐藏表征中被线性解码，以及这种隐藏状态可访问性与显式言语分类相比如何。
AI.method: 提出TACIT框架，沿Source、Transformation、World Effect三个轴分解外部需求，定义八个结构上不同的能力类别；使用来自基准、合成示例和新领域场景的1,600条平衡训练查询，在四个开放权重LLM家族的生成前隐藏状态上训练线性探针，并与自然语言显式分类进行对比。
AI.result: 在所有模型上，细粒度能力结构均可以高准确率被线性解码；但同一批模型在被要求用自然语言显式分类相同查询时可靠性显著降低，出现表征—言语化鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 所需外部能力的信息在LLM隐藏表征中是线性可访问的，但无法被可靠表达，作者将这一现象定义为"结构化但沉默"（structured but silent）。

title: The Labeling Problem in Hallucination Detection Benchmarks: An Empirical Evaluation
comment: 27 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track. Data: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/PCHISZ. Code: https://github.com/jova486/LPHB
summary: In recent years, several methods for detecting when large language models (LLMs) hallucinate have been developed. These methods are often benchmarked with open-domain question answering (QA) datasets containing questions and corresponding short reference answers. First, an LLM is used to generate answers to questions within the QA dataset. Then, some automated labeling strategy is used to label these answers as hallucinated or not by comparing them with the reference answers in the dataset. This evaluation setting creates a methodological ambiguity between two criteria: reference faithfulness (whether the answer is fully supported by the reference) and factual correctness (whether the answer is free from contradictions and factually false specific claims). In practice, automated labelers may apply the former criterion even when the intended target is the latter. We study this potential criterion mismatch using 900 human-labeled question-answer pairs spanning three commonly used QA datasets and three generator models, with labels targeting answer-level factual correctness. We evaluate lexical similarity metrics, a reference-entailment NLI baseline, and seven LLM judges under controlled prompt variants as automated labelers. Our experiments reveal substantial disagreement both among automated labeling strategies and between these labels and human annotations. Many strategies also exhibit strong directional error biases, and for most judge-generator pairs, replacing a faithfulness-oriented prompt with a factual-correctness prompt improves agreement with human annotations and reduces false-positive dominance, indicating that automated hallucination labels depend strongly on how the target criterion is specified. Label-source choice should therefore be considered a fundamental part of benchmark design and made explicit, validated, and matched with the benchmark goal.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM幻觉检测评测中自动标注策略存在"引用忠实性"与"事实正确性"标准混淆问题，并通过900条人工标注数据验证该混淆会显著影响评测结论。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM幻觉检测方法的评测普遍采用开放域QA数据集，以LLM生成答案后用自动标注策略对比参考答案来判定幻觉。这一流程隐含了两种不同标准：引用忠实性（答案是否被参考答案完全支持）与事实正确性（答案是否包含事实性错误的断言）。实践中自动标注器可能使用了与目标标准不一致的判据，从而引入方法学歧义。
AI.method: 构建包含900条人工标注问答对的数据集，覆盖三个常用QA数据集与三个生成模型，标注目标为答案级事实正确性。在该数据上评估三类自动标注器：词汇相似度指标、基于引用蕴含的NLI基线、以及七种LLM评判者（judge），并通过受控的prompt变体（忠实性导向vs事实正确性导向）进行对比实验。
AI.result: （1）不同自动标注策略之间、以及自动标注与人工标注之间存在显著不一致；（2）多数策略表现出明显的方向性错误偏差（如假阳性主导）；（3）对大多数judge-生成模型组合，将忠实性导向prompt替换为事实正确性导向prompt后，与人工标注的一致性提升，假阳性主导现象减弱。
AI.conclusion: 自动幻觉标签高度依赖于目标标准的表述方式。标注来源的选择应被视为benchmark设计的根本组成部分，需明确、验证并与benchmark目标相匹配。

title: Are Language Models Script-Aware?
summary: Language models frequently generate outputs in unintended languages or scripts, a phenomenon known as off-target generation. While existing research has focused on language selection, the dimension of script knowledge remains understudied: before any linguistic understanding can occur, users must recognize the graphic symbols in a model's response. We investigate whether Small and Large Language Models (SLMs and LLMs) possess script knowledge by testing them on multi-scriptic languages. Through two complementary experiments, we evaluate whether models (1) adapt their output script to match the input, and (2) follow explicit instructions to generate text in a specified script. The models we tested demonstrate substantial script knowledge: they all achieve a near-perfect Latin script fidelity (more than 98%) and follow script instructions with high frequency. Nevertheless, we notice differences between LLMs and SLMs, with higher scores for LLMs including for non-standard script combinations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大/小语言模型是否具备"文字系统知识"，通过多文字语言的两组实验测试模型能否根据输入自动匹配输出文字，以及能否遵循显式文字指令。结果表明模型普遍具备较强的文字知识（拉丁字母保真度>98%），且大模型优于小模型。
AI.motivation: 现有关于"偏离目标生成"（off-target generation）的研究主要聚焦于语言选择（如输出错误的语种），而忽略了文字系统（script）这一维度。作者认为，在用户理解模型输出之前，首先要能识别输出所用的图形符号，因此模型是否具备文字系统知识是一个尚未被充分研究的重要问题。
AI.method: 作者选取多文字语言（multi-scriptic languages）作为测试对象，设计了两组互补实验：(1) 测试模型是否将输出文字自动适配为与输入一致的文字；(2) 测试模型能否遵循显式指令，用指定文字生成文本。实验同时覆盖小语言模型（SLMs）与大语言模型（LLMs）。
AI.result: 所有被测模型均展现出显著的文字系统知识：拉丁字母保真度接近完美（超过98%），且能高频率地遵循文字指令。同时观察到LLM与SLM之间存在差异，LLM得分更高，包括在非标准文字组合上的表现也更好。
AI.conclusion: 模型确实具备相当程度的文字系统知识，能够进行文字层面的输入-输出适配并遵循显式文字指令，但该能力随模型规模增长而增强，SLM在非标准文字组合等场景下仍有不足。该工作将"文字系统"作为偏离目标生成研究的新维度加以补充。

title: DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks
comment: 9 pages (31 including Appendix), 8 figures (11 including Appendix). We release the code and artifacts, including generation and inference traces, at https://github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus
summary: LLM agents often lack the operational knowledge to act reliably in new environments, as they must discover specific tool behaviors or environment conventions on their own. Without memory of past attempts, they repeat the same mistakes across tasks, leading to more task failures and longer trajectories. To address this, agentic systems typically rely on human-written guidelines or on procedural memory built from training tasks and an oracle verifier, both of which require prior knowledge of the environment. We present DAEDALUS, a method for bootstrapping reusable agent memory from self-generated practice without existing tasks or oracle verifiers. DAEDALUS pairs two agents: an explorer that interacts with the environment to generate challenging yet solvable tasks, and a solver that attempts them. A heuristic is derived from each solver failure and accepted only after the solver repeatedly succeeds with that heuristic in context. These outcomes also provide feedback for the explorer to refine the difficulty of future tasks. Accepted heuristics are then consolidated into a memory bank for test-time use. Across AppWorld, $τ^2$-bench, and AutomationBench, DAEDALUS improves mean success rates by up to 15.9 points and pass^5 by up to 2.2x over a no-memory baseline, and is competitive with methods using training tasks, at a lower inference cost than most. We show that performance gains already emerge with a small exploration budget, and that its heuristics also benefit agents from other model families. Our ablations further reveal that solver traces provide the key information needed to derive effective heuristics, while factorizing early discoveries makes exploration more cost-efficient. Beyond memory construction, we find that the tasks generated by DAEDALUS can serve as a proxy for benchmark tasks when ranking models by performance. Code and artifacts: www.github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DAEDALUS，一种无需既有任务或 oracle 验证器、通过自生成练习引导可复用智能体记忆的方法，在多个基准上显著提升成功率与稳定性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在新环境中缺乏操作知识，需自行摸索工具行为与环境约定；缺少对过往尝试的记忆会导致跨任务重复犯错，进而增加任务失败率并拉长轨迹长度。现有方案依赖人工编写的指南，或依赖训练任务与 oracle 验证器构建的程序性记忆，均需先验环境知识。
AI.method: DAEDALUS 由两个智能体配对组成：探索者（explorer）与环境交互，生成具挑战性但可解决的任务；求解者（solver）尝试这些任务。每次求解失败后导出一条启发式规则，仅当求解者在上下文中使用该启发式反复成功后，才被接受。这些结果同时作为反馈，供探索者调整后续任务难度。被接受的启发式规则被整合进记忆库，用于测试时调用。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld、τ²-bench 和 AutomationBench 上，相较无记忆基线，DAEDALUS 平均成功率最多提升 15.9 个百分点，pass^5 最多提升 2.2 倍，并与使用训练任务的方法相当，推理成本低于多数对比方法。较小探索预算下即可获得性能增益，且其启发式规则也可惠及其他模型族的智能体。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验表明，求解者轨迹是推导有效启发式规则的关键信息，而对早期发现进行因子化能使探索更具成本效率。除记忆构建外，DAEDALUS 生成的任务可作为基准任务的代理，用于按性能对模型进行排序。

title: Language Carries the Expert's Impression: Instrument-Anchored LLM Judges Transfer Counseling-Quality Assessment and Beat In-Domain Training
summary: Automatic assessment of communication quality in dyadic counseling conversations is bottlenecked by data: expert-rated corpora are small and expensive to grow. We study cross-domain transfer of expert overall-impression prediction across three German corpora of simulated counseling (two general-practice medical, one school-related parent-teacher; $n=195$ expert-rated sessions, one corpus after scale equating). Training on the other domains beats training in-domain: leave-one-domain-out transfer reaches nested Spearman $ρ= 0.54$ against $\le 0.48$ within the target domain, a paired session-level gap of $+0.15$ that holds at $+0.12$ when the training-set sizes are matched, so it is not simply data volume. The decisive features are session-level construct scores from small open-weight LLMs reading the two-speaker transcript, with the constructs largely derived from the experts' rating instruments: the instrument-derived battery lifts a single judge from $0.32$ to $0.41$ over generic dialogue qualities, judges from three model families ensemble to $0.51$ language-only, and a nonverbal-dyadic block adds $+0.03$ more, not separable from noise at this sample size. We also price the recording setup: one corpus lost its per-speaker audio, 16% of its diarised segments carry the wrong speaker, and repair is worth $+0.07$ there. At practically attainable corpus sizes, the expert's overall impression is carried by what is said, and by other communication programs' data more than by one's own.

AI.tldr: 在三份德语模拟咨询语料（n=195）上，跨域迁移训练优于域内训练，专家总体印象主要由"说了什么"（会话级构念分数）承载，非言语信息贡献有限。
AI.motivation: 双人咨询对话中沟通质量的自动评估受制于数据瓶颈：专家评分的语料规模小、扩充成本高，因此需要研究专家总体印象预测的跨域迁移可行性。
AI.method: 采用留一域外（leave-one-domain-out）迁移评估，对比跨域与域内训练效果并做训练集规模匹配控制；特征上使用小型开放权重LLM读取双人转录文本，生成会话级构念分数（构念多源自专家评分量表），并与通用对话质量特征、三模型家族集成、非言语-双人特征块及录音修复进行消融比较。
AI.result: 跨域迁移嵌套Spearman ρ=0.54，优于目标域内的≤0.48，会话级配对差距+0.15，规模匹配后仍为+0.12；量表衍生特征使单评判者从0.32升至0.41，三家族集成达0.51（仅语言），非言语块仅增益+0.03（该样本量下与噪声不可分）；一个语料缺失逐说话人音频，16%的说话人分离片段标注错误，修复可带来+0.07增益。
AI.conclusion: 在实际可获得的语料规模下，专家的总体印象主要由言语内容承载，且其他沟通项目的数据比自身域内数据更有价值，跨域迁移是一条可行的低成本路径。

title: HINTT Submission to the 2nd MLC-SLM Challenge: Comparing Cascaded and Unified Approaches to Diarization and ASR
summary: This paper presents the HINTT system submitted to the 2nd Challenge and Workshop on Multilingual Conversational Speech Language Model (MLC-SLM). We address multilingual speaker-attributed ASR, where systems must determine who spoke when and what was spoken. We investigate two modeling strategies for this problem: a cascaded pipeline that combines speaker diarization with speech-LLM-based ASR, and a unified speech LLM that directly generates speaker labels, timestamps, and transcriptions. Our final submission is based on the cascaded pipeline, consisting of a fine-tuned DiariZen diarization model, a fine-tuned Qwen3-ASR model, and LLM-based generative error correction. For comparison, we also fine-tune VibeVoice-ASR as a unified model using the same official training data. All task-specific fine-tuning and model selection are performed using only the official MLC-SLM data, without external data or pseudo-labels. Experimental results demonstrate that the cascaded system remains more reliable under the MLC-SLM Task 1 conditions, while unified speech LLMs offer a promising direction for future speaker-attributed ASR.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍面向MLC-SLM挑战赛Task 1的HINTT系统，针对多语言“说话人归属ASR”任务，比较级联流水线与统一语音大模型两种策略，最终提交基于级联流水线（微调DiariZen + 微调Qwen3-ASR + LLM生成式纠错），并在相同官方数据下微调VibeVoice-ASR作为统一模型对照。结果显示级联系统在Task 1条件下更可靠，统一语音LLM具有前景。
AI.motivation: 多语言说话人归属ASR需同时回答“谁在何时说了什么”，现有方案在级联模块化与端到端统一建模之间尚缺乏在统一数据条件下的系统对比，因此作者希望通过参与MLC-SLM挑战赛，明确两种建模范式在该任务上的实际表现差异。
AI.method: 研究两种建模策略：（1）级联流水线，将说话人日志（speaker diarization）与基于语音LLM的ASR结合，具体为微调DiariZen日志模型、微调Qwen3-ASR模型，并加入基于LLM的生成式纠错；（2）统一语音LLM，直接生成说话人标签、时间戳与转写文本。作为对照，使用相同官方训练数据微调VibeVoice-ASR作为统一模型。所有任务特定微调与模型选择仅使用MLC-SLM官方数据，不使用外部数据或伪标签。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在MLC-SLM Task 1条件下，级联系统相比统一语音LLM更为可靠。
AI.conclusion: 级联流水线在当前任务条件下仍是更稳健的选择；统一语音LLM为未来说话人归属ASR提供了有前景的研究方向。同时，仅用官方数据即可完成两种范式的训练与选型，保证了对比的公平性。

title: PhysTacGen: Physics-Aware Visual-Tactile Sensor Image Generation
summary: Realistic physical interaction is a cornerstone of embodied intelligence, yet collecting paired visual--tactile data remains costly. Visual-to-tactile synthesis offers a promising approach to augmenting such data, but learning this mapping is complicated by the gap between visual appearance and contact-related material properties, as well as spatial misalignment in paired observations. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{PhysTacGen}, a visual-to-optical-tactile image generation framework that integrates material-aware descriptions with geometric conditioning. First, we introduce Group Tactile Policy Optimization (GTPO), a reinforcement learning strategy that refines a vision--language model to generate structured material descriptions using task-specific rewards. Second, we combine DINOv2-based pair curation with monocular relative-depth estimation to select training pairs and provide geometric priors. Finally, an SDXL ControlNet synthesizes optical tactile images conditioned on RGB, relative depth, and GTPO-generated text. Experiments on curated SSVTP data demonstrate improved structural similarity over the compared baselines, while a blinded user study shows a preference for GTPO-generated descriptions. Generated tactile inputs also improve performance on an attribute-derived force-coefficient prediction proxy. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of PhysTacGen for optical tactile image synthesis and its utility in the evaluated downstream task.The code will be available at https://github.com/VDIGPKU/PhysTacGen.

AI.tldr: PhysTacGen：一种视觉到光学触觉图像的生成框架，融合材料感知描述与几何条件，缓解视觉外观与触觉属性间的差距及配对错位问题。
AI.motivation: 物理交互对具身智能至关重要，但成对视觉-触觉数据采集成本高昂。视觉到触觉合成可扩充数据，但视觉外观与接触相关材料属性之间存在鸿沟，且成对观测存在空间错位，导致映射学习困难。
AI.method: 提出PhysTacGen框架：1）GTPO（Group Tactile Policy Optimization），基于强化学习、用任务特定奖励微调视觉语言模型，生成结构化材料描述；2）结合DINOv2配对筛选与单目相对深度估计，挑选训练对并提供几何先验；3）用SDXL ControlNet，以RGB、相对深度和GTPO生成文本为条件合成光学触觉图像。
AI.result: 在筛选后的SSVTP数据上，结构相似度优于对比基线；盲测用户研究显示GTPO生成描述更受偏好；生成触觉输入在由属性导出的力系数预测代理任务上提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了PhysTacGen在光学触觉图像合成上的有效性及其在所评估下游任务中的实用价值，代码将开源。

title: Two Halves are More than One: Phase-wise Velocity Distillation for Fast and High-Quality Image Generation
summary: Recent diffusion-based image generation backbones have grown substantially in scale, making the network inference cost increase rapidly. While diffusion distillation techniques can reduce the number of inference steps, high-quality image generation within a single full-backbone-forward compute budget remains challenging. Existing one-step methods typically allocate this budget to a single evaluation of a monolithic student. However, approximating the heterogeneous coarse-to-fine transport with a single monolithic mapping is difficult and often leads to over-smoothed outputs. To address this issue, we propose Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD), which partitions the generation timeline into a coarse and a fine phase, and models the transition within each phase via the average velocity. A dedicated half-sized expert is assigned to each phase, decoupling structural composition from detail refinement while keeping the cumulative computation equivalent to one full-backbone forward pass. We show that the use of two half-sized phase-specific experts outperforms a single full-size monolithic student. On class-conditional image generation, PVD achieves an FID of 1.48 on ImageNet 256 x 256. On more complex text-to-image (T2I) tasks, PVD-distilled models (Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium, FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image) produce results competitive with their multi-step teachers, significantly outperforming prior distillation methods. Moreover, across the evaluated T2I backbones, PVD reduces active parameters by 49.10-50.89% and peak VRAM by 45.76-48.36% compared to the corresponding teachers. Source code and distilled models are available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/PVD.

AI.tldr: 提出 Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD)，将生成时间线分为粗/细两个阶段，各用半尺寸专家建模平均速度，在累积计算量等价于一次完整骨干前向的预算下实现高质量单步生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型骨干规模持续增大导致推理成本快速上升；扩散蒸馏虽能减少采样步数，但在单次完整骨干前向的计算预算内实现高质量生成仍具挑战。现有单步方法通常把该预算分配给单一单体学生模型的一次评估，而用单体映射逼近异质的“由粗到细”传输过程较为困难，常导致输出过度平滑。
AI.method: PVD 将生成时间线划分为粗阶段与细阶段，用平均速度刻画各阶段内部的传输，并为每个阶段分配一个半尺寸专家，从而将结构构图与细节精修解耦，同时保持累积计算量等价于一次完整骨干前向。实验验证两个半尺寸阶段专家优于单一全尺寸单体学生。
AI.result: 类别条件生成在 ImageNet 256×256 上达到 FID 1.48；在更复杂的文生图任务上，PVD 蒸馏模型（Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image）取得与其多步教师相当的结果，显著优于既有蒸馏方法。在上述 T2I 骨干上，PVD 相比对应教师减少激活参数量 49.10–50.89%，峰值显存降低 45.76–48.36%。
AI.conclusion: 以阶段化、半尺寸专家替代单体全尺寸学生，是在单次完整骨干前向预算下提升单步扩散生成质量的有效途径，并在类别条件与文生图任务上同时实现性能与效率优势；代码与蒸馏模型已开源。

title: Optimization Encoders: Rethinking Second-Order Meta-Learning for Neural Fields
summary: Conditional neural fields represent signals continuously, but their effectiveness depends on how the conditional latent representations are inferred from observed data. In meta-learning, this encoding occurs through gradient updates induced by the decoder, tying representation learning directly to decoder design. We formalize this connection by interpreting latent optimization as an optimization encoder, unifying the roles of second-order differentiation, latent parameterization, and task supervision. This concept enables second-order meta-learning for end-to-end training of the encoding procedure alongside the decoder, and clarifies which learning pathway first-order approximations discard. Guided by this view, we introduce Attentive Latent Fields (MetaLF), an equivariant transformer-based neural field that contextualizes a latent pointcloud through self-attention. These interactions shape both field predictions and the updates that construct their representation, allowing local observations to inform coherent non-local structure. Disentangling the inner encoding objective from outer task supervision unifies reconstruction, classification, and segmentation within an end-to-end meta-learning framework, using reconstruction-only latent adaptation at test time. Controlled experiments on polynomial fields link latent coordination to lower effective rank and stronger alignment with the underlying function space. Across image and 3D shape reconstruction, MetaLF improves fidelity within three to five gradient updates, while supporting semantic prediction across images, shapes, and volumes. Together, these findings position the optimization encoder perspective as a unified basis for designing neural fields around how representations are constructed, coordinated, and used.

AI.tldr: 该论文将元学习中潜变量优化过程形式化为"优化编码器"，统一了二阶微分、潜变量参数化与任务监督，并提出基于等变Transformer的Attentive Latent Fields (MetaLF)，实现更高效的神经场表示学习。
AI.motivation: 条件神经场能连续表示信号，但其效果取决于如何从观测数据推断条件潜表示。在元学习中，编码通过解码器诱导的梯度更新完成，使表示学习与解码器设计紧密耦合，但这一联系缺乏理论框架。作者希望形式化这一关系，并厘清一阶近似所丢失的学习路径。
AI.method: 作者将潜变量优化解释为"优化编码器"，统一二阶微分、潜变量参数化与任务监督三个角色，从而实现编码过程与解码器的端到端二阶元学习训练。基于此视角提出MetaLF：一个等变Transformer神经场，通过自注意力对潜点云进行上下文建模，使局部观测影响场预测及构建表示的更新；并将内层编码目标与外层任务监督解耦，统合重建、分类与分割。
AI.result: 多项式场控制实验表明潜变量协调对应更低的有效秩及与底层函数空间更强对齐。在图像与3D形状重建中，MetaLF在三到五次梯度更新内提升保真度，并支持图像、形状与体数据的语义预测；测试时仅需重建潜适应。
AI.conclusion: 研究将"优化编码器"视角确立为设计神经场的统一基础，强调围绕表示如何被构造、协调与使用来设计神经场。MetaLF验证了该框架在重建与语义任务上的有效性与通用性。

title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to 24.2 pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when 37--98% of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where 98% of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at 0.0% success, while adding SRD reaches 60.6% under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出"前瞻学习"(prospective learning)及Self-Retrospection Distillation(SRD)，利用事后轨迹经验监督交互前的预判预测，缓解RLVR在奖励无对比时的信号消失问题。
AI.motivation: RLVR主要通过交互后的标量结果奖励产生学习信号，但在组相对目标下，当同组所有rollout获得相同奖励时信号消失，尽管这些轨迹仍包含任务要求与失败模式的信息。作者提出互补问题：事后经验能否教会智能体在行动前应预见什么。
AI.method: 提出prospective learning，用事后经验监督来自交互前视角的预判预测；具体实例化为SRD：将已完成轨迹中的特权后见知识蒸馏为同一策略的、与轨迹无关的预判(foresight)。预判仅作训练目标，推理时无需显式生成。
AI.result: 在10个工具集成推理与长程智能体任务上，SRD在RLVR与自蒸馏基线之上取得最高24.2个百分点的提升。当37–98%的rollout组为奖励均匀时优势尤为明显；2B设置下98%组为全失败，RLVR成功率为0.0%，加入SRD后达60.6%（相同rollout预算）。
AI.conclusion: 事后智能体经验不仅可用于评估或改进行为，还能在可用交互之前塑造预测性表征。

title: POLAR: Ontology-Guided Risk Prevention for Tool-Calling LLM Agents
summary: LLM tool-use agents operate in dynamic environments where many actions carry operational risk. However, most safety mechanisms react only after errors manifest. Existing pre-emptive approaches either fine-tune the agent on chain-of-thought deliberation or compile natural-language guardrails into runtime checks, but they do so without exposing a structural, auditable verdict. We propose POLAR, a guardrail framework for small tool-calling agents that assesses reversibility through a structured two-layer ontology. POLAR assigns each action a graded reversibility score by deriving a candidate inverse sequence; calls failing a threshold are pruned before execution. Evaluated on $τ^2$-bench across six agent models, POLAR improves mean task reward by 0.11 to 0.18 points on airline for four of six agents, but only eight of eighteen model--domain cells improve overall; retail and stronger agents often regress. POLAR provides an auditable structural check and characterizes its task-utility trade-offs. Reward is not a direct measure of prevented harm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 POLAR，一个面向小型工具调用智能体的护栏框架，通过结构化两层本体评估动作可逆性，在执行前剪枝高风险调用。在 τ²-bench 上，六模型十八个"模型—领域"单元中仅八个获得整体提升，任务效用存在明显权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM 工具使用智能体在动态环境中执行动作常伴随操作风险，而多数安全机制仅在错误发生后响应；现有预防性方法（思维链微调、自然语言护栏编译为运行时检查）缺乏结构化、可审计的判定结果。
AI.method: POLAR 采用结构化两层本体对动作可逆性进行分级评分：为每个动作推导候选逆序操作序列，据此赋予分级可逆性分数，对低于阈值阈值的调用在执行前剪枝。
AI.result: 在 τ²-bench 上对六个智能体模型评测：航空领域中六个模型里有四个平均任务奖励提升 0.11–0.18 分；但十八个"模型—领域"单元中仅八个整体提升，零售领域及较强模型常出现回退。
AI.conclusion: POLAR 提供了可审计的结构化检查，并刻画了其在任务效用上的权衡；作者强调奖励并非防止实际危害的直接度量。

title: DirectSpeech2LLM: A Simple End-to-End Framework to Mitigate Prompt Overfitting in Speech-LLMs
summary: Speech-LLMs often exhibit prompt overfitting, where models solely trained on automatic speech recognition (ASR) instruction fail to generalize to new instructions such as speech translation and continue to behave primarily as ASR system. We propose DirectSpeech2LLM, a simple end-to-end framework that preserves the instruction-following ability of the LLM on unseen tasks when conditioned on speech. It computes distance-based CTC loss over the frozen LLM embedding matrix and uses greedy CTC labels to derive geometrically and temporally aligned speech embeddings respectively as an input to the LLM. Trained solely on 960 hours of LibriSpeech ASR data, DirectSpeech2LLM outperforms the cascaded system on ASR (seen task) and generalizes zero-shot to speech translation and emotion recognition (two unseen tasks), closely matching the cascaded system upper bound on these two new instructions despite seeing neither during training. We also find that geometric alignment strength plays a smaller role than previously assumed, as our modified CTC loss is shown to provide sufficient implicit geometric grounding without requiring an explicit regression loss. Results are consistent across two LLM families and scale with both more training data and model capacity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DirectSpeech2LLM，一种端到端框架，通过在冻结的LLM嵌入矩阵上计算基于距离的CTC损失，缓解语音-LLM的提示过拟合问题，从而在仅用ASR数据训练的情况下实现零样本跨任务泛化。
AI.motivation: 语音-LLM常出现提示过拟合：仅在自动语音识别（ASR）指令上训练的模型难以泛化到语音翻译等新指令，仍主要表现得像ASR系统。作者希望在不牺牲所见任务性能的前提下，保留LLM对未见任务的指令跟随能力。
AI.method: 提出DirectSpeech2LLM端到端框架：在冻结的LLM嵌入矩阵上计算基于距离的CTC损失；利用贪心CTC标签分别推导几何与时间对齐的语音嵌入，作为LLM输入。仅用960小时LibriSpeech ASR数据训练。
AI.result: 在ASR（所见任务）上超越级联系统；零样本泛化到语音翻译与情感识别（两个未见任务），性能接近级联系统上限。发现几何对齐强度作用比以往假设更小，改进的CTC损失无需显式回归损失即可提供充分的隐式几何接地。结果在两个LLM家族上一致，并随训练数据与模型容量增加而提升。
AI.conclusion: DirectSpeech2LLM证明可在仅用ASR数据训练时保持LLM指令跟随能力并实现零样本跨任务泛化；隐式几何接地可替代显式回归损失，且方法具有良好的通用性与可扩展性。

title: Multi-Dataset Diagnostic Utility of Clinical Visual Concepts in AI Systems for Dermatology
comment: Accepted at the MICCAI ISIC Workshop 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and dataset: https://github.com/Digital-Dermatology/SkinLex
summary: The clinical integration of AI systems in digital dermatology relies heavily on human trust. Clinically interpretable visual concepts can act as intermediate representations enhancing trust and reliability. However, research in this domain is currently limited by scattered, heterogeneous dataset annotations. In this work, we introduce SkinLex, a harmonized dataset of 48 clinical morphological attributes across four public datasets (SkinCon, DermaCon-IN, MM-Skin, and PASSION) for a total of 20,411 records. Supervised nine-partition classification of skin conditions shows that limiting features to specific visual groups, like shapes or colors alone, reduces diagnostic accuracy. Bootstrapped backward elimination reveals that the set of 48 visual concepts has some degree of redundancy for algorithmic nine-partition diagnosis on the examined dataset. This demonstrates that coarse diagnosis on the selected dataset requires a relatively small but varied combination of clinical concepts, and motivates further research to improve concept taxonomy. Results can be translated into clinical benefits by reducing inputs for concept-based models, improving efficiency for annotation and modeling, and further enhancing interpretability. Code and prompt templates are available at https://github.com/Digital-Dermatology/SkinLex.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkinLex——一个整合四个公开数据集、涵盖 48 个临床形态学属性、共 20,411 条记录的统一数据集，并基于此评估视觉概念对九分类皮肤病诊断的作用与冗余性。
AI.motivation: AI 系统在数字皮肤病学中的临床落地高度依赖人类信任，而临床可解释的视觉概念可作为中间表征提升信任与可靠性；但该领域研究受限于标注分散、异构的数据集，缺乏统一、可比较的概念级数据基础。
AI.method: 构建 SkinLex 统一数据集，整合 SkinCon、DermaCon-IN、MM-Skin 与 PASSION 四个公开数据集，统一为 48 个临床形态学属性、共 20,411 条记录；在此基础上开展九分区（九分类）皮肤状况的监督分类实验，比较仅使用特定视觉特征组（如仅形状或仅颜色）的效果，并采用自助法（bootstrapped）后向消除进行概念筛选与冗余性分析。
AI.result: 将特征限制在单一视觉组（如仅形状或仅颜色）会降低诊断准确率；自助后向消除表明，48 个视觉概念在所考察数据集上对算法九分类诊断存在一定冗余，即粗粒度诊断仅需数量相对较少但多样的临床概念组合。
AI.conclusion: 粗粒度诊断依赖小而多样的概念组合，说明有必要进一步改进概念分类体系；研究结果可转化为临床收益：减少概念模型所需输入、提升标注与建模效率，并进一步增强可解释性。代码与提示模板已开源。

title: SAGE: Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution for Grounded Medical QA Data Synthesis
summary: Developing reliable models for clinical tasks, such as Medical Question Answering (QA), is severely constrained by the limited availability of high-quality, expert-annotated training data. This challenge is exacerbated by stringent privacy requirements and the impracticality of utilizing large open-source corpora or proprietary cloud APIs within resource-limited clinical settings. To address these obstacles, we introduce SAGE (\textit{Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution}), a novel data synthesis framework that enables small, locally deployed models to generate high-quality medical training data. SAGE leverages lightweight, publicly available taxonomies such as MeSH as semantic anchors, imposing a structured prior to effectively guide and ground the data generation process. At its core, SAGE iteratively interleaves atomic (individual concept-based) and associative (relation-based) synthesis, bootstrapping training data from minimal seeds. This approach eliminates the need for large collections of medical documents or reliance on external APIs, providing a practical solution for on-premises data creation. Extensive experiments across multiple medical question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that models fine-tuned with SAGE-synthesized data consistently outperform those trained using self-derived or conventional document-based paradigms, highlighting tangible improvements in data efficiency and resource utilization for medical LLM development. Code is available at https://github.com/DIaacKr/SAGE.

AI.tldr: SAGE是一个数据合成框架，利用MeSH等语义锚点指导小型本地模型迭代生成高质量医学问答训练数据，摆脱对外部API和大量医学文档的依赖，在多个医学QA基准上性能优于自生成和传统文档驱动范式。
AI.motivation: 医学问答等临床任务依赖高质量专家标注数据，但这类数据稀缺；隐私要求严格，且资源受限的临床环境难以使用大型开源语料或专有云API，导致可靠模型开发受限。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution）数据合成框架：以MeSH等轻量公开分类体系作为语义锚点，引入结构化先验来引导和约束生成；核心为迭代交替进行原子合成（基于单个概念）与联想合成（基于关系），从极少量种子自举扩展训练数据；无需大量医学文档或外部API，支持本地部署。
AI.result: 在多个医学问答基准上的大量实验表明，使用SAGE合成数据微调的模型持续优于使用自生成数据或传统文档驱动范式训练的模型，在数据效率和资源利用方面取得明显提升。
AI.conclusion: SAGE为资源受限临床环境下医学LLM开发提供了一种实用、可本地化的数据创建方案，有效缓解高质量医学训练数据匮乏问题。

title: Natural Language Questions as an Interface for Knowledge Graphs: QRAKEN Graph Distillation and Semantic Self-Healing
summary: Natural-language access to RDF knowledge graphs is a core Semantic Web ambition. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SPARQL, yet on unfamiliar graphs they often generate valid queries that misrepresent the populated data model. QRAKEN is a training-free, ontology-agnostic neurosymbolic pipeline grounding generation in empirical graph evidence rather than schema expectations. An offline distiller produces TTQL, a compact description of populated multi-hop patterns, conditional frequencies and path-conditioned literal examples, plus a class-property co-occurrence matrix. Online, TTQL guides the LLM, while deterministic syntax, vocabulary and data-model checks provide diagnostics for iterative refinement. On CK25 (First International Text2SPARQL Challenge), under matched-condition recomputation on a QLever snapshot, QRAKEN achieves strict F1 of 0.643 $\pm$ 0.026 with GPT-4.1 mini and 0.652 $\pm$ 0.012 with GPT-5.4: relative gains of 30% and 32% over the strongest recomputed participant, outperforming systems using the same base model family. Ablations identify TTQL patterns as the dominant driver (+0.31 strict F1 over a shape-only baseline); the refinement loop provides a cheap safety net, rejecting triple patterns unsupported by the co-occurrence matrix. Compared with auto-derived SHACL, TTQL yields 64% higher strict F1, supporting the value of empirical patterns beyond schema exposure. With two local 35B 4-bit open-weight models at zero marginal cost, the same pipeline matches the strongest recomputed participant, and TTQL advantages over shape-only and SHACL baselines persist. Results on a single, relatively small benchmark provide an initial empirical signal; monolithic TTQL injection on very open cross-domain graphs remains the main limitation.

AI.tldr: QRAKEN 是一个免训练、本体无关的神经符号流水线，通过离线蒸馏得到的 TTQL（填充多跳模式、条件频率、路径条件字面量示例及类-属性共现矩阵）在推理时引导 LLM 生成 SPARQL，并结合确定性语法/词汇/数据模型检查进行迭代精炼。在 CK25 上严格 F1 达 0.643（GPT-4.1 mini）与 0.652（GPT-5.4），较最强复现参赛系统相对提升 30%/32%。
AI.motivation: 自然语言访问 RDF 知识图谱是语义网的核心目标之一。LLM 已推动 Text-to-SPARQL 进展，但在陌生图谱上常生成语法有效却与已填充数据模型不符的查询——即模型依赖 schema 预期而非实际图数据证据。因此需要一种将生成过程"接地"于经验图证据、且不依赖特定本体的方法。
AI.method: QRAKEN 为免训练、本体无关的神经符号流水线：(1) 离线蒸馏器生成 TTQL，包含已填充多跳模式、条件频率、路径条件字面量示例的紧凑描述，以及类-属性共现矩阵；(2) 在线阶段以 TTQL 引导 LLM 生成，并配合确定性语法、词汇与数据模型检查，作为诊断信号驱动迭代精炼；精炼环节可拒绝共现矩阵不支持的 triple pattern。
AI.result: 在 CK25 上按匹配条件在 QLever 快照重算，QRAKEN 严格 F1 为 0.643 ± 0.026（GPT-4.1 mini）与 0.652 ± 0.012（GPT-5.4），相对最强复现参赛者提升 30% 与 32%，优于使用同基座模型家族的系统。消融显示 TTQL 模式是主要贡献因素（较仅 shape 基线 +0.31 严格 F1）；精炼循环提供低成本安全网。与自动推导的 SHACL 相比，TTQL 严格 F1 高出 64%。使用两个本地 35B 4-bit 开放权重模型、零边际成本时，同一流水线可匹配最强复现参赛者，且 TTQL 相对 shape-only 和 SHACL 基线的优势依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 经验性填充模式比单纯暴露 schema 更具价值；TTQL 引导与确定性检查的结合可在不训练的情况下显著提升陌生图谱上的 Text-to-SPARQL 性能，并可用开放权重模型低成本复现。局限在于结果仅来自单个相对较小的基准，初步经验信号有限；在高度开放的跨域图谱上，单体式 TTQL 注入仍是主要瓶颈。

title: Beyond Training from Scratch: Foundation Models for Data-Efficient and Generalizable Cardiac MRI Reconstruction
summary: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction aims to recover high-quality images from undersampled acquisitions, enabling faster scans while preserving diagnostic fidelity. Recent reconstruction methods are typically trained from scratch and often require large amounts of task-specific data, limiting their robustness under data scarcity and distribution shifts. In this work, we investigate whether pretrained vision foundation models can serve as effective priors for accelerated cardiac MRI reconstruction. We propose a reconstruction framework that integrates frozen and parameter-efficiently adapted visual encoders, including CLIP, BiomedCLIP, and DINOv2, within a transformer-based reconstruction architecture. Extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 and CMRxRecon2024 benchmarks demonstrate that pretrained representations consistently outperform a transformer trained from scratch across multiple acceleration factors. We further evaluate performance under limited supervision and cross-dataset transfer, showing that foundation models provide superior data efficiency and generalization. While frozen representations are particularly effective in extreme low-data regimes, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) yields additional gains when moderate amounts of training data are available. Among the evaluated backbones, DINOv2 achieves the strongest overall performance. These findings highlight the potential of vision foundation models as robust and transferable priors for cardiac MRI reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文将CLIP、BiomedCLIP、DINOv2等视觉基础模型作为先验，集成到Transformer重建框架中用于加速心脏MRI重建。在CMRxRecon2023/2024基准上，预训练表征在多种加速倍数下均优于从头训练的Transformer，并在小样本与跨数据集迁移中展现更优的数据效率与泛化能力；DINOv2综合表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 加速心脏MRI重建需从欠采样数据中恢复高质量图像。现有重建方法多从头训练，依赖大量任务特定数据，在数据稀缺和分布偏移下鲁棒性不足。作者因此探究预训练视觉基础模型能否作为有效先验。
AI.method: 提出一种重建框架，将冻结及参数高效适配的视觉编码器（CLIP、BiomedCLIP、DINOv2）集成进基于Transformer的重建架构，并采用LoRA进行参数高效微调。
AI.result: 在CMRxRecon2023与CMRxRecon2024基准上，预训练表征在多个加速倍数下持续优于从头训练的Transformer；在有限监督与跨数据集迁移下数据效率与泛化性更佳。冻结表征在极端低数据场景尤为有效，LoRA在中等数据量时带来额外增益；DINOv2整体表现最强。
AI.conclusion: 视觉基础模型可作为心脏MRI重建的鲁棒且可迁移先验，为数据受限与分布偏移场景下的加速重建提供有效方案。

title: Conversation Is a Two-Body Problem: Dyadic Evaluation of Full-Duplex Dialogue Models
summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models listen and speak at the same time, enabling voice agents to have natural, low-latency interactions that turn-based systems cannot offer. However, they are commonly evaluated against single-sided interlocutors: pre-recorded audio that cannot react, or an automated examiner that reacts in real time but only administers a fixed sequence of tests and is never graded. These single-sided frameworks evaluate only half of a two-body problem, where turn-taking, overlap, and interruption are joint products of two coupled speakers. We propose DyaFDB, a framework that evaluates full-duplex models in a dyadic setup: two models converse directly under assigned roles with cooperative or conflicting goals, and both sides are scored offline with an external judge. DyaFDB probes how the two models behave toward each other, such as how they take turns or carry an assigned role under different interests. We instantiate four tasks as 140 scenarios and record 7,560 conversations, covering six self- and cross-play pairings. Throughout the experiments, we observe that how a model behaves continually reshapes its partner. We thus demonstrate that each model must be both the examiner and examinee of the other, and no single fixed interlocutor can play both parts. We will release the scenarios, role prompts, and recording protocols between two full-duplex models, without any pre-recorded audio.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DyaFDB，一个在双人（dyadic）设定下评估全双工语音对话模型的框架：两个模型在指定角色与协作/冲突目标下直接对话，并由外部裁判对双方离线打分，从而弥补现有单向评估的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有全双工语音对话模型的能力虽已突破轮次交互限制，但其评估普遍采用单向对话者：要么是预先录制、无法反应的音频，要么是能实时反应但只执行固定测试序列、且自身不被评分的自动考官。这种单向框架只评估了"双体问题"的一半——轮流、重叠与打断本质上是两个耦合说话者共同产生的联合产物，无法被单向设定充分刻画。
AI.method: 提出 DyaFDB 框架：两个全双工模型在指定角色下直接对话，目标可为协作或冲突，双方均通过外部裁判离线评分。框架考察两模型如何相互对待，例如如何轮流、如何在不同利益下维持所分配的角色。具体实例化 4 项任务、共 140 个场景，录制 7,560 段对话，覆盖 6 种自我对弈与交叉对弈组合。
AI.result: 实验观察到模型的行为会持续重塑其对话伙伴，说明在双人交互中每个模型都同时是对方的考官与考生，任何单一固定对话方都无法同时承担这两种角色。
AI.conclusion: 单向评估不足以刻画全双工对话的联合行为，需采用双人框架对双方同时评分。作者将公开场景、角色提示词及两个全双工模型间的录制协议，且不使用任何预录音频。

title: Supermarket Product Detection and Recognition: Utilizing Deep Learning with Rectified Imagery
summary: Product Identification has sprung up to become one of the most challenging problems in the automation of the retail industry. With the new industry 5.0 standards, automated inventory management, and catalog creation tasks are vitally important. Object identification models have emerged as a viable answer with their unprecedented identification and localization accuracy. However, the close-knit rack design of supermarkets generates the problem of angle variation in capturing images. The angle-variant densely packed images(a single image contains many objects) become overwhelming for these models alone. In this paper, we try to supplement object detection models with traditional Hough transform (HT) and homogeneous estimation concepts. We study the effect of rectified images using homography estimation and hough transform and their limitations on the problem of grocery identification. We make a case for creating a new dataset to test the effects of such rectification and produce analytical results on different scenarios of angle variation and object densities per image. Extensive experiments on different object detection models suggest that image rectification of angled images improves the detection accuracy of grocery products in images. The results also highlight the limitation of rectification on the angle of image capture and the object density of the image.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究零售商品识别中角度变化与密集排布导致的检测困难，提出用霍夫变换与单应性估计对倾斜图像进行矫正，并构建新数据集验证矫正对检测精度的影响及局限。
AI.motivation: 随着工业5.0标准推进，自动化库存管理与目录创建变得至关重要；商品识别成为零售自动化的核心难题。现有目标检测模型虽精度高，但超市密集货架结构导致拍摄图像存在角度变化，加上单图内物体密集，使模型检测性能大幅下降。
AI.method: 将传统霍夫变换（HT）与单应性估计（homogeneous/homography estimation）引入目标检测流程，对倾斜拍摄的商品图像进行几何矫正（rectification）；并专门构建新数据集，用于测试矫正效果，在不同角度变化与单图物体密度场景下进行对比分析。
AI.result: 在多种目标检测模型上的大量实验表明，对倾斜图像进行矫正可提升商品检测精度；同时结果也揭示了图像矫正方法在拍摄角度和图像物体密度方面的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 图像几何矫正能有效改善角度变化下密集商品图像的检测性能，但其增益受拍摄角度与物体密度制约，存在明确适用边界。

title: Mu-DisCoCat: A Variational Pipeline for Compositional Generalization on Quantum Processors
summary: Achieving compositional concept generalization (CoCoGen), the ability to understand novel situations by recombining learned primitives, remains a fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence. Compositional semantic models such as Compositional Distributional Semantics (DisCoCat) offer solutions by generalising vectors to tensors, but suffer from scaling bottlenecks when learning the tensors. Mapping DisCoCat onto Variational Quantum Circuits (VQCs) resolves this limitation for text, yet the methodology has not been expanded to multimodal situations such as the ones involved in CoCoGen. This paper introduces Mu-DisCoCat: a multimodal variational quantum learning framework for DisCoCat that achieves CoCoGen. The framework first learns stable object representations from single-object image-text pairs, then fixes these and uses them to learn the relations between them in multi-object situations.
