In classical simulations, the model used Uhlmann state fidelity to compute the overlap between the multimodal circuit representations and achieved higher relational OOD accuracy than the evaluated CLIP baseline. Its deployment was evaluated using the destructive SWAP test across noisy quantum emulators, including a range of IBM fake backends, IQM FakeAphrodite, and the IBM Marrakesh quantum processor. Despite real-world device noise, the hardware-executed models maintained a strong positive correlation with simulated fidelities, reliably distinguishing unseen similar and dissimilar pairs. Our work establishes a framework for executing CoCoGen on VQCs, demonstrating a viable use case for near-term quantum hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mu-DisCoCat，一个面向多模态场景的变分量子学习框架，用于实现组合式概念泛化（CoCoGen）。
AI.motivation: 组合式概念泛化（CoCoGen）是AI的核心难题。DisCoCat等组合语义模型虽可通过张量泛化解决，但学习张量时存在扩展瓶颈。将DisCoCat映射到变分量子电路（VQC）可缓解该限制，但此前仅用于文本，尚未扩展至多模态场景。
AI.method: Mu-DisCoCat先学习稳定的单物体图文对表示，然后固定这些表示，用于学习多物体情境中的关系。基于Uhlmann状态保真度计算多模态电路表示间的重叠；部署时采用destructive SWAP测试，在含噪声的量子模拟器（IBM fake后端、IQM FakeAphrodite及IBM Marrakesh处理器）上评估。
AI.result: 在经典模拟中，模型取得了比CLIP基线更高的关系级OOD准确率。在真实设备噪声下，硬件执行模型与模拟保真度保持强正相关，能可靠区分未见过的相似与不相似对。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了在VQC上执行CoCoGen的框架，展示了近期量子硬件的可行用例。

title: FinVector-Market-4B: A Controlled Study of LoRA Adaptation for Structured Financial Tasks
summary: FinVector-Market-4B adapts Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B with rank-16 LoRA on a 22,000-example corpus for structured financial tasks. We evaluate the base and adapted models on the same 600-example benchmark under implicit and explicit JSON-schema contracts. Supplying the schema alone raises base-model JSON validity from 0% to 91.3%. Under matched explicit prompting, the frozen scores improve from 14.7% to 40.0% for FinQA answer exact match, from 48.0% to 82.7% for calculator-expression correctness, from 20.1% to 89.5% for scenario branch-label agreement, and from 52.4% to 87.2% for implication-direction agreement. A post-hoc policy-scoring audit shows that the reported macro-F1 decline reflects a changing label set; using the same three target classes gives 77.4% for the base and 83.1% for the adapter. Filing overlap and calculator-target inconsistencies qualify the benchmark's generalization claims. The results show that compact financial domain adaptation can produce substantial task-specific gains beyond output-format learning under matched prompting, with gains bounded by the evaluated task distribution and prompt contract.

AI.tldr: 使用 rank-16 LoRA 对 Qwen3.5-4B 进行金融领域适配（FinVector-Market-4B），在匹配显式提示下多项结构化金融任务指标大幅提升，但增益受任务分布与提示契约限制。
AI.motivation: 评估紧凑型金融领域适配能否在输出格式学习之外带来实质性的任务能力提升，并厘清基线模型 JSON 输出失败与提示格式之间的关系。
AI.method: 基于 Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B，在 22,000 条样本语料上以 rank-16 LoRA 微调得到 FinVector-Market-4B；在相同 600 条基准上，对基座与适配模型分别采用隐式与显式 JSON-schema 契约进行对比评测；并对策略评分标签集变化做事后审计。
AI.result: 仅提供 schema 即使基座模型 JSON 有效率由 0% 升至 91.3%；在匹配显式提示下，冻结基座到适配器的分数分别由 14.7%→40.0%（FinQA 答案精确匹配）、48.0%→82.7%（计算器表达式正确性）、20.1%→89.5%（情景分支标签一致性）、52.4%→87.2%（蕴含方向一致性）。事后策略评分审计显示宏观 F1 下降源于标签集变化，统一为三个目标类别后基座 77.4%、适配器 83.1%。申报文件重叠与计算器目标不一致对基准泛化性构成限制。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑型金融领域适配在匹配提示契约下能带来显著的任务特定增益，且超出单纯的输出格式学习；但这些增益受评测任务分布与提示契约边界约束，泛化性结论需谨慎。

title: VLA-ACL: Action-Consistent Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong robotic manipulation performance but incur high computational costs from processing long token sequences at every control step, limiting real-time deployment. Visual token pruning offers a direct solution, as visual patches dominate the input sequence and contain considerable redundancy. Existing approaches, however, either rely on indirect training-free heuristics, such as attention scores and motion thresholds, or require costly fine-tuning of the base VLA model. We introduce VLA-ACL (Action Consistency Learning), which learns a lightweight visual token pruning policy through action-level supervision while keeping the base VLA model entirely frozen. The training objective encourages actions produced from pruned visual contexts to remain consistent with the full-context teacher, with ground-truth actions as auxiliary supervision. This directly ties token selection to its effect on the downstream control output. Experiments on LIBERO and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-ACL prunes up to 87.5% of visual tokens while retaining competitive performance, reduces computation by up to 75%, and achieves a 1.5x inference speedup. These results establish a stronger performance-efficiency trade-off than existing frozen-VLA pruning methods and demonstrate the value of action-level supervision for visual token selection. Code is available at https://github.com/du-owen/VLA-ACL.

AI.tldr: 提出 VLA-ACL，用动作级监督学习轻量视觉 token 剪枝策略，在冻结基座 VLA 的前提下剪除最多 87.5% 视觉 token，计算量降低 75%，推理加速 1.5 倍，性能仍具竞争力。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型在每个控制步处理长 token 序列，计算成本高，难以实时部署；视觉 patch 占输入序列主导且冗余大。现有剪枝方法要么依赖注意力分数、运动阈值等间接的免训练启发式，要么需对基座 VLA 做昂贵的微调。
AI.method: VLA-ACL（Action Consistency Learning）：在基座 VLA 完全冻结的条件下，学习一个轻量视觉 token 剪枝策略。训练目标为动作级监督，使剪枝视觉上下文产生的动作与全上下文教师保持一致，并以真值动作作为辅助监督，从而将 token 选择与下游控制输出直接关联。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 及真实世界操作任务上，剪除最多 87.5% 视觉 token 仍保持竞争力性能，计算量最多降低 75%，推理加速 1.5 倍。相比现有冻结 VLA 剪枝方法，取得更优的性能—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 动作级监督对视觉 token 选择具有明确价值，可在不微调基座模型的前提下显著提升 VLA 推理效率，为实时机器人操作部署提供可行路径。代码已开源。

title: Rethinking Visual Provenance: Detection and Watermarking Across Direct Visual Generation and LLM-Driven Code Rendering
comment: 46 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Conceptual research agenda; no experiments. Video: https://youtu.be/14SMl0d_e48. Project page: https://zhenggao-30.github.io/Rethinking-Visual-Provenance/
summary: AI systems create images and videos with image/video generation models or by writing code and graphics descriptions that are then rendered. These routes can produce similar visible artifacts but expose different representations, intervention points, and provenance evidence. We develop a production-centered framework that compares detection and watermarking across both routes. An explicit verification specification distinguishes passive inference, message recovery, and authenticated provenance. We organize image, video, source-code, and rendering-aware watermarks by production stage. We examine the different requirements of generated images and video, plots and SVG, programmable video, and agent-composed workflows. Documented Claude, OpenAI, and rendering-tool interfaces connect the framework to concrete systems. We pose ten scoped research questions on identifiability, observability, fair comparison across stages, recoverable payload, reconstruction, synchronization, composition, hybrid local contribution, and private production-event authentication. The result is a conceptual research agenda grounded in published methods, inspected interfaces, and elementary boundary examples. It reports no experiments and claims no new theorems; its appendix results are elementary calculations, and documentation and source inspection establish interfaces, not empirical robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以生产流程为中心的概念框架，对比"生成模型直接产出"与"写代码/图形描述再渲染"两条路径下的检测与水印；区分被动推断、消息恢复与认证溯源三类验证，按生产阶段组织多类水印，并围绕可识别性等提出十个研究问题。全文不报告实验、不主张新定理，仅为基于公开方法与接口调研的研究议程，边界示例为初等计算，接口通过文档与源码检查确认，非实证鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: AI图像/视频既可由生成模型直接产出，也可由编写代码与图形描述后渲染得到，二者可见瑕疵相似却暴露不同的表征、干预点与溯源证据；现有检测与水印研究多按模态或算法分类，缺乏统一的生产流程视角来对照两条路径，因此需要建立以生产为中心的比较框架与验证规范。
AI.method: 构建以生产为中心的概念框架：(1)明确验证规范，区分被动推断、消息恢复与认证溯源；(2)按生产阶段组织图像、视频、源码与渲染感知水印；(3)分析生成图像/视频、图表与SVG、可编程视频、智能体组合工作流的差异化需求；(4)结合Claude、OpenAI及渲染工具的文档化接口把框架落到具体系统；(5)提出十个限定范围的研究问题，并以公开方法、接口检查与初等边界示例支撑。
AI.result: 形成一份以已发表方法、接口检查和初等边界示例为基础的概念性研究议程，覆盖可识别性、可观测性、跨阶段公平比较、可恢复载荷、重建、同步、组合、混合局部贡献与私有生产事件认证等十个问题域，完成两条生成路径在多阶段的对照组织，并建立文档化接口与框架的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不开展实验、不提出新定理，附录为初等计算，文档与源码检查仅确立接口而非实证鲁棒性；其贡献在于提供生产流程导向的对照框架、验证分类与研究议程，为后续跨路径检测与水印研究界定问题与比较基准。

title: Penalty-Framed No-Valid-Option MCQA: Analyzing LLM Abstention under Invalid Choices
comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference (Short Paper)
summary: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) is commonly used to evaluate large language models under the assumption that one of the provided options is correct, typically using answer-selection accuracy. However, in real deployments, users or retrieval systems may provide invalid option sets in which none of the listed choices is correct, and selecting one of them may incur downstream cost. We study this setting as penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA. Using the mathematics subset of MMLU-Pro, we remove the labeled correct option, allow models to either choose a remaining option or output ABSTAIN, and penalize invalid forced-choice responses. We further introduce correct-conditioned analysis, evaluating abstention only on instances that the model originally answered correctly. Experiments show that high MCQA accuracy does not fully guarantee abstention reliability: even under explicit no-valid-option-aware instructions and penalty-based scoring, models still produce invalid forced-choice responses for a subset of originally correct instances. These results show that penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA reveals an aspect of model reliability not captured by standard answer-selection accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"惩罚框架下的无有效选项MCQA"设定：在MMLU-Pro数学子集中移除正确选项，允许模型选择剩余选项或输出ABSTAIN并惩罚无效强制选择，同时引入正确条件分析，发现高MCQA准确率并不能完全保证模型的弃答可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统MCQA评估假设给定选项中必有正确答案，并以答案选择准确率衡量模型。但实际部署中用户或检索系统可能提供无效选项集（无一正确），此时模型若强行选择会产生下游代价。因此需要研究在无有效选项情形下模型的弃答能力，揭示标准准确率无法捕捉的可靠性维度。
AI.method: 基于MMLU-Pro数学子集构造无有效选项MCQA任务：移除标注的正确选项，允许模型在剩余选项中选择或输出ABSTAIN，并对无效强制选择响应施加惩罚。进一步提出正确条件分析，仅在模型原本回答正确的实例上评估弃答表现。
AI.result: 实验表明高MCQA准确率不能完全保证弃答可靠性：即使在明确的无有效选项指令和基于惩罚的评分下，模型仍对部分原本回答正确的实例产生无效强制选择响应。
AI.conclusion: 惩罚框架下的无有效选项MCQA揭示了标准答案选择准确率未能捕捉的模型可靠性维度，说明准确率与弃答可靠性需分开评估。

title: Making COMET Comparable Across Scripts: Diagnosis and Correction of Tokeniser-Induced Script Bias in Indic MT Evaluation
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Camera-ready version, accepted at WMT 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/John-salvin/script-bias-comet-normalisation
summary: COMET reports translation quality as a single number, and that number is routinely compared across target languages written in different scripts. Such a comparison assumes Script Invariance: the score should not depend on the writing system that carries the target. We test it on IndicMT Eval by re-encoding the target into Latin script, which changes orthographic form while holding content and human ratings fixed. Script identity then accounts for 22.9% of native-script COMET variance, and agreement with annotators falls in all five languages studied. We trace the effect to the tokeniser and measure it with three label-free diagnostics. The bias is two faults, not one. Scores from different scripts occupy incompatible ranges, and within a single script the metric orders translations less accurately. No order-preserving transform of the score can repair the second fault. The first is removed exactly by COMET-QN, which maps the score distribution of each (language, script) pair onto a shared reference. Pooled agreement with annotators rises from 0.300 to 0.399, which is what makes scores from different scripts safe to place on one axis, and every within-language ordering is provably preserved. A regressor over parity features recovers a further 17.1% of the lost sensitivity. The remainder belongs to the encoder, and no post-processing can reach it. We therefore recommend publishing the normalised score, the three diagnostics, and the identity of the tokeniser they were computed against, so that a reader can tell how much of a score reflects translation quality and how much reflects the writing system.

AI.tldr: 本文检验COMET跨书写系统评分是否满足"文字系统不变性"，发现目标语言转写为拉丁字母后评分显著变化，并将偏差分解为量纲不兼容与序内灵敏度下降两类，通过COMET-QN归一化消除前者、部分修复后者。
AI.motivation: COMET将翻译质量压缩为单一分数，并被跨不同书写系统的目标语言直接比较，这一做法隐含假设"文字系统不变性"。作者认为该假设未被验证，若分数受书写系统影响，则跨文字系统的分数比较将失真。
AI.method: 在IndicMT Eval上，保持内容与人工评分不变，仅将目标文本重新编码为拉丁字母（改变正字法形式），比较原生文字与拉丁转写下的COMET分数；用三个无标签诊断指标将偏差溯源至分词器；提出COMET-QN，将每个（语言，文字系统）对的分数分布映射到共享参考分布；再用基于奇偶性特征的回归器恢复灵敏度。
AI.result: 文字系统身份可解释原生文字COMET方差的22.9%，且五个语言中与标注者的一致性均下降。偏差包含两类：不同文字系统的分数落在不相容区间；同一文字系统内排序准确性下降，后者无法通过保序变换修复。COMET-QN精确消除第一类偏差，与标注者的合并一致性由0.300升至0.399，且各语言内部排序可证明保持不变；基于奇偶性特征的回归器额外恢复17.1%的损失灵敏度，剩余部分归于编码器，无法通过后处理消除。
AI.conclusion: COMET不满足文字系统不变性，跨文字系统的分数比较需要谨慎。作者建议发布归一化分数、三个诊断指标及其所依赖的分词器身份，使读者能辨别分数中有多少反映翻译质量、多少反映书写系统。

title: Symphony for Text Generation: Benchmarking Clinical Note Generation
summary: Ambient documentation systems are rapidly gaining adoption, yet their impact on clinical note quality remains poorly characterized. We introduce MedConv, a multilingual dataset of 300 clinical encounters in English, Danish, and German, and use it alongside the Ambient Clinical Intelligence benchmark (ACI-BENCH) to compare Corti, a clinical AI platform, with two leading, accessible ambient scribe software applications built on general-purpose AI. We present a controlled clinical evaluation framework that combines entailment metrics with LLM-judged pairwise comparisons across eight dimensions adopted from PDSQI-9. Results show that Corti's API-based text-generation infrastructure is on par with or outperforms leading commercial scribes. We further show that Corti's configurable API provides the flexibility necessary to fine-tune quality dimensions for specific documentation use cases. We present the evaluation methodology and release a dataset to support future reproducible comparison of ambient documentation systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多语言数据集MedConv（300例英/丹/德临床问诊），结合ACI-BENCH，用蕴含指标与LLM成对评判（8个PDSQI-9维度）比较临床AI平台Corti与两款通用型ambient scribe软件，发现Corti的API文本生成能力持平或优于领先商业产品，且可通过配置微调文档质量维度。
AI.motivation: 环境式文档（ambient documentation）系统正快速被采用，但其对临床记录质量的影响尚缺乏充分表征，也缺少可复现的对比评测方法。
AI.method: 构建多语言数据集MedConv（300例临床问诊，涵盖英语、丹麦语、德语）；结合ACI-BENCH基准；提出受控临床评估框架，融合文本蕴含度量与基于LLM的成对比较，评判维度取自PDSQI-9的八个维度；据此比较Corti（基于API的文本生成）与两款基于通用AI的可获取ambient scribe软件。
AI.result: Corti基于API的文本生成基础设施与领先商业scribe持平或更优；其可配置API具备足够灵活性，可针对特定文档用例微调质量维度。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了可复现的环境式文档系统评估方法学并发布数据集，以支持未来对该类系统的可复现比较。

title: The Failure Is in the Readout: Fine-Grained Emotion Recognition Benchmarks Measure Elicitation, Not Perception
summary: Fine-grained emotion recognition supports therapy tools and social robots, but it needs facial data, which raises privacy and data-protection concerns. EmoNet-Face-HQ answers that with generated portraits, expert-rated over a $40$-category taxonomy far finer than the usual six to eight basic emotions. Under the protocol it ships with, vision-language models (VLMs) score poorly on that taxonomy, and the benchmark concludes that a dedicated fine-tuned model is necessary: Empathic-Insight-Face (EIF; Small/Large). We show that off-the-shelf VLMs match or beat that fine-tuned model when the answer is not generated but read from the logits, as one binary query per category. We keep the benchmark's images, taxonomy and ratings, and change only how the answer is read. Experts agree at $κ_w = 0.468$ on the five categories they measure most reliably. Generatively, no interval among eleven open-weight VLMs lies entirely above that anchor ($κ_w=0.268$-$0.486$). Under verification all eleven clear it, each of them significantly better at $κ_w=0.507$-$0.586$. Three also significantly beat EIF sitting at $κ_w = 0.551$ (Small; $0.534$ Large). The gain comes from the graded probability and not from asking a yes/no question: as a control, thresholding those same probabilities to yes/no costs 142% of the average gains and drops binarization below generative elicitation to $κ_w=0.254$-$0.423$. A replication on real photographs (FACES) is weaker and mixed: of the ten models that pass a validity gate, six gain, three are neutral to positive and one is negative, so the effect is not confined to synthetic data.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，EmoNet-Face-HQ基准所主张的"必须使用微调专用模型(EIF)"结论，源于其采用生成式作答协议；若将同一批图像、同套40类taxonomy与专家评分保留不变，仅改为从logits逐类读取二元概率(verification)，十一个开源权重VLM全部超越专家一致性锚点(κ_w=0.507-0.586)，显著优于生成式(κ_w=0.268-0.486)，其中三个还显著超过EIF。增益来自分级概率本身，而非是否问yes/no；在真实照片FACES上的复现效果较弱且混合。
AI.motivation: 细粒度情绪识别可支撑治疗工具与社交机器人，但依赖面部数据，带来隐私与数据保护问题。EmoNet-Face-HQ以生成式人像、40类专家评分taxonomy回应这一需求。然而该基准在其随附协议下使VLM表现很差，并据此得出结论：必须使用专门微调的模型EIF。作者质疑这一结论是否由模型能力不足所致，还是由作答读取方式（生成式 vs. 从logits读取）造成的评估假象。
AI.method: 保留基准的图像、taxonomy与专家评分，仅改变答案读取方式：对每个类别做一次二元查询，从模型logits读取分级概率，而非生成式作答。以专家在五个最可靠类别上的一致性κ_w=0.468作为参照锚点。测试十一个开源权重VLM，对比生成式与verification(概率读取)两种协议，并与EIF(Small/Large)比较。设置阈值化控制实验：将同一概率阈值化为yes/no，以区分增益来源是"分级概率"还是"是否问yes/no"这一问题形式。最后在真实照片数据集FACES上进行复现，并设有效性门控。
AI.result: 专家一致性锚点κ_w=0.468。生成式下，十一个VLM的区间κ_w=0.268-0.486，无一区间整体高于锚点。verification下全部十一个均显著超过锚点，κ_w=0.507-0.586，其中三个还显著超过EIF(Small κ_w=0.551，Large κ_w=0.534)。增益源于分级概率而非yes/no提问形式：阈值化控制使平均增益损失142%，并使二值化降到κ_w=0.254-0.423，低于生成式诱导。FACES真实照片复现较弱且混合：通过有效性门控的十个模型中，六个增益、三个中性至正向、一个负向，说明效应不限于合成数据。
AI.conclusion: 现有基准中"专用微调模型必要"的结论很可能是评估协议造成的假象，而非模型能力差距。仅改变答案读取方式(从logits读取分级概率)即可使现成VLM达到甚至超越微调模型与专家一致性锚点，且该效应不局限于合成人像。这提示情绪识别基准应审慎区分生成式与verification协议，并重新评估微调必要性与隐私驱动数据策略的前提。

title: Align, Then Correct: Training-Free Two-Stage Low-Rank Compensation for Extremely Quantized Large Language Models
summary: Low-rank quantization error compensation (LQEC) recovers the accuracy lost under aggressive weight quantization by attaching a closed-form rank-$r$ adapter beside each frozen quantized weight, without any training. We show that existing compensators are limited by two shared simplifications. They calibrate symmetrically, evaluating the full-precision and compensated weights on the same activation, which yields a compensation target that is inherently high-rank -- so a fixed rank budget captures only a small fraction of it. And they minimize only the second-order term of the loss, although the compensated model is not stationary: a first-order descent direction larger than the applied compensation itself remains in every layer, and no reconstruction objective can absorb it. We propose a two-stage closed-form framework that removes both simplifications. Stage 1 aligns each layer's output with the full-precision model under a Fisher-weighted asymmetric objective, concentrating the rank budget on a rank-compressible target. Stage 2 re-measures statistics on the compensated model and applies a rank-constrained natural-gradient step that absorbs the remaining first-order signal. Every adapter is the result of a single truncated SVD; backward passes serve only to collect statistics. At 2 bits under QuIP#, our method reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 12.43 to 10.26 on Qwen3-8B and from 21.11 to 13.22 on Qwen3-4B. On the held-out C4 corpus, it recovers 51% and 84% of the gap to FP16, versus 31% and 63% for the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in the seven-task zero-shot average, at higher bit-widths, and under a distinct quantizer.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段闭式低秩量化误差补偿框架，去除现有补偿器的对称标定与仅用二阶损失的简化，在2比特量化下显著降低困惑度并缩小与FP16的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩量化误差补偿器存在两点共同简化：一是对称标定，在全精度与补偿权重上使用同一激活，导致补偿目标本身高秩，固定秩预算只能捕获小部分；二是仅最小化损失的二阶项，而补偿后模型非平稳，每层仍残留大于所施加补偿的一阶下降方向，重建目标无法吸收。
AI.method: 提出两阶段闭式框架。第一阶段：在Fisher加权非对称目标下，将每层输出与全精度模型对齐，使秩预算集中于可秩压缩目标。第二阶段：在补偿模型上重新测量统计量，施加秩约束的自然梯度步以吸收剩余一阶信号。每个适配器均由一次截断SVD得到，反向传播仅用于收集统计量，无需训练。
AI.result: 在QuIP# 2比特下，Qwen3-8B的WikiText-2困惑度从12.43降至10.26，Qwen3-4B从21.11降至13.22；在C4语料上分别恢复51%和84%的与FP16差距（最强基线为31%和63%），七任务零样本平均、更高比特宽度及不同量化器下均有一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除对称标定与仅二阶损失两项简化，所提两阶段闭式框架在不训练的前提下显著提升低秩量化误差补偿效果，更有效地恢复量化模型精度。

title: Visual Orchestration Tax in Agentic VLM Pipelines: Auditing and Certifying Visual Evidence Reuse
summary: Agentic VLM pipelines increasingly pass the same static visual evidence through multiple specialist agents and tools. This design creates an orchestration-level redundancy mode: semantically unchanged images are repeatedly reconstructed as image-conditioned requests at the VLM API boundary. We call this phenomenon visual orchestration tax and develop a measurement-to-certification framework for visual evidence reuse in agentic VLM pipelines. The audit side defines $\mathrm{M1}_{\mathrm{trace}}$ to count raw visual-evidence touches and M2 to measure structural touch redundancy, with query-level distributions, bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired quality tests. Across SeeingEye and MAMMQA on chart, document, general-VQA, and multi-modal-QA tasks, audits reveal 66.8-75.6% visual-evidence touch redundancy, and every audited query exceeds the predefined gate. The certification side introduces SharedVisCache, a contract-aware evidence reuse hook keyed by image content, preprocessing fingerprint, and encoder assumptions. On SeeingEye, contract validation certifies 75.0-75.5% repeated touches as reusable while preserving 350/350 output strings and $Δ\mathrm{M5}{=}0$. At the physical layer, certified hits reduce $F_{\mathrm{vision}}$ from 800 to 200 in ChartQA-200 trace replay and from 200 to 50 inside live SeeingEye translator-stage physical integration, preserving 800/800 replay strings and 200/200 integrated call outputs. The results position visual reuse as a measurable, behavior-preserving property of agent orchestration and define an agent-layer contract that makes backend prefix or token reuse semantically interpretable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"视觉编排税"(visual orchestration tax)概念，刻画智能体VLM流水线中静态视觉证据被重复重建的冗余现象，并构建从测量到认证的框架：审计侧以M1_trace与M2量化冗余，认证侧以SharedVisCache实现契约感知的视觉证据复用。
AI.motivation: Agentic VLM流水线将同一静态视觉证据传递给多个专用智能体与工具，导致语义未变的图像在VLM API边界被反复重建为图像条件请求，产生编排层冗余。该现象此前缺乏度量与可控机制，且后端前缀/令牌复用难以在语义层面解释。
AI.method: 框架分两部分：审计侧定义M1_trace统计原始视觉证据触碰次数、M2度量结构性触碰冗余，配合查询级分布、bootstrap置信区间与配对质量检验；认证侧提出SharedVisCache，一种以图像内容、预处理指纹与编码器假设为键的契约感知证据复用钩子，并进行契约验证与物理层集成。
AI.result: 在SeeingEye与MAMMQA的图表、文档、通用VQA与多模态QA任务上，审计显示66.8-75.6%的视觉证据触碰冗余，且每条被审查询均超过预设门限。SeeingEye上契约验证将75.0-75.5%重复触碰认证为可复用，保持350/350输出字符串且ΔM5=0。物理层上，认证命中使ChartQA-200轨迹回放的F_vision从800降至200，实时SeeingEye翻译阶段集成中从200降至50，分别保持800/800回放字符串与200/200集成调用输出。
AI.conclusion: 视觉复用可作为智能体编排中可度量且行为保持的属性；所定义的智能体层契约使后端前缀或令牌复用在语义上可解释。

title: View Matters: Keyframe-Guided Text-Driven 3D Gaussian Editing
summary: Text-driven 3D Gaussian editing commonly does not distinguish the editing reliability of rendered views, although different viewpoints provide supervision of substantially different quality. Views that clearly show the scene and match the edit instruction provide reliable guidance, while less informative views may weaken the edit when all views are treated equally. We present View Matters, a view-importance-aware framework that conducts editing around reliable keyframes. Keyframe Importance Estimation (KIE) identifies reliable views using geometric visibility, semantic distinctiveness, and edit relevance. Keyframe-Guided Editing (KGE) then propagates their editing signals asymmetrically to non-keyframes without noisy reverse influence, while Importance-Aware Optimization (IAO) preserves this reliability preference during 3DGS optimization. Across 23 scene-prompt pairs, View Matters achieves the highest average CLIP text-image similarity of 0.2822 and directional similarity of 0.2564 among the evaluated methods, with a four-minute editing time. Additional adjacent-view analysis indicates that the fidelity-oriented editing process maintains cross-view coherence.

AI.tldr: 提出 View Matters，一个“视图重要性感知”的文本驱动 3D 高斯编辑框架，围绕可靠关键帧进行编辑，在 23 组场景-提示对上取得最高平均 CLIP 文本-图像相似度 0.2822 与方向相似度 0.2564，编辑耗时约 4 分钟。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动 3D 高斯编辑通常不区分各渲染视图的编辑可靠性，对所有视图同等对待。但不同视角的监督质量差异显著：能清晰呈现场景且与编辑指令匹配的视图可提供可靠引导，而信息量不足的视图会削弱编辑效果。
AI.method: 框架包含三个组件：Keyframe Importance Estimation（KIE）利用几何可见性、语义显著性与编辑相关性识别可靠视图；Keyframe-Guided Editing（KGE）将关键帧的编辑信号以非对称方式传播至非关键帧，避免噪声的反向影响；Importance-Aware Optimization（IAO）在 3DGS 优化过程中保持这种可靠性偏好。
AI.result: 在 23 组场景-提示对上，View Matters 在被评估方法中取得最高平均 CLIP 文本-图像相似度 0.2822 和方向相似度 0.2564，编辑时间约 4 分钟；额外的相邻视图分析表明该面向保真度的编辑过程维持了跨视图一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模视图重要性并以关键帧为中心进行编辑信号传播与优化，可有效提升文本驱动 3D 高斯编辑的质量与跨视图一致性，同时保持较高的编辑效率。

title: PIE-PS: Photometric Stereo from Physical Irradiance Event Streams
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
summary: Event cameras record asynchronous log-image-irradiance changes with microsecond latency and high dynamic range. These properties are useful for photometric stereo under moving illumination, but raw events are sparse and depend on an unknown contrast threshold. We start from the event trigger model and derive a physical relation between adjacent events, light motion, and surface normals. This relation gives a direct physics-only solver, but the solver needs the threshold, enough events at each pixel, and independent per-pixel optimization. To address these limits, we introduce PIE-PS, a learning-based framework for dense surface normal reconstruction from raw event streams and known lighting. We form Physical Irradiance Events (PIEs) by pairing two adjacent events at the same pixel with their corresponding light directions. Each PIE provides a Physical Irradiance Event Feature (PIEF), defined as the signed event rate. PIEF does not require the unknown contrast threshold. To share spatial and temporal context across nearby PIEs, we introduce PIE-GNN, which treats each PIE as a graph node and encodes it with its light-pair geometry. Since the reliability of PIE observations can vary with local appearance, illumination geometry, and sensor noise, Reliability-Grading Attention (RGA) predicts reliability weights to down-weight unreliable PIEs. Pixel aggregation then produces dense normals. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that PIE-PS outperforms prior event-based photometric stereo methods and the direct solver baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIE-PS框架，从原始事件流与已知光照中重建稠密表面法线，通过构造不依赖对比度阈值的物理辐照事件特征并利用图神经网络与可靠性分级注意力聚合，性能优于既有事件光度立体方法与直接物理求解基线。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备微秒级延迟与高动态范围，适合运动光照下的光度立体，但原始事件稀疏且依赖未知对比度阈值，直接物理求解需要阈值、每像素足够事件数及独立逐像素优化，难以实现稠密重建。
AI.method: 从事件触发模型出发，推导相邻事件、光照运动与表面法线之间的物理关系，得到仅依赖物理的直接求解器；进而提出PIE-PS：将同一像素相邻两事件与其光照方向配对构成Physical Irradiance Events (PIEs)，定义PIEF为带符号事件率（无需对比度阈值）；用PIE-GNN将每个PIE视为图节点并编码光照对几何以共享时空上下文；用Reliability-Grading Attention (RGA)预测可靠性权重以抑制不可靠PIE；最后经像素聚合得到稠密法线。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上，PIE-PS优于既有基于事件的光度立体方法及直接求解器基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过将事件对建模为物理辐照事件并引入图神经网络与可靠性注意力机制，可在不依赖未知对比度阈值的情况下实现稠密、鲁棒的事件光度立体法线重建。

title: MacJEPA: Missingness-Robust Audio-Visual Recognition from Untrimmed Egocentric Videos
summary: Audio-visual models improve egocentric action recognition by exploiting complementary cues, yet typically assume that both streams remain available at inference. Existing missing-modality methods operate on trimmed, single-event clips in which a stream is entirely present or absent, whereas real sensors fail and recover within long, untrimmed observations. We redefine egocentric modality missingness as temporally localized sensor outages within untrimmed, multi-event observations, with whole-clip absence as the limiting case. We introduce \textbf{MacJEPA}, a missing-modality-robust \textbf{Ma}sked-\textbf{c}ontext query \textbf{JEPA} that recognizes visual actions and acoustic events from supplied interval queries over audio-visual context. Window-local modality dropout simulates these sensor outages during training. MacJEPA further repurposes masking in JEPA from a self-supervised pretext into a supervised robustness objective, aligning masked and clean latent representations of both multimodal content tokens and the task-conditioned queries. All objectives are optimized jointly with recognition in a single stage, requiring no test-time adaptation. Across Epic-Kitchens-100 and Epic-Sounds, a single checkpoint remains competitive under complete input and consistently surpasses published missing-modality baselines when either the dominant or auxiliary stream is removed. MacJEPA thus unifies strong full-input recognition with temporal missing-modality robustness in a single model operating on untrimmed multi-event videos.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MacJEPA，将自我中心模态缺失重新定义为未裁剪多事件视频中的时间局部化传感器中断，通过窗口局部模态dropout与掩码-干净表征对齐，实现单阶段训练、无需测试时自适应的鲁棒音视频动作/声事件识别。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频模型推理时假设双流均可用；已有缺失模态方法仅处理被裁剪的单事件片段（流要么全有要么全无），而真实传感器会在长时未裁剪观测中反复失效与恢复，缺乏对时间局部化中断的建模。
AI.method: 提出MacJEPA（Masked-context query JEPA），在音频-视觉上下文的区间查询上识别视觉动作与声学事件。训练时用窗口局部模态dropout模拟传感器中断；将JEPA中的掩码从自监督 pretext 改造为监督式鲁棒性目标，对齐多模态内容token与任务条件查询的掩码/干净隐表征；所有目标与识别任务在单阶段联合优化，无需测试时自适应。
AI.result: 在Epic-Kitchens-100与Epic-Sounds上，单检查点在完整输入下保持竞争力；当主导流或辅助流被移除时，一致超越已发表的缺失模态基线。
AI.conclusion: MacJEPA在单一模型中统一了强完整输入识别与时间缺失模态鲁棒性，适用于未裁剪多事件视频。

title: STRUCTURALCOST: A controlled reading time dataset for modeling human sentence processing difficulty
summary: We introduce STRUCTURALCOST, a self-paced reading dataset of 475 participants and 40,800 observations isolating the processing cost of long-distance subject-verb dependency resolution. We replicate a low-powered psycholinguistic finding at NLP scale, namely that human reading times at the main verb increase with dependency length, driven by syntactic embedding beyond linear distance. Different language models -- spanning n-gram models, SSMs, and transformers -- partially mirror this graded difficulty profile, yet underestimate the integration cost humans incur, with a gap that persists across architectures and model sizes. This suggests these models capture the predictive component of human processing but not the full integration cost that working memory imposes. STRUCTURALCOST provides data needed to drive progress toward evaluating the cognitive plausibility of language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRUCTURALCOST数据集（475名被试、40800条观测），在NLP规模上复现了长距离主谓依存解析的加工成本，并发现各类语言模型虽能部分反映这一难度梯度，但普遍低估了人类的整合成本。
AI.motivation: 长距离主谓依存解析的心理语言学效应此前仅在低统计效力的小样本实验中被发现，缺乏大规模数据验证；同时，语言模型是否具备与人类相似的加工难度profile尚不明确，需要可支撑认知合理性评估的数据资源。
AI.method: 构建自定步速阅读数据集STRUCTURALCOST，包含475名被试、40800条观测，专门隔离长距离主谓依存解析的加工成本；并在该数据上对比n-gram、SSM和transformer等不同架构与规模的语言模型的预测表现。
AI.result: 在主谓动词处，人类阅读时间随依存长度增加而上升，且该效应由句法嵌套（而非线性距离）驱动；不同语言模型部分反映了这一难度梯度，但一致低估了人类的整合成本，该差距在不同架构与模型规模下均存在。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可能捕捉了人类加工的预测成分，但未体现工作记忆施加的完整整合成本；STRUCTURALCOST为推动语言模型认知合理性评估提供了必要数据。

title: RACE-FPP: A Robust AI-assisted Characterisation Enhancement for Fringe Projection Profilometry
summary: Fringe Projection Profilometry (FPP) requires precise system characterisation to achieve reliable three-dimensional (3D) reconstructions; however, characterisation accuracy strongly depends on robust checkerboard feature localisation, which can deteriorate under challenging imaging conditions such as lens blur and characterisation target orientations. Existing deep learning-based corner detectors are typically assessed using detection metrics and camera reprojection error alone, without considering their wider impact on projector characterisation, camera-projector stereo characterisation consistency, or overall measurement accuracy. In this work, we introduce a complete FPP characterisation pipeline that incorporates deep learning-based corner detection into the standard camera characterisation workflow. We also characterise the projector by sampling phase values at the centres of the white squares in the characterisation target. Rather than treating corner detection as an isolated task, the proposed framework explicitly analyses how localisation errors propagate throughout the entire FPP characterisation chain. Performance is evaluated using detection metrics (e.g., precision and recall), camera and projector reprojection errors, and the camera and projector stereo characterisation. Across a mixed dataset of clean and degraded images, the camera reprojection error is reduced from 1.237 pixels to 0.259 pixels, while the projector reprojection error is reduced by roughly 50%. Dimensional evaluation of reconstructed artefacts shows improved geometric accuracy compared with those resulting from the conventional pipeline. Overall, the findings indicate increased robustness of system-level characterisation under challenging imaging conditions, thereby enabling more reliable industrial FPP measurements.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出完整的条纹投影轮廓术（FPP）标定流程，将深度学习角点检测融入相机标定，并通过采样标定靶白块中心的相位值标定投影仪，系统分析角点定位误差在整条标定链中的传播。混合数据集上相机重投影误差由1.237像素降至0.259像素，投影仪重投影误差降低约50%，重建件尺寸精度优于传统流程，提升了挑战性成像条件下的系统级标定鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: FPP实现可靠三维重建依赖精确的系统标定，而标定精度高度依赖棋盘格特征定位的稳健性；在镜头模糊、标定靶姿态倾斜等挑战性成像条件下定位精度会下降。现有深度学习角点检测器多以检测指标和相机重投影误差评估，未考虑其对投影仪标定、相机-投影仪立体标定一致性及整体测量精度的更广泛影响。
AI.method: 构建完整的FPP标定流程：将深度学习角点检测集成到标准相机标定工作流中；对投影仪则通过采样标定靶白色方块中心的相位值进行标定。该框架不将角点检测视为孤立任务，而是显式分析局部定位误差如何在整个FPP标定链中传播。评估指标包括精度、召回率等检测指标，相机与投影仪重投影误差，以及相机-投影仪立体标定结果，并使用洁净与退化图像混合数据集。
AI.result: 在混合数据集上，相机重投影误差从1.237像素降至0.259像素，投影仪重投影误差降低约50%；对重建件的尺寸评估显示，其几何精度相比传统流程有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在挑战性成像条件下系统级标定的鲁棒性得到增强，从而可实现更可靠的工业FPP测量。

title: How Many Independent Samples Does a Satellite Image Contain? Generalization Bounds for Spatially Dependent Data
summary: Machine learning classifiers for remote sensing imagery are typically evaluated as though every pixel were an independent sample. Spatial autocorrelation violates this assumption, since neighboring pixels carry redundant information which inflates sample sizes. How many independent samples does a satellite image actually contain? For an $n \times n$ image whose spatial correlation persists over a range of $r$ pixels, the effective sample size is $Θ(n^2/r^2)$, not $n^2$. We prove this as a finite-sample upper bound for classifiers on spatially correlated data, and show via a matching lower bound that the rate is tight, and no algorithm can do better. We extend the results to images with directional correlation and spatially varying correlation structure. Our result justifies spatial cross-validation since block holdout with separation proportional to the correlation range achieves optimal generalization guarantees, while random holdout can underestimate confidence interval widths by a factor proportional to $r$. We validate the theory on synthetic data and satellite image tiles from three sensors (Landsat 8, Sentinel-2, and Sentinel-1).

AI.tldr: 该论文证明空间自相关使遥感影像的有效样本量为Θ(n²/r²)而非n²，并给出紧的上界与下界，为空间交叉验证提供理论依据。
AI.motivation: 遥感影像分类器通常假设每个像素为独立样本进行评估，但空间自相关使相邻像素携带冗余信息，导致样本量被高估、置信区间过窄。论文旨在回答卫星影像实际包含多少独立样本这一基础问题。
AI.method: 作者针对空间相关性持续范围为r像素的n×n图像，证明有效样本量为Θ(n²/r²)的有限样本上界，并通过构造匹配的下界证明该速率的紧性；进一步将结果推广到具有方向性相关和空间变化相关结构的图像，并在合成数据及Landsat 8、Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1三种传感器的卫星影像瓦片上进行验证。
AI.result: 理论上确立了有效样本量Θ(n²/r²)的紧界，表明不存在更优算法；实验验证了该理论预测。结果表明随机留出法会将置信区间宽度低估约r倍，而块状留出法（间隔与相关范围成正比）可达到最优泛化保证，从而从理论上支持空间交叉验证。
AI.conclusion: 空间自相关显著降低遥感影像的有效样本量，该结论为空间交叉验证的必要性提供了严格理论支撑，并量化了随机留出法低估不确定性的程度。

title: TSRN-RTVD: Real-Time Video Deblurring System
summary: As video capture moves to handheld and edge devices, motion blur from camera shake has become a pervasive degradation that lowers perceptual quality and harms downstream vision tasks. The strongest deblurring networks recover impressive detail, yet they remain computationally heavy and overwhelmingly complex, so their quality comes at a cost that consumer hardware cannot pay in real time. This gap between restoration quality and on-device speed is exactly what makes real-time deblurring difficult. We developed and implemented TSRN-RTVD, an efficient video deblurring system that explicitly reconstructs the underlying camera trajectory during exposure and uses the recovered motion to guide restoration. This approach turns the physical cause of blur into a signal that drives sharpening. Our system runs on a single consumer GPU and restores the video at 30 FPS while reaching 30.08 dB PSNR on the GoPro dataset. We demonstrate TSRN-RTVD on consumer devices with interactive side-by-side visualization of the blurry input and the deblurred output, live throughput, and an on-screen view of the recovered camera trajectory. Demo video is available at https://youtu.be/3alMwVrVALU.

AI.tldr: 提出高效视频去模糊系统TSRN-RTVD，通过显式重建曝光期间相机轨迹并用于引导复原，在单张消费级GPU上以30 FPS运行，GoPro数据集PSNR达30.08 dB。
AI.motivation: 手持与边缘设备拍摄普及，相机抖动导致的运动模糊普遍存在，降低感知质量并损害下游视觉任务。现有最强去模糊网络虽细节恢复出色，但计算量大、结构复杂，消费级硬件无法实时承受，复原质量与端侧速度之间存在明显鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出TSRN-RTVD高效视频去模糊系统，在曝光过程中显式重建底层相机轨迹，并利用恢复出的运动信息引导复原，将模糊的物理成因转化为驱动锐化的信号。
AI.result: 在单张消费级GPU上以30 FPS恢复视频，在GoPro数据集上达到30.08 dB PSNR；并在消费级设备上演示，支持模糊输入与去模糊输出的交互式并排可视化、实时吞吐量显示以及恢复的相机轨迹屏上展示。
AI.conclusion: TSRN-RTVD通过轨迹引导实现了实时视频去模糊，在消费级硬件上兼顾了速度与复原质量。

title: Whose Face Is It Anyway? A Multi-Model Audit of Facial Affect Recognition on Children, and Why the Gap Is the Head, Not the Features
summary: Facial affect models are trained almost entirely on adults, yet are increasingly applied to children in education, health, and developmental research. We present a controlled, multi-model audit of five AffectNet-pretrained expression models (EmoNet, EmotiEffLib, DDAMFN++, OpenFace 3.0, LibreFace) on children, across four child image datasets, the AffectNet-8 validation set, and two spontaneous child video datasets, through one shared harness. Three findings emerge. First, the child gap is model-agnostic: every architecture degrades from posed to naturalistic faces and shares the fear$\rightarrow$surprise confusion. Second, it is concentrated and corroborated across all five models: open-mouth faces (read as surprise, correlating with the AU26 jaw drop) and South-Asian children degrade systematically, with a smaller averted-gaze penalty, while closed-mouth faces, White and Black children, and direct gaze do not; the bias tracks expression morphology and specific populations, not skin tone. Third, the gap is diagnosable: a linear probe on frozen features reaches 0.75-0.91 on unseen children versus 0.48-0.66 zero-shot, so it lies largely in the classifier head, not the representation, whereas dimensional valence/arousal regression degrades sharply under domain shift. Building on this, recalibrating only the head on a little target data recovers $+0.13$ to $+0.28$ on the two largest child sets across all five models at negligible adult cost, though the gain is in-distribution and does not transfer across child collections. We will release the harness, per-sample predictions, and analysis code; the child face data stays license-locked and is never redistributed.

AI.tldr: 本文对五个基于AffectNet预训练的表情模型在儿童面部数据上进行统一框架下的多模型审计，发现儿童性能差距具有模型无关性、集中于特定形态与人群，且主要位于分类头而非特征表示，仅重校准分类头即可显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 面部情感模型几乎完全基于成人数据训练，却被日益应用于儿童相关的教育、健康和发展研究中，存在潜在的适用性与公平性风险，因此需要对儿童面部表情识别中的性能差距进行系统、受控的审计。
AI.method: 在单一共享框架（harness）下，对五个AffectNet预训练表情模型（EmoNet、EmotiEffLib、DDAMFN++、OpenFace 3.0、LibreFace）进行受控多模型审计，测试集包括四个儿童图像数据集、AffectNet-8验证集以及两个儿童自发视频数据集；通过线性探针（linear probe）与零样本（zero-shot）对比分析差距来源，并尝试仅重校准分类头。
AI.result: （1）儿童差距与模型无关：所有架构从摆拍过渡到自然表情时性能均下降，并共享fear→surprise混淆；（2）差距集中于特定形态与人群：张嘴表情（被误判为surprise，与AU26下颌张开相关）和南亚儿童系统性退化，较小程度的回避注视惩罚，而闭嘴表情、白人与黑人儿童及直视注视无此问题，偏差与表情形态及特定人群相关而非肤色；（3）差距可诊断：线性探针在未见儿童上达0.75–0.91，而零样本仅0.48–0.66，说明差距主要位于分类头而非表示层，维度效价/唤醒回归在域迁移下急剧退化。仅用少量目标数据重校准分类头，在最大两个儿童数据集上于全部五个模型提升+0.13至+0.28，且成人成本可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 儿童面部表情性能差距是模型无关且集中于分类头的，可通过少量目标数据重校准分类头在极低成人代价下显著缓解；但增益属分布内，无法跨儿童数据集迁移。将发布框架、逐样本预测与分析代码（儿童面部数据受许可限制，不予再分发）。

title: Event Detection in Table Tennis Videos using 2D Keypoints
comment: Accepted at the 9th International ACM Workshop on Multimedia Content Analysis in Sports
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of automatic, frame-accurate event detection in table tennis videos. Current methods for estimating 3d ball trajectories and ball spin typically require that key events, such as ball-racket contacts, have already been identified in advance. This requirement makes it difficult to apply these methods to longer, unedited video recordings. To overcome this limitation, we propose EventNet, a two-stage pipeline to detect key events: (1) 2d keypoints are extracted of the upper-body poses for both players, table corners and ball center. A small keypoint transformer combines them into a compact representation that is robust to changes in viewpoint, lighting, and background clutter. (2) The temporal sequences of these frame-based representations are processed by a transformer encoder that predicts two time-to-event values for each frame, indicating how close the current frame is to the next and previous ball-racket contact. One novelty is a new, temporal cosine-like target signal. Furthermore, we introduce viewpoint augmentation via 3D reprojection and frame-rate augmentation to improve robustness and generalization. Our extensive ablation study gives deeper insights into the importance of various architectural and training aspects. Experimental results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1 score of 91.16% and a mean frame deviation between ground truth and predicted frame of 0.42 on the Latte-MV dataset and 73.08% / 1.16 on the challenging TTHQ dataset. Overall, our work demonstrates that 2d keypoint-based temporal modeling with our EventNet architecture is a promising and practical approach for automatic event detection in table tennis videos.

AI.tldr: 提出EventNet两阶段流水线，仅用2D关键点即可在长视频中实现帧级乒乓球关键事件（球拍接触）自动检测，在Latte-MV上F1达91.16%、平均帧偏差0.42，在TTHQ上为73.08%/1.16。
AI.motivation: 现有3D球轨迹与旋转估计方法依赖预先标注的关键事件（如球-拍接触），难以应用于长时、未剪辑的乒乓球录像，因此需要一种能自动、帧级精确检测关键事件的方法。
AI.method: EventNet为两阶段流水线：(1) 提取双方上半身姿态、球台角点与球心的2D关键点，由小型关键点Transformer融合为对视角、光照和背景杂乱鲁棒的紧凑表示；(2) 用Transformer编码器处理这些帧级表示的时间序列，逐帧预测到下一次和上一次球拍接触的time-to-event值。创新点包括类似余弦的时间目标信号、基于3D重投影的视角增强与帧率增强。
AI.result: 在Latte-MV数据集上F1为91.16%，预测帧与真值帧平均偏差0.42；在更具挑战的TTHQ数据集上为73.08%与1.16。大量消融实验分析了各架构与训练要素的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 基于2D关键点的时间建模配合EventNet架构，是乒乓球视频自动事件检测中一种有前景且实用的方案，可摆脱对预标注关键事件的依赖。

title: Memory Depth and Reconstructed Context Width: A Controlled Evaluation of Hierarchical Retrieval
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the PALM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Long-term conversational memory is becoming an integral component of modern LLM systems. Proposed architectures group records by topics and events, construct hierarchies and graphs, and connect facts through causal and temporal relations. We experimentally study the interaction between two memory parameters: structural depth and the width of context supplied to the answer model. Using EverMemBench, we evaluate depths D1-D4, core budgets of 1,024/2,048/4,096 tokens, and additional Production and Oracle conditions up to the full archive. Increasing width from 1K to 4K improves Accuracy by 10.11-17.98 percentage points, whereas increasing depth provides no monotonic gain. Beyond 8-16K, Production performance reaches a plateau while tokens per correct answer continue to increase; Oracle preserves quality on full archives of 68-71K tokens. These results motivate further investigation of large, coherent context blocks instead of progressively deeper memory structures.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过 EverMemBench 实验研究对话记忆系统中"结构深度"与"上下文宽度"两个参数对回答质量的影响，发现增加上下文宽度显著提升准确率，而加深记忆层级并无单调收益。
AI.motivation: 现代 LLM 系统广泛引入长期对话记忆，现有架构通过主题/事件分组、层级与图结构、因果与时间关系等方法来组织记忆，但尚不清楚"记忆结构的深度"与"提供给回答模型的上下文宽度"这两类参数如何相互作用、各自对性能贡献几何，因此需要实证研究以指导架构设计方向。
AI.method: 使用 EverMemBench 基准进行实验。自变量包括：（1）结构深度 D1–D4；（2）核心上下文预算 1,024 / 2,048 / 4,096 tokens；（3）额外的 Production 与 Oracle 条件，上下文可扩展至完整档案（68–71K tokens）。评估指标包括 Accuracy 以及每个正确答案所消耗的 token 数。
AI.result: 上下文宽度从 1K 提升到 4K 时，Accuracy 提升 10.11–17.98 个百分点；而增加结构深度未带来单调增益。当上下文超过 8–16K 后，Production 条件性能进入平台期，但每个正确答案的 token 消耗持续上升；Oracle 条件在 68–71K token 的完整档案上仍能保持质量。
AI.conclusion: 结果不支持"越深越好"的记忆层级假设，而倾向于使用更大、更连贯的上下文块。作者据此建议后续研究应更多关注大规模连贯上下文而非不断加深的记忆结构。

title: Language Unalignability: Why Some Concepts Resist Cross-Cultural Benchmark Evaluation
comment: Position paper. 32 pages (10 pages main text), 6 figures, 12 tables
summary: Current evaluation of multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) rests on an implicit Translation-Isomorphism Assumption (TIA): that semantic structures across languages are congruent and mutually mappable without loss of information. We argue that this assumption is not merely violated in practice, but ill-posed in principle for a typologically identifiable class of concepts, including pragmatic markers, honorifics, and diachronically stratified terms. We formalize this failure using a usage-cloud framework, representing concepts as point sets of contextualized embeddings. We define $α$-unalignability as the impossibility of any mapping that simultaneously preserves lexical faithfulness (centroid correspondence) and structural faithfulness (local neighborhood topology). We provide three layers of evidence. Behaviorally, we show that FLORES-200 translation failures are predicted by language family and resource class but not by script, and that LOBSTER reasoning scores vary by family. Mechanistically, we report a Representation-Intervention Gap (RIG) in a nine-model case study on Yami: the models' activations encode a regularity along which Yami groups with other low-resource and Austronesian languages, yet interventions on language-specific neurons show no demonstrated advantage over random masks: the regularity is visible but not usable by this intervention. Finally, we operationalize these findings into a multidimensional diagnostic profile: Cycle-Consistency, Pragmatic-Load Disagreement, Manifold-Curvature Mismatch, and RIG. We argue that collapsing cultural competence into a single scalar incentivizes "probabilistic flattening," and that recognizing the unalignable class is a precondition for AI that respects, rather than erases, cultural divergence. This suggests that multilingual alignment is not a single well-defined objective, but a set of mutually incompatible projections.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑多语言LLM评测中隐含的"翻译同构假设"（TIA），指出对语用标记、敬语、历时分层词等概念，该假设在原理上不成立，并用"用法云"框架将其形式化为α-不可对齐性。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言LLM评测默认语义结构跨语言同构、可无损互映，但该假设对特定类型学概念在实践与原理上均被违背，需揭示其错误以避免"概率性扁平化"抹除文化差异。
AI.method: 提出"用法云"框架：将概念表示为语境化嵌入的点集；定义α-不可对齐性，即不存在同时保持词汇忠实性（质心对应）与结构忠实性（局部邻域拓扑）的映射；并构建三层证据——行为层（FLORES-200、LOBSTER的数据分析）、机制层（九模型在Yami上的表征-干预差距RIG案例）、诊断层（四种多维诊断指标）。
AI.result: FLORES-200翻译失败可由语系与资源类别预测而非书写系统；LOBSTER推理得分随语系变化；Yami案例中模型激活存在规律性（Yami与低资源及南岛语系聚簇），但针对语言特异神经元的干预相对随机掩码无优势。
AI.conclusion: 多语言对齐并非单一良定义目标，而是多种互不兼容的投影；应识别"不可对齐类"概念，以多维诊断替代单一标量评分，从而构建尊重文化分歧的AI。

title: CoDe-LoRA: Mitigating the Orthogonality Dilemma in Continual Learning of LLMs via Knowledge Consolidation and Decoupling
summary: Continual learning (CL) is essential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to sequentially adapt to evolving tasks. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, recent advances implement low-rank adaptation with orthogonal projections (e.g., O-LoRA) to isolate task parameters. However, we reveal that such strict geometric constraints trigger an "Orthogonality Dilemma": rigid parameter isolation impedes the transfer and accumulation of shared representations across semantically related tasks. In this work, we propose a new replay-free method, called Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA (CoDe-LoRA), for CL of LLMs. CoDe-LoRA disentangles the learning process into Consolidating Universal Knowledge and Decoupling Task-Specific Knowledge. To achieve this, CoDe-LoRA leverages an adaptive null space projection mechanism and semantic routing to balance knowledge accumulation with task-specific adaptation. Experimental results across four backbones and three CL benchmarks show that CoDe-LoRA achieves the best average accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Estrellajer/CoDe-LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示O-LoRA类方法存在"正交性困境"，提出免回放的CoDe-LoRA，通过自适应零空间投影与语义路由解耦通用知识巩固与任务特定知识解耦，在4个骨干和3个基准上取得最佳平均精度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型需持续学习以顺序适应演化任务，但面临灾难性遗忘。现有基于正交投影的低秩适配（如O-LoRA）通过严格几何约束隔离任务参数，虽可缓解遗忘，却阻碍了语义相关任务间共享表示的迁移与积累，形成"正交性困境"。
AI.method: 提出免回放方法CoDe-LoRA，将学习过程解耦为"巩固通用知识"与"解耦任务特定知识"两部分，并采用自适应零空间投影机制与语义路由，以平衡知识积累与任务特定适配。
AI.result: 在4种骨干模型与3个持续学习基准上的实验表明，CoDe-LoRA取得最佳平均精度。
AI.conclusion: 严格正交约束并非持续学习的理想方案；通过自适应零空间投影与语义路由实现通用知识巩固与任务特定知识解耦，可在免回放条件下有效平衡遗忘抑制与知识迁移。

title: Catastrophic Forgetting in Sequential Thermal Anti-UAV Detection: The Role of Scale-Conditioned Gradient Imbalance
summary: Counter-UAV systems based on thermal infrared detection must stay accurate as operational datasets evolve, yet sequential fine-tuning causes catastrophic forgetting of prior tasks, a problem that remains insufficiently characterized in this domain. This continual-learning study measures the stability-plasticity trade-off in YOLOMG, a YOLOv5-based detector run as a single thermal-infrared stream with the motion channel disabled, trained sequentially across three anti-UAV benchmarks of rising scale difficulty: Anti-UAV-RGBT, Anti-UAV410, and CST Anti-UAV. Naive fine-tuning on CST yields a Forgetting Measure of -0.605 against the Stage 1 ceiling, corresponding to a 90% capability loss, with -0.572 occurring in Stage 3 alone. In contrast, knowledge distillation from a frozen teacher is associated with FM = -0.033 +/- 0.004 across three seeds, corresponding to 95% retention. Because no Stage 2 no-KD control is included, this result establishes retention under KD training rather than a causal KD effect. Per-stratum analysis shows large-target detection collapsing to near zero within the first epoch, despite an inter-stage cosine similarity of 0.987 over the gradient-updated weights, pointing to scale-conditioned gradient imbalance, rather than weight drift, as a candidate mechanism. Scale-Stratified Herding (SSH), a 300-exemplar buffer balanced across four UAV size strata, roughly halves the forgetting (FM = -0.605 to -0.311) and keeps large-target detection non-zero. An ablation attributes the gain primarily to scale stratification rather than herding: random-stratified replay performs at least as well (FM = -0.221 versus -0.311 for SSH). These replay results are single-seed and should therefore be treated as preliminary.

AI.tldr: 该研究在YOLOMG（YOLOv5）热红外反无人机检测器上量化持续学习中的稳定性-可塑性权衡：朴素微调出现灾难性遗忘（FM=-0.605，约90%能力损失），知识蒸馏可保留95%性能（FM=-0.033±0.004），并初步显示尺度分层回放缓存可将遗忘减半（FM=-0.311），但消融表明增益主要来自尺度分层而非herding。机制上指向尺度条件梯度失衡而非权重漂移。
AI.motivation: 热红外反无人机系统需随运行数据集演进保持检测精度，但顺序微调会导致对先前任务的灾难性遗忘，该问题在反无人机领域缺乏充分刻画，因此需要量化其稳定性-可塑性权衡并探索缓解策略与机制。
AI.method: 在YOLOMG（基于YOLOv5，单热红外流、关闭运动通道）上，按难度递增顺序在Anti-UAV-RGBT、Anti-UAV410、CST Anti-UAV三个基准上顺序训练；对比朴素微调与冻结教师知识蒸馏；进行逐尺度分层分析，计算跨阶段梯度更新权重的余弦相似度；提出尺度分层Herding（SSH，300个样本、跨四个无人机尺寸层均衡）并做消融对比random-stratified replay。
AI.result: CST上朴素微调FM为-0.605（相对Stage 1上限），约90%能力损失，其中Stage 3贡献-0.572；冻结教师知识蒸馏在三个随机种子下FM=-0.033±0.004，保留95%性能。逐尺度分析显示大目标检测在第一个epoch内几乎归零，而跨阶段梯度更新权重余弦相似度达0.987。SSH将遗忘从-0.605降至-0.311并保持大目标检测非零；消融显示random-stratified replay表现至少与SSH相当（FM=-0.221 vs -0.311），表明增益主要来自尺度分层而非herding。
AI.conclusion: 顺序微调在热红外反无人机检测中造成严重灾难性遗忘，知识蒸馏可有效保留性能，回放缓存（尤其尺度分层策略）能部分缓解遗忘。机制上更可能是尺度条件梯度失衡而非权重漂移所致。由于缺少Stage 2无KD对照，KD结果仅为训练条件下的保留率而非因果效应；回放结果仅单种子，属初步结论。

authors: Heyam Bin Jahlan Areej Alhothali Abeer Alhothali
title: Transferable Spatial Temporal Coherence Adversarial Attack on Black-Box Vision Language Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: The rapid integration of Vision Language Models (VLMs) into sensitive systems introduces critical safety vulnerabilities that remain unexplored in exist studies. While adversarial attack robustness has been extensively studied for image-based models, the susceptibility of VLMs to temporally-aware adversarial attacks against video in driving context poses a distinct and under examined threat. In this paper, we introduce novel adversarial attack against video targeting VLM models used for autonomous driving scenes named Spatial Temporal Coherence Adversarial Attack (STCA). Our attack comprise from three stages: modalities expansion, Spatial attack, and STCA attack. In modalities expansion, we propose caption-guided frame selection method in order to ensure that adversarial perturbation target the most semantically significant frames. Secondly.In spatial attack, we craft effective perturbation and preserve high similarity. Then the perturbed video generated fed into STCA stage that disrupt cross-frame temporal coherence using motion guided mask. Our method operate under black box threat model against victim target VLMs, relying solely on transferability from white-box surrogate model.We conduct our experiments on the BDD100K and nuScenes autonomous driving datasets across three VLM models: Video LLaVA-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Dolphin. Experimental results demonstrate spatial attack achieves an ASR with high SSIM. Our finding reveal that existing video language model, remain highly susceptible to adversarial attack in autonomous driving scenarios, underscoring the urgent need for robust defense for VLM models.

AI.tldr: 提出针对自动驾驶视频VLM的时空一致性对抗攻击STCA，在黑盒威胁模型下通过替代模型迁移实现攻击，实验表明现有视频语言模型仍高度易受对抗攻击。
AI.motivation: VLM被快速集成到敏感系统中，带来关键安全漏洞，但现有研究尚未充分探讨。图像模型的对抗鲁棒性已有广泛研究，而VLM在驾驶场景中对视频的时序感知对抗攻击的脆弱性是一个独特且研究不足的威胁。
AI.method: 提出时空一致性对抗攻击（STCA），包含三个阶段：模态扩展、空间攻击和STCA攻击。模态扩展中提出基于字幕引导的帧选择方法，确保扰动针对语义最重要的帧；空间攻击中构造有效扰动并保持高相似度；随后将扰动视频输入STCA阶段，利用运动引导掩码破坏跨帧时序一致性。方法在黑盒威胁模型下运行，仅依赖白盒替代模型的迁移性。
AI.result: 在BDD100K和nuScenes自动驾驶数据集上，针对Video LLaVA-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Dolphin三个VLM模型进行实验。结果表明空间攻击在保持高SSIM的同时实现了较高的ASR。发现现有视频语言模型在自动驾驶场景中仍高度易受对抗攻击。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频语言模型在自动驾驶场景下仍高度易受对抗攻击，凸显了对VLM模型构建鲁棒防御的迫切需求。

title: Digital Twin-Driven Real2Sim2Real: Simulator-Conditioned Generation via Paired Driving-Scene Reconstruction
summary: Camera-based 3D perception for autonomous driving relies heavily on large annotated datasets, and deploying such a system to a new target region typically requires data collection and annotation. Generative augmentation has been proposed to reduce this cost, but existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: label-conditioned methods consume the very annotations they aim to replace, while simulator-conditioned methods offer free annotations but lack visual grounding to specific real environments. This work investigates the extent to which a digital-twin-driven Real2Sim2Real pipeline (DT-R2S2R) can substitute for target-region real data. By reconstructing recorded driving clips inside a georeferenced digital twin (DT-R2S), we condition a diffusion model on geometrically aligned simulator renderings, establishing a digital twin-grounded Sim2Real model (DT-S2R). As a result, DT-S2R synthesizes photorealistic driving images given low-cost yet georeferenced simulator data across both reconstructed and novel simulator scenes within digital-twin coverage. The efficacy of generated data is verified on diverse 3D detectors. DETR3D, especially, reports 93.18% of mAP obtained by a target-region real-data oracle, without employing target images for detector training. Furthermore, simple co-training with existing out-of-target real data outperforms the oracle. Thus, DT-R2S2R can substantially reduce the cost of manual on-site data collection and annotation in digital twin-available districts, providing a practical foundation for scaling 3D perception.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出数字孪生驱动的Real2Sim2Real (DT-R2S2R) 流程，用地理配准的仿真渲染条件化扩散模型，在无需目标区域真实图像的情况下合成逼真驾驶图像，从而替代目标区域真实数据。
AI.motivation: 基于相机的自动驾驶3D感知依赖大规模标注数据，部署到新目标区域通常需重新采集与标注。现有生成式增强存在矛盾：标签条件方法需消耗本欲替代的标注，而仿真器条件方法标注免费但缺乏对具体真实环境的视觉接地。
AI.method: 构建数字孪生驱动的Real2Sim2Real流程：先在数字孪生中重建真实驾驶片段 (DT-R2S)，再以几何对齐的仿真渲染作为条件训练扩散模型，得到数字孪生接地的Sim2Real模型 (DT-S2R)，从而在孪生覆盖的重建场景与新场景中合成逼真图像。
AI.result: 在多种3D检测器上验证生成数据有效性；DETR3D尤其达到目标区域真实数据oracle mAP的93.18%，且训练检测器时未使用目标图像；与现有域外真实数据简单协同训练可超过oracle。
AI.conclusion: DT-R2S2R可在数字孪生可覆盖区域大幅降低手工现场采集与标注成本，为3D感知规模化提供实用基础。

title: DIPrune: Task-Aware Token Pruning with Dual Importance for Efficient Multimodal Language Models
summary: Recent training-free pruning approaches for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) effectively cut computational overhead by exploiting visual redundancy or text-vision attention. However, they frequently suffer from semantic degradation due to their task-agnostic design or unreliable attention estimates. Based on our empirical analysis, we have found that this issue arises because salient tokens in shallow layers persistently suppress emerging semantic ones through numerical inertia, leading to premature discarding of signals crucial for deep reasoning. To address the aforementioned issue, from the task-oriented aspects, we first reformulate training-free pruning as a minimization of the distortion in the final task loss and derive a tractable, token-wise upper bound to serve as a surrogate objective. Specifically, this formulation inherently reveals a previously neglected inter-layer term that accounts for gradients across layers. Accordingly, for the implementation, we propose DIPrune, a rank-based framework that employs a dual importance scoring mechanism to jointly optimize intra-layer static feature saliency and inter-layer dynamic semantic evolution. Extensive experiments on LLaVA and Qwen-VL demonstrate that DIPrune consistently achieves state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练剪枝框架DIPrune，通过任务损失失真最小化与双层重要性评分，缓解MLLM剪枝中的语义退化，在LLaVA与Qwen-VL上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型免训练剪枝方法依赖视觉冗余或文本-视觉注意力，因任务无关设计或注意力估计不可靠，导致语义退化。实证分析发现：浅层显著 token 通过数值惯性持续抑制新出现的语义 token，使深层推理所需信号被过早丢弃。
AI.method: 从任务导向角度将免训练剪枝重构为最终任务损失失真的最小化问题，推导可处理的 token 级上界作为替代目标；该公式揭示了一个此前被忽略的跨层项（层间梯度）。据此提出 DIPrune，一个基于秩（rank）的框架，采用双重重要性评分机制，联合优化层内静态特征显著性与层间动态语义演化。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA 和 Qwen-VL 上的大量实验表明，DIPrune 持续取得最先进（SOTA）结果。
AI.conclusion: DIPrune 通过任务导向的损失失真建模与跨层动态语义建模，有效缓解免训练剪枝的语义退化，为 MLLM 高效推理提供可行方案。

title: PolarScale: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Radiometrically Consistent RGB-to-Stokes Estimation
comment: 22 pages, 17 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Polarization imaging provides physical cues beyond intensity imaging but typically requires specialized hardware. Recent methods infer polarization from RGB-like inputs, yet predict only normalized Stokes components or relative descriptors, from which the radiometric scale needed for full Stokes reconstruction has been divided out. We introduce PolarScale, a benchmark that makes this scale an explicit prediction and evaluation target. Built on existing trichromatic full-Stokes measurements, PolarScale takes the per-scene normalized total-intensity image $s_0$ (a scene-referred linear image, not a consumer sRGB photograph) and asks models to predict normalized Stokes components, AoLP/DoLP/DoCP, and a per-scene scale. Because the scale is divided out of the input, it is not physically identifiable; PolarScale therefore evaluates dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation against a constant-scale control, together with angular, self-consistency, and physical-bound metrics. Across seven restoration-based and generative backbones and three prediction strategies, the strongest restoration models estimate the scale with 3.6-4.3% mean relative error versus 5.7% for the constant control and violate physical bounds on fewer than 0.25% of pixels, whereas two generative baselines collapse to a near-zero scale; explicit descriptor supervision improves descriptor accuracy (23.66 vs. 18.88 dB PSNR for MAE). Predicted full-Stokes representations improve diffuse/specular separation, material segmentation, and glare classification, although in diffuse/specular separation the learned scale performs only on par with the constant control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PolarScale 基准，将全 Stokes 偏振重建中被消去的辐射尺度作为显式预测与评估目标，并系统评测多种模型在尺度估计与偏振描述符上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有从类 RGB 输入推断偏振的方法仅预测归一化 Stokes 分量或相对描述符，缺少完整 Stokes 重建所需的辐射尺度信息，且该尺度被消去后无法从输入中物理辨识，因此需要一个显式评估该尺度的基准。
AI.method: 基于已有三色全 Stokes 测量构建 PolarScale，输入为每场景归一化总强度图 s0（场景参考线性图像，非消费级 sRGB 照片），要求模型预测归一化 Stokes 分量、AoLP/DoLP/DoCP 及每场景尺度；因尺度不可物理辨识，故采用数据集条件下的语义尺度估计，并与常数尺度对照比较，同时引入角度、自一致性与物理边界指标。评测覆盖 7 种复原类与生成式骨干及 3 种预测策略。
AI.result: 最强的复原模型尺度估计平均相对误差为 3.6–4.3%（常数对照为 5.7%），物理边界违例像素少于 0.25%；两个生成式基线退化至接近零尺度；显式描述符监督提升描述符精度（MAE 下 PSNR 23.66 vs 18.88 dB）。预测的全 Stokes 表示改善漫反射/镜面分离、材质分割与眩光分类，但在漫反射/镜面分离任务上学习尺度仅与常数对照持平。
AI.conclusion: 将辐射尺度作为显式预测目标可提升尺度估计与描述符精度，并有助于多项下游偏振任务，但其在漫反射/镜面分离上相较常数对照并无显著优势，表明该尺度的语义可辨识性有限。

title: Test-Time Adaptation of Quantized ViTs via Single-Pass Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration
summary: Post-training quantization is a standard route to fitting vision transformers (ViTs) into edge compute and memory budgets, yet quantized models become especially brittle under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses such shifts without labels, but most existing approaches are poorly aligned with the constraints of quantized inference. Prevailing TTA methods recover accuracy through backpropagation, while backprop-free methods often still incur overhead from extra forward passes or parameter updates, and lightweight feature- or logit-level methods recover only part of the loss. Across these approaches, a quantization-specific failure mode that amplifies the drop is not directly targeted: under shift, activations occupy frozen quantizers' calibrated ranges differently, distorting their code distribution. We propose Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR), a single-pass TTA method tailored to quantized ViTs that neither backpropagates nor updates any model parameters. QuAR recalibrates activations at the input to a frozen quantizer, mapping the test stream's running per-channel statistics back toward the source calibration. On ImageNet-C with ViT-B, QuAR achieves the highest mean accuracy among state-of-the-art backprop-free TTA methods at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit weight/activation precision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.28 points at 8 bits and 4.00 at 3 bits, with 46% lower latency and a memory overhead of only 0.17 MB (0.01% of peak inference memory). Analysis and diagnostics trace the gain to a reduced per-channel mismatch at these quantizers, which restores the code distribution the baselines leave unchanged or distort further. A single fixed configuration remains ahead across continual streams, non-i.i.d. label shift, seven out-of-distribution suites, and three other backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出QuAR：面向量化ViT的单次前向测试时适应方法，在冻结量化器输入端重标定激活，无需反向传播与参数更新，显著提升分布偏移下的精度并降低延迟与内存开销。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化使ViT适配边缘设备，但量化模型在分布偏移下尤为脆弱；现有TTA方法多依赖反向传播、额外前向或参数更新，与量化推理约束不匹配，且未针对量化特有的失效模式——偏移下激活在冻结量化器标定区间内的分布改变导致码字分布失真——进行直接处理。
AI.method: QuAR（Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration）：单次通过（single-pass）的TTA方法，专为量化ViT设计，不反传、不更新任何模型参数；在冻结量化器输入端对激活进行重标定，将测试流的逐通道运行统计映射回源标定统计，从而对齐量化器码字分布。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-C与ViT-B上，3/4/6/8位权重与激活精度下取得无反向传播TTA方法中最高的平均精度；8位相比最强基线高2.28个百分点，3位高4.00个百分点；延迟降低46%，内存开销仅0.17 MB（峰值推理内存的0.01%）。诊断表明收益来源于量化器处逐通道失配的减少。单一固定配置在持续流、非i.i.d.标签偏移、七种OOD数据集及三种其他骨干网络下均保持领先。
AI.conclusion: QuAR通过量化器对齐的激活重标定，以极低开销有效缓解量化ViT在分布偏移下的精度下降，且配置固定、跨流与跨骨干泛化性好，是一种高效且与量化推理约束高度契合的TTA方案。

title: A Stevens's Power Law Check-up of GPT-5.5's Implicit Reading of Visual Encoding
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, including supplementary material. Accepted by the VISxGenAI workshop at IEEE VIS 2026
summary: We adapt Stevens's power law to measure the implicit ability of AI models to read visualizations, which can reveal the built-in perceptual mechanisms of algorithmic models. In our pilot study, AIs see no legend. In the color conditions, no colormap name is provided either. GPT-5.5 first views a reference visual representation and estimates its magnitude, then estimates the magnitude of each subsequent image of the same representation relative to that reference. Our evaluation of twelve visual variables makes how algorithmic models read visual encodings measurable, comparable with human perception, and more transparent to humans.

AI.tldr: 该研究将Stevens幂定律迁移用于测量AI模型对可视化图表的隐含感知能力，通过参考-相对估计范式，在无图例、无色图名条件下评估12种视觉变量，使算法模型的视觉编码解读能力变得可量化、可与人类感知对比、并对人类更透明。
AI.motivation: AI模型已广泛参与可视化生成与解读，但其内在的感知机制不透明，缺乏可量化的度量手段；同时缺少能与人类感知基准直接比较的评估框架。因此需要一种可迁移的心理物理学方法，揭示算法模型"内建"的视觉感知机制。
AI.method: 将Stevens幂定律（心理物理学的刺激-感知强度幂函数关系）适配为AI可视化阅读能力的度量工具。采用参考-相对估计范式：模型先观察参考视觉表征并估计其量级，再对同一表征的后续图像相对参考进行量级估计。实验设置中AI看不到图例（no legend）；在颜色条件下也不提供colormap名称，以排除语义线索、聚焦纯感知判断。共评估12种视觉变量。
AI.result: 对12种视觉变量的评估表明，该方法可将算法模型如何读取视觉编码这一过程转化为可测量的量，实现与人类感知的可比性，并提升模型行为的可解释性与透明度。摘要未报告具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: Stevens幂定律可有效迁移至AI视觉感知测量，为算法模型的可视化解读能力提供了可量化、可跨主体（AI与人类）比较、且对人类透明的评估范式，为理解模型的感知机制提供了新工具。当前为试点研究，后续可扩展。

title: UniCounting: Instance-Aware Proposal Consolidation for Image-Query-Free Multi-Category Counting
summary: Visual counting is commonly formulated as counting a single specified target, with a model receiving an image-specific exemplar, text query, or target category and returning a single count. We instead study fixed-vocabulary image-query-free multi-category counting. A global vocabulary is fixed for each run, and, given only an RGB image, the model predicts a complete category--count vector without being told which categories appear. We present UniCounting, which casts counting as instance-aware structural inference over an over-complete proposal set. Generic segmenters produce duplicate masks, partial views, and proposals from neighboring instances; semantic scores can name them but cannot determine which denote the same object. Frozen SAM~2.1 generates masks, while frozen DINOv2 and OpenCLIP provide relation and category features. A 3,267-parameter category-shared relation head predicts same-instance affinities from instance-mask-derived supervision. Sparse graph construction, representative selection, labeling, and background-margin admission then convert each admitted component into one count with replayable group evidence. Only the relation head is trained, without count or density-map targets. On COCO clean500, UniCounting obtains lower point-estimate vector $\ell_1$ error and absent-class false mass than calibrated OWLv2-All80, with comparable micro presence F1. Under a matched decoder, the learned relation reduces both errors relative to mask containment, mask IoU, CLIP, and DINO, while revealing a fragmentation--merge trade-off. We also report transfer diagnostics on OmniCount-sub, FSC-147, and CARPK.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UniCounting，将多类别计数建模为过完备提议集上的实例感知结构推断，仅训练一个 3,267 参数的关系头，即可在无图像查询条件下输出完整类别-计数向量。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉计数通常聚焦单目标设定，模型需依赖图像特定示例、文本查询或目标类别，且每类只输出单一计数。作者转而研究固定词表、无图像查询的多类别计数：词表在每次运行前固定，仅给一张 RGB 图像，模型需预测完整的类别-计数向量，且不被告知哪些类别出现。
AI.method: 方法将计数转化为过完备提议集上的实例感知结构推断。冻结的 SAM 2.1 生成掩码，冻结的 DINOv2 与 OpenCLIP 提供关系与类别特征。一个 3,267 参数、类别共享的关系头基于实例掩码导生的监督预测同实例亲和度。随后经稀疏图构建、代表选择、标注与背景边界准入，把每个被接纳的连通分量转换为一个计数，并给出可复现的成组证据。仅训练关系头，不使用计数或密度图目标。
AI.result: 在 COCO clean500 上，UniCounting 相比校准的 OWLv2-All80 获得更低的点估计向量 ℓ1 误差与缺失类虚假质量，微平均存在性 F1 相当。在匹配解码器下，所学关系相较掩码包含、掩码 IoU、CLIP 和 DINO 均降低两类误差，同时揭示碎片化—合并权衡。另在 OmniCount-sub、FSC-147 与 CARPK 上报告了迁移诊断结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式学习实例关系结构可在无计数/密度监督下实现有效的固定词表多类别计数，且泛化诊断显示一定迁移能力，但存在碎片化与合并的固有权衡。

title: Foresight-over-Graph: Reasoning Beyond Local Horizons for Knowledge Base Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in question answering, yet they still frequently suffer from hallucinations on knowledge-intensive tasks. Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide LLMs with structured, interpretable, and updatable factual grounding, making them a promising external knowledge source for reliable reasoning. However, existing LLM-guided graph reasoning methods typically rely on hop-wise greedy or beam-style pruning during evidence retrieval. Such local decision processes are inherently myopic: evidence that appears weak near the source may become crucial only after deeper graph context is explored, causing answer-critical branches to be discarded prematurely and making the reasoning chain difficult to recover. To address this limitation, we propose Foresight-over-Graph (FoG), a foresight-aware evidence retrieval framework for knowledge base question answering (KBQA). FoG iteratively constructs a question-relevant evidence subgraph and uses far-to-near feedback to guide path exploration, and maintains a compact memory subgraph to support continued exploration. Extensive experiments on widely used KBQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a particularly large improvement of 16.58% in Hit on CWQ, while also reducing LLM calls and token usage. Our code is available at https://github.com/yhong7/FoG .

AI.tldr: 提出 FoG 框架，用远到近反馈引导证据检索，缓解 KBQA 中的近视剪枝问题，取得 SOTA 并降低开销。
AI.motivation: LLM 在知识密集型任务中易产生幻觉，KG 可提供结构化、可解释、可更新的知识支撑。但现有 LLM 引导的图推理方法在证据检索时采用逐跳贪心或束搜索式剪枝，决策局部且近视：靠近源节点看似弱的证据，只有探索更深图上下文后才显关键，导致关键分支被过早丢弃，推理链难以恢复。
AI.method: 提出 Foresight-over-Graph（FoG），一种面向 KBQA 的前瞻感知证据检索框架。FoG 迭代构建与问题相关的证据子图，并使用远到近反馈引导路径探索，同时维护紧凑的记忆子图以支持持续探索。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的 KBQA 基准上取得 SOTA 性能，CWQ 上 Hit 提升达 16.58%，同时减少 LLM 调用次数与 token 消耗。
AI.conclusion: FoG 通过前瞻反馈与记忆子图机制有效解决近视剪枝问题，提升 KBQA 准确率并降低推理开销，代码已开源。

title: UP-MOPD: Update Projection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation from multiple teachers combines expertise from different domains in a single student, but conflicting gradients can hinder this integration. Gradient corrections directly constrain parameter updates under plain SGD. With optimizers such as AdamW, however, momentum, adaptive scaling, and weight decay can turn a corrected gradient into an update that increases a domain loss to first order. To address this gap, we propose Update Projection for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (UP-MOPD). UP-MOPD lets the original mixed gradient update the optimizer state and generate a candidate displacement, then projects only violating candidates before they are committed to the parameters. The projection gives the unique feasible update closest to the candidate in Euclidean distance. In experiments combining medical and general domains, UP-MOPD improves IFEval-loose accuracy late in training by 2.96 points over vanilla M-OPD. It achieves an average score of 60.03 across eight metrics, compared with 59.00 for gradient projection and 59.15 for update rejection. On a public benchmark covering mathematics, code, and instruction following, it achieves the best average across six tasks (32.67), leads on LiveCodeBench v5, and ties for the best IFEval result.These results support projecting optimizer updates to reduce interference between domains.

AI.tldr: 提出UP-MOPD，将优化器更新投影到可行域，缓解多教师在线策略蒸馏中的域间冲突。
AI.motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏可整合多领域专长，但梯度冲突阻碍融合。已有梯度修正方法在SGD下有效，然而AdamW等优化器的动量、自适应缩放与权重衰减会使修正后的梯度产生一阶上增大某域损失的更新，存在理论与方法缺口。
AI.method: UP-MOPD先让原始混合梯度更新优化器状态并生成候选位移，再仅对违反约束的候选进行投影后才写入参数；投影给出欧氏距离下唯一最接近候选的可行更新。
AI.result: 在医学与通用领域实验中，UP-MOPD相比vanilla M-OPD在训练后期将IFEval-loose准确率提升2.96点；八项指标平均60.03，优于梯度投影（59.00）与更新拒绝（59.15）。在覆盖数学、代码、指令遵循的公开基准上，六任务平均最优（32.67），LiveCodeBench v5领先，IFEval并列最佳。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对优化器更新进行投影以降低领域间干扰，弥补梯度修正与自适应优化器不匹配的问题。

title: GeoPID: Decomposing and Steering Visual Information in Vision-Language Models
summary: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown outstanding performance across diverse applications, they tend to under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context. In this work, we propose \textsc{GeoPID}, a training-free framework that analyzes multimodal information within VLMs from a geometric perspective. \textsc{GeoPID} decomposes information into Redundant, Modality-Unique, and Synergistic components through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. Through an extensive analysis across 22 VLMs and 14 benchmarks, we confirm that correct predictions exhibit stronger vision-unique components when questions strongly require visual grounding. Building on this geometric analysis, we introduce a targeted intervention technique that selectively amplifies visual representations along the vision-unique subspace during inference. As a result, visual grounding capabilities were enhanced without any additional model parameter updates, achieving an average relative accuracy gain of 7.63\%.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的GeoPID框架，从几何视角分解VLM中的信息，并据此干预以增强视觉定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）虽性能优异，但倾向少用视觉信息、过度依赖文本上下文，即视觉定位能力不足。
AI.method: GeoPID将信息分解为冗余、模态独有与协同三部分，依据视觉与文本表征子空间之间的几何关系进行分析，并在推理时沿视觉独有子空间选择性放大视觉表征，无需更新任何模型参数。
AI.result: 在22个VLM与14个基准上验证，正确预测在强视觉定位需求下具有更强的视觉独有成分；干预后平均相对准确率提升7.63%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明从几何视角分析多模态信息可有效诊断并缓解VLM的视觉欠用问题，且免训练干预即可提升视觉定位能力。

title: Decoy and disclosure radii of invariant shape descriptors
summary: A recognizer that compares rotation-invariant descriptors sees a surface only up to the fiber of the descriptor. We measure this fiber by its radius in the orbit distance from the enrolled surface. A large radius admits decoys, that is, distant shapes that pass the matcher. A small radius discloses the enrolled shape to anyone who captures the stored value. For star-shaped surfaces truncated to spherical harmonics of degree at most $L$, with $n$ coefficients, a descriptor of generic rank $r$ has generic fibers of dimension $n-3-r$ modulo rotations. The standard pool of band powers, even bispectra, and three invariants of the degree-three band therefore admits decoy families of dimension $5$, $13$, $20$ at $L=4,6,8$. Its rank first reaches $n-3$ at $L=16$, and a mirror decoy remains at every $L$. The odd bispectra remove the mirror decoy generically for $L \geq 4$. Yet at fixed mean radius the same pool determines the enclosed volume exactly, and it does not determine whether a surface meets a clearance requirement. We certify two cases by exact and interval arithmetic. At $L=6$ a decoy matches all $32$ invariants to relative precision $2 \cdot 10^{-18}$ at orbit distance at least $0.87$ times the norm of the enrolled tuple. For the radar shape model of asteroid (101955) Bennu, the pool recovers the modeled volume, misses the handedness, and leaves the keep-out radius uncertain by more than $7 \, \mathrm{m}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析旋转不变描述子的纤维结构，量化其“诱饵”与“泄露”风险：标准不变量池存在高维诱饵族，但可精确恢复体积。
AI.motivation: 旋转不变描述子只保留形状的部分信息，其纤维（同一描述子对应的所有形状集合）的大小决定了两类风险：纤维半径大则允许远处的“诱饵”形状通过匹配，半径小则向窃取存储值者泄露原始形状。因此需要刻画该纤维的维度与几何性质。
AI.method: 针对截断至球谐次数不超过L的星形曲面（n个系数），用轨道距离来度量纤维半径，并以描述子的泛型秩r刻画纤维维度（模旋转为n-3-r）。对标准不变量池（带幂、偶双谱、三次带三不变量）进行代数与数值分析，采用精确算术与区间算术验证两类情形。
AI.result: 标准不变量池在L=4,6,8时分别允许维度为5,13,20的诱饵族；秩首次在L=16达到n-3，且每个L均残留镜像诱饵。奇双谱在L≥4时可泛型消除镜像诱饵。在固定平均半径下该池可精确确定包围体积，但不能判定是否满足间隙要求。L=6时存在诱饵在轨道距离至少为注册元组范数0.87倍处，以相对精度2×10⁻¹⁸匹配全部32个不变量；对小行星(101955)Bennu的雷达形状模型，该池恢复体积、丢失手性，并留下超过7 m的禁入半径不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 旋转不变描述子的纤维分析揭示标准不变量池既可产生高维诱饵（安全隐患）又可能泄露形状信息，同时其信息内容有限（能定体积但不能定间隙与手性），实际应用（如Bennu）中需谨慎。

title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Cross-Domain and Multi-Turn Generalization of Latent Underspecification Signals
summary: Large language models routinely answer questions that cannot be answered from the information given, and in dialogue they answer before enough has been said. Unanswerability is linearly decodable from hidden states, but it is unclear which of its forms share a representation and whether the signal is useful in dialogue. We contribute a turn-labeled multi-turn benchmark (423 conversations, 1,661 labeled turn-states) and an evaluation harness with a simulated user who answers clarifying questions, and use them with six datasets and six open-weight LLMs to test how far probes for unanswerability carry. Probes transfer robustly between datasets that share a ground of unanswerability: missing information in math (AUROC 0.77-0.97) and in a passage (SQuAD 2.0<->MuSiQue, 0.77-0.90). Probes for epistemic "known-unknowns" transfer poorly to math, but this separation weakens under lexical controls and changes with layer and coordinate system, so it remains unresolved. Single-turn probes fail zero-shot to detect when a conversation becomes answerable; in-structure probes recover it, but no better than a bag-of-words classifier. A gate on the calibrated probe, with no model fine-tuning, fires on underspecified turns far more precisely than chance, and its end-task success comes within 0.08 of a gate given the true labels. Yet across four models it does not reliably beat vanilla generation or prompted consolidation. The remaining gap lies mostly in how models use a clarification, not in detection.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了一个多轮对话的"不可回答性"基准（423段对话、1,661个标注轮次状态）及带模拟用户的评测框架，在6个数据集、6个开源模型上检验不可回答性探针的可迁移性与对话实用性。结果显示：共享"不可回答性根据"的数据集之间探针可稳健迁移，但跨类型（如数学缺失信息与认知性"已知的未知"）迁移较差；单轮探针无法零样本检测对话何时变得可回答；基于校准探针的门控在欠指定轮次上精度远高于随机，端任务成功率接近使用真实标签（差距0.08），但仍不能稳定优于朴素生成或提示式整合，主要瓶颈在于模型如何使用澄清信息而非检测本身。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型经常回答信息不足、本不可回答的问题，在对话中也会在信息尚未说清时就作答。已有研究显示"不可回答性"可从隐状态中线性解码，但尚不清楚不同形式的不可回答性是否共享同一表征，以及该信号在真实对话中是否有用。因此作者希望系统检验不可回答性探针的可迁移边界及其对下游对话任务的实际价值。
AI.method: 贡献两个资源：(1) 轮次级标注的多轮基准，含423段对话、1,661个标注轮次状态；(2) 一套评测框架，其中模拟用户会回答澄清性问题。在此之上，结合6个数据集与6个开源权重LLM，测试不可回答性探针的迁移能力，并设置对照实验：跨数据集迁移、词汇控制、不同层与坐标系、单轮vs结构内探针、以及基于校准探针的门控与真实标签门控、朴素生成、提示式整合的对比。
AI.result: (1) 探针在共享"不可回答性根据"的数据集间稳健迁移：数学中的缺失信息（AUROC 0.77–0.97）、段落中的缺失信息（SQuAD 2.0↔MuSiQue，0.77–0.90）。(2) 认知性"已知的未知"探针迁移到数学表现差，但该分离在词汇控制下减弱、并随层与坐标系变化，尚无定论。(3) 单轮探针零样本无法检测对话何时变为可回答；结构内探针可以检出，但不优于词袋分类器。(4) 基于校准探针的门控（无需微调）在欠指定轮次上触发精度远高于随机，端任务成功率与使用真实标签的门控仅差0.08；但在四个模型上都不能稳定优于朴素生成或提示式整合。
AI.conclusion: 不可回答性的检测本身并非主要瓶颈：探针（尤其结构内探针）能提供一定信号，门控也能较精确地在欠指定轮次触发并接近真实标签门控的性能。真正剩余的差距在于模型如何利用澄清信息（use of a clarification），即从"检测到不可回答/已可回答"到"正确据此作答"的环节，尚不能稳定转化为下游收益。

title: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding for Privacy-Friendly AIoT
summary: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding (IBFU) aims to directly perform fine-grained classification and semantic description generation from encoded image byte sequences. In contrast to conventional pixel-domain visual understanding, IBFU conducts semantic analysis without fully decoding images into the pixel domain. Since pixel-level visual content is not explicitly reconstructed during inference, this paradigm reduces visual exposure within the processing pipeline and suits privacy-friendly Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) applications. In this paper, we propose Bitstream Fine-grained Generator (BFG), a novel foundation model tailored for IBFU. BFG consists of two main components: a Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) and a Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG). BSeE directly models semantic representations from encoded image bitstreams without explicit pixel reconstruction, while FSeG transforms the extracted bitstream semantics into detailed natural-language descriptions through autoregressive generation. To train BFG and comprehensively evaluate IBFU in practical AIoT scenarios, where image bitstreams may suffer corruption during transmission and storage, we construct a large-scale Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D), containing both intact bitstreams and corrupted variants across multiple corruption types and severity levels. Experiments show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained caption generation under bitstream corruption. For example, the performance only has slight change from 0.6339 to 0.6077 in terms of average CIDEr score on Stanford Dogs Caption dataset, while vision-language models, such as Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM, Gemini, and GPT suffer severe performance decrease. This paper provides a practical paradigm for privacy-friendly fine-grained understanding in AIoT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向 AIoT 的隐私友好型"图像比特流细粒度理解"(IBFU)范式及基础模型 BFG，可直接从编码比特流生成细粒度描述，无需完整解码到像素域，并在比特流受损场景下保持稳定性能。
AI.motivation: 传统像素域视觉理解需完整解码图像，导致视觉内容在流程中暴露，隐私性差；同时 AIoT 场景中比特流在传输/存储时易受损，现有视觉语言模型在此类条件下性能严重下降。
AI.method: 提出 BFG 基础模型，含 Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) 直接对比特流建模语义表示、不重建像素；Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG) 以自回归方式将比特流语义转为细粒度自然语言描述。并构建大规模 Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D)，涵盖完整比特流及多类型、多严重程度的受损变体用于训练与评测。
AI.result: BFG 在比特流受损下仍保持稳定细粒度描述生成：在 Stanford Dogs Caption 数据集上平均 CIDEr 仅从 0.6339 微降至 0.6077；而 Qwen-VL-Chat、BLIP-2、GLM、Gemini、GPT 等视觉语言模型性能严重下降。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 AIoT 中隐私友好的细粒度理解提供了可行范式，验证了直接基于比特流的语义理解在鲁棒性上的优势。

title: Ariadne's Thread of LipSync: Unraveling Forgeries via Inconsistency between Lip Motions and Head Poses
summary: Recent advances in LipSync generation technology have led to the creation of highly realistic videos, posing severe societal risks. However, existing defense strategies struggle against LipSync forgeries, as advanced LipSync generation methods not only achieve better lip synchronization but also eliminate visual artifacts. An important reason is that they overlook an inherent biological coupling between lip movements and head poses in natural speech videos. In this paper, we propose LipDA, a novel framework for joint LipSync Detection and Attribution, which takes advantage of the inconsistency between head and lip. For detection, the framework learns to quantify this discrepancy by contrasting lip and pose features from authentic versus forged videos. For attribution, our method is designed to capture the unique temporal dynamics and audio-visual synchronization patterns that act as the fingerprint of models, enabling source tracing. We conduct extensive experiments on two challenging LipSync datasets as well as our own proposed large-scale and multi-generator dataset.
