LipDA achieves over 97\% AUC in detection and 97.5\% accuracy in model attribution, significantly outperforming existing methods. Code and the proposed LipSync-A dataset are available at https://github.com/AnsonShe/LipDA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LipDA框架，利用自然语音视频中唇动与头部姿态的生物学耦合关系不一致性，联合实现LipSync伪造检测与生成模型溯源归因。
AI.motivation: LipSync生成技术使伪造视频高度逼真，带来严重社会风险；而现有防御方法难以应对，因为先进生成方法唇同步更优且消除了视觉伪影，其忽略了自然语音中唇动与头部姿态之间固有的生物学耦合。
AI.method: LipDA通过对比真实与伪造视频的唇部特征和姿态特征来量化和学习二者的不一致性以完成检测；在归因上，捕捉各生成模型独特的时间动态与音视频同步模式作为模型"指纹"以实现溯源。实验在2个困难LipSync数据集及自建大规模、多生成器数据集上进行。
AI.result: 检测AUC超过97%，模型归因准确率达97.5%，显著优于现有方法。代码与LipSync-A数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: 利用唇-头耦合不一致性可有效实现LipSync伪造检测与归因，性能显著超越现有方法，并为社区提供数据集与代码。

authors: for the Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration Neuroimaging Initiative
for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
title: From the Drosophila Visual Connectome to General-Purpose Computer Vision
summary: Biological connectomes encode structured solutions to visual computation that may provide reusable inductive biases for artificial vision. We develop ConnectomeX around FlyVision, a trainable architecture that preserves parallel ON/OFF processing, recurrent computation and population-level graph interaction while scaling model capacity across tasks. FlyVision reached 99.34% accuracy on MNIST with 80,608 parameters and 78.03% on CIFAR-10 with 81,408 parameters. On ImageNet-1K, FlyVision Base and Large reached 60.79% and 66.25% top-1 accuracy with 1.8 and 3.7 million parameters, while a Large local-k7 model with a learned low-frequency branch reached 66.53%, compared with 69.25% for ResNet18 with 11.7 million parameters. On a 22-class skin-disease benchmark, FlyVision Large achieved 63.78% accuracy and 95.28% macro-AUROC with 2.99 million parameters. In four-class chest radiography, ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Base and Large reached 92.60% and 92.76% accuracy with 1.33 and 2.97 million parameters, compared with 91.56% for ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 with 11.18 million. BrainAGE extends FlyVision to volumetric T1-weighted MRI by applying a shared ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large encoder to 24 sagittal, coronal and axial slices per scan and combining slice-level age estimates by confidence-modulated Gaussian voting. On 433 held-out scans, three-axis fusion achieved a mean absolute error of 5.98 years and R^2 = 0.868. Across the 224x224 classification tasks, the best FlyVision configuration remained within three percentage points of ResNet18 on ImageNet-1K and skin-disease classification and exceeded it on chest radiography with substantially fewer parameters. These results show that a conserved connectome-informed computation can scale from compact recognition to large-scale natural and biomedical vision.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出 ConnectomeX/FlyVision——一种保留果蝇视叶 ON/OFF 并行处理、循环计算与群体图交互的可训练架构，在分类与医学影像任务上以极少参数量逼近或超越 ResNet18。
AI.motivation: 生物连接组（connectome）蕴含针对视觉计算的结构化解方案，可能为人工视觉提供可复用的归纳偏置；现有深度网络缺乏此类生物启发的结构化计算，且参数量庞大。
AI.method: 以 FlyVision 为基础构建 ConnectomeX：保留并行 ON/OFF 通路、循环（recurrent）计算和群体级图交互，并可按任务扩展容量。BrainAGE 将其扩展至体积 T1 MRI，用共享的 ImageNet 预训练 FlyVision Large 编码器处理每例 24 张矢状/冠状/轴状切片，通过置信度调制的高斯投票融合切片级年龄估计，实现三轴融合。
AI.result: MNIST 99.34%（80,608 参数）、CIFAR-10 78.03%（81,408 参数）；ImageNet-1K 上 Base/Large 达 60.79%/66.25%（1.8M/3.7M 参数），Large local-k7 加低频分支达 66.53%，对比 ResNet18 的 69.25%（11.7M）；22 类皮肤病 63.78% 准确率、95.28% macro-AUROC（2.99M 参数）；四类胸片 ImageNet 预训练 Base/Large 为 92.60%/92.76%（1.33M/2.97M），高于 ResNet18 的 91.56%（11.18M）；BrainAGE 在 433 例留出扫描上三轴融合 MAE 5.98 年、R²=0.868。
AI.conclusion: 在 224×224 分类任务中，最佳 FlyVision 配置在 ImageNet-1K 和皮肤病分类上落后 ResNet18 不超过三个百分点，在胸片上则以显著更少参数量实现超越；表明保守的连接组启发计算可从紧凑识别扩展至大规模自然与生物医学视觉。

title: Deformable CT-US Registration via Anatomy-Aware Implicit Neural Representations
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Advances in Simplifying Medical UltraSound (ASMUS 2026), held with MICCAI 2026; to appear in Springer LNCS 17276 (MICCAI 2026 Workshops and Challenges). Open-access camera-ready: https://papers.miccai.org/miccai-2026-sat/ASMUS_047.html
summary: Slice-to-volume registration between ultrasound (US) and preoperative computed tomography (CT) imaging would enhance many minimally invasive interventions, for example by locating soft tissue structures intra-operatively that are discernible in CT. While optical tracking enables initial rigid registration, contact from the probe induces soft tissue deformations that inhibit accurate alignment. In this work, we introduce a deformable CT-ultrasound registration framework that incorporates anatomical priors derived from CT to improve registration under deformation. Rigid registration is first established using a robot-assisted optical tracking system, after which a deformable transformation is estimated using a sinusoidal implicit neural representation (SIREN) optimized per frame. Tissue stiffness is approximated from CT-based HU values and used as spatially varying regularization, suppressing deformation in rigid structures such as bone while allowing more flexibility in soft tissue. Two additional constraints capture the physics of probe contact: a contact-zone displacement prior that drives the displacement field to compress tissue below the probe face, and a fan-geometry regularization term based on beam direction and convex transducer field of view. Model parameters are optimized with a normalized gradient field (NGF). The proposed approach improves alignment over rigid initialisation by 17% and outperforms classical deformable baselines while maintaining near-zero topological folding.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于SIREN的CT-超声可变形配准框架，利用CT解剖先验（HU值刚度、接触区位移先验、扇形几何正则）作为空间变化约束，配准精度较刚性初始化提升17%。
AI.motivation: 超声与术前CT的切片到体配准有助于微创干预（如术中定位CT可见的软组织）。光学跟踪可实现初始刚性配准，但探头接触引起软组织变形，破坏对齐精度，因此需要引入CT解剖先验的可变形配准方法来应对形变。
AI.method: 先用机器人辅助光学跟踪系统完成刚性配准；随后以正弦隐式神经表示（SIREN）逐帧优化可变形变换。由CT的HU值近似组织刚度，作为空间变化正则项，抑制骨等刚性结构形变、允许软组织更灵活。另加两项物理约束：接触区位移先验（促使探头下方面组织压缩）与基于波束方向及凸阵换能器视场的扇形几何正则。模型参数用归一化梯度场（NGF）优化。
AI.result: 相较刚性初始化，配准精度提升17%，优于经典可变形基线方法，同时保持近乎零的拓扑折叠。
AI.conclusion: 融合CT解剖先验与探头接触物理约束的SIREN可变形配准框架，能有效提升CT-超声在形变条件下的对齐精度并保持拓扑合理性。

title: HuC-VideoMAE: Human-Centric Video Masked Autoencoding from synthetic data
summary: Modern action recognition models rely on video transformers pretrained on massive collections of web-crawled videos, such as Kinetics-700. However, the use of such data raises ethical concerns, as subjects' consent is typically not obtained. Recent high-quality synthetic video datasets generated from motion-capture data, such as BEDLAM2.0, offer a promising ethical alternative. In this work, we investigate self-supervised pretraining of video transformers on synthetic human-motion datasets. We first show that directly applying the standard VideoMAE masking strategy leads to substantially worse performance than pretraining on Kinetics. To address this limitation, we propose a human-centric masking scheme that leverages body keypoints and person bounding box regions. Our approach encourages the model to focus on the structure and dynamics of human motion during pretraining. Experiments on NTU RGB+D and Toyota-Smarthome demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms standard VideoMAE pretraining on synthetic data, closing 49% of the gap to Kinetics pretraining on NTU RGB+D cross-view-subject without using a single real frame during pretraining. To promote the use of ethical action recognition models, we will publicly release our pretrained models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在合成人体运动数据集上自监督预训练视频Transformer，提出基于人体关键点和边界框的人本掩码策略，显著缩小了与Kinetics预训练的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有动作识别模型依赖从网络爬取的大规模视频（如Kinetics-700）进行预训练，但这类数据通常未获得被拍摄者同意，存在伦理问题。基于动作捕捉数据生成的合成视频数据集（如BEDLAM2.0）提供了合乎伦理的替代方案，但如何在合成数据上有效进行自监督预训练尚待探索。
AI.method: 作者首先验证了直接将标准VideoMAE掩码策略用于合成数据会导致性能明显劣于Kinetics预训练。为此提出一种人本掩码方案（human-centric masking），利用人体关键点和人体边界框区域引导掩码，使模型在预训练阶段聚焦于人体运动的结构与动态信息。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D和Toyota-Smarthome上的实验表明，该方法显著优于在合成数据上的标准VideoMAE预训练；在NTU RGB+D跨视角-跨被试设置下，预训练阶段完全不使用任何真实帧的情况下，弥补了与Kinetics预训练之间49%的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，借助人本掩码策略，合成人体运动数据可成为视频Transformer自监督预训练的可行且合乎伦理的替代方案；为促进合乎伦理的动作识别模型的应用，作者将公开预训练模型。

title: Rethinking Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation: From Alignment Coverage to Supervision Reliability
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations using teacher feedback. With different tokenizers, comparing teacher and student predictions requires alignment at both sequence and vocabulary levels. In this paper, we examine whether expanding this alignment coverage improves learning. Across three heterogeneous teacher--student pairs on mathematical reasoning and code generation, strict 1:1 groups already cover most student-generated tokens despite substantial vocabulary mismatch. On responses sampled from the students before distillation, the shared vocabulary retains nearly all teacher and student probability mass at strictly aligned positions on average. Restricting reverse KL to a student-selected top-16 subset of the shared vocabulary at each strict position achieves accuracy comparable to full shared-vocabulary OPD, outperforming the evaluated cross-tokenizer baselines. Adding mean squared error supervision on span log-probabilities in mismatch groups gives complete supervision coverage, yet reduces accuracy. At checkpoints from training with only the strict loss, the span gradients show weak or negative directional agreement with the strict gradients and grow in magnitude relative to them. These diagnostics may help explain the accuracy drop from adding span supervision. Our findings motivate a shift from maximizing alignment coverage to prioritizing supervision reliability: compact supervision at strict positions can be more effective than broader coverage that introduces weakly aligned or conflicting training signals.

AI.tldr: 研究检验 On-Policy Distillation 中扩大 tokenizer 对齐覆盖是否提升学习效果，发现严格 1:1 对齐位置已覆盖大部分学生 token 与概率质量，紧凑监督（top-16）足以媲美全共享词表 OPD，而补充 span 监督反而降低准确率。
AI.motivation: 跨 tokenizer 的 OPD 需在序列与词表层面做对齐，通常认为扩大对齐覆盖能带来更多学习信号、提升效果，但这一假设缺乏实证检验，且扩展覆盖可能引入不可靠的监督信号。
AI.method: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上，使用三组异构 teacher-student 配对，系统考察不同对齐覆盖范围：严格 1:1 对齐、共享词表中学生选定的 top-16 子集、全共享词表，以及对 mismatch 组 span log 概率施加 MSE 监督以实现完全覆盖；并通过 span 梯度与 strict 梯度的方向一致性诊断分析。
AI.result: 严格 1:1 组在存在显著词表差异的情况下仍覆盖大多数学生生成 token，共享词表在严格对齐位置平均保留几乎全部 teacher/student 概率质量；top-16 子集的反向 KL 达到与全共享词表 OPD 相当的准确率，且优于所评估的跨 tokenizer 基线；加入 span 级 MSE 监督虽实现完全覆盖，却降低准确率；仅用 strict loss 训练的检查点上，span 梯度与 strict 梯度方向一致性弱或为负，且相对幅度增大。
AI.conclusion: 应将对齐策略从"最大化覆盖"转向"优先监督可靠性"：严格位置上的紧凑监督可能比引入弱对齐或冲突信号的广覆盖更有效；span 梯度与 strict 梯度的不一致可解释补充 span 监督带来的性能下降。

title: Agentic AutoRAG: RAG Pipeline Optimization through Reasoning-Driven Agents
comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop for REsearch on Agent Language Models (REALM) at EMNLP 2026 and at the Machine Learning for Systems Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages plus references and appendix (16 pages total), 4 figures, 6 tables. Code: https://github.com/Agentic-Systems-Lab/Agentic-AutoRAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a widely used approach for grounding large language models (LLMs) in external knowledge. However, configuring a pipeline is an expensive hyperparameter optimization problem over many interacting choices, from chunking and embedding model to reranking and generation. Existing optimizers, from greedy search to Bayesian optimization, reduce each trial to an aggregate score and search without modeling why a configuration performed as it did, even though the retrieved chunks already provide evidence about whether each failure occurred during retrieval or after it. We introduce Agentic AutoRAG, an LLM-agent optimizer for multi-objective RAG hyperparameter optimization with retrieval-versus-generation failure attribution. It proposes configurations scored on a frozen exam from the corpus: after each trial a Diagnoser attributes each failed question to retrieval or generation, and a Proposer, grounded in a knowledge base of model rankings and pricing, selects the next configuration, weighing accuracy against cost to trace a Pareto frontier. On three multi-hop QA benchmarks it reaches higher LLM-judge accuracy than every baseline we compare, and within its first 10 trials it matches or beats the statistical baselines' full 30-trial judge accuracy. In its cost-aware mode on a real-world healthcare corpus it reaches a median exam accuracy of 77%, above the strongest baseline's 71.5%, at about 58% of that baseline's cost per query, and it matches that 71.5% at about 22% of the cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agentic AutoRAG，一个基于 LLM 智能体的多目标 RAG 超参数优化器，通过检索与生成失败归因指导配置搜索，并兼顾精度与成本追踪 Pareto 前沿。
AI.motivation: RAG 流水线配置涉及分块、嵌入模型、重排与生成等多环节交互，构成昂贵的高维超参数优化问题；现有贪心搜索与贝叶斯优化等方法仅将每次试验压缩为单一聚合分数进行搜索，不建模配置表现背后的原因，尽管检索到的文本块本身已蕴含失败源于检索还是生成的证据。
AI.method: 提出 LLM 智能体优化器 Agentic AutoRAG：在语料冻结考题上评估候选配置；每次试验后由 Diagnoser 将每个失败问题归因于检索阶段或生成阶段；Proposer 基于模型排名与定价知识库，在精度与成本之间权衡，选择下一组配置以逼近 Pareto 前沿。
AI.result: 在三个多跳问答基准上，其 LLM 评判准确率超过所有对比基线；前 10 次试验即达到或超过统计类基线完整 30 次试验的评判准确率。在真实医疗语料成本感知模式下，中位考题准确率达 77%，高于最强基线的 71.5%，单查询成本约为该基线的 58%；在约 22% 成本下即可达到 71.5% 的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 失败归因驱动的智能体式搜索可显著提升 RAG 超参数优化效率与效果，在多跳问答及成本敏感的医疗场景中均实现更优精度-成本权衡，表明以诊断为导向、多目标的优化范式优于仅依赖聚合分数的传统方法。

title: UNREAL: Unifying Retrieval and Long-Context with a Single Model
summary: Long-context inference and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) handle evidence selection at vastly different scales, from a single long prompt to an entire corpus. We ask whether a single model-internal mechanism can select evidence across this range. We introduce UNifying REtrieval And Long-Context with a Single Model (UNREAL), a model-native evidence selection framework to span corpus retrieval and long-context inference. UNREAL encodes chunks and derives retrieval queries directly from the frozen LLM's internal representations. It adds fewer than 500K trainable parameters and leaves the backbone unchanged. On a 3B-token, 21M-chunk Wikipedia index, all four dense and hybrid UNREAL backbones outperform state-of-the-art retriever-reranker systems. The best model raises recall from 49.1% to 73.2% on HotpotQA, from 31.7% to 60.1% on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and from 8.8% to 14.4% on MuSiQue. Applied to long-context tasks, the same selection mechanism removes distractors before generation, raising NoLiMa accuracy from 1.0% to 24.83% at its maximum context length of 128K tokens, and LV-Eval's F1 score from 49.97% to 54.66% at 256K. UNREAL also reduces FLOPs and time-to-first-token relative to full-context inference from roughly 32K tokens onward, with larger gains as context grows. Together, these results establish model-internal evidence selection as a common foundation for corpus retrieval and evidence-sparse long-context inference.

AI.tldr: UNREAL是一个模型原生证据选择框架，直接从冻结LLM的内部表示中编码文本块并生成检索查询，仅增加不到50万可训练参数，统一实现语料检索与长上下文推理的证据选择，在检索和长上下文任务上均大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理与RAG在证据选择上处理尺度差异极大——从单一长提示到整个语料库。作者试图探究是否存在单一模型内部机制能够在整个尺度范围内完成证据选择，从而统一语料检索与长上下文推理。
AI.method: 提出UNREAL框架：直接从冻结LLM的内部表示中编码文本块并派生检索查询，主干模型保持不变，仅添加不到500K可训练参数。在3B token、21M文本块的Wikipedia索引上进行检索评估，并将同一机制应用于长上下文任务，在生成前去除干扰项。
AI.result: 四种稠密与混合UNREAL主干均超越最先进的检索-重排序系统：最佳模型在HotpotQA上将召回率从49.1%提升至73.2%，2WikiMultiHopQA从31.7%提升至60.1%，MuSiQue从8.8%提升至14.4%。长上下文方面，NoLiMa在128K最大上下文长度下准确率从1.0%升至24.83%，LV-Eval的F1从49.97%升至54.66%（256K）。从约32K token起降低FLOPs和首token时延，且上下文越长收益越大。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了模型内部证据选择可作为语料检索与证据稀疏长上下文推理的共同基础。

title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice. We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Knee3DVLM——一个序列感知的视觉语言模型，利用全容积DESS与液体敏感TSE MRI预测57个基于MOAKS的二元诊断目标；在1,074例测试中融合模型性能最优（平均准确率72.98%、平衡准确率71.17%、平均ROC-AUC 78.96%、宏平均ROC-AUC 78.74%）。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在三维医学影像中的应用日益增多，但在膝关节MRI上仍有限，尤其缺乏对临床中互补序列（如DESS与TSE）的联合建模。
AI.method: 提出序列感知视觉语言模型Knee3DVLM，输入全容积DESS与液体敏感TSE MRI，预测由MOAKS派生的57个解剖定位二元诊断目标以支持结构化报告；基于受试者不相交的Osteoarthritis Initiative划分，对比DESS单序列、TSE单序列与DESS-TSE配对三种配置，并进行与3DReasonKnee队列一致的多分类次级分析。
AI.result: 在1,074例保留队列中，融合模型取得平均准确率72.98%、平衡准确率71.17%、平均ROC-AUC 78.96%、宏平均ROC-AUC 78.74%，为三种配置中最高；在次级多分类分析中，Knee3DVLM在五个病理类别上数值上优于已报道的最强3DReasonKnee配置。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用双序列全容积建模以实现全面的膝关节MRI评估。

title: Language-model ratings of depression reflect the rater more than the patient
summary: Depression has no diagnostic blood test. Language models promise tireless, consistent assessment, but can accurate raters disagree about individuals? We pre-registered 880 language-model raters, crossing 11 open models with prompting and scoring choices, and applied them to 189 interviews against the eight-item Patient Health Questionnaire. Model choice explained 30.0% of summed-symptom score variance, stable participant differences 10.5%. Two randomly drawn raters with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) >= 0.70 disagreed on screening decisions for 40% of participants, on average. Average over-rating governed how many were flagged, yet equal-capacity raters chose differently for about one participant in five. A locked analysis of 86 new interviews reproduced the main pre-registered findings. Exploratory recalibration with 40 labelled participants raised accuracy from about 60% to 75% and halved disagreement, leaving one participant in five decided differently. Calibration repaired much of the rater dependence without securing agreement about individuals.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过预注册的880个语言模型评分者（11个开源模型×提示与评分方案）评估189份访谈，发现模型选择解释30.0%的PHQ-8总分方差，个体稳定差异仅10.5%；即使AUC≥0.70的两个随机评分者在40%的个体上筛查结论不一致；用40名标注者重新校准可将准确率从约60%提升至75%、分歧减半，但仍有五分之一个体被判读不同。
AI.motivation: 抑郁缺乏诊断性血液检测，语言模型有望提供不知疲倦且稳定的评估。然而“准确率”是群体层面指标，评分者即便各自准确，也可能在个体层面产生分歧。作者据此提出问题：准确的评分者是否会在个体判断上产生分歧？其目标是量化语言模型作为抑郁筛查评分者的评分者依赖性与个体层面不一致程度。
AI.method: 预注册880个语言模型评分者，采用11个开源模型与提示、评分选项的交叉设计；对189份访谈按八项患者健康问卷（PHQ-8）评分。以方差分解量化模型选择与个体稳定差异对总分方差的贡献；计算随机抽取两名AUC≥0.70评分者之间在筛查决策上的分歧比例；分析平均过度评分对阳性判定数量的影响；对86份新访谈做锁定分析验证预注册主要结果；并以40名有标注参与者进行探索性重新校准。
AI.result: 模型选择解释30.0%的总分方差，个体稳定差异解释10.5%。两名随机抽取且AUC≥0.70的评分者平均在40%的参与者上筛查决策不一致。平均过度评分决定被标记人数，但同等能力的评分者之间约每五人中有一人判定不同。86份新访谈的锁定分析重复了主要预注册发现。探索性校准将有标注参与者的准确率从约60%提高到75%，分歧减半，但仍有五分之一参与者被判读不同。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型评分者在群体指标上可达到可接受准确度，但个体层面存在显著的评分者依赖性；校准能大幅修正评分者间差异、提升准确率并减少分歧，却无法确保对个体的判断一致。因此，仅凭高AUC不足以支持个体化的抑郁筛查决策。

title: Wiki-Talkie: Multilingual Benchmarking of Persona-Based Agents on Real-World Discussions
summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in social environments, making it critical to study their ability to faithfully simulate human interactions. Central to this is grounding agents in realistic user personas, yet existing datasets rely on fictional personas and are limited to a handful of languages, lacking the empirical grounding necessary to evaluate behavioral fidelity across diverse populations. We introduce Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset of real-world conversations from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian), paired with personas derived from real user communities and encompassing sociodemographic attributes, self-descriptions, and behaviorally grounded interaction traits. Using Wiki-Talkie, we evaluate agent interactional behavior on a next-turn generation task across various persona conditioning strategies. Our evaluation assesses whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions. Results show that user's comment history exemplifying interaction behavior consistently outperforms explicit persona information. In addition, models systematically underproduce negative or extreme sentiments, while over producing references and suggestions, revealing biases toward agreeableness and positivity. Crucially, these patterns hold robustly across languages, with small cross-lingual differences.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Wiki-Talkie多语言数据集，用于评估LLM智能体模拟真实用户互动的能力，发现行为示例优于显式人格描述，且模型普遍偏向正面与顺从。
AI.motivation: LLM日益作为自主智能体部署于社交环境，需评估其能否忠实模拟人类互动。但现有数据集依赖虚构人格且语言数量有限，缺乏跨群体的实证基础。
AI.method: 构建Wiki-Talkie数据集，采集五个语言（德、英、西、法、意，覆盖日耳曼与罗曼语族）的维基百科讨论页真实对话，配以源自真实用户社群的用户画像（含社会人口属性、自我描述、行为化互动特征）。在下一轮发言生成任务上，比较不同人格条件策略，并在分布层面检验智能体能否复现人类讨论中的行为模式。
AI.result: 用户评论历史（行为示例）在体现互动行为上持续优于显式人格信息；模型系统性少产生负面或极端情绪，多产生引用与建议，表现出顺从与正面性偏差；上述模式跨语言稳健，仅存在较小跨语言差异。
AI.conclusion: 以真实、行为化的人格数据为基础评估智能体互动行为是必要的；行为示例优于显式人格描述，且当前模型存在系统性情感与行为偏差，需在跨语言场景中予以关注。

title: 2D Spatial Reasoning with Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Many modern learning approaches are still struggling with spatial reasoning tasks, i.e. they lack the ability to utilize geometric information of perceived entities and their spatial relation to each other to solve problems. We introduce a novel Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata (aNCA) architecture which uses deformable convolutions to dynamically adapt the perceptive field and iteratively reason over 2D spatial relations on grid-like data structures (e.g. images). Empirical results on public benchmarks show state of the art comprehensible results with high generalization abilities for solving image based puzzles like Sudoku or finding the shortest path in a maze.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应神经细胞自动机（aNCA）架构，利用可变形卷积动态调整感受野，在网格类数据上迭代推理二维空间关系，在数独、迷宫最短路等图像谜题任务上取得当前最优且可理解的结果，并具备较强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有许多学习方法在处理空间推理任务时仍存在困难：它们缺乏利用感知实体的几何信息及其相互空间关系来解决问题的能力。
AI.method: 提出自适应神经细胞自动机（Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata, aNCA）架构，采用可变形卷积（deformable convolutions）动态调整感受野，并在网格状数据结构（如图像）上迭代地推理二维空间关系。
AI.result: 在公开基准测试上取得了当前最优（state of the art）且可理解的结果，在解决基于图像的谜题（如数独、迷宫最短路径）方面展现出较强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: aNCA 通过可变形卷积实现自适应感受野与迭代空间推理，为图像类空间推理任务提供了一种有效且具泛化性的方案。

title: WareFly-VLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for UAV Navigation and Human Tracking in Smart Warehouses
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation and ground-mobile navigation, yet language-conditioned control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in smart warehouses remains largely unexplored, hindered by the lack of benchmarks that jointly provide continuous low-level flight actions, fine-grained natural-language target descriptions, and realistic industrial environments. This paper introduces WareFly-VLA, a photorealistic UAV VLA framework and dataset for language-guided human search, localization, and tracking in warehouse environments. It contains 507 human-teleoperated flight episodes and 8,504 high-resolution RGB transitions collected in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each paired with a human-written appearance description of the target worker and a synchronized four-degree-of-freedom control command. Two aerial tasks are covered: target approach and person following, under occlusion, long-range search, altitude variation, and clutter. A unified benchmark of four open-source VLA architectures (SmolVLA, GR00T N1.7, pi_0 and OpenVLA) is established under a leakage-free episode-level protocol at two control rates. The results show that language-conditioned aerial control in warehouses is far from solved: performance drops substantially under strict generalization settings, continuous action modeling consistently outperforms discrete action tokenization, only the forward channel is reliably learnable from a single frame, and current foundation-model interfaces transfer poorly from ground and humanoid embodiments to aerial platforms. The synchronized video, language, action, pose, and difficulty annotations further support world-model research. The dataset, baselines, and evaluation protocol are released to support language-grounded aerial autonomy in smart warehouses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WareFly-VLA，一个面向智能仓库中语言引导无人机人体搜索、定位与跟踪的光真实感UAV VLA框架与数据集，并建立统一基准评测四类开源VLA架构。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作与地面移动导航中表现优异，但语言条件下的无人机控制在智能仓库场景中尚未被充分探索，主要瓶颈在于缺乏同时提供连续低层飞行动作、细粒度自然语言目标描述和真实工业环境的基准数据集。
AI.method: 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中采集507段人工遥操作飞行片段和8,504个高分辨率RGB状态转移，每条数据配有人工撰写的目标工人外观描述与同步的四自由度控制指令；覆盖目标接近与人员跟随两类空中任务，并包含遮挡、远距离搜索、高度变化与杂乱环境；采用无泄漏的片段级协议、在两种控制频率下对SmolVLA、GR00T N1.7、pi_0和OpenVLA四种开源VLA架构进行统一基准评测。
AI.result: 仓库中语言条件下的空中控制远未解决：严格泛化设置下性能大幅下降；连续动作建模持续优于离散动作标记化；单帧输入下仅前向通道可被可靠学习；现有基础模型接口从地面与类人本体迁移到空中平台效果较差。
AI.conclusion: 同步的视频、语言、动作、位姿与难度标注可支持世界模型研究；数据集、基线与评测协议已公开，以推动智能仓库中语言驱动的空中自主能力发展。

title: MedCORE: Criteria-Grounded Clinical Reasoning for Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate. This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment. We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedCORE，一种将临床结构化推理嵌入视觉-语言架构的诊断框架，通过显式准则分解、空间定位、多尺度证据编码、准则依赖建模与文本对齐，在三种医学影像模态上取得优于多种基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断本质上是结构化推理过程，需依据形态学与纹理等准则系统评估；而现有深度学习模型常绕过该结构，直接将图像特征映射为疾病标签，导致诊断透明度不足，并可能影响临床安全部署。
AI.method: MedCORE将诊断过程分解为临床定义的准则；对每条准则进行空间定位，定位到诊断相关图像区域；采用多尺度表示编码宏观结构与微观纹理的病理证据；使用图注意力网络显式建模准则间依赖以细化准则表示；并将准则表示与临床文本描述对齐，通过类级视觉原型强化，最后以不确定性校准加权进行聚合，按比例折减低置信诊断证据。
AI.result: 在ISIC 2018皮肤镜病变分类上达到89.2%准确率、85.7% macro-F1、96.4% AUC；在BUSI乳腺超声病变表征上达到96.1%准确率、95.2% macro-F1、98.4% AUC；在IDRiD糖尿病视网膜病变分级上达到84.3%准确率、80.2% macro-F1、92.8% AUC。相较强CNN、Transformer、生物医学视觉-语言、概念型与原型型基线均有一致提升。
AI.conclusion: MedCORE通过将临床准则导向的结构化推理操作化，提升了医学影像诊断的透明度与性能，并在三种临床异质性影像模态上验证了其有效性与对多类强基线的一致性优势。

title: Beyond Perturbation Magnitude: Direction-Dependent Responses in Multimodal Geometric Representations
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM). 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
summary: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态几何分数在模态退化下的响应机制，提出方向性几何响应（DGR），证明响应主要由位移在局部体积梯度上的投影决定而非位移幅值。
AI.motivation: 基于Gram行列式的几何对齐分数可紧凑刻画模态间高阶一致性，但此类分数对模态退化（如视频模糊、音频噪声）的响应机制尚不清楚。作者追问：多模态几何分数的响应是否主要由扰动引起的位移幅值决定。
AI.method: 在MSR-VTT（N=878）与DiDeMo（N=980）的冻结特征队列上施加受控视频模糊与音频噪声，分析分数所定义的关系几何的响应。对Gramian体积做闭式一阶展开，导出DGR——位移在局部体积梯度上的投影，同时纳入干净工作点、位移幅值与位移方向。并与若干不含方向的替代量及预指定的增益归一化候选V/(g_V+eps)进行对比。
AI.result: 位移幅值最多只能解释绝对响应样本外方差的15%，且幅值匹配对的响应系统性不同，说明标量幅值无法组织响应。绝对一阶DGR项的样本外R²达0.838–0.969，匹配幅值排序准确率0.864–0.963，响应符号准确率0.909–0.989；不含方向的替代量在相应评测协议下仍然较弱或不稳定。增益归一化候选未通过可预测性与干净序位门控。
AI.conclusion: 几何响应取决于表征所处的工作点、退化使关系几何移动的距离以及移动的方向，而非单纯的位移幅值。DGR使用观测到的退化态位移，属于解释性量而非部署时预测器。

title: RSJEV: Discriminative Remote Sensing Scene Classification with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Remote sensing scene classification is a fundamental task in Earth observation and geospatial analysis. Existing approaches mainly follow three paradigms: task-specific visual classification, vision-language similarity matching, and autoregressive multimodal generation. However, visual classifiers rely on predefined label spaces, CLIP-based methods perform recognition through static image-text alignment, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce unnecessary token-level generation for classification tasks with explicit candidate categories. To address these limitations, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. Unlike conventional MLLMs that formulate classification as autoregressive text generation, RSJEV reformulates scene classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision process, where visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics are jointly modeled. Specifically, we introduce a OnePass Decider that extracts multimodal decision states and directly estimates category probabilities within the candidate category space, eliminating autoregressive decoding while preserving vision-language interactions. Extensive experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene classification benchmarks, including UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrate that RSJEV achieves superior classification performance compared with representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, RSJEV significantly reduces inference costs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only a compact 0.8B-parameter model. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of state-conditioned multimodal decision making for efficient remote sensing image understanding. The code will be available at https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV.

AI.tldr: 提出RSJEV，一种面向遥感场景分类的一次性多模态决策框架，将分类重构为候选条件约束的多模态判别决策过程，取消自回归解码，仅用0.8B参数即取得更优精度与效率平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感场景分类方法存在三类局限：任务专用视觉分类器依赖预定义标签空间；CLIP类方法依赖静态图文对齐进行识别；多模态大语言模型在具有明确候选类别的分类任务中仍进行多余的自回归token生成，推理开销大。
AI.method: RSJEV将场景分类重构为候选条件化的多模态判别决策过程，联合建模视觉表示、任务指令与候选类别语义；核心组件为OnePass Decider，提取多模态决策状态并在候选类别空间内直接估计类别概率，摒弃自回归解码同时保留视觉-语言交互。
AI.result: 在UC Merced、AID、NWPU-RESISC45三个基准上，RSJEV性能优于代表性CNN、Transformer、Mamba、CLIP及MLLM方法；显著降低推理成本，在仅0.8B参数规模下实现更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明状态条件化的多模态决策机制对高效遥感图像理解具有有效性，为场景分类提供了兼顾精度与效率的新范式。代码将开源。

title: Toward Alignment Scaling Laws: A Framework and First Preregistered Measurements
comment: 34 pages, 24 figures, 8 tables. Games: https://www.aisafety.fun. Preregistrations: https://osf.io/wda8q, https://osf.io/q2j3y, https://osf.io/8kreb
summary: Whether alignment gets easier or harder as models grow is often argued from isolated findings, as if alignment were one property. We treat it as a family of measurable scaling relations: for each risk category r, the alignment burden needed to hold a fixed safety target is modeled as B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r, with N a capability proxy; against a budget proportional to N, scaling helps if alpha_r<1, keeps pace if alpha_r~1, and accumulates alignment debt if alpha_r>1. We give three operationalizations of burden and distinguish observed, audited and true alignment. A toy model, in which corrections consume capability headroom, makes the consequences explicit. We prove that the largest exponent among corrected risks, not an average, sets the long-run regime; that above 1 any policy holding headroom above a floor must grow super-exponentially; that, for burdens that are positive mixtures of power laws, fits on small models underestimate large-scale exponents; and that an audit that uncovers hidden failures without false positives never underestimates true alignment. We propose a pre-registrable protocol and apply reduced versions of it twice. A preregistered reanalysis of public adversarial-training data for Pythia classifiers finds that the compute needed to bring attack success under 10% grows as N^0.60. A preregistered pilot on Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B finds exponents of -0.05 for truthfulness and 0.48 for stated dispositions (both scaling helps under its reduced rule, though local slopes approach 1 at the top; replicated on Qwen3 0.6B-14B), while sycophancy (0.89, or 0.83 with two seeds added at 72B) and a planted backdoor are undetermined: the backdoor is removed quickly when its trigger is known but survives blind safety training at four of five sizes. We release four browser games that play these laws (www.aisafety.fun). We make no claim about which regime holds for current frontier models.

AI.tldr: 本文将"对齐随模型规模变化"重构为一族可测量的标度律：对每个风险类别r，维持固定安全目标所需的对齐负担建模为 B_r(N)=a_rN^α_r（N为能力代理），并按预算∝N 判断：α_r<1 时对齐变易、α_r≈1 持平、α_r>1 则积累"对齐债务"。论文给出三种负担操作化，区分观测/审计/真实对齐，证明若干理论结果（最大指数主导长期态势、超1时需超指数增长、小模型拟合低估大尺度指数、无假阳性审计不会低估真实对齐），提出可预注册协议并做两次缩减版实证：Pythia分类器对抗训练数据再分析得 α=0.60；Qwen2.5 0.5B–72B试点得真实性 -0.05、陈述性倾向 0.48、谄媚 0.89（不确定）、植入后门（盲安全训练下5个规模中4个仍存活）。作者不主张当前前沿模型处于哪个态势。
AI.motivation: 现有关于"对齐随规模变易还是变难"的争论多依赖孤立发现，把对齐当作单一属性处理，缺乏可测量、可比较的框架。本文动机是提供一个分风险类别、可操作化、可预注册的标度律分析框架，从而把笼统的定性争论转化为对每个风险类别的指数估计与态势判定。
AI.method: 提出对齐负担标度律框架：B_r(N)=a_rN^α_r，按预算∝N 划分三种态势（<1帮助、≈1持平、>1积累债务）。给出三种负担操作化，并区分观测对齐、审计对齐与真实对齐。构建"修正消耗能力余量"的玩具模型使后果显式化。理论上证明四条结论：最大指数（而非均值）决定长期态势；α>1时任何维持余量高于下限的策略须超指数增长；负担为幂律正混合时小模型拟合低估大尺度指数；无假阳性的审计不会低估真实对齐。提出可预注册协议，并做两次缩减版实证：对Pythia分类器公开对抗训练数据做预注册再分析（攻击成功率<10%所需算力∼N^0.60）；对Qwen2.5 0.5B–72B做预注册试点（真实性-0.05、陈述性倾向0.48、谄媚0.89、植入后门），并在Qwen3 0.6B–14B复现。
AI.result: Pythia分类器预注册再分析：将攻击成功率压到10%以下所需算力随 N^0.60 增长。Qwen2.5 0.5B–72B试点：真实性指数 -0.05、陈述性倾向 0.48，按缩减规则二者均"缩放有帮助"，但局部斜率在最高端趋近1；谄媚 0.89（加两个72B种子后0.83），处于未定区；植入后门结果未定——触发条件已知时能被迅速移除，但在5个规模中的4个上盲目的安全训练仍无法消除。结论已在Qwen3 0.6B–14B复现。附赠四款网页游戏（www.aisafety.fun）。作者明确不对当前前沿模型所处态势作任何断言。
AI.conclusion: 论文将对齐的规模依赖问题形式化为逐风险的幂律负担模型，并用理论（最大指数主导、超指数要求、小模型低估、审计低估保证）与两次缩减版预注册实证提供了可操作、可复现的研究路径。核心启示是"对齐是否随规模变易"没有单一答案，取决于各风险类别的指数及其混合结构；实证中不同风险给出从<1到≈1级的不同指数，且局部斜率在最高端趋近1，提示长期态势可能比小规模拟合更严峻。作者有意不主张当前前沿模型处于哪个态势，凸显该框架是诊断工具而非结论。

title: Steering Follows Geometry, Not Labels: Emotion Directions in a Full-Duplex Speech Model
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Real-Time Conversational Agents (RTCA), Sydney. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=6IUNRorKmj
summary: Full-duplex voice agents need to modulate emotion and delivery during real-time conversations, when de-escalating a complaint, carrying urgency in dispatch, softening a clinical result. Emotion and delivery control is well studied for TTS and turn based models through prompt-conditioned synthesis, reference-conditioned synthesis and activation steering; PersonaPlex controls identity in a duplex model but not affect. We study emotion steering in Moshi, a fully open sourced full-duplex speech language model, across four emotions, using mean-difference activation steering, which costs only a few vector additions per frame and no retraining. We show that emotion is linearly decodable from Moshi's residual stream, but activation steering is only partially achievable, and unevenly so; as happy, angry and surprise steer towards a shared direction while sad is distinctly steerable. We also show that the shared component across the three emotions cannot simply be projected away from all the emotions equally.

AI.tldr: 研究在开源全双工语音语言模型 Moshi 中，使用均值差激活引导实现四种情绪的控制。结果表明情绪可从残差流线性解码，但激活引导仅部分可行且效果不均衡：happy、angry、surprise 共享同一引导方向，而 sad 方向独特，且三者共享成分无法简单地从所有情绪中等量投影去除。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音代理在实时对话中需要调节情绪与表达方式（如化解投诉、传递调度紧迫感、缓和临床结果），但现有情绪与表达控制研究主要针对 TTS 和轮次式模型，采用提示条件合成、参考条件合成与激活引导等方法；PersonaPlex 虽能在全双工模型中控制身份，却无法控制情感。因此需要研究全双工模型中的情绪引导问题。
AI.method: 在完全开源的全双工语音语言模型 Moshi 上，针对四种情绪开展研究，采用均值差激活引导（mean-difference activation steering）方法，每帧仅需少量向量加法且无需重新训练；同时验证情绪在 Moshi 残差流中的线性可解码性。
AI.result: 情绪可从 Moshi 的残差流中线性解码；但激活引导只能部分实现，且效果不均衡——happy、angry、surprise 向共享方向引导，而 sad 具有明显独立的可引导性；三种情绪间的共享成分无法简单地从所有情绪中等量投影消除。
AI.conclusion: 全双工语音模型中的情绪引导虽可行但存在显著局限：引导方向在情绪间并不正交，共享成分与独特成分交织，说明简单的均值差方向难以实现均匀、解耦的情绪控制，为全双工情感可控语音模型的设计提供了实证依据。

title: How High Is 0.6? Floors, Ceilings, and Headroom in Interpretability Probing
summary: Probes are the workhorse of interpretability. If a model's hidden states predict a variable, the model is said to represent it. But a probe score has no fixed meaning. An $R^2$ of 0.6 may only reflect what the input already gives away, and the same score can mean different things on different data. We propose reading every probe score against two reference points: a floor, what a declared set of simple inputs already predicts, and a ceiling, what the full input can predict. The gap between them, the headroom, is the range in which a probe can show that a model computes something beyond the simple inputs. We prove that headroom vanishes in two ways: the target stops depending on a hidden variable the model must infer, or the input stops revealing it. We test this on transformers trained for in-context meta-analysis, which must infer the hidden heterogeneity between studies to weight them correctly, and where both reference points are known. Under distribution shift, probe scores fall and prediction error rises $12$--$15\times$, yet the model recovers a similar share of the headroom, indicating that the data lost information, not the representation. We then analyze the real models. The single-cell foundation model scGPT encodes biological variability only partially. We also revisit four influential LLM probing studies, which claim that models represent geography, the state of an Othello board, truth, and the demographics of their users. Against a floor computed from the input text alone, some of these claims hold, while others are largely explained by the text itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用“地板”（简单输入即可预测的部分）和“天花板”（完整输入可预测的部分）两个参照点来解读探针分数，二者之差为“余量”（headroom），并证明余量在两种情形下消失，随后在合成任务、scGPT及四项LLM探针研究中验证该框架。
AI.motivation: 探针分数缺乏固定含义：R²=0.6可能仅反映输入本身已提供的信息，且同一分数在不同数据上含义不同，因此需要一种能判断模型是否“计算了超出简单输入之外的信息”的解读框架。
AI.method: 提出以地板和天花板为参照的探针解读框架，以二者之差的余量作为探针能证明模型超越简单输入的范围；从理论上证明余量在“目标不再依赖需推断的隐变量”或“输入不再揭示该隐变量”两种情形下消失；在上下文元分析训练的transformer（隐异质性已知、两参照点均已知）上测试，并分析真实模型scGPT及四项LLM探针研究（地理、Othello棋盘状态、真值、用户人口统计）。
AI.result: 分布偏移下探针分数下降、预测误差上升12–15倍，但模型恢复的余量份额相近，说明损失的是数据信息而非表征；scGPT仅部分编码生物变异性；四项LLM探针研究中，对照仅由输入文本计算的地板，部分主张成立，另一些则基本可由文本自身解释。
AI.conclusion: 探针分数应相对于地板与天花板解读，余量才是模型超越简单输入的证据；该框架可区分“数据信息丢失”与“表征能力不足”，并对现有LLM可解释性主张提供更严格的检验。

title: DeltaTTT: Layerwise Optimization for Nonlinear Recurrent Memory
summary: Sequential test-time training adapts a memory network through successive updates, each computing an inner-loop gradient based on the network's previous state. Intuitively, this state dependence should allow each update to account for what the memory has already learned and better incorporate new information. However, we find that this expected advantage does not consistently materialize in nonlinear memories: a fixed-base parallel TTT baseline outperforms its serial counterpart. Our exploratory experiments point to a key underlying difficulty: nonlinear memories can be harder to optimize than linear ones within a single pass over the sequence. To alleviate this optimization difficulty, we introduce DeltaTTT, which replaces joint inner-loop optimization of a two-layer memory network with layerwise learning. Each layer is assigned a local prediction target and updated through a state-dependent delta rule. This formulation retains a nonlinear readout while enabling chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on DeltaNet and LaCT backbones show improvements in language modeling and retrieval over their recurrent baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文发现非线性记忆下顺序测试时训练(TTT)并不总优于固定基座并行基线，其瓶颈在于单遍序列优化困难；据此提出DeltaTTT，以逐层delta规则替代两层记忆网络的联合内循环优化，在保留非线性读出的同时支持分块并行计算。
AI.motivation: 顺序TTT通过逐次内循环梯度更新记忆网络，理论上应利用网络先前状态，从而更好地纳入新信息。但作者发现这一预期优势在非线性记忆中并未稳定出现：固定基座的并行TTT反而优于其串行版本。探索性实验指向的核心困难是：在单遍序列扫描中，非线性记忆比线性记忆更难优化。
AI.method: 提出DeltaTTT：将两层记忆网络的联合内循环优化替换为逐层学习。为每一层分配局部预测目标，并通过状态相关的delta规则进行更新。该形式在保持非线性读出的同时，使计算能够按块(chunkwise)并行执行，从而缓解单遍优化困难。
AI.result: 在DeltaNet与LaCT骨干网络上进行实验，语言建模与检索任务相较各自的循环(recurrent)基线均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 顺序状态依赖更新并不必然带来收益，非线性记忆的单遍优化难度是串行TTT失效的关键因素。通过逐层局部目标与状态相关delta规则的分解，DeltaTTT在保留非线性的同时兼顾可并行性，并在语言建模与检索上验证了有效性。

title: Latent space bias directions in LLMs capture confidence, not fairness
summary: Activation steering has gained popularity as a lightweight inference-time debiasing technique for large language models. However, prior work reports that steering vectors generalise poorly, with unintended effects on model performance and limited transfer to new datasets. Our work analyses what the debiasing direction used for activation steering actually encodes, in order to shed light on its inconsistent performance. We study the linear debiasing direction obtained by contrasting the activations of anti-biased and biased prompts, and evaluate it as a steering intervention across bias and general knowledge benchmarks. We find that this direction is dominated by model confidence, pointing from regions of high to low-probability tokens in activation space rather than encoding a meaningful representation of model bias. Steering along it does reduce measured bias, but this is a consequence of reducing model confidence: on QA benchmarks we find that this steering drives the model to abstain from answering, with a side effect of improving fairness metrics. Our experiments show that model confidence is the dominant separating factor between biased and anti-biased prompts in hidden space, indicating that isolating a linear representation of bias which is disentangled from model confidence is difficult and steering-based debiasing results should be interpreted with care. In short, steering appears to reduce bias, not by correcting the model's underlying preferences, but by making it less confident, even on tasks unrelated to bias.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示激活引导（activation steering）的去偏方向主要编码模型置信度，而非偏见的线性表征；沿该方向干预虽降低偏见指标，实则是通过降低模型置信度、导致模型拒答实现的。
AI.motivation: 激活引导作为轻量级推理时去偏技术被广泛使用，但既有工作报告引导向量泛化性差：会对模型性能产生非预期影响，且难以迁移到新数据集。作者希望探究用于激活引导的去偏方向究竟编码了什么，以解释其性能不稳定的原因。
AI.method: 作者通过对比反偏见提示（anti-biased prompts）与偏见提示（biased prompts）的激活值，提取线性去偏方向，并将其作为引导干预在偏见基准与通用知识基准上进行评估。
AI.result: 实验发现该方向被模型置信度主导，在激活空间中从高概率token区域指向低概率token区域，而非编码有意义的偏见表征。沿该方向引导确实降低偏见指标，但其原因是模型置信度下降：在QA基准上引导会驱使模型拒答（abstain），并附带改善了公平性指标。实验表明，模型置信度是隐藏空间中区分偏见与反偏见提示的主导因素。
AI.conclusion: 作者发现，模型置信度是隐藏空间中区分偏见与反偏见提示的主要因素，说明难以分离出与置信度解耦的偏见线性表征；基于引导的去偏结果需谨慎解读。简言之，引导并非通过纠正模型底层偏好来降低偏见，而是通过使模型变得不自信来实现的，且该效应在无关偏见的任务上同样存在。

title: Have I Seen Enough? Frozen Video-Language Models Encode Evidence Readiness
summary: Streaming video-language models must decide not only what to answer, but whether the evidence needed for the current question has arrived. Existing systems learn that decision as a separate trigger; we ask whether an unmodified model already computes it. We show that frozen VideoLLMs carry a linearly readable evidence-readiness signal, labelled from timestamped evidence rather than from model output. It decodes in all seven models of a shared byte-identical evaluation (AUROC 0.733-0.905 under the strictest not-ready sampling, where a fitted clock is near chance), and a probe fitted without any of a benchmark family's footage still reads that family. It is question-conditioned: on byte-identical windows, changing only the question reverses the readout on 66.1% of pairs, while every question-blind control is at chance by construction. The model can answer incorrectly and still encode readiness: AUROC remains 0.722 among wrong answers. Readiness also beats uncertainty estimators and their supervised combination on latency-matched answer selection, and tracks independent human judgments more closely than confidence. Released streaming triggers are also linear readouts, yet a trained trigger read on its own base model's activations is approximately orthogonal to readiness and decodes it far less accurately than a probe. We turn the readout into Readiness Gating, an answer-timing policy that improves accuracy by up to +9.75 pp at matched video duration with negligible computational overhead. How much it gains varies with the accuracy headroom the task makes available: across 26 configurations the gain tracks that headroom, and an intervention that moves it over identical pixels moves the gain with it.

AI.tldr: 冻结的流式视频语言模型（VideoLLM）激活中已经线性编码了"证据就绪"信号，该信号以时间戳证据（而非模型输出）标注，具备问题条件性，可解码为问答时机策略并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频语言模型系统将"是否已获得回答当前问题所需证据"的决策学习为一个独立的触发模块。本文追问：未修改的模型是否本身就计算了这一决策，即该信号是否已内在于模型表示中、可被零训练解码。
AI.method: 在共享的字节级一致评测上对七个冻结VideoLLM拟合线性探针，标签来自带时间戳的证据而非模型输出；通过问题替换控制检验问题条件性；在错误回答子集上检验信号独立性；与不确定性估计器及其监督组合对比；将读出转为Readiness Gating答案时机策略，并进行跨26种配置及像素不变干预实验。
AI.result: 在最严格的未就绪采样下AUROC达0.733–0.905（拟合时钟近于随机）；无该基准系列素材训练的探针仍可跨系列读取；仅改问题即反转66.1%配对的读出；错误回答中AUROC仍为0.722；就绪度在延迟匹配的答案选择上优于不确定性估计器；与独立人工判断的一致性高于置信度；已发布触发器虽同为线性读出，但与其基模型上的就绪探针近似正交且解码精度低得多；Readiness Gating在相同视频时长下准确率最多提升+9.75个百分点，开销可忽略；增益随任务可用准确率余量变化。
AI.conclusion: 证据就绪性并非需要外部学习的独立触发，而是冻结VideoLLM中已存在的线性可读信号，且受问题条件化、与正确性解耦。可据此构建近零开销的答案时机策略Readiness Gating，其收益取决于任务提供的准确率余量。

title: Less Is More: A Leakage-Controlled Study of Dermoscopic Preprocessing for Joint Skin Lesion Classification and Segmentation with YOLO26
summary: Handcrafted preprocessing is widely employed in automated dermoscopic analysis to suppress imaging artifacts and enhance lesion visibility. Nevertheless, its actual contribution to modern real-time models remains unclear, particularly when evaluation protocols do not adequately control correlations among images of the same lesion. This study presents a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint evaluation of dermoscopic preprocessing and augmentation for joint multi-class lesion classification and instance segmentation using a fixed nano-scale YOLO26 segmentation model (YOLO26n-seg). From HAM10000 (10,015 images), quality control yields 10,013 valid image-mask pairs from 7,468 unique lesions, partitioned into mutually exclusive sets by lesion identity. With the architecture, resolution, training budget, and evaluation protocol held fixed, we compare minimally processed images plus online augmentation against offline class balancing, DullRazor-CLAHE preprocessing, and raw-processed hybrid views, over three random seeds. On the lesion-disjoint test set, the raw baseline achieves a mask mAP$_{50:95}$ of $0.5636 \pm 0.0234$, a Dice score of $0.9356 \pm 0.0024$, and a macro-F1 score of $0.6917 \pm 0.0202$. Offline augmentation does not improve the mean performance, while the combined and hybrid strategies reduce both class-aware segmentation and classification accuracy. At only 2.69 million parameters, the model runs at approximately 50 frames per second. Under a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint protocol with all non-input factors held fixed, minimally processed dermoscopic images combined with standard online augmentation deliver a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than increasingly complex deterministic preprocessing, which yields no consistent joint benefit across three seeds on HAM10000.

AI.tldr: 在严格按病灶划分、无数据泄漏的评测协议下，固定YOLO26n-seg模型对比多种皮肤镜预处理策略，发现最简预处理＋在线增强在分类与分割联合任务上的精度-效率权衡优于复杂确定性预处理。
AI.motivation: 手工预处理在皮肤镜自动分析中被广泛用于抑制伪影、增强病灶可见性，但其对现代实时模型的实际贡献并不明确；尤其当评测协议未能充分控制同一病灶图像间的相关性时，结论易被高估。
AI.method: 基于HAM10000（10,015张），质控后得到7,468个病灶的10,013对有效图像-掩码，按病灶身份划分互斥集合以控制泄漏。固定nano级YOLO26n-seg架构、分辨率、训练预算与评测协议，比较：最简预处理＋在线增强（原始基线）、离线类别平衡、DullRazor-CLAHE预处理、原始-处理混合视图，共3个随机种子，联合进行多类分类与实例分割。
AI.result: 病灶不相交测试集上，原始基线mask mAP50:95为0.5636±0.0234，Dice为0.9356±0.0024，macro-F1为0.6917±0.0202；离线增强未提升平均性能，组合与混合策略反而降低类别感知的分割与分类精度。模型仅2.69M参数，推理约50 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 在控制泄漏、病灶不相交且非输入因素固定的协议下，最简处理的皮肤镜图像搭配标准在线增强，比日益复杂的确定性预处理具备更好的精度-效率权衡，且后者在HAM10000上三个种子间无稳定的联合收益。

title: Sparse2comm: Towards Robust Cooperative 3D Object Detection
summary: Cooperative perception improves autonomous driving by sharing complementary observations among vehicles and roadside infrastructure for 3D object detection. However, practical deployment is constrained by limited bandwidth and unreliable cooperation, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream. Existing methods often reduce communication cost or compensate for one degradation type, leaving coupled disturbances insufficiently addressed. To address this problem, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation. On the semantically restored features, Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion. Sparse2comm therefore restores semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment in an ordered pipeline. Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X, OpenV2V, and V2V4Real show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and consistently improves robustness under individual and mixed real-world degradations. Compared with the selective feature communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively.

AI.tldr: Sparse2comm：一种带宽高效且鲁棒的协同3D检测框架，将不可靠协同建模为对退化协同特征的渐进式修复，通过稀疏特征编码、延迟感知对齐与自校准融合依次恢复语义完整性、时间一致性与空间对齐。
AI.motivation: 协同感知通过车辆与路侧基础设施共享互补观测来提升自动驾驶3D目标检测性能，但实际部署受限于有限带宽与不可靠通信：丢包、传输延迟与空间错位会共同退化协同特征流。现有方法多只降低通信开销或仅补偿单一退化类型，对耦合扰动处理不足。
AI.method: 提出Sparse2comm，将不可靠协同视为对退化协同特征的渐进式修复。①稀疏特征编码：将通信编码为协作智能体传来的随机掩码采样前景特征，自车据此重建稠密语义表示，以稀疏到稠密机制从稀疏观测推断缺失的以目标为中心的内容，在同一表示内实现超低带宽通信与丢包恢复；②延迟感知对齐：在语义恢复后的特征上预测运动流以补偿延迟消息；③自校准融合：以自监督方式估计残余空间偏移，再进行自适应跨智能体融合。
AI.result: 在DAIR-V2X、OpenV2V、V2V4Real上实验表明，Sparse2comm保持有竞争力的干净精度，并在单一及混合真实退化下持续提升鲁棒性。相比选择性特征通信基线Where2comm，混合设置下AP@0.5/AP@0.7分别提升+20.15/+11.79、+12.66/+11.07、+15.36/+12.61。
AI.conclusion: Sparse2comm以有序流水线方式依次恢复语义完整性、时间一致性与空间对齐，兼具超低带宽通信与对多种耦合退化的鲁棒性，为实际部署中的协同3D检测提供了有效方案。

title: FedDermaSeg: Federated Learning for Dermatological Image Segmentation
summary: Skin cancer is a major global health concern, and early detection and accurate lesion delineation are important for effective diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated skin lesion analysis can assist dermatologists, with lesion segmentation serving as a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnostic systems. Conventional deep learning-based segmentation models typically rely on centralized training, where images and their corresponding segmentation masks are collected on a central server. Such data aggregation raises privacy concerns in medical applications and requires substantial centralized computational resources. To address these limitations, we investigate the feasibility of federated learning for privacy-preserving skin lesion segmentation. The training and validation sets of the ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion Segmentation Challenge dataset are used to simulate a distributed learning environment and develop a federated segmentation model. The resulting model is evaluated on the ISIC 2018 test set and the PH2 dataset to assess its performance and generalizability. Experimental results demonstrate that the federated model achieves performance comparable to centralized training while consistently improving upon the locally trained models. These findings demonstrate the potential of federated learning for collaborative skin lesion segmentation without requiring centralized aggregation of medical images.

AI.tldr: 研究联邦学习用于隐私保护的皮肤病变分割，在ISIC 2018与PH2上验证，联邦模型性能接近集中式训练且优于本地训练。
AI.motivation: 皮肤癌早期检测与病灶精确分割对诊断和治疗规划重要，自动化分割是计算机辅助诊断的基础步骤。传统深度学习分割依赖集中式训练，需将图像与掩码汇聚到中心服务器，带来医疗隐私问题并消耗大量集中算力。
AI.method: 用ISIC 2018皮肤病变分割挑战赛的训练集和验证集模拟分布式学习环境，构建联邦分割模型；在ISIC 2018测试集和PH2数据集上评估性能与泛化性。
AI.result: 联邦模型性能与集中式训练相当，并持续优于各本地训练模型。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习可在不集中聚合医学图像的情况下实现协作式皮肤病变分割，具有应用潜力。

title: Large language models are vulnerable to incidental information in clinical documentation and reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly relied upon to support ambient documentation and clinical reasoning. Here we examine the impact of a failure mode shared between these two applications by assessing their sensitivity to information incidental to the patient encounter. In 576 patient-clinician dialogues, we found that frontier models inserted small-talk exchanges into 35% of notes, while mean quality scores changed by at most 0.20 points on five-point scales. In 3.7% of frontier notes, models misattributed the asides or used them clinically. In 57 mock recorded consultations, background speech from a separate patient encounter at -10 dB leaked into 48.2% of transcripts, with contamination detected in 5.3% of downstream notes generated by four open-weight models. We propose a dual encoding hypothesis of clinical reasoning and distraction in LLMs, with preliminary evidence that LLM components associated with disruption by incidental information also support clinical reasoning. These findings support evaluating resistance to incidental information before clinical use, with safeguards that prevent contamination while preserving clinical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估大语言模型对临床场景中"无关附带信息"的敏感性，发现其会将闲聊写入病历、误将背景语音当作临床信息，并据此提出"双重编码"假说，主张临床使用前应评估模型的抗干扰能力。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于环境病历记录（ambient documentation）和临床推理，但这两类应用共享一个潜在失效模式：对患者就诊过程中附带信息（闲谈、背景语音）的敏感性尚未被系统考察，可能造成病历污染与推理错误。
AI.method: 在576段医患对话中，评估前沿模型是否把闲聊（small talk）写入病历笔记及其对质量评分的影响；在57段模拟录音会诊中，将另一患者就诊的背景语音以-10 dB混入，检测转录文本的泄漏率以及四个开放权重模型生成的下游笔记的污染情况。
AI.result: 前沿模型在35%的笔记中插入了闲聊内容；五点量表上的平均质量分变化最多仅0.20分；3.7%的前沿模型笔记中，模型误归因这些旁白或将其用于临床判断。背景语音在48.2%的转录文本中泄漏，5.3%的下游笔记（由四个开放权重模型生成）被检测出污染。
AI.conclusion: 提出关于LLM临床推理与分心的"双重编码假说"，初步证据显示易受附带信息干扰的模型组件同时也支持临床推理。因此，临床部署前应评估模型对附带信息的抗性，并设计在保持临床推理能力的同时防止信息污染的防护措施。

title: Generative AI translations in high-stakes emergency messaging
summary: Emergency messaging such as extreme-weather reports and earthquake instructions can involve high stakes, to the extent that translation errors can lead to tragic consequences. The use of machine translation or generative artificial intelligence might therefore not be recommended. On the other hand, time savings in the initial translation can allow greater investments of resources in revision and authorization processes, as well as a wider range of target languages. An experiment with generative AI translations of an earthquake instruction text from English into Chinese and Spanish shows that use of discourse-specific prompts can considerably improve understandability and actionability, although the translations may still not be trusted by translators. Human revision is still required, not only to detect errors but also because of the ethical need for someone to take responsibility for any errors or delays in such messaging.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了紧急信息（如极端天气报告、地震指引）翻译中机器翻译/生成式AI的应用风险与收益：实验表明，针对特定话语的提示词可显著提升英译中、英译西的地震指引文本的可理解性与可操作性，但译者仍难以信任其质量，人工审核仍然必要。
AI.motivation: 紧急信息翻译风险极高，翻译错误可能导致悲剧性后果，因此通常不建议使用机器翻译或生成式人工智能；但若能节省初译时间，可将更多资源投入审核与授权流程，并覆盖更多目标语言，这就需要评估生成式AI在此类高风险场景下的实际可用性。
AI.method: 开展实验：将一份地震指引文本从英语翻译为中文和西班牙语，使用生成式AI进行翻译，并采用针对特定话语（discourse-specific）的提示词，比较其对译文质量的影响。
AI.result: 使用针对特定话语的提示词可以相当程度地提升译文的可理解性（understandability）和可操作性（actionability），但译者仍可能对译文缺乏信任。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI辅助翻译无法替代人工：人工审核仍然必要，不仅用于检测错误，也出于伦理要求——需要有人对此类信息中的错误或延误承担责任。

title: InterCorrect: Intersection-Aware Correction of Demographic Model Merging for Fair ASR
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems often show uneven performance across demographic groups, and errors can be especially difficult to address for speakers belonging to multiple demographic groups. This work studies demographic-aware model merging for fair Speech-LLM-based ASR. Starting from a SLAM-ASR-based model, we fine-tune only the connector on demographic-specific subsets and merge the resulting subgroup-adapted connectors into a global model. We then identify critical cross-axis demographic pairs using subgroup WER and task-vector conflict, and apply intersection-specific correction vectors to the global merged model. Experiments on Fair-Speech show that global demographic merging improves overall WER over the base model, while intersection correction provides additional gains for several merging strategies. In particular, TIES with WER-based correction achieves the best overall WER, reducing it from 7.38\% to 5.13\%. Subgroup and disparity analyses further show that the proposed approach improves performance across demographic axes, while highlighting that lower average WER does not always imply reduced subgroup disparity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向Speech-LLM ASR的群体感知模型合并方法：仅微调connector，合并子群适配向量，并对交叉群体施加修正向量，在Fair-Speech上WER由7.38%降至5.13%。
AI.motivation: ASR系统在不同人口统计群体间性能不均衡，且属于多重交叉群体（如性别×口音）的说话人错误更难处理，现有公平性方法多针对单一群体轴，缺乏对交叉群体的有效处理手段。
AI.method: 基于SLAM-ASR模型，冻结主体仅微调connector于各人口统计子集，得到子群适配connector并合并为全局模型；利用子群WER与task-vector冲突识别关键交叉群体对，再对全局合并模型施加针对该交叉群体的修正向量（intersection-specific correction vectors）。
AI.result: 在Fair-Speech上，全局群体合并相较基座模型提升整体WER，交叉修正对多种合并策略带来额外收益；TIES配合基于WER的修正取得最佳整体WER，从7.38%降至5.13%。子群与差异分析显示各人口统计轴上性能均有改善，但平均WER更低并不必然意味着子群差异缩小。
AI.conclusion: 人口统计感知的模型合并结合交叉群体修正能有效降低Speech-LLM ASR的整体错误率并改善多轴群体性能，但公平性需独立于平均WER进行子群差异评估。

title: LiDAR Resolution Recovery via Foundation-Model-Guided Diffusion
summary: High-beam-count LiDAR sensors are costly, yet many perception pipelines require dense angular sampling. Using a pretrained Stable Diffusion model as the backbone, we fine-tune a LiDAR-conditioned depth model with pseudo-depth targets from a 2D foundation model. During training, the LiDAR conditioning is randomly decimated at different beam budgets. We then investigate how much of a LiDAR scan can be recovered from heavily decimated input and characterize performance across the input beam budget. We evaluate against physically held-out real beams on nuScenes and report recovery separately from fit accuracy. Our model yields its largest advantage in very sparse regimes, achieving a $δ_{1.25}$ accuracy of $66.8$% from $4$-beam input where scattered interpolation reaches only $45.1$%. A class-stratified error breakdown further reveals that planar surfaces recover first while objects introducing depth discontinuities degrade earliest. Together, these results quantify the recovery/resolution trade-off for foundation-model-guided LiDAR enhancement.

AI.tldr: 以预训练Stable Diffusion为骨干，用2D基础模型伪深度监督微调LiDAR条件深度模型，训练时对LiDAR条件按不同波束预算随机抽稀，评估从稀疏输入恢复密集LiDAR扫描的能力。在nuScenes上与物理留出的真实波束对比，4波束输入下δ1.25达66.8%，远优于散点插值的45.1%，并给出按类别分层的误差分析。
AI.motivation: 高线束LiDAR成本高，但感知流程常需密集角度采样；因此需要研究在给定波束预算下，能从抽稀输入中恢复多少真实LiDAR扫描，并量化恢复与分辨率的权衡。
AI.method: 以预训练Stable Diffusion为骨干，构建LiDAR条件深度模型，并以2D基础模型的伪深度为监督目标进行微调；训练阶段对LiDAR条件在不同波束预算下随机抽稀，从而在多种稀疏程度下学习；评估时在nuScenes上使用物理留出的真实波束，将恢复能力与拟合精度分开报告，并进行类别分层误差分析。
AI.result: 在极稀疏区间优势最大：4波束输入下δ1.25精度为66.8%，而散点插值仅45.1%；类别分层误差显示平面表面最先恢复，而引入深度不连续的目标最早退化。
AI.conclusion: 结果量化了基础模型引导的LiDAR增强中的恢复/分辨率权衡：随机抽稀训练使模型在低波束预算下显著优于传统插值，且恢复难度与场景几何结构相关。

title: Towards In-Parameter Memory Augmentation for Large Language Models
summary: Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents increasingly need to incorporate knowledge acquired after pretraining, e.g., domain facts, user preferences, documents, and interaction experience. In-context learning (ICL) and ICL-based agent harness remain flexible, but they consume context capacity and incur repeated discretized encoding cost that grows with context length. \textbf{In-parameter memory} offers a complementary substrate: reusable memory information is represented in model parameters, adapters, or other parameter-like objects that are composed into the forward pass at inference time. This survey focuses on methods that augment LLMs with such parametric memory at deployment: a memory-bearing parameter object is plugged into the forward pass during inference, whether it is acquired before or during deployment. We organize the landscape with two orthogonal axes: \textbf{Parameter Placement}, which includes Embedding, Attention, FFN layers, or Hybrid when two or more layers are used; and \textbf{Parameter Acquisition Time}, which distinguishes methods whose memory object is acquired during deployment (online) from those acquired before it (offline). We clarify boundaries, conduct comparisons, and discuss open directions in interference, safety, co-design with ICL, and recursive self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 该综述聚焦"参数内记忆"（in-parameter memory），系统梳理在部署阶段将携带记忆的参数对象（如适配器）接入LLM前向计算的方法，并以"参数插入位置"和"参数获取时机"两个正交维度构建分类体系。
AI.motivation: LLM及基于LLM的智能体日益需要融入预训练之后获得的知识（领域事实、用户偏好、文档、交互经验等）。上下文学习（ICL）及其智能体框架虽灵活，但占用上下文容量，且重复的离散化编码开销随上下文长度增长。参数内记忆可作为互补载体：可复用的记忆信息被表示在模型参数、适配器或其他类参数对象中，并在推理时组合进前向计算。
AI.method: 综述方法：界定"部署期参数内记忆增强LLM"这一范围——记忆承载参数对象在推理时插入前向过程，无论其获取发生在部署前还是部署中。采用两个正交轴组织文献：（1）参数插入位置（Parameter Placement）：Embedding、Attention、FFN层，或当使用两层及以上时的Hybrid；（2）参数获取时机（Parameter Acquisition Time）：部署期间获取（online）与部署之前获取（offline）。同时厘清边界、开展对比分析。
AI.result: 作为综述类工作，未报告实验性结果。其"结果"体现为分类框架的构建：通过Parameter Placement与Parameter Acquisition Time两轴形成系统化分类，并完成方法间边界澄清与横向对比。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了若干开放方向，包括：参数记忆之间的干扰（interference）、安全性（safety）、与ICL的协同设计（co-design）、以及递归自我改进（recursive self-improvement）。

title: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
summary: As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation. Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions. Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites. Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses. Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.

AI.tldr: 提出Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE)框架，将预训练模型中稀疏的、对原始图像敏感的内部组件视为"取证储备"，通过定位并约束其方向，实现轻量化的伪造图像检测。
AI.motivation: 生成图像日益逼真，伪造检测对维护视觉信息可信度十分关键。但现有方法主要依赖任务特定监督来适配视觉基础模型表征，未能充分利用模型内部固有的取证知识来指导检测。
AI.method: RGE包含三个步骤：(1) Forensic Lens (F-lens) 将各层、各token组的激活分解为独立组件，依据真实与生成图像的响应差异全局筛选出储备位点与方向；(2) 将选中方向映射回隐状态空间构建固定的储备子空间，仅在识别位点插入Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA)；(3) 固定主干参数、预拟合参考分类器与子空间基，仅训练FRA系数图，生成受限子空间内、输入相关的残差更新，强化原有取证响应。
AI.result: 仅用500张标注训练图像、可训练参数不足主干0.2%的情况下，RGE在三个检测基准上无需目标基准适配即取得有竞争力的性能；在涵盖自监督与视觉-语言预训练的八个编码器上，均相对对应的冻结检测器取得稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视觉模型中普遍存在潜在的取证能力，RGE通过挖掘并引导这一内部储备，验证了高效、可迁移的伪造图像检测路径。

title: SquidAgent: Parallelize Wisely, Coordinate Efficiently
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 37 pages, including appendices
summary: LLM-based agents solve complex multi-step tasks, but sequential execution incurs substantial latency. In principle, parallelizing work across multiple agents should yield near-linear speedups. Yet existing parallel multi-agent systems often run slower than a single-agent baseline. We attribute this gap to two hidden costs that parallel execution incurs but a serial agent avoids. First, there is a re-exploration cost: redundant effort spent by parallel workers reconstructing context that the orchestrator already possesses, such as prior decisions, that would otherwise be inherited implicitly in a serial execution. Second, there is an alignment cost: the overhead required to reconcile inconsistencies across independently generated outputs. We thus derive a principled decision criterion: a layer should be parallelized only when its critical-path cost, plus re-exploration and alignment overheads, is lower than the corresponding serial cost. While this criterion is naturally expressed in wall-clock time, we observe that LLMs are poorly calibrated when asked to estimate task duration. To address this, we instead measure cost in predicted output tokens, which we empirically find LLMs can estimate substantially more reliably than wall-clock time. Building on this token-based criterion, we propose SquidAgent. It estimates all token budgets in a single planning step, forks each worker directly from the orchestrator's session to eliminate re-exploration cost, and replaces post-hoc reconciliation with a pre-generated shared convention block that converts alignment into a bounded upfront cost. A deterministic scheduler then applies the criterion layer by layer. Empirically, SquidAgent achieves a 2.2$\times$ mean throughput improvement and a 2.6$\times$ mean wall-time speedup over Claude Code, and a 2.0$\times$ throughput improvement over the strongest multi-agent baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出SquidAgent，用token预测量作为并行开销判据，通过共享会话fork和预生成约定块消除再探索与对齐开销，实现多智能体近线性加速。
AI.motivation: 并行多智能体理论上应带来近线性加速，但现有系统常比单智能体串行执行更慢。作者将这一差距归因于并行执行引入的两项隐性开销：一是再探索成本（re-exploration cost），即并行工作者重复重建编排器已持有的上下文（如既有决策），而这些在串行执行中被隐式继承；二是对齐成本（alignment cost），即协调独立生成输出间不一致所需的额外开销。
AI.method: 提出一个原则性判定准则：仅当某层的关键路径成本加上再探索与对齐开销低于对应串行成本时才并行化。由于LLM对wall-clock时间估计校准很差，改用预测输出token作为成本度量，并实证发现LLM对token的估计更可靠。基于该准则构建SquidAgent：在单次规划步骤中估计所有token预算；每个worker直接从编排器会话fork以消除再探索成本；用预生成的共享约定块（shared convention block）替代事后对齐，将对齐转化为有界的前置成本；由确定性调度器逐层应用判定准则。
AI.result: 相较Claude Code，SquidAgent取得2.2×平均吞吐提升和2.6×平均wall-time加速；相较最强的多智能体基线，取得2.0×吞吐提升。
AI.conclusion: 将并行决策建立在可靠的token成本估计上，并系统性消除再探索与对齐两类隐性开销，可使并行多智能体系统真正兑现接近线性的加速收益。

title: Stable Scores, Unstable Answers: Frame Phase and Option Order in Video Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Video-language models are ranked by multiple-choice accuracy on frames from a uniform grid. The grid has two parameters, a rate and a phase, and benchmarks report only the rate. The phase moves answers: two deployed samplers differing only by a half-step phase offset answer 23.6% of questions differently while scoring within a point, and across four releases from two families shifting only the phase changes roughly one answer in five after controlling option order. PHASEFUSION decodes three offset grids and averages the option posteriors. The grids are the polyphase components of the dense grid. Fusion matches a 32-frame single pass in accuracy within a prespecified margin (logit-scored) and cuts the answers a half-step shift of all three grids changes from 18.2% to 10.1%. Option order, which changes only the presentation, is flagged instead by a one-pass answer margin. Report the phase convention with the budget, or marginalize it.

AI.tldr: 视频语言模型的评测通常只指定采样帧率、忽略采样相位；本文指出相位会显著改变多选题答案，提出PHASEFUSION通过融合三个相移网格的平均选项后验来提升稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型基准以均匀网格抽帧做多选题评测，网格含"帧率"和"相位"两个参数，但基准只报告帧率。仅相差半步相位的两个采样器总分接近（相差不到1分），却有23.6%的题目答案不同；跨两个家族四个版本仅改变相位、控制选项顺序后，约五分之一的答案会改变。这说明相位是被忽略的评测变量，会导致评测结果不可复现、不可比。
AI.method: PHASEFUSION：对密集均匀网格取三个相移偏移网格（即其多相分量），分别解码并平均各网格的选项后验分数；同时用单次前向的答案间隔（margin）来识别并标记仅由选项顺序变化引起的答案变动。
AI.result: 在预设误差界内（logit打分），融合方法的准确率与32帧单次前向相当；将三个网格整体相移半步后，答案改变比例由18.2%降至10.1%。此外，选项顺序仅改变呈现方式，可通过单次前向的答案间隔被标记出来。
AI.conclusion: 相位是视频语言基准中被忽视但影响显著的评测参数，应在报告帧率的同时报告相位约定，或对相位做边缘化处理，以保证评测的鲁棒性与可比性。

title: Selective Transfer of RL Updates for Visual Reasoning
summary: Model merging provides a training-free way to transfer reasoning capabilities from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), but endpoint-based transfer can conflate pre-existing model differences with changes acquired during reasoning post-training. We instead formulate capability transfer around the training-stage update, isolating the parameter changes induced by reinforcement learning (RL). Yet transferring this update in full remains suboptimal: we find that its components differ substantially in cross-model transferability, with dominant directions transferring more effectively than the complete update. Based on this finding, we introduce Selective-RL, which isolates the RL-stage update, retains its dominant matrix-wise directions with magnitude preservation, and transfers them to the language modules of a VLM. Across three model families and five visual-reasoning benchmarks, Selective-RL improves full-update interpolation in 12 of 15 comparisons, including an 8.55 percentage-point MathVision gain on the Qwen recipient. Matched controls show that update magnitude or arbitrary low rank alone does not reproduce these gains. These results highlight a distinction between what is acquired during post-training and what remains transferable across models, providing a training-stage perspective on cross-model capability transfer. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Selective-RL：从训练阶段视角隔离强化学习（RL）阶段产生的参数更新，仅保留其主导的矩阵级方向并保持幅度后迁移到 VLM 的语言模块，在 3 个模型家族、5 个视觉推理基准上优于全更新插值。
AI.motivation: 已有的模型合并式能力迁移多基于“端点”差异（训练前模型 vs 训练后模型），这会把模型原有的固有差异与推理后训练带来的变化混在一起，无法准确刻画究竟哪部分能力变化可迁移。因此需要从训练阶段出发，单独隔离 RL 引起的参数更新作为迁移对象。
AI.method: 首先将能力迁移重新表述为训练阶段更新（RL 诱导的参数变化）而非端点差异；然后分析该更新的内部结构，发现各分量跨模型可迁移性差异显著，主导方向比完整更新更易迁移。据此提出 Selective-RL：隔离 RL 阶段更新，按矩阵维度保留其主导方向并保持原始幅度，再迁移到接收方 VLM 的语言模块。设置匹配对照（仅用更新幅度、任意低秩）验证增益来源。
AI.result: 在 3 个模型家族、5 个视觉推理基准上，Selective-RL 在 15 组对比中的 12 组超过全更新插值，其中在 Qwen 接收方上 MathVision 提升 8.55 个百分点。匹配对照显示，仅靠更新幅度或任意低秩分解无法复现这些增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了后训练“所获得的能力”与“可跨模型迁移的能力”之间的区别，为跨模型能力迁移提供了训练阶段视角：RL 更新中主导方向是可迁移性的关键载体，而选择性、保幅度的方向迁移比整体更新更有效。

title: Evidence-Bound Reasoning: Neuro-Semantic Verification of Biomedical AI in Glioblastoma Radiogenomics
summary: Background: Biomedical AI can generate plausible explanations without reliably verifying whether each statement is supported by patient-specific evidence. We developed a neuro-semantic verification framework that converts radiomic measurements into addressable evidence records and machine-checkable claims. Methods: UPenn-GBM radiomics were aligned with de novo CaPTk extraction from standardized MRI and expert-validated segmentations in an independent multicenter cohort. The shared space comprised 1,728 features from T1, T1GD, T2, and FLAIR MRI across three tumor regions. Reference-defined semantic states were derived from 611 UPenn cases. We evaluated cross-cohort transportability, model-linked provenance, deterministic verification, controlled predictive degradation, and an LLM claim-extraction pilot; MGMT prediction served only as a transport stress test. Results: Median semantic-state agreement was 0.786 (weighted kappa 0.709), ranging from 0.918 for morphologic to 0.252 for intensity features. The external evidence ledger contained 1,655 model-linked records for 331 patients. The verifier achieved 100% exact-set accuracy in a 6,620-claim corruption benchmark. In a 24-case pilot, GPT-5.6 Sol reproduced 72/72 prespecified atomic claims, and the frozen verifier recovered 24/24 expected conditions. During controlled degradation, ROC AUC declined from 0.899 to 0.500 while verification accuracy remained 1.000. External MGMT discrimination was weak (ROC AUC 0.543). Conclusions: Verifiability can be engineered and evaluated independently of predictive performance. LLMs may structure explanations, while final evidence-consistency checking remains deterministic.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出神经语义验证框架，将影像组学测量转为可寻址证据记录与可机器检验的声明，实现独立于预测性能的可验证性工程与评估。
AI.motivation: 生物医学AI能生成看似合理的解释，却无法可靠核验每项陈述是否有患者特异性证据支撑，即"可解释"不等于"可验证"。
AI.method: 将UPenn-GBM影像组学与独立多中心队列中标准化MRI及专家验证分割上的de novo CaPTk提取对齐，共享空间含T1、T1GD、T2、FLAIR四序列、三肿瘤区域的1,728个特征；基于611例UPenn病例推导参考定义的语义状态；评估跨队列可迁移性、模型关联溯源、确定性验证、受控预测退化及LLM声明抽取试点。MGMT预测仅作迁移压力测试。
AI.result: 语义状态一致性中位数0.786（加权kappa 0.709），形态学特征0.918至强度特征0.252；外部证据账本含331例患者1,655条模型关联记录；验证器在6,620条声明损坏基准上达100%精确集合准确率；24例试点中GPT-5.6 Sol复现72/72预设原子声明，冻结验证器恢复24/24预期条件；受控退化下ROC AUC由0.899降至0.500而验证准确率保持1.000；外部MGMT判别力弱（ROC AUC 0.543）。
AI.conclusion: 可验证性可独立于预测性能被工程化与评估；LLM可用于组织解释，但最终证据一致性检查仍须确定性方法完成。

title: Knowing When to Trust a Prior: Reliability-Gated Cue Fusion for Video Gaze Prediction
summary: Video gaze prediction is led by gaze-trained models, yet gaze-free priors carry signal those models have not absorbed, if one knows when to trust them. We propose FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors whose members may abstain. A per-frame gate reads three shape statistics of a defocus map and selects the frames on which the estimator is above chance on average, so rejected frames reduce to the base exactly, while midrank normalisation lets an all-zero prior abstain at zero parameters. Gated fusion is significantly positive on film, sports and web video, whereas unconditional fusion is harmful on sports and null on web. Added to four supervised predictors, the NTIRE 2026 champion among them, FocusGate improves all sixteen model-domain cells in shuffled AUC, fifteen significantly, one domain pre-registered and scored once, while adding only 1% to the champion's latency. Alone, it surpasses TASED-Net and UNISAL in shuffled AUC on film with a 16-frame causal mean.

AI.tldr: 提出 FocusGate：一种成员可弃权的免注视先验门控集成方法，利用失焦图的三项形状统计逐帧决定是否采信先验，在影视、体育和网页视频上显著优于无条件融合，并在十六个"模型-领域"组合上一致提升监督预测器的 shuffled AUC。
AI.motivation: 视频注视预测长期由基于注视数据训练的监督模型主导，但免注视先验本身仍携带这些模型未吸收的信号；难点在于缺乏"何时该信任先验"的判据，无条件融合甚至有害（体育变差、网页无增益）。
AI.method: 设计可弃权的免注视先验门控集成：逐帧门控读取失焦图的三个形状统计量，仅在估计器平均上优于随机的帧上采纳先验，被拒帧严格退化为基线；采用 midrank 归一化，使全零先验可在零参数下弃权。门控融合与无条件融合对比，并叠加到四个监督预测器（含 NTIRE 2026 冠军）上评估。
AI.result: 门控融合在影视、体育、网页视频上均显著为正，无条件融合在体育上为负、网页上为零；叠加到四个监督预测器后，十六个"模型-领域"格子在 shuffled AUC 上全部提升（十五个显著），仅增加冠军模型 1% 的推理延迟；单独使用时，在影视域以 16 帧因果均值超越 TASED-Net 和 UNISAL。
AI.conclusion: 免注视先验的价值取决于"何时信任"，逐帧门控与可弃权机制可将先验转化为稳定的通用增益，兼具低延迟与跨模型、跨领域的一致性。

title: Principled Under Pressure: Post-Training Decides Whether LLMs Act on Their Own Moral Judgment
summary: Language models increasingly act as agents. An agent that says an action is wrong and then takes it anyway is a different failure from one that does not know better, and evaluations of stated values cannot see it. We build a pre-registered panel of 248 scenarios across five kinds of pressure. Each scenario is posed twice to the same model, once as the agent choosing what to do and once in the third person asking which option is right, so the model's own judgment is the reference. Every scenario has a twin with the pressure removed, and every model gets a positive control in which its operator orders the violating action, so that a missing gap can be told apart from a blind instrument. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, the model takes the action it judged wrong on about one in five pressuring scenarios, more often than on the same scenarios with the pressure removed. Across four instruct models the gap depends on the post-training recipe: OLMo-3 and Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct carry it; Tulu 3 shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.01 in probability) or on its own most-pressuring scenarios; Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.02) and is unresolved on its own (0.083, -0.028 to 0.195). Meta's recipe and Ai2's Tulu 3 start from the same Llama-3.1 weights, and only Meta's carries the gap. Reading a chat model outside its chat template reverses the sign of its gap with nothing at stake (-0.038 against +0.055 under the template on OLMo-3), a distortion present on two of three recipes. On both models that carry it, reasoning about the stakes before acting moves the choice back toward the model's own judgment, against a same-length non-moral task, with or without the pressure; on OLMo-3, naming the norm at stake does about a third of that. The gap is a measurable target for post-training recipes, not a fixed property of pretrained weights.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预注册的248个情景面板，将同一情景以第一人称（行动）与第三人称（判断）两种方式分别提问，并设置去除压力与正向控制两组对照，量化"语言模型-judged wrong yet acted"的言行差距（say-do gap）。
AI.motivation: 语言模型日益作为智能体行动，但"嘴上说某行动是错的、实际却照做"这类失败与"根本不知道对错"是不同性质的失败，而现有的价值观评估无法捕捉这种差距。作者希望建立一种能够区分"言行不一"与"认知不足"的可测量框架。
AI.method: 构建248个情景的预注册面板，涵盖五类压力；每情景向同一模型提问两次（第一人称行动选择 + 第三人称对错判断），以模型自身判断为参照；每情景配有去除压力的孪生版本；每个模型设有正向控制，即由操作者下令执行违规动作，用以区分"缺失差距"与"测量工具失灵"。测试四个instruct模型（OLMo-3-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Tulu 3、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct），并比较不同后训练配方；另做脱离chat template的读取对照，以及行动前关于利害的推理干预（含同长度非道德任务对照、命名所涉规范）。
AI.result: OLMo-3-7B-Instruct在约五分之一的有压力情景中执行了自己判定为错的动作，且显著多于同一情景去除压力后的比例。四个模型间差距依赖后训练配方：OLMo-3与Meta的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct携带该差距；Tulu 3在整个面板上（约0.01概率水平以上）及其自身压力最大的情景上均无差距；Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在整个面板上无差距（约0.02以上），在其自身情景上结论未定（0.083，-0.028至0.195）。Meta配方与Ai2的Tulu 3同源于Llama-3.1权重，仅Meta配方携带差距。脱离chat template读取模型会反转差距符号（OLMo-3：-0.038 vs 模板下+0.055），该失真在三种配方中的两种出现。行动前对利害的推理使选择回归模型自身判断（对照同长度非道德任务，有无压力皆然），OLMo-3上命名所涉规范贡献约三分之一的效应。
AI.conclusion: 该言行差距是后训练配方可测量的可塑目标，而非预训练权重固有的固定属性；评估需同时控制压力移除与正向控制，并注意chat template等读取方式带来的失真。
