A cascaded pipeline that performs speech-to-phoneme (S2P) conversion followed by phoneme-to-grapheme (P2G) conversion has been shown to outperform end-to-end speech LLMs in this regime, suggesting that phoneme-mediated processing is beneficial when paired data is scarce. We propose \textit{phoneme-guided initialization}, a simple method that uses this insight within an end-to-end framework: we pre-train the audio encoder on S2P and the LLM on P2G tasks, then connect them and fine-tune the full model end-to-end on the target ASR task. Experiments on Japanese (CSJ), Chinese (AISHELL-1), and two low-resource languages from Common Voice 25.0 (Tatar and Urdu) show that our method matches or outperforms both the cascaded S2P-P2G baseline and the end-to-end model without P2G initialization.

AI.tldr: 提出"音素引导初始化"方法，通过分别预训练音频编码器（S2P）与LLM（P2G），再端到端微调，在低资源ASR上媲美或超越级联S2P-P2G基线及无P2G初始化的端到端模型。
AI.motivation: 语音大模型在配对语音-文本数据充足时ASR表现优异，但在低资源场景下性能下降。级联的S2P-P2G流水线在此情形下优于端到端语音大模型，说明配对数据稀缺时音素中介的处理方式有益，作者希望将这一优势引入端到端框架。
AI.method: 音素引导初始化：先在S2P任务上预训练音频编码器，在P2G任务上预训练LLM，然后连接两者并在目标ASR任务上进行全模型端到端微调。
AI.result: 在日语CSJ、中文AISHELL-1以及Common Voice 25.0中的两种低资源语言（鞑靼语、乌尔都语）上，该方法达到或超过级联S2P-P2G基线及未使用P2G初始化的端到端模型。
AI.conclusion: 音素引导初始化是一种简单有效的方法，能在端到端框架内利用音素中介的优势，提升低资源ASR性能。

title: How Fragile Is On-Device Language Model Safety? Localizing Safety-Critical Parameters for Sparse Fault Analysis
summary: As small language models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on resource-constrained and on-device platforms, including as components of agentic systems, the integrity of locally stored model parameters becomes an important safety concern. We investigate whether safety-sensitive behavior in LLaMA-2-7B-Chat is concentrated within a sparse subset of parameters, creating a reduced fault surface for targeted analysis. We study two complementary localization methods: low-rank safety-associated subspace analysis and parameter-level safety--utility importance filtering. Both approaches reveal highly non-uniform safety sensitivity across the network, with the MLP down_proj consistently emerging as a prominent safety-sensitive component and o_proj providing a smaller contribution. Using parameter-level localization, modifying only 0.19% of model weights in down_proj yields 53% Basic ASR and 56% GCG ASR, while tinyBenchmarks accuracy remains at 51.6% compared with a 52.2% unmodified baseline. These results motivate targeted fault analysis and selective integrity protection for language models deployed in resource-constrained, on-device, and agentic settings.

AI.tldr: LLaMA-2-7B-Chat的安全行为集中于极稀疏的参数子集（主要是MLP的down_proj），仅修改0.19%权重即可大幅提升攻击成功率，同时几乎不损失通用能力。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型日益部署于资源受限、端侧及智能体系统，其本地存储参数的完整性成为重要安全问题。需要判断安全敏感行为是否集中于稀疏参数子集，从而界定可被攻击的"故障面"并指导针对性防护。
AI.method: 采用两种互补的定位方法：低秩安全关联子空间分析与参数级安全—效用重要性过滤。前者在子空间层面识别安全相关方向，后者在网络参数层面对安全敏感度与通用效用进行联合过滤，从而定位具体权重。
AI.result: 两种方法均显示安全敏感度在网络中高度非均匀分布；MLP的down_proj始终是最突出的安全敏感组件，o_proj有较小贡献。仅改动down_proj中0.19%的权重，即可达到53%的Basic ASR与56%的GCG ASR，而tinyBenchmarks准确率为51.6%，与未修改基线52.2%基本持平。
AI.conclusion: 安全行为可由极稀疏参数子集承载，形成小故障面，说明针对参数完整性的定向故障分析与选择性完整性保护对资源受限、端侧与智能体场景下的语言模型具有现实必要性。

title: Personalize at Test Time: Learning User Preferences for Image Generation
summary: Diffusion models can generate high-quality images, yet aligning their outputs with individual user preferences remains challenging. A key bottleneck is accurately modeling diverse user preferences from limited feedback. Existing approaches often rely on labor-intensive manual preference annotations or vision-language models (VLM) to extract preference information from user interaction histories, introducing substantial annotation or computational costs that limit scalability. We propose an approach that learns personalized reward models directly from users' historical image preference pairs. First, we use an autoencoder to compress hundreds of visual attributes into 50 attribute-anchored preference dimensions and train an evaluator to score images along these dimensions. We then represent each user's preferences as a linear combination of the shared dimension scores, estimating the user-specific weights by maximizing the likelihood of their observed pairwise preferences under the Bradley-Terry model. This formulation reduces per-user adaptation to optimizing a low-dimensional weight vector, simplifying optimization and enabling data-efficient personalization from sparse feedback. The learned personalized rewards guide image generation at inference time while keeping the diffusion model frozen. Experiments on real-user preference data show that our approach achieves approximately 77% held-out pairwise preference prediction accuracy and improves the alignment of generated images with individual user preferences.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从用户历史图像偏好对中直接学习个性化奖励模型的方法：用自编码器将数百视觉属性压缩为50个属性锚定偏好维度，将用户偏好表示为共享维度得分的线性组合，通过Bradley-Terry模型极大似然估计用户权重，从而以低维权重优化实现稀疏反馈下的高效个性化，并在推理时引导扩散模型生成（模型保持冻结），在真实用户数据上达到约77%的留出成对偏好预测准确率。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽能生成高质量图像，但使其输出对齐个体用户偏好仍具挑战。关键瓶颈在于：从有限反馈中准确建模多样的用户偏好很困难。现有方法依赖人工偏好标注或视觉语言模型（VLM）从用户交互历史中提取偏好信息，带来高昂的标注或计算成本，限制了可扩展性。
AI.method: 1）使用自编码器将数百个视觉属性压缩为50个属性锚定的偏好维度，并训练评估器沿这些维度对图像打分；2）将每个用户的偏好表示为这些共享维度得分的线性组合，在Bradley-Terry模型下通过最大化其观测成对偏好的似然来估计用户特定权重；3）该形式将每用户适配简化为优化一个低维权重向量，降低优化难度并支持从稀疏反馈中实现数据高效个性化；4）学习到的个性化奖励在推理时引导图像生成，同时保持扩散模型冻结。
AI.result: 在真实用户偏好数据上的实验表明，该方法在留出成对偏好预测上达到约77%的准确率，并改善了生成图像与个体用户偏好的对齐程度。
AI.conclusion: 通过属性锚定的低维偏好表示与Bradley-Terry似然估计，可在无需大量标注或VLM计算开销的情况下，从稀疏成对反馈中高效学习个性化奖励，并在推理阶段以冻结扩散模型的方式实现用户偏好对齐，兼顾可扩展性与个性化效果。

title: BEACON-SP: Ontology-Grounded GraphRAG Framework for Clinical Suicide Risk Assessment
summary: We present BEACON-SP, an ontology-grounded Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework for clinician-facing decision support in behavioral health settings such as suicide prevention, where effective assessment requires integrating heterogeneous clinical, behavioral, social, and temporal evidence. BEACON-SP combines patient knowledge graphs with ontology-guided retrieval to support multi-hop reasoning across diagnoses, medications, risk and protective factors, life events, and temporal relationships. The framework is enabled by a comprehensive suicide prevention ontology that integrates the Three-Step Theory, the Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model, and the Suicide Social Determinants of Health Ontology into a unified representation of patient risk factors. We construct ontology-grounded patient knowledge graphs and evaluate BEACON-SP for clinician-facing question answering. Compared with a vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baseline on a 1,500-query benchmark spanning 15 clinical categories and 100 patients, BEACON-SP improves completeness, clinical relevance, and evidence grounding under a corrected comparative evaluation protocol, with a small gain on factual accuracy. In paired criterion-level comparisons, GraphRAG is preferred in 76.4% of cases. These results demonstrate the potential of ontology-guided GraphRAG to provide structured, contextualized patient evidence for clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BEACON-SP——一种本体驱动的 GraphRAG 框架，用于行为健康（如自杀预防）临床决策支持，通过患者知识图谱与本体引导检索实现多跳推理，在 1500 条查询基准上优于向量 RAG 基线。
AI.motivation: 行为健康场景下的有效评估需要整合临床、行为、社会与时间等异构证据，传统向量检索 RAG 难以支撑跨诊断、用药、风险与保护因素、生活事件及时间关系的多跳推理。
AI.method: 将患者知识图谱与本体引导检索相结合；构建统一的自杀预防本体，融合三步理论（Three-Step Theory）、整合动机—意志模型（Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model）与自杀健康社会决定因素本体；据此构建本体锚定的患者知识图谱，并在面向临床医生的问答任务上评估。
AI.result: 在覆盖 15 个临床类别、100 名患者的 1500 条查询基准上，与向量 RAG 基线相比，经校正的比较评估协议下，BEACON-SP 在完整性、临床相关性和证据支撑性上均有提升，事实准确性略有增益；配对的准则级比较中 GraphRAG 被偏好比例为 76.4%。
AI.conclusion: 本体引导的 GraphRAG 能为临床决策支持提供结构化、情境化的患者证据，展现出良好潜力。

title: Visual Memory Attacks Can Persist Through The KV Cache
summary: Modern language model systems operate autonomously over increasingly long contexts containing untrusted text and images. Can an adversarial input continue to steer a model even after that input is removed from its context? We show that attacks can be trained to persist through the key/value (KV) cache of subsequent tokens, allowing adversarial influence to outlive direct access to its source.We consider the Visual Memory Injection (VMI; Schlarmann and Hein, 2026) attack setting, in which an adversarial image that stays in the context plants a hidden backdoor: the model behaves normally until a chosen trigger elicits an attacker-chosen response. We first demonstrate persistence in this setting with optimized soft prompts, which remain effective after we mask the prompt from attention. We then introduce Persistent Visual Memory Injection (P-VMI), which optimizes images to preserve this adversarial behaviour after they are masked from attention. These attacks persist over conversations substantially longer than those used during optimization. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, P-VMI achieves up to approximately $90\%$ target success in its strongest configuration and remains effective under a stricter removal setting that exposes the image only on the first turn. A cache-swap ablation localizes the persistent influence to the KV cache. Finally, we show that these attacks can be trained to survive compaction that retains the KV cache of a summary generated by the same model, demonstrating that adversarial behaviour can persist in cached state without continued access to its source.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究对抗性输入在被移出上下文后能否继续操控语言模型。作者在视觉记忆注入(VMI)设定下,先以优化软提示证明攻击可在被掩蔽注意力后仍生效,进而提出P-VMI:优化图像以在其被掩蔽后保留后门行为。在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上,P-VMI最强配置可达约90%目标成功率,并在仅首轮暴露图像的更严格移除条件下仍有效;缓存置换消融将持久影响定位到KV缓存,且攻击可经摘要压缩存活。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型在越来越长的上下文中自主运行,其中包含不可信文本与图像。已有对抗攻击通常假设攻击源持续存在于上下文中;但若攻击输入被移除(掩蔽或压缩),其影响是否会随之消失尚不清楚。作者希望探究对抗影响能否"超越"对其来源的直接访问,即通过KV缓存的持久传播,使后门行为在源被移除后仍长期存在。
AI.method: 1) 采用VMI(Visual Memory Injection)攻击设定:上下文中放置对抗图像植入隐藏后门,模型平时表现正常,遇到选定触发器才给出攻击者指定响应。2) 先用优化软提示证明持续性:将提示从注意力中掩蔽后其仍然有效。3) 提出P-VMI(Persistent Visual Memory Injection):直接优化图像,使其在从注意力中被掩蔽后仍保留对抗行为。4) 在显著长于优化时所用的对话长度上评估持续性;并在更严格移除设定(仅在首轮暴露图像)下测试。5) 通过cache-swap(缓存置换)消融,将持久影响定位到KV缓存。6) 进一步训练攻击以在"保留同一模型生成摘要之KV缓存"的压缩(compaction)下存活。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上,P-VMI在最强配置下达到约90%的目标成功率;攻击在对话中的持续时长远超优化所用长度。在仅首轮暴露图像的更严格移除设定下仍保持有效。缓存置换消融表明持久影响位于KV缓存中。攻击还能经过保留摘要KV缓存的压缩过程存活,说明对抗行为可在无持续访问其来源的情况下留存于缓存状态。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性影响可以借助KV缓存"超越"其原始输入,即使图像/提示已从注意力中移除,后门行为仍能持续,并可抵抗基于摘要的压缩。这表明仅从上下文中删除或压缩不可信输入并不足以消除对抗风险,缓存状态本身构成新的攻击面,对长上下文自主智能体的安全性提出新的防御需求。

title: Shape-Bayes: Bayesian Inference of Structured Shapes under Visual Ambiguity
summary: Perceiving structured shapes, such as human faces, from pixels is an inherently ambiguous task in real-world conditions. Yet, shape inference is largely posed as a deterministic regression task predicting fixed spatial coordinates. We find that deterministic regression is brittle when visual evidence is ambiguous or incomplete; under severe occlusions deterministic models exhibit structural collapse, predicting incoherent shapes or reverting to generic averages. To address this, we introduce Shape-Bayes, a probabilistic framework that couples uncertainty-aware visual perception with Bayesian shape reasoning. Rather than forcing point estimates, Shape-Bayes dynamically weights visual evidence against geometric priors to infer a structurally valid shape posterior. Demonstrated on human face shape regression, a rigorous testbed featuring complex non-rigid deformations and strict anatomical constraints, Shape-Bayes comprises: (1) a base model predicting noisy landmarks alongside distilled aleatoric uncertainties; (2) a lightweight Transformer encoding these observations into an adaptive prior over a PCA shape manifold; and (3) a differentiable Bayesian solver computing closed-form posteriors by balancing the noisy predictions against this prior. By guaranteeing complete structural integrity, Shape-Bayes achieves an absolute improvement of up to ~34% IDR over state-of-the-art deterministic models. Simultaneously, it yields highly calibrated uncertainty bounds and reduces relative error by up to 12.5%, establishing a new state-of-the-art for robust 2D face shape regression under severe occlusion. The project page is at https://shape-bayes.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出概率框架Shape-Bayes，将不确定性感知的视觉感知与贝叶斯形状推理耦合，在人脸形状回归这一严格测试平台上，保证结构完整性，IDR绝对提升最高约34%，相对误差降低最高12.5%，并给出良好校准的不确定性边界，在严重遮挡下达到新的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 从像素感知人脸等结构化形状本质上是病态/歧义任务，但形状推理多被建模为确定性回归，直接预测固定空间坐标；作者发现确定性回归在视觉证据歧义或不完整时非常脆弱，严重遮挡下会出现结构塌陷，预测出不连贯形状或退化为通用平均值。
AI.method: Shape-Bayes由三部分组成：(1) 基模型预测含噪关键点及蒸馏的偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）；(2) 轻量Transformer将观测编码为PCA形状流形上的自适应先验；(3) 可微贝叶斯求解器通过平衡含噪预测与该先验，以闭式解计算后验。整体不强制点估计，而是动态权衡视觉证据与几何先验，推断结构有效的形状后验。
AI.result: 在2D人脸形状回归上（含复杂非刚性形变与严格解剖约束），Shape-Bayes保证完整结构完整性，相比SOTA确定性模型IDR绝对提升最高约34%；同时给出高度校准的不确定性边界，相对误差降低最高12.5%，在严重遮挡下建立新的SOTA。项目页：https://shape-bayes.github.io。
AI.conclusion: 将形状推理从确定性回归转为不确定性感知+贝叶斯形状推理，可显著提升歧义/遮挡条件下的鲁棒性与结构有效性，并同时提供校准良好的不确定性估计，为鲁棒2D人脸形状回归提供新范式。

title: Beyond Explanation: Debugging Medical Imaging Models via Concept Intervention
comment: Accepted at the 5th Workshop on Applications of Medical AI (AMAI), MICCAI 2026
summary: Medical imaging models often operate as black boxes, limiting interpretability and systematic debugging. We introduce an easy-to-use, plug-and-play framework for concept-based interpretation and model refinement. By aligning a single-modality encoder to BioMedCLIP, we construct a Concept Bottleneck Model (CBM) that enables concept-level interventions. These interventions allow us to isolate causal versus spuriously correlated concepts, validate insights with domain experts, and generate counterfactual samples for targeted fine-tuning. We evaluate our framework on a Mayo Clinic ultrasound dataset and the CheXpert 5x200 chest X-ray dataset. Results demonstrate that concept intervention enables reliable model diagnosis while maintaining, and occasionally improving predictive performance via guided fine-tuning. Our findings highlight the practical value of this framework for controlled, interpretable refinement of clinical deep learning models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可插拔的基于概念的解释与模型精炼框架，通过将单模态编码器对齐到BioMedCLIP构建概念瓶颈模型（CBM），实现概念级干预以区分因果与虚假相关概念，并在超声和胸部X光数据集上验证其诊断与性能提升价值。
AI.motivation: 医学影像模型常为黑箱，缺乏可解释性与系统性调试手段，限制了临床信任与模型优化。
AI.method: 将单模态编码器对齐到BioMedCLIP，构建概念瓶颈模型（CBM）；通过概念级干预隔离因果概念与虚假相关概念，借助领域专家验证，并生成反事实样本用于定向微调。
AI.result: 在Mayo Clinic超声数据集和CheXpert 5x200胸部X光数据集上评估，概念干预可实现可靠的模型诊断，同时通过引导微调保持乃至偶尔提升预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架对临床深度学习模型的可控、可解释精炼具有实际应用价值。

title: Quad-State Safety Evaluation of Open-Weight Large Language Models on Non-Canonical Inputs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust). 12 pages, 11 tables. Project page: https://www.pavanmaddula.com/quadstate Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/pavanmaddula/ASRD-Dataset
summary: Standard safety evaluations of large language models assess harmful requests written in canonical plain text, while models in real-world deployment routinely receive inputs containing emojis, altered spellings, encoded strings, and character-level variations. This work introduces the Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset (ASRD), comprising 2,100 prompts across seven distinct surface-form families. Five open-weight language models are evaluated across these prompts, producing 10,500 responses. The Quad-State Evaluation Rubric classifies each response into one of four outcomes: harmful compliance, safe response, comprehension failure, or indeterminate. Emoji and invisible Unicode variations cause almost no comprehension failure, with pooled harmful compliance of 20.27% and 17.20% against a 22.87% baseline that is driven mainly by Mistral 7B, whereas leetspeak, encoded wrappers, and hybrid transformations score 2.40%, 0.13%, and 2.40% while comprehension failure rises to 36.47%, 65.60%, and 34.47%. Inspection of raw model outputs reveals three response behaviors: hallucinated benignity, structural collapse, and language drift. Project page: www.pavanmaddula.com/quadstate

AI.tldr: 本文提出对抗性表形稳健性数据集(ASRD)，含7类表形变体的2100条提示，对5个开源权重模型生成10500条响应，并用四态评估准则分类，揭示表情符号类变体几乎不损害理解但仍有较高有害遵从率，而编码类变体显著提升理解失败率。
AI.motivation: 标准大语言模型安全评估通常只考察规范纯文本形式的恶意请求，但真实部署中模型常接收含表情符号、变体拼写、编码字符串和字符级变异的输入。这种评估与部署之间的落差可能导致安全性被高估，因此需要系统研究模型对表形变体的稳健性。
AI.method: 构建对抗性表形稳健性数据集(ASRD)，包含7个表形家族共2100条提示；在5个开源权重语言模型上共生成10500条响应；采用四态评估准则(Quad-State Evaluation Rubric)将每条响应分为有害遵从、安全响应、理解失败或不确定四类；并进一步对原始输出进行定性检查，归纳响应行为模式。
AI.result: 表情符号与不可见Unicode变体几乎不导致理解失败，合并有害遵从率分别为20.27%和17.20%，对照基线为22.87%(主要由Mistral 7B驱动)；而leet语、编码包装和混合变换的有害遵从率分别为2.40%、0.13%和2.40%，同时理解失败率升至36.47%、65.60%和34.47%。原始输出检查发现三类响应行为：幻觉良性化、结构崩溃和语言漂移。
AI.conclusion: 表形扰动对模型安全性的影响具有异质性：视觉/不可见字符类变体保持可理解性但未有效降低有害遵从，而编码类变体主要通过引发理解失败而非安全拒答来"规避"危害，说明理解失败不等于安全性提升。研究提示需将表形稳健性纳入安全评估，并区分真正拒答与因解析失败造成的表面安全。

title: Multi-Label Topic Assignment via LLM Distillation: A Comparative Analysis of Generative vs. Discriminative Student Models
summary: Multi-label topic assignment for user-generated content (UGC) -- including product reviews and buyer-seller conversations -- poses unique scalability challenges in large-scale e-commerce due to informal language, extreme label sparsity, and rapidly evolving taxonomies. While utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) as labeling oracles to distill ground-truth data has emerged as an industry standard to bypass prohibitive manual annotation costs, determining the optimal, low-latency architecture for the resulting student models remains an open challenge. To address this, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation across Small Language Model (SLM) parameter scales (1B, 4B, and 8B) and architectural paradigms (causal generative versus bidirectional discriminative). Comparing generative text-to-label classifiers against discriminative baselines (DeBERTa-V3 and ModernBERT), our analysis reveals a crucial data-dependent trade-off: while discriminative models outperform ultra-lightweight generative models on structured product reviews, even the smallest 1B generative model surpasses discriminative baselines on complex, multi-turn conversational data. Furthermore, generative models maintain robust performance under massive label-set expansion (up to 112 topics) and severe long-tail distributions, whereas discriminative baselines suffer a 35% drop in Macro-F1 at scale. Finally, we detail the successful production deployment of these optimized models across both product review and conversational domains, demonstrating strict latency compliance and tangible business impact at a global marketplace scale.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对大规模电商UGC多标签主题分类的可扩展性问题，系统评估了1B/4B/8B小语言模型及因果生成式与双向判别式两种范式，发现判别式模型在结构化评论上更优，而生成式模型在多轮对话、标签集扩展及长尾分布下更稳健，并成功实现生产部署。
AI.motivation: 大规模电商UGC（商品评论与买卖双方对话）的多标签主题分类面临非正式语言、极端标签稀疏性与快速演化的分类体系带来的可扩展性挑战。尽管用LLM作为标注器蒸馏训练数据已成为规避人工标注高成本的行业标准，但如何为学生模型选择最优的低延迟架构仍是未解难题。
AI.method: 在SLM参数规模（1B、4B、8B）与架构范式（因果生成式 vs 双向判别式）两个维度上开展全面评测，将生成式文本到标签分类器与判别式基线（DeBERTa-V3和ModernBERT）进行对比，考察结构化评论与复杂多轮对话、大规模标签集扩展（至112个主题）及严重长尾分布等场景下的表现。
AI.result: 呈现数据依赖的权衡：在结构化商品评论上判别式模型优于超轻量生成式模型，但在复杂多轮对话数据上，即便最小的1B生成式模型也超过判别式基线；生成式模型在标签集大幅扩展和严重长尾分布下保持稳健性能，而判别式基线在规模扩展时Macro-F1下降35%。
AI.conclusion: 所提优化模型已在商品评论与对话两类场景成功生产部署，满足严格的延迟要求，并在全球市场规模下产生切实的业务价值；架构选择应依据数据类型权衡判别式与生成式范式。

title: Talking with Language Models
summary: When we interact with large language models (LLMs), are we having a conversation? They are designed to invite us to treat them as intelligent interlocutors who remember, act, and make commitments. But appearances deceive. We introduce the artifactual stance, a framework that reconceives human-AI interaction as artifact-mediated exchanges of candidate texts. LLM outputs are candidate texts optimized for utility, not utterances bearing meaning or force. LLMs are sophisticated text generators, not speakers. Between sessions, nothing runs; between turns, no one remembers. What persists is a configuration and a transcript. The "conversation" is a user's solo performance, interpretive labour disguised by interface and artifact design. This shift dissolves recent philosophical puzzles. Questions about what 'I' and 'you' refer to in AI exchanges, about whether systems can lie or be held to promises, about the identity of our supposed interlocutors all rest on a false presupposition. There is no speaker behind the screen, hence no one to refer to, no one to hold responsible. What feels like dialogue with someone is interaction with an artifact that generates text at unprecedented scale and fit. By abandoning the conversational framing, we see these systems for what they are: immensely sophisticated artifacts that afford varied uses. The philosophical questions that matter are about the normative underpinnings of design, adoption, authorization, and human practices of use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人工物立场"框架，将人机交互重新理解为经人工物中介的候选文本交换，主张LLM不是言说者而是文本生成器，"对话"实为用户独白式的阐释劳动。
AI.motivation: 学界围绕LLM的哲学讨论（"我""你"的指称、系统能否撒谎或作出承诺、对话者身份）建立在"对话"这一错误预设之上。LLM的输出被误认为承载意义与言语力量的言语行为，交互界面的设计也诱使用户将其视为有记忆、能行动、可承诺的智能对话者，从而产生了大量伪问题。
AI.method: 提出"人工物立场"（artifactual stance）框架：将人机交互重新定义为以人工物为中介的"候选文本"（candidate texts）交换。区分候选文本与言语行为：LLM输出是为效用而优化的文本生成物，非承载意义与力量的言语；系统是文本生成器而非言说者；会话之间无进程运行，轮次之间无记忆主体，持久存在的只是配置与转录记录。
AI.result: 该框架消解了近期一系列哲学难题：AI交互中的"我"与"你"无所指，系统既不能撒谎也无需为承诺负责，所谓对话者的身份问题不成立——因为屏幕背后没有言说者，故无人可指称、无人可问责。看似与他人的对话，实则是对一个高规模、高拟合度文本生成人工物的交互。
AI.conclusion: 放弃对话式框架后，LLM应被认识为高度复杂的人工物，可供多种用途。真正重要的哲学问题转向设计与采用、授权以及人类使用实践的规范性基础。

title: GUARD: Geometric Uncertainty-Aware Point Cloud Denoising and Segmentation for Robotic Hard Disk Drive Disassembly
summary: Reliable robotic disassembly requires part-level representations that distinguish genuine component geometry from scanning and reconstruction artifacts. In point clouds of hard disk drives (HDDs), structured ghost artifacts can resemble valid components locally while remaining inconsistent with the overall geometry, allowing erroneous measurements to receive plausible semantic labels. This creates an engineering information problem: semantic prediction confidence alone does not establish whether the underlying geometry is reliable. We propose \textbf{GUARD}, a geometric uncertainty-aware framework that performs point filtering and segmentation within a single forward pass by modeling the reliability of learned geometric representations. GUARD combines a multi-scale geometric transformer with a multi-bandwidth random Fourier feature Gaussian Process to estimate per-point geometric uncertainty, complemented by predictive entropy to suppress unreliable measurements while preserving informative structures. Evaluation on 2,745 real HDD point clouds shows that GUARD improves PointNet++ segmentation mean intersection over union from 0.7739 to 0.8318. Additional experiments on ShapeNetPart and ScanNet examine robustness across corruption types, point-cloud domains, and segmentation backbones. On manually annotated ScanNet samples, geometric uncertainty achieves a corrupted-point detection F1 score of 0.7931, compared with 0.2212 for predictive entropy. The results demonstrate the value of distinguishing geometric reliability from semantic confidence and reveal a tradeoff between artifact suppression and preservation of informative structures. GUARD contributes a reliability-aware approach to interpreting imperfect 3D measurements for component identification and subsequent robotic handling. Project website: https://001-wang.github.io/GUARD_Point_denoiser/.

AI.tldr: GUARD提出几何不确定性感知框架，在单次前向传播中完成点云滤波与分割，通过多尺度几何Transformer与随机傅里叶特征高斯过程估计逐点几何不确定性，在HDDs点云上将PointNet++分割mIoU从0.7739提升至0.8318。
AI.motivation: 可靠机器人拆解需要部件级表征区分真实几何与扫描重建伪影。HDD点云中的结构化幽灵伪影局部形似有效部件，却与整体几何不一致，可能获得合理的语义标签。仅靠语义预测置信度无法判断几何可靠性，这是工程信息问题。
AI.method: GUARD将多尺度几何Transformer与多带宽随机傅里叶特征（RFF）高斯过程相结合，估计逐点几何不确定性，并辅以预测熵来抑制不可靠测量、同时保留有信息量的结构；滤波与分割在同一前向传播内完成。
AI.result: 在2,745个真实HDD点云上，PointNet++分割mIoU由0.7739提升至0.8318；在ShapeNetPart与ScanNet上验证了跨损坏类型、点云域与分割主干的鲁棒性；在人工标注ScanNet样本上，几何不确定性检测损坏点的F1为0.7931，而预测熵仅为0.2212。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明区分几何可靠性与语义置信度的价值，揭示伪影抑制与保留有效结构之间的权衡。GUARD为面向部件识别与后续机器人操作的不可靠3D测量解释提供了可靠性感知方法。

title: OverLay++: Dense-Overlap Layout-to-Image Generation Dataset
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Project website: https://mlpc-ucsd.github.io/OverLayPP . Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mlpcucsd/OverLayPP
summary: Layout-to-Image generation has made substantial progress in spatial and object-level control. However, existing methods still struggle with complex scenes containing many overlapping and interacting objects. We argue that training data is a particular bottleneck: existing datasets lack examples with dense, complex object interactions. To address this gap, we introduce OverLay++, a large-scale Layout-to-Image dataset with structurally complex scenes. OverLay++ contains approximately 500K images with an average of 6.6 objects per image, exceeding existing datasets by 1.67 times in annotation density. Beyond annotation density, OverLay++ provides rich semantic detail with object captions over six times longer than in current datasets. Our dataset generation pipeline is simple and produces dense, overlapping object annotations with rich per-object captions. Across multiple benchmarks, state-of-the-art Layout-to-Image methods trained on the OverLay++ dataset show consistent improvement and faster convergence, demonstrating the importance of dense, overlap-aware, and caption-rich supervision for controllable image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大规模布局到图像数据集 OverLay++，包含约50万张图像，平均每图6.6个对象，标注密度为现有数据集的1.67倍，对象描述长度超过现有数据集6倍，旨在解决复杂重叠与交互场景下布局到图像生成的训练数据瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有布局到图像生成方法在空间与对象级控制上已有进展，但在包含大量重叠与交互对象的复杂场景中仍表现不佳。作者认为训练数据是关键瓶颈：现有数据集缺乏密集、复杂对象交互的样本。
AI.method: 构建 OverLay++ 数据集，其生成流水线简单，可产出密集、重叠的对象标注以及丰富的逐对象描述。数据集规模约50万张图像，平均每图6.6个对象。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，使用 OverLay++ 训练的当前最优布局到图像生成方法取得一致性提升，并实现更快的收敛。
AI.conclusion: 密集、重叠感知且描述丰富的监督信号对可控图像生成具有重要意义，OverLay++ 有效缓解了复杂场景下的数据瓶颈。

title: DISRQAD: Diffusion Image Super-Resolution Quality Assessment Dataset and Benchmark
summary: Diffusion-based image super-resolution (SR) can create visually plausible detail that is not supported by the low-resolution input. We introduce DISRQAD, a subjective-quality dataset and diagnostic benchmark for this setting. It contains mean opinion scores (MOS) for 14,000 SR outputs from ten diffusion and four non-diffusion methods, spanning four low-resolution degradation conditions and x2/x4 upscaling. We evaluate 51 standard full-reference and no-reference metric configurations and 11 adapted variants. Agreement with MOS is substantially weaker on diffusion outputs: the strongest standard no-reference baseline reaches 0.431 SRCC on diffusion SR versus 0.813 on non-diffusion SR. As a case study in benchmark use, a pruned and distilled Q-ReAlign-mini student reaches 0.496 SRCC on diffusion SR. DISRQAD measures perceived output quality, not faithfulness to the input; it enables analysis of metric behavior across generator families and input conditions. Our findings reveal a substantial gap in the assessment of diffusion-based SR and provide a basis for developing quality models sensitive to diffusion-specific artifacts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DISRQAD——面向扩散式图像超分辨率的众包主观质量数据集与诊断基准，包含1.4万张SR输出的MOS评分，并揭示现有全参考/无参考指标在扩散输出上的一致性显著下降。
AI.motivation: 扩散式图像超分辨率能生成低分辨率输入并不支持、但视觉上看似合理的细节；这类幻觉细节使传统以保真度为导向的质量评价指标失效，而当前缺乏针对扩散SR的感知质量数据与系统性指标诊断。
AI.method: 构建DISRQAD数据集：对10种扩散方法与4种非扩散方法生成的14,000个SR输出收集主观平均意见分数（MOS），覆盖4种低分辨率退化条件与x2/x4放大倍率；评估51种标准全参考/无参考指标配置及11种适配变体，并与MOS计算相关性；以剪枝蒸馏的Q-ReAlign-mini学生模型作为基准使用案例。
AI.result: 在扩散SR输出上，指标与MOS的一致性明显弱于非扩散输出：最强的标准无参考基线在扩散SR上SRCC为0.431，而在非扩散SR上达0.813；剪枝蒸馏的Q-ReAlign-mini学生在扩散SR上达到0.496 SRCC。
AI.conclusion: DISRQAD衡量的是感知输出质量而非对输入的保真度，可用于跨生成器家族与输入条件分析指标行为；结果揭示了扩散式SR质量评估存在显著空白，为开发对扩散特有伪影敏感的质量模型提供了基础。

title: Large-scale Repository Engineering via Agent-Native Reusable Code Primitives
summary: Large language models equipped with development environments have moved code generation toward repository-scale construction, yet building complete repositories remains difficult because interacting modules, interfaces, configurations, tests, and dependencies must work together. We introduce Code Primitives, agent-native reusable executable components with interface contracts, dependency closures, validation tests, and provenance. Each primitive uses a resident LLM to assess relevance and adapt its implementation, interfaces, and dependencies to the target repository, and we organize 1,424 validated primitives in CodeFace, a searchable library for repository construction. We introduce LEGO (Large-scale repository Engineering via aGent-native reusable cOde primitives), which activates task-relevant primitives, integrates their adapted implementations with task-specific code while resolving cross-component constraints, and revises the result against executed tests. To measure construction end to end, we build LEGO-REPO, a benchmark of 522 executable reconstruction tasks spanning seven software domains, 22 capability tracks, and five difficulty levels, scored against native test suites between an empty-package floor and original-source ceiling. The strongest of 13 evaluated backbones reaches a delivery score of 0.318 and scores zero on 41.0% of tasks; LEGO improves all 13 by 0.1474 on average and raises GPT-5.6-terra from 0.3180 to 0.5134 (+61.4%). In controlled comparisons, adapted primitives outperform retrieved code supplied as context or vendored unchanged. The effect persists against independent repository agents, across three external benchmarks, and with a disjointly re-mined CodeFace; GPT-OSS-20B for adaptation and diagnosis retains 95.1% of the homogeneous score at 24.0% lower cost.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Code Primitives（带接口契约、依赖闭包、验证测试与来源的可复用可执行组件）与 CodeFace 库（1424 个已验证原语），并构建 LEGO 框架用于仓库级代码构建，配合 LEGO-REPO 基准（522 个可执行重建任务）验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 具备开发环境的大语言模型已把代码生成推进到仓库级构建，但构建完整仓库仍然困难，因为相互交互的模块、接口、配置、测试与依赖必须协同工作。现有方法难以端到端衡量与解决跨组件约束问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出 Code Primitives：agent 原生的可复用可执行组件，包含接口契约、依赖闭包、验证测试与溯源信息；每个原语由常驻 LLM 评估相关性，并将其实现、接口与依赖适配到目标仓库。2) 构建 CodeFace 可搜索原语库（1424 个已验证原语）。3) 提出 LEGO 框架：激活任务相关原语，将其适配实现与任务特定代码集成，同时解决跨组件约束，并依据执行测试迭代修订。4) 构建 LEGO-REPO 基准：522 个可执行重建任务，覆盖 7 个软件领域、22 条能力赛道、5 个难度等级，以原生测试套件评分，区间为空包下限到原始源码上限。
AI.result: 13 个评测主干中最强者交付得分为 0.318，41.0% 任务得分为零；LEGO 使全部 13 个主干平均提升 0.1474，将 GPT-5.6-terra 从 0.3180 提升至 0.5134（+61.4%）。在受控对比中，适配后的原语优于以上下文形式提供的检索代码或未经修改直接内嵌（vendored）的代码。该效果在独立仓库智能体、三个外部基准以及重新挖掘的不相交 CodeFace 上依然成立；使用 GPT-OSS-20B 进行适配与诊断可保留同构设置的 95.1% 得分，同时成本降低 24.0%。
AI.conclusion: 以 agent 原生可复用原语为核心、结合适配与约束求解的 LEGO 方法，能显著提升仓库级代码构建的端到端可执行交付能力，且效果具备跨主干、跨基准与跨原语库的稳健性，并可通过小模型适配实现成本与性能的折中。

title: Anaximander: Interactively Running Geospatial Deep Learning Models on Any Compute Backend
comment: Accepted as a poster at the TerraBytes II workshop, ECCV 2026
summary: Applying deep learning models to satellite imagery from within geographic information systems (GIS) remains high-friction for remote sensing practitioners. Models arrive in incompatible formats and target different compute environments, from local workstations to serverless cloud services. As a result, every evaluation demands custom deployment, tiling, and georeferencing code before a single prediction reaches the analyst's map. This friction discourages systematic comparison in a domain where model choice directly affects operational outcomes such as field delineation, crop monitoring, and disaster response. We present Anaximander, an open-source system that unifies model source and compute location choice behind one interactive interface. The system's backend is an inference server that loads models from multiple commonly-used sources and serves them on any accessible compute backend. The server provides session management and model caching, and streams results back per tile. The backend is paired with a QGIS plugin that drives tiling, result reassembly, georeferencing, and real-time per-tile status visualization. An additional user-interface path injects layer legends as prompts into vision-language models. We demonstrate the system in a code-free side-by-side comparison of three heterogeneous models on an agricultural field delineation task: gpt-image-1 via a cloud API, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) on a remote GPU, and DelineateAnything on a local CPU. The inference backend and protocol are open-source and available at https://github.com/microsoft/nxmndr.

AI.tldr: 我们提出 Anaximander，一个开源系统，通过统一推理服务器与 QGIS 插件，将异构深度学习模型的来源与算力选择解耦，实现遥感影像在 GIS 中的无代码推理与对比。
AI.motivation: 将深度学习模型应用于 GIS 中的卫星影像对遥感从业者仍摩擦很大：模型格式互不兼容，目标算力环境各异（本地工作站到无服务器云服务），每次评估都需自写部署、切瓦片、地理配准代码，阻碍了该领域系统性的模型比较。
AI.method: Anaximander 后端为推理服务器，可从多种常用来源加载模型并在任意可访问算力后端上服务，提供会话管理与模型缓存，并按瓦片流式返回结果；前端为 QGIS 插件，负责切瓦片、结果重组、地理配准与逐瓦片实时状态可视化；另有 UI 路径将图层图例作为提示注入视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 在农田地块勾绘任务上实现了三种异构模型的无代码并排对比：通过云 API 的 gpt-image-1、远程 GPU 上的 SAM3、本地 CPU 上的 DelineateAnything。推理后端与协议已开源（GitHub: microsoft/nxmndr）。
AI.conclusion: Anaximander 以统一接口消除了模型来源与算力选择的部署摩擦，支持在 GIS 内进行无代码、可复现的异构模型对比，代码与协议已开源。

title: U-Space: Uncovering When and Why Uncertainty Arises in Language Models
summary: Large language models are informing decisions with ever-higher stakes. As the consequences of their errors grow, a central question becomes harder to ignore: how much can we trust an individual answer? Yet recognizing when to defer remains difficult because language models can present incorrect conclusions with fluent explanations and an authoritative tone. Uncertainty quantification seeks to address this disconnect by estimating the reliability of individual predictions. However, many existing methods require repeated generations or separately trained components, and their scalar estimates do not reveal where uncertainty arises or how it evolves during reasoning. Recent work has also shown that generation length can be strongly associated with uncertainty estimates and correctness, raising the question of how much of an estimator's predictive power comes from uncertainty-specific information rather than output length alone. Mechanistic interpretability offers a way to address these limitations by connecting human-interpretable concepts to intermediate model states. Building on this capability, we introduce the U-Space, a low-dimensional subspace that makes a model's evolving uncertainty measurable and interpretable. We identify semantic anchors for doubt and certainty, map their unembedding directions back into the residual space, and combine their contrasts into an orthogonal basis. The U-Lens projects each token state onto these basis vectors, yielding an interpretable token-level uncertainty map that can be inspected directly or aggregated into a scalar uncertainty score. Our approach requires no correctness labels, repeated generations, or training. Across reasoning benchmarks, its confidence score outperforms established baselines under both standard and length-controlled evaluation and transfers more reliably than supervised estimators. Code: https://github.com/s2labres/U-Space.

AI.tldr: 提出 U-Space——一个低维子空间，用语义锚点构建正交基，通过 U-Lens 将 token 状态投影为可解释的不确定性图，兼具 token 级可视化与标量置信度，无需正确性标签、重复生成或训练。
AI.motivation: 大模型在高风险决策中应用日益广泛，但错误代价上升，核心问题是个体答案可信度评估困难。模型能以流畅解释和权威语气给出错误结论，而现有不确定性量化方法存在不足：需重复生成或额外训练组件、标量估计无法揭示不确定性来源与推理中的演化过程；此外生成长度与不确定性和正确性强相关，需辨析估计器预测力中有多少来自不确定性信息而非仅输出长度。
AI.method: 借助机械可解释性，将人类可解释概念与模型中间状态关联。具体为：识别"怀疑"与"确定"的语义锚点，将其 unembedding 方向映射回残差空间，对比组合成正交基，构成 U-Space。U-Lens 将每个 token 状态投影到这些基向量上，得到 token 级不确定性图，可直接检查或聚合为标量不确定性分数。方法无需正确性标签、重复生成或训练。
AI.result: 在推理基准上，其置信度分数在标准与长度控制评估下均优于既有基线，且相比监督式估计器具有更可靠的迁移性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: U-Space 将不确定性表征与可解释性结合，提供兼具细粒度与聚合形式的不确定性度量，规避对标签、采样与训练的需求，并在长度控制下验证了其预测力来源于不确定性特异信息。

title: Constraint Tree Exploration for Learning from Language Feedback
summary: Natural-language feedback in interactive learning often explains why an action failed by pointing to violated requirements. Misinterpreting this feedback can lead an agent to rule out valid solutions. We study this setting by modeling user intent as latent constraints over an action space and formulating learning from language feedback as pure exploration over feasible regions. We introduce TRACE, an algorithm that organizes candidate constraints in a tree and tests each proposed refinement by generating actions that satisfy it. TRACE commits to the refinement only if the resulting feedback does not contradict it over repeated tests. We distinguish two ways of using the same feedback: (i) falsification, which detects contradictions to the constraint set currently being tested, and (ii) identification, which may additionally name a violated constraint. We prove high-probability coverage bounds with dependence on the candidate class size $H$ for TRACE-Falsification. With reliable identification, TRACE-Identification can replace this dependence by $K/p_{\mathrm{ext}}$, where $K$ is the number of latent constraints and $p_{\mathrm{ext}}$ lower-bounds the probability of extracting a missing true constraint from informative feedback. We evaluate TRACE across six language-feedback tasks. On RecMovie, TRACE-Identification achieves 73% and 86% final-output success under caps of 20 and 60 evaluated outputs, compared with at most 42% and 48% for the evaluated prompting baselines given the same feedback and output caps. Controlled identity-corruption experiments further show greater robustness than direct accumulation when the falsification detector remains reliable.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究从自然语言反馈中学习的问题，将其建模为对潜在约束的纯探索，提出 TRACE 算法（含 Falsification 与 Identification 两种反馈利用方式），并给出高概率覆盖界与多任务实验验证。
AI.motivation: 交互式学习中的自然语言反馈常通过指出被违反的要求来解释动作失败的原因。若智能体误读该反馈，可能错误地排除有效解。因此需要一种方法，能从语言反馈中稳健地推断用户意图（潜在约束），避免因误解而丢失可行解。
AI.method: 将用户意图建模为动作空间上的潜在约束，把从语言反馈学习形式化为对可行区域的纯探索。提出 TRACE 算法：把候选约束组织成树结构；对每个提议的细化生成满足该约束的动作进行测试；仅当重复测试中反馈不与细化矛盾时才提交该细化。区分同一反馈的两种用法：(i) 证伪（falsification），检测与当前测试约束集的矛盾；(ii) 识别（identification），可额外命名被违反的约束。对应 TRACE-Falsification 与 TRACE-Identification。
AI.result: 证明 TRACE-Falsification 具有依赖于候选类大小 H 的高概率覆盖界；在具备可靠识别时，TRACE-Identification 可将该依赖替换为 K/p_ext（K 为潜在约束数，p_ext 为从信息性反馈中提取缺失真实约束概率的下界）。在六个语言反馈任务上评估：RecMovie 上，在评估输出上限为 20 和 60 时，TRACE-Identification 的最终输出成功率分别达 73% 和 86%，而所评估的提示基线在相同反馈与输出上限下至多为 42% 和 48%。受控的身份扰动实验显示，当证伪检测器保持可靠时，该方法比直接累积更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TRACE 通过树式约束组织与谨慎的提交机制，有效利用自然语言反馈进行约束学习，在理论上给出覆盖保证，在实验中显著优于提示基线，并在反馈噪声/扰动下表现出更强鲁棒性。

title: Same Text, Different Prediction: Serving-Context Nondeterminism in Text Classifiers
summary: Deterministic inference is essential for reliable and trustworthy machine learning. Prior studies of text generation have shown that changing factors such as batch size, batch composition, hardware, or inference engine can alter the generated text, even when the prompt, model parameters, and sampling randomness are fixed. These differences have been attributed in part to floating-point non-associativity, shape-dependent kernel selection, and other implementation-level differences in numerical execution. However, it remains unclear whether, when, and to what extent the same factors affect text classification. We present a systematic study of serving-context non-invariance in text classifiers, which prior work has measured only through generated text. We train 180 models spanning discriminative, pseudo-generative, and fully generative classifier formulations and evaluate each across four categories of serving contexts, holding the checkpoint and the text fixed. Label stability does not imply score stability. Changing only the batch shape changes no labels across fp32 comparisons, yet under bf16 it moves up to 56.7 percentage points of predicted probability mass, with label changes concentrated at small margins. Fully generative classifiers change more labels than their discriminative counterparts under the same serving changes. We derive sufficient conditions for label stability under each serving change and give a separate mitigation for each mechanism. Our results identify and quantify the serving conditions that must be fixed for reproducible text classification.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了文本分类器在服务上下文（serving context）下的非不变性，发现标签稳定不等于分数稳定，batch shape 在 bf16 下可移动最多 56.7 个百分点的预测概率质量，并给出各服务变化的标签稳定充分条件与针对性缓解措施。
AI.motivation: 已有研究显示，即使提示词、模型参数和采样随机性固定，batch size、batch 组成、硬件或推理引擎等因素仍会改变生成文本，原因包括浮点非结合性、形状相关的核选择等实现层差异。但这些问题是否、何时以及在多大程度上影响文本分类尚不清楚，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 训练 180 个模型，涵盖判别式、伪生成式和完全生成式三类分类器形式；在固定检查点与文本的前提下，将每个模型在四类服务上下文中进行评估；针对每种服务变化推导标签稳定的充分条件，并分别设计缓解机制。
AI.result: 标签稳定性并不意味着分数稳定性：仅改变 batch shape 在 fp32 比较下不改变任何标签，但在 bf16 下最多移动 56.7 个百分点的预测概率质量，且标签变化集中在较小间隔处；相同服务变化下，完全生成式分类器比判别式分类器改变更多标签。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别并量化了可复现文本分类必须固定的服务条件，并为每种服务变化机制提供了相应的缓解方案。

title: From Uncertainty to Action: Learning to Steer LLM Agents
summary: Steering an LLM agent means deciding whether to correct it, at which step, and with which mechanism. Uncertainty is often used to decide when to correct an agent, but whether it can guide these decisions remains unclear. We steer agent trajectories separately at every non-terminal step with each of four mechanisms and run each continuation to completion. The resulting stepwise outcome table (SOT) holds about 82,000 counterfactual continuations of 1,864 trajectories from three benchmarks and two agents. It shows that uncertainty can identify failing trajectories, but that no single signal reliably locates the step at which steering helps. We therefore propose VoS (Value of Steering), a trajectory-level monitor, offline or online, that learns from SOT the value of steering at each step and decides where to steer by it. A harm-budgeted trigger decides whether to steer, limiting the fraction of successful trajectories that VoS disturbs. VoS improves on unmodified execution in all 12 settings of benchmark, agent, and offline or online use, by 7.8 points on average, and outperforms the strongest of five existing uncertainty-triggered methods in 11, by 2.9 points on average. Ablations show that training on measured outcomes and a tight harm budget are both essential.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了包含约8.2万条反事实续推的逐步结果表（SOT），发现不确定性可识别失败轨迹但难以定位有效修正步骤，据此提出轨迹级监控器VoS，通过学习每步的引导价值并配合伤害预算触发机制来决定是否与何处进行引导。
AI.motivation: 引导LLM智能体需要回答三个问题：是否修正、在哪一步修正、用何种机制修正。不确定性常被用于判断何时修正，但其能否指导这些决策尚不明确；现有方法缺乏对"在哪一步引导才真正有效"的可靠定位信号。
AI.method: 在每个非终态步骤上，用四种机制分别对轨迹进行引导，并将每条续推运行至完成，从而构建逐步结果表（SOT），包含来自3个基准、2个智能体的1,864条轨迹的约82,000条反事实续推。基于SOT提出VoS（Value of Steering），一个可在离线或在线使用的轨迹级监控器，学习每一步的引导价值并据此决定引导位置；同时采用带伤害预算的触发机制决定是否引导，以限制VoS对成功轨迹的干扰比例。
AI.result: VoS在基准、智能体及离线/在线共12种设置下均优于未修改执行，平均提升7.8分；在11种设置中优于五种现有不确定性触发方法中最强的一种，平均提升2.9分。消融实验表明，基于实测结果进行训练与采用严格的伤害预算是两个必要因素。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性可用于识别失败轨迹，但无法可靠定位引导有效的步骤，因此需要学习式的价值评估来指导"在哪引导"；VoS验证了以SOT实测结果为监督、并施加伤害预算约束的轨迹级引导策略能稳定提升智能体表现。

title: SPLATIFY: Reproduce, Discover, Innovate! From Papers and Ideas to Trainable 3DGS Code
summary: The rapid growth of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) research demands significant effort to reimplement papers before building on them. We introduce SPLATIFY, a multi-agent framework that converts 3DGS papers into trainable gsplat-based implementations, where generic paper-to-code methods and frontier models fail. SPLATIFY achieves this through five innovations: (1) A context-free grammar for gsplat over a modular method template with extension points for losses, densification, rendering, and optimization, constraining synthesis so generated code satisfies gsplat's architectural invariants by construction. (2) Architectural elements for faithful reproduction: fork-aware citation recovery retrieving component-level code at function-level granularity, Graph-of-Thought synthesis in topological dependency order, RAG-guided in-context example selection from over 20 verified implementations, and visual feedback combining PSNR-guided regeneration, Gaussian-level structural checks, and VLM-driven patching. (3) Knowledge-driven compositional improvement that autonomously finds weaknesses and composes complementary regularizers, losses, and densification strategies to improve upon original results. (4) Interdisciplinary method discovery where agents retrieve physical priors from outside the 3DGS literature and compose them with rendering knowledge to produce methods for previously unaddressed scene types. (5) SPLATIFY-Bench, an evaluation framework across 30 diverse 3DGS papers. On papers without public code, SPLATIFY matches expert implementations while reducing development time from weeks to minutes, and through compositional discovery further improves PSNR by up to 2.4 dB. We additionally demonstrate novel methods for volumetric nebula rendering and other scientific domains, synthesized entirely by SPLATIFY.

AI.tldr: SPLATIFY是一个多智能体框架，可将3DGS论文自动转换为可训练的gsplat实现，在无公开代码情况下达到专家级复现水平，并将开发时间从数周缩短至分钟级。
AI.motivation: 3DGS研究快速增长，复现论文需大量精力，且通用论文到代码方法与前沿模型在此任务上均失败，亟需专用自动化复现方案。
AI.method: 五项创新：(1) 面向gsplat的上下文无关文法与模块化方法模板，含损失、致密化、渲染、优化的扩展点；(2) 忠实复现的架构组件：fork感知引用恢复、按拓扑依赖顺序的Graph-of-Thought合成、基于20余个已验证实现的RAG示例选择、结合PSNR引导重生成与VLM驱动修补的视觉反馈；(3) 知识驱动的组合式改进；(4) 跨学科方法发现；(5) SPLATIFY-Bench评测框架。
AI.result: 在30篇3DGS论文上评测；无公开代码时匹配专家实现，开发时间从数周降至分钟，组合式发现使PSNR最高提升2.4 dB；并合成出体积极云渲染等新方法。
AI.conclusion: SPLATIFY验证了多智能体、文法约束与知识组合在3DGS论文自动复现与创新上的有效性，可扩展至科学领域新方法生成。

title: TopoCurve: Geometry-Aware Topology Reasoning via Bézier Curves in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (main track). 15 pages, 4 figures
summary: Topology reasoning jointly detects 3D lanes and traffic elements from multi-view images and infers their structural connectivity. Current methods model lanes as discrete polylines, lacking smoothness, analytical tangent directions, and global spatial support for attention, while providing sparse topology supervision. We propose TopoCurve, a geometry-driven architecture for 3D topology reasoning grounded in a structured parametric lane representation. Lanes are modeled as endpoint-fixed cubic Bézier curves, enabling continuous geometry with exact endpoints and analytically defined directionality. We exploit this shared curve geometry across the entire pipeline. Endpoint distance and tangent alignment are encoded with multi-scale Fourier features and injected into the topology head. Sampled curve points serve as geometry-aligned references for deformable cross-attention spanning the full lane. Parallel curve-anchored attention branches provide diverse predictions for one-to-many topology supervision. These components form a tightly coupled cascade where representation enables geometric reasoning, guides feature aggregation, and supports denser supervision. TopoCurve achieves 50.6 OLS on the OpenLane-V2 benchmark without any post-processing, establishing a new state-of-the-art among end-to-end camera-only methods, and outperforms all existing approaches on endpoint detection (56.8 vs. 52.6 on DET_p).

AI.tldr: 提出TopoCurve，用参数化三次贝塞尔曲线建模车道，实现几何驱动的3D拓扑推理，在OpenLane-V2上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将车道建模为离散折线，缺乏平滑性、解析切线方向和全局空间注意力支持，且拓扑监督稀疏。需要一种连续、几何一致的表示来支撑更高精度的3D车道拓扑推理。
AI.method: 采用端点固定的三次贝塞尔曲线表示车道，获得连续几何与精确端点及解析方向性；全流程复用曲线几何：用多尺度傅里叶特征编码端点距离与切线对齐并注入拓扑头；采样曲线点作为几何对齐参考用于跨整条车道的可变形交叉注意力；并行曲线锚定注意力分支产生多样预测以支持一对多拓扑监督，形成表示—推理—聚合—监督紧密耦合的级联结构。
AI.result: 在OpenLane-V2基准上无需任何后处理达到50.6 OLS，在纯相机端到端方法中刷新SOTA；端点检测DET_p达56.8，优于此前最佳52.6。
AI.conclusion: 结构化参数化曲线表示可同时提升几何连续性、注意力对齐与监督密度，是3D拓扑推理的有效范式，验证了几何驱动架构的优越性。

title: Depth-to-RGB: Repurposing a Frozen Depth Estimator for Geometry-Guided Compositing
summary: Reference-based object compositing inserts or replaces an object using a background image, a reference image, and a 2D compositing mask. These inputs guide appearance and placement but leave the completed scene's geometry implicit, which can distort object structure or alter the surroundings. Our Depth-to-RGB (D2R) framework predicts composite depth for a scene not yet observed in the RGB inputs. It learns reference-conditioned corrections to a frozen depth estimator using encoder features of paired completed scenes as targets. The unchanged decoder maps the corrected representation to the intended scene's depth, which a separately trained renderer holds fixed during RGB synthesis. Under matched architecture and training, encoder-feature supervision reduces OOD Stage-1 AbsRel by 31.4% relative to decoded-depth supervision. We also introduce AnyInsertion++ with paired in-distribution and category-disjoint splits to evaluate generalization beyond compositing training categories. The complete D2R system leads 12 open-source and 3 closed-source baselines in estimator-derived geometry and photometric quality on both paired splits. On category-disjoint data, D2R reduces AbsRel by 43.7% and improves PSNR by 2.4 dB over the matched RGB baseline. Across three unpaired benchmarks, D2R leads both identity metrics and reduces mean CLIP reference cosine distance by 55% relative to the strongest baseline. Project page: https://shjo-april.github.io/Depth2RGB/

AI.tldr: 提出Depth-to-RGB (D2R)框架：在参考图像引导的对象合成任务中显式预测合成场景深度，通过冻结深度估计器+编码器特征监督实现几何一致性，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 基于参考的对象合成（插入/替换对象）依赖背景图、参考图和2D掩码，但这些输入使完成场景的几何信息保持隐式，容易导致对象结构扭曲或周围环境被改变。
AI.method: D2R先预测RGB输入中尚未观测到的合成场景深度：以配对完成场景的编码器特征为目标，学习对冻结深度估计器的参考条件化修正；未被修改的解码器将修正后的表示映射为目标场景深度，并由单独训练且在RGB合成中保持固定的渲染器输出结果。同时构建AnyInsertion++数据集，包含配对同分布与类别不相交（category-disjoint）划分以评估跨类别泛化。采用编码器特征监督而非解码深度监督（OOD Stage-1 AbsRel降低31.4%）。
AI.result: 在架构与训练匹配条件下，编码器特征监督较解码深度监督使OOD Stage-1 AbsRel降低31.4%；完整D2R系统在估计器导出几何与光度质量上领先12个开源和3个闭源基线；类别不相交数据上AbsRel降低43.7%、PSNR提升2.4 dB；三个非配对基准上身份指标领先，平均CLIP参考余弦距离较最强基线减少55%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模合成场景深度并结合编码器特征监督，可有效提升参考引导对象合成的几何保真度与泛化能力；D2R在配对与非配对评估中均达到领先水平。

title: Noise Your Prompt: Noising Conditioning Tokens in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026
summary: We revisit a standard accepted practice in the continuous diffusion language model literature of fixing conditioning prompt tokens clean during training. We make a very simple modification: also noise the conditioning prompt tokens during training. We demonstrate that under this modified training objective, we achieve better generalization in combinatorial reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and N-Queens, with the largest gains on harder variants ($3.73\% \to 24.65\%$ solve rate on Sudoku Hard), and increased diversity of generated solutions ($50.60\% \to 73.79\%$ coverage on 10x10 N-Queens). We also show measurable improvements to natural language generation quality in modest dataset regimes with Gigaword summarization, but notably demonstrate that gains do not transfer to all natural language tasks (e.g open ended dialogue generation). Our method is a single line change to the training objective, requires no additional inference costs by default, and provides the flexibility of classifier-free guidance inspired guided sampling. Our \href{https://github.com/LateralIntelligence/noise-your-prompt}{code} is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对连续扩散语言模型训练目标的一行修改：训练时对条件提示词也加噪，从而提升组合推理任务的泛化性、解多样性，并在部分自然语言生成任务上取得改进。
AI.motivation: 现有连续扩散语言模型文献中存在一个被普遍接受的惯例，即在训练时保持条件提示词（conditioning prompt tokens）干净不加噪。作者质疑这一惯例的合理性，认为其可能限制模型的泛化能力与生成多样性。
AI.method: 仅对训练目标做单行修改：在训练阶段不再固定条件提示词为干净状态，而是同样对提示词 token 加噪。该方法默认不增加额外推理成本，并可支持类似无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）的引导采样。
AI.result: 在组合推理任务上泛化性更好，困难变体提升最大：Sudoku Hard 求解率从 3.73% 提升至 24.65%；10x10 N-Queens 解覆盖率从 50.60% 提升至 73.79%。在中小规模数据集上的 Gigaword 摘要任务中，自然语言生成质量有可测量提升；但增益并不迁移到所有自然语言任务（如开放式对话生成）。
AI.conclusion: 对条件提示词加噪是一个简单但有效的训练目标修改，能改善组合推理泛化、解多样性及部分自然语言生成质量，但效果并非普遍适用。代码已开源。

title: sk-bench: A Native-First Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Slovak
summary: Multilingual LLM benchmarks omit Slovak, a morphologically rich West Slavic language of five million speakers, or cover it only by machine translation. We present sk-bench, a native-first Slovak benchmark with 30 datasets (33 scored task variants) across ten skill categories. Eleven resources are introduced or first packaged for generative-LLM evaluation, including IFEval-SK with Slovak-adapted instruction checkers and native Chiby/SKJ1 resources for Slovak grammar and morphology. We evaluate 55 open- and closed-weights models under one harness. The best open model trails proprietary APIs by 12.6 points. Model rankings are similar for native and translated closed-form data ($ρ\geq0.98$), though translation separates the strongest models less well. By contrast, human-authored and LLM-generated QA questions rank models differently ($ρ=0.72$). For Qwen3-14B, continued Slovak pretraining lowers the overall score by 13.9 points. A small instruction set restores three quarters of that loss. Test-time reasoning improves scores by 8.5 to 12.5 points for models of 9B and above. Together, these findings suggest four design lessons for other under-resourced languages: use native data where translation fails, plan instruction repair after language adaptation, enable test-time reasoning before scaling up, and avoid overinvesting in target-language prompts. We release the data and code at https://github.com/slovak-nlp/sk-bench

AI.tldr: 该论文提出sk-bench，首个以母语数据优先构建的斯洛伐克语LLM评测基准，覆盖30个数据集、33个任务变体与10类技能，并在统一评测框架下评估55个开放与闭源权重模型，总结出面向低资源语言的四条设计经验。
AI.motivation: 多语言LLM基准普遍缺失斯洛伐克语，或仅通过机器翻译覆盖，难以真实反映模型在该形态丰富语言上的能力。作者希望为斯洛伐克语提供原生优先的评测资源，并为其他低资源语言提供可复用的设计经验。
AI.method: 构建sk-bench基准：包含30个数据集、33个计分任务变体、10类技能；新引入或首次打包11项资源，如带斯洛伐克语适配指令检查器的IFEval-SK、面向斯洛伐克语语法与形态的原生Chiby/SKJ1资源。在统一评测框架（one harness）下评测55个开放与闭源权重模型，并开展翻译对比、人工与LLM生成QA对比、继续预训练与指令修复、测试时推理等消融实验。
AI.result: 最强开放模型落后专有API 12.6分；原生与翻译后的闭式数据模型排名相似（ρ≥0.98），但翻译对最强模型区分度更低；人工编写与LLM生成QA问题导致模型排名不同（ρ=0.72）；Qwen3-14B继续斯洛伐克语预训练使总分下降13.9分，少量指令数据可恢复其中四分之三损失；测试时推理对9B及以上模型提升8.5至12.5分。
AI.conclusion: 面向低资源语言评测提出四条设计经验：翻译失效处应使用原生数据；语言适配后需规划指令修复；扩展规模前先启用测试时推理；避免在目标语言提示上过度投入。数据与代码已开源于https://github.com/slovak-nlp/sk-bench。

title: ToolRACER: A Robust Agentic Conversation Emulation Resource for Agent Training and Evaluation
summary: Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under real world conversation scenarios as they rarely follow a predictable script, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks often emphasize successful, cooperative interactions and underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present ToolRACER, a synthetic data generation pipeline that coordinates user, assistant and tool emulation models to generate and validated multi-turn interactions between a user and an agent. Using \sysn, we construct ToolRACERBench a robust multi-turn conversation benchmark spanning six domains, ranging over 55 varied personas, generating a validated corpus of 5.6K conversation trajectories, with approximately 66\% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We inject adversarial behaviors, producing validated conversational interaction trajectories that capture realistic, robust scenarios. We evaluate models trained on ToolRACERBench against internal benchmarks, as well as on function calling benchmarks such as $τ^2$-bench, BFCLv3 and ACEBench to evaluate agentic accuracy and robustness. Models trained on ToolRACERBench improve end to end agentic accuracy across $τ^2$-bench and ACEBench, demonstrating significant gains when mixed with in-domain dataset in small language models for agent capability tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToolRACER，一个协调用户、助手和工具模拟模型的合成数据生成流水线，用于生成并验证多轮交互轨迹；基于该流水线构建了ToolRACERBench基准（涵盖6个领域、55种人物画像、5.6K条验证轨迹，约66%包含易失败场景），并验证了其在提升智能体准确性与鲁棒性方面的效果。
AI.motivation: 面向任务的对话智能体在真实场景中表现脆弱，因为对话很少遵循可预测脚本，尤其是用户表现出非合作行为时。现有函数调用基准多强调成功、合作的交互，对对抗性对话轨迹的覆盖不足，导致开发鲁棒智能体所需的训练资源受限。
AI.method: 提出ToolRACER合成数据生成流水线，协调用户、助手与工具模拟模型，生成并验证用户与智能体之间的多轮交互。利用该流水线构建ToolRACERBench：跨6个领域、覆盖55种人物画像，生成5.6K条经验证的对话轨迹，约66%含易失败场景，并注入对抗行为以形成可捕获真实鲁棒场景的验证轨迹。模型在内部基准及τ²-bench、BFCLv3、ACEBench等函数调用基准上评估智能体准确性与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在ToolRACERBench上训练的模型提升了在τ²-bench和ACEBench上的端到端智能体准确性；在小语言模型上，与同领域数据集混合训练时，智能体能力任务取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: ToolRACER通过合成对抗性多轮对话数据，弥补了现有函数调用基准在非合作/失败场景覆盖上的不足，为构建鲁棒的任务型对话智能体提供了有效的训练资源，并实证了其在准确性与鲁棒性上的增益。

title: RDGSplat: Render-Dedicated Geometry for Novel View Synthesis
summary: 3D foundation models enable efficient novel view synthesis by carrying a Gaussian head on the representation they already use for reconstruction. However, the views they render fall short of the geometry they recover, because that geometry is estimated under a metric objective and never scored on how it renders. Recent methods alleviate this by updating the backbone weights, but they thereby discard the metric predictions the model was built for and must be repeated for every new backbone. To this end, we propose RDGSplat, a framework that decodes a second geometry dedicated to rendering from a frozen 3D foundation model, leaving its metric predictions intact. In particular, we devise Render-Dedicated Geometry Decoding, which duplicates the pretrained decoders and optimizes the duplicates under photometric supervision alone. Then, a Target-Pose Conditioned Adapter is introduced to reformulate the representation those decoders read, conditioned on the target camera pose rather than the target image. Extensive experiments show that RDGSplat improves novel view synthesis across three feed-forward backbones on four benchmarks, with every pretrained weight frozen. On RE10K, it raises WM2.0 from 20.918 to 24.266\,dB while training 205.5\,M added parameters against a frozen 1.4\,B backbone, and the depth and pose the same model predicts are unchanged.

AI.tldr: RDGSplat框架从冻结的3D基础模型中解码一个专门用于渲染的第二几何表示，在保持原度量预测不变的前提下提升新视角合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有3D基础模型通过在表示上附加高斯头实现高效新视角合成，但其渲染视图达不到所恢复几何的质量，因为几何是在度量目标下估计的，从未以渲染效果作为评分标准。已有方法通过更新主干权重缓解该问题，但会丢弃模型原有的度量预测能力，且每换一个新主干都需重新训练。
AI.method: 提出RDGSplat框架，从冻结的3D基础模型解码出专用于渲染的第二几何，使度量预测保持完整。具体包含：渲染专用几何解码（Render-Dedicated Geometry Decoding），复制预训练解码器并仅以光度监督优化副本；目标位姿条件适配器（Target-Pose Conditioned Adapter），以目标相机位姿而非目标图像为条件，重构解码器所读取的表示。
AI.result: 在四个基准、三个前馈主干上，所有预训练权重冻结时新视角合成均得到提升。在RE10K上，WM2.0从20.918 dB提升至24.266 dB，仅训练205.5M新增参数对应冻结的1.4B主干，且同一模型预测的深度与位姿保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 通过将渲染专用几何与冻结基础模型的度量几何解耦，RDGSplat在不破坏原有度量预测的前提下显著改善新视角合成，并具备跨主干、跨基准的通用性与参数效率。

title: LayerRoPE: Dynamic Depth-wise Magnitude & Angular Superposition
summary: As data propagates through a Transformer, the norm of its hidden states grows by orders of magnitude with depth, a phenomenon framed as 'curse of depth' and nearly universally treated as a pathology to be suppressed. We take the opposite view. Across 16 pre-trained LLMs from 9 families, spanning dense, mixture-of-experts and hybrid architectures and Pre-, Peri- and Post-Norm designs, we find that this growth reflects an emergent depth-positional encoding, carried by the only learned per-layer gain on the residual stream, the normalization weight $γ$: with depth, $γ$ grows in magnitude and rotates in direction, jointly encoding the layer index. We make this depth-conditioned encoding explicit with LayerRoPE, an implicit analog of RoPE along the depth axis, which replaces all layerwise $γ$ vectors with a single shared vector and depth-conditioned scalars, at a net reduction in parameters and $<0.02\%$ change in FLOPs. Across a model ladder scaled up to $100$B+ tokens, LayerRoPE consistently outperforms Pre-, Post- and Peri-Norm and Layer-Norm Scaling, reaching Pre-Norm's 1.3B loss with $3.4\times$ less compute; LayerRoPE is the only approach that shows strong convergence and improves near monotonically as depth scales to 512 layers. It improves learning-rate sensitivity by $3$-$10\times$, and transfers naively to and consistently improves looped latent models and Vision Transformers. Inspecting its learned schedule inverts the prevailing premise: LayerRoPE does not shrink the residual stream but widens it, damping what each block reads while amplifying what it writes. Depth stability, our results suggest, calls not for suppressing the residual stream, but for depth-conditioned regulation of the computational blocks it feeds.

AI.tldr: 论文指出Transformer隐藏态范数随深度增长并非病态，而是一种由归一化权重γ承载的隐式深度位置编码；提出LayerRoPE将其显式化，用共享向量与深度条件标量替代逐层γ，参数更少、FLOPs变化<0.02%，在100B+ token规模下持续优于Pre-/Post-/Peri-Norm与Layer-Norm Scaling，并可扩展到512层。
AI.motivation: 隐藏态范数随深度呈数量级增长被普遍视为"深度诅咒"病态并加以抑制。作者反向假设：这种增长可能编码了层序信息。通过对9个族系、16个预训练LLM（涵盖dense、MoE、hybrid架构及Pre-/Peri-/Post-Norm设计）的观察，发现残差流上唯一的学习型逐层增益——归一化权重γ——随深度幅值增大且方向旋转，联合编码层索引，说明这是一种涌现的深度位置编码。
AI.method: 提出LayerRoPE：作为深度轴上RoPE的隐式类比，将所有逐层γ向量替换为单个共享向量γ与深度条件标量，从而把深度条件编码显式化。实现上净减少参数量，FLOPs变化<0.02%。在模型阶梯上扩展至100B+ token进行验证，并与Pre-Norm、Post-Norm、Peri-Norm及Layer-Norm Scaling对比；同时测试对学习率敏感性、looped latent模型与Vision Transformer的迁移效果，并分析学习到的调度曲线。
AI.result: LayerRoPE在全部对比中持续优于Pre-/Post-/Peri-Norm及Layer-Norm Scaling，以3.4倍更少算力达到Pre-Norm 1.3B模型的loss；是唯一在深度扩展至512层时保持强收敛且近似单调提升的方法；将学习率敏感性改善3–10倍；可朴素迁移并持续提升looped latent模型与ViT。学习到的调度显示LayerRoPE并非缩小残差流，而是加宽残差流——抑制每个block的读取、放大幅值写入。
AI.conclusion: 深度稳定性并非来自抑制残差流，而应来自对其所驱动的计算块进行深度条件化调控（depth-conditioned regulation）。LayerRoPE以共享γ+深度标量实现该调控，兼顾参数效率与深层可扩展性，支持将"深度诅咒"重新诠释为有益的深度位置编码。

title: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free 4D Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Radial-Decomposed Flow Matching
summary: Cine cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) captures the cardiac cycle as a four-dimensional (4D) sequence, but standard acquisition requires electrocardiogram (ECG) gating and repeated breath holds. Visual realism alone does not establish accurate patient-specific ejection fraction (EF) or ventricular volumes. We present PhaseFlow3D, a generative framework that synthesizes a complete 4D cine sequence from a single end-diastolic (ED) three-dimensional (3D) volume without ECG. To capture asymmetric systolic and diastolic dynamics, it represents the cardiac cycle as a piecewise linear phase anchored at ED and end-systolic (ES) time points. At inference, a population-level canonical template supplies this phase without patient-specific temporal information. A phase-conditioned rectified flow model generates a cardiac motion trajectory in latent space. Radial Contraction Decomposition converts each latent state into a 3D displacement field, combining a physics-informed radial component for centripetal myocardial contraction with an image-conditioned residual for rotation and out-of-plane motion. Each frame is generated by directly warping the ED volume, bypassing variational autoencoder decoding. On the combined ACDC and M&Ms benchmark, PhaseFlow3D achieves the lowest EF mean absolute error, the only positive left-ventricular volume-curve $R^2$, and the best distributional quality among compared methods. Ablations confirm each component's contribution. Downstream evaluations demonstrate the utility of the synthesized sequences and displacement fields for segmentation, pathology classification, label propagation, and myocardial strain analysis.

AI.tldr: PhaseFlow3D 提出一种从单个 ED 3D 体积合成完整 4D cine 序列的生成框架，无需 ECG，使用相位条件 rectified flow 与径向收缩分解直接形变 ED 体积，在 ACDC 与 M&Ms 上取得更低 EF 误差和更优分布质量。
AI.motivation: 标准 cine CMR 采集依赖心电门控与多次屏气，且视觉真实不等于患者特异的 EF 或心室容积准确。目标是仅用单个 ED 3D 体积、无需 ECG，生成具有患者特异心动周期动力学且下游可用的 4D cine 序列，解决标准采集的局限与真实性问题。
AI.method: 将心动周期表示为以 ED 和 ES 为锚点的分段线性相位，以捕捉非对称收缩与舒张动力学；推理时用群体级规范模板提供相位、无需患者特异时间信息。采用相位条件 rectified flow 在潜空间生成心脏运动轨迹。通过 Radial Contraction Decomposition 将潜状态转为 3D 位移场，包含物理启发的径向分量（向心性心肌收缩）与图像条件残差（旋转与离面运动）。每帧通过直接形变 ED 体积生成，绕过 VAE 解码。
AI.result: 在合并的 ACDC 与 M&Ms 基准上，PhaseFlow3D 取得最低 EF 平均绝对误差、唯一为正的左心室容积曲线 R²，以及相比对比方法最佳的分布质量。消融实验证实各组分均有贡献。下游评估显示合成序列与位移场可用于分割、病理分类、标签传播和心肌应变分析。
AI.conclusion: PhaseFlow3D 实现了无 ECG、单 ED 体积输入的 4D cine 生成，兼顾动力学准确性与分布质量，并可为分割、分类、标签传播与应变分析等下游任务提供有用信号。

title: R-CNN-Based Chess Position Recognition
summary: Performing chess game position recognition solely from a single image of a three-dimensional board requires predicting the position and orientation of the board relative to the camera, the occupancy of squares and the piece type, which includes its colour. We propose an R-CNN-based framework with independent components for piece recognition and board geometry estimation, whose predictions are combined to reconstruct the position. For piece recognition, we adapt Faster R-CNN using a class-weighted objective and a deeper classification head. The detector operates directly on the input image, retaining alternative piece hypotheses that are subsequently refined using constraints on piece counts and square occupancy. For board detection, we introduce an octagonal arrangement of eight labelled boundary keypoints, predicted using the keypoint head of Mask R-CNN. These provide redundant correspondences for homography estimation and encode board orientation. The estimated homography maps representative points from the piece boxes to an 8x8 grid. On a synthetic dataset, the modifications to piece detection increase mean average precision from 61.59% to 90.14%. Of the predicted board keypoints, 97.11% are within 1% of the image diagonal of their labelled targets. Using ground-truth piece boxes with the predicted homographies gives correct square assignments for every test position. The complete framework recovers 76.61% of test positions exactly and 96.49% with at most one incorrect square.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个基于R-CNN的框架，从三维棋盘单张图像中完成棋子识别与棋盘几何估计，将两者预测结合以重建棋局位置。
AI.motivation: 从单张三维棋盘图像识别棋局，需要同时预测棋盘相对相机的位姿与朝向、格子占用情况以及棋子类型和颜色，任务复杂且需多任务协同。
AI.method: 采用带独立组件的R-CNN框架：棋子识别改良Faster R-CNN，引入类别加权目标与更深分类头，并保留候选假设，通过棋子数与格子占用约束进行精修；棋盘检测引入8个带标签边界关键点的八边形布局，用Mask R-CNN关键点头预测，提供冗余对应以估计单应并编码棋盘朝向；将单应映射棋子框代表点至8x8网格。
AI.result: 在合成数据集上，棋子检测平均精度由61.59%提升至90.14%；97.11%的预测棋盘关键点误差在图像对角线的1%以内；使用真值棋子框与预测单应，所有测试位置均得到正确格子分配；完整框架精确恢复76.61%的测试位置，至多一个格子错误时达96.49%。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能够从单张三维棋盘图像有效重建棋局，关键点单应估计与棋盘几何预测显著提升格子分配准确性，整体在合成数据上取得较高的精确与近似精确恢复率。

title: Bookkeeping, Composition, or Unreachable Gold? Reading MemoryAgentBench's Conflict-Resolution Scores Against a Frozen Last-Write Resolver
comment: Accepted at the IAB Workshop (Interpreting Agent Behavior) at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 19 pages
summary: MemoryAgentBench's Conflict Resolution split is read as measuring "selective forgetting". We execute the benchmark's own rule - the newest statement about a fact wins - as a zero-learning resolver frozen on one of the four fact lists. Under the official metric the rule answers 80.25% of the questions (74.5% on the three held-out lists). Of the rest, 67 items have a released gold that the last-write graph cannot reach but overwritten statements would ("The capital of India is New Delhi." superseded by "The capital of India is Grosseto."; gold New Delhi); such items are a third of the multi-hop questions at 262K. Two long-context models and our pre-registered approximate re-implementation of the benchmark's BM25 agent, one retained run per item and outcomes only, score 84.7%, 82.6% and 41.6% on the items the rule solves against 10.4%, 11.9% and 6.0% on those 67. The failures are a reachability split plus a small parser-scope residual; the per-item split, not the aggregate, is the unit at which a score here can be read.

AI.tldr: MemoryAgentBench 的"冲突消解"子集并非衡量选择性遗忘，而是衡量"最后写入可达性"：无学习的最简规则即足以解答 80.25% 的官方计分问题。
AI.motivation: 作者质疑该子集被解读为"选择性遗忘"能力的合法性，希望检验一个"最新陈述获胜"的零学习规则能否解释其分数，从而厘清该基准实际测量的能力维度。
AI.method: 将该基准自身规则（关于某事实的最新陈述获胜）实现为一个冻结在四条事实列表之一上的零学习解析器，在官方指标下评测；进一步识别最后写入图不可达但被覆盖陈述可达、且带公开 gold 的 67 个条目，并与两个长上下文模型及作者预注册的 BM25 智能体近似复现（每条目保留一次运行、仅记录结果）做逐条目对比。
AI.result: 规则在官方指标下答对 80.25%（三条留出列表上 74.5%）；剩余条目中 67 项 gold 无法被最后写入图触及，却可被被覆盖陈述触及（如印度首都由 New Delhi 被 Grosseto 覆盖而 gold 为 New Delhi），在 262K 长度下占多跳问题的三分之一。两个长上下文模型与 BM25 复现分别在规则可解条目上得 84.7%、82.6%、41.6%，而在该 67 项上仅 10.4%、11.9%、6.0%。
AI.conclusion: 失败来源是一个"可达性分裂"加上少量解析器作用域残差；因此该分数应以逐条目分裂而非聚合分数为读数单位，该子集测量的并非选择性遗忘。

title: StableGrasp: Reconstructing Physically Stable Human Hand Grasps from Single Images
summary: Reconstructing a physically stable human grasp from a single RGB image is challenging because physically modeling grasps is itself difficult, and the problem requires estimating not only a visually constrained hand pose but also a control target that stabilizes the grasp. Existing methods either model only visual hand geometry without considering physics, or rely on less plausible physical modeling, which limits the physical validity of the resulting grasps. In this paper, we present StableGrasp, a differentiable simulation-based optimization framework that explicitly separates the visual hand pose from the control target that determines the grasping forces. Our method jointly optimizes hand geometry and control by minimizing the kinetic energy of the grasp in a differentiable simulator, while regularizing the hand geometry to preserve visual consistency and geometric plausibility. The reconstructed grasps are substantially more stable under rigorous physical simulation, while remaining visually consistent with the input images and geometrically plausible. Experiments show that our approach produces far more stable grasps than alternative hand-control strategies, benefiting visual-only grasp reconstruction pipelines by turning their outputs into physically stable grasps.

AI.tldr: 提出StableGrasp，一个基于可微仿真的优化框架，将手部视觉姿态与控制目标分离，联合优化几何与控制以最小化抓取动能，从而从单张RGB图像重建出物理稳定的抓取。
AI.motivation: 从单张RGB图像重建物理稳定的人手抓取很困难：物理建模本身困难，且问题不仅需估计受视觉约束的手部姿态，还需估计能稳定抓取的控制目标。现有方法要么只建模视觉手部几何而忽略物理，要么依赖不那么合理的物理建模，限制了生成抓取的物理有效性；同时现有视觉抓取重建流程的输出缺乏物理稳定性。
AI.method: 提出StableGrasp，可微仿真优化框架，显式地将视觉手部姿态与决定抓取力的控制目标相分离。在可微仿真器中，通过最小化抓取动能来联合优化手部几何与控制，同时对手部几何施加正则化以保持视觉一致性与几何合理性。
AI.result: 重建的抓取在严格物理仿真下显著更稳定，同时与输入图像保持视觉一致且几何合理。实验表明，该方法的抓取稳定性远超其他手部控制策略，并可将纯视觉抓取重建流程的输出转化为物理稳定的抓取。
AI.conclusion: StableGrasp通过分离视觉姿态与控制目标并借助可微仿真联合优化，有效解决了单图人手抓取的物理稳定性问题，可作为提升现有视觉抓取重建流程物理有效性的通用模块。

title: StyleFields: Multi-Scale AdaIN-Modulated Implicit SDFs for Coarse-to-Fine 3D Shape Reconstruction and Editing
comment: 39 pages, 20 figures, 3 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: We introduce StyleFields, a DeepSDF-based architecture for high-fidelity 3D reconstruction that enables controllable geometric style mixing: the coarse structure of one object can be combined with the fine-scale details of another. The core idea is depth-aware modulation: instead of a single global code, we inject latents via multi-level Adaptive Instance Normalization at several decoder depths, and supervise matching auxiliary heads with a coarse-to-fine schedule while gradually growing network depth. This aligns early layers with global shape and later layers with high-frequency detail, achieving content-style decoupling without part labels or adversarial training. StyleFields delivers faithful reconstructions, convincing cross-instance hybrids, and consistent gains in ablations over injection depth and supervision granularity. We further demonstrate a practical application in automotive aerodynamics: a learned surrogate drag predictor serves as a differentiable objective to optimize reconstructed cars, allowing targeted edits of global form or surface details by freezing the complementary latent stream. StyleFields offers a simple, effective recipe for controllable implicit reconstruction and downstream performance-driven design.

AI.tldr: StyleFields 提出一种基于 DeepSDF 的隐式三维重建架构，通过多级 AdaIN 注入 latent 与粗到细监督，实现无需部件标注或对抗训练的几何风格解耦与混合，并用于气动性能驱动的汽车形状优化。
AI.motivation: 实现高保真三维重建中"粗结构"与"细尺度细节"的可控混合（内容-风格解耦），同时避免对部件标签和对抗训练的依赖。此外希望将重建与下游性能驱动设计（如气动阻力）衔接。
AI.method: 基于 DeepSDF 的隐式解码器架构；核心是 depth-aware modulation：不再使用单一全局编码，而是在解码器的多个深度层级通过多级 AdaIN 注入 latent；配合粗到细（coarse-to-fine）监督调度，用辅助匹配头进行监督，并逐步增长网络深度，使浅层对齐全局形状、深层对齐高频细节。优化阶段使用学习到的阻力代理模型作为可微目标，通过冻结互补 latent 流实现对整体形态或表面细节的定向编辑。
AI.result: 实现忠实的重建结果和有说服力的跨实例风格混合；消融实验显示在注入深度与监督粒度上均有稳定增益；在汽车气动应用中，代理阻力预测器可驱动对重建车辆的整体形态或表面细节进行定向优化。
AI.conclusion: StyleFields 为可控隐式重建提供了简单有效的方案，并支持性能驱动的下游设计。

title: Few Bits, One Law: Toward W2A4KV2
summary: Extreme low-bit LLM compression is most challenging when weights, activations, and KV caches are quantized together: their distributions differ, and quantization errors interact throughout the network. We introduce CanonQ, a unified quantization-aware training framework that addresses these challenges by separating source canonicalization from task-aware adaptation. Fixed rotations and energy normalization map heterogeneous tensor sources to canonical coordinates, enabling frozen Gaussian-reference codebooks to be reused across layers and models. Joint training then adapts the network to the coupled errors of weight, activation, and cache quantization within a common scalar/vector interface. We bound frozen-codebook transfer error and local task loss, and derive an exact normalization-aware straight-through Jacobian that links quantization distortion to gradient bias. The strongest gains arise under joint W2A4KV2 compression: across LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B, CanonQ-Omni achieves up to 14.28x lower WikiText-2 perplexity and up to 57.9% higher mean zero-shot accuracy than prior state-of-the-art and representative quantization baselines. The benefits extend to Qwen3-1.7B, code generation, and mathematical reasoning: on instruction-tuned MobileLLM-Pro-1B at W2A16KV16, CanonQ achieves relative improvements of 41.7% in HumanEval pass@1 and 39.1% in GSM8K exact match over the strongest evaluated quantization baseline.

AI.tldr: CanonQ：统一量化感知训练框架，分离"源规范化"与"任务自适应"，在权重/激活/KV缓存联合极低位压缩下显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当权重、激活和KV缓存同时量化时，三者分布不同且量化误差在网络中相互耦合，极低位LLM压缩面临巨大挑战；现有方法难以在异构张量源与耦合误差间取得统一且可迁移的量化方案。
AI.method: 提出CanonQ，将源规范化与任务自适应解耦：1) 通过固定旋转与能量归一化，将异构张量源映射到规范坐标系，使冻结的高斯参考码本可跨层、跨模型复用；2) 联合训练在统一标量/向量接口下适配权重、激活、缓存量化的耦合误差；3) 理论证明冻结码本迁移误差与局部任务损失上界，并推导精确的归一化感知直通Jacobian，将量化失真与梯度偏差关联。
AI.result: 在W2A4KV2联合压缩下，CanonQ-Omni在LLaMA3-1B/3B/8B上WikiText-2困惑度最多降低14.28倍，零样本平均准确率最多提升57.9%，优于先前最优及代表性量化基线。该优势在Qwen3-1.7B、代码生成和数学推理任务上同样成立：指令微调的MobileLLM-Pro-1B在W2A16KV16下，HumanEval pass@1相对提升41.7%，GSM8K精确匹配相对提升39.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过源规范化与任务自适应分离、冻结高斯码本复用及归一化感知直通梯度，CanonQ为极低位联合量化提供统一有效框架，并在多模型、多任务上验证了泛化性与显著性能优势。

title: Do Vision Models Learn Physical Constraints or Rendering Shortcuts? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Grounded Physical Consistency
comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026 the 1st Workshop on Physical World AI
summary: Modern image editing models can satisfy a text instruction while breaking the physics of the edited scene. A new object may cast no shadow, a mirror may fail to reflect visible geometry, or an object may float above a surface that should support it. We study physical plausibility diagnosis, detecting whether an edited image violates scene physics, naming the violation type, localizing the affected region, and explaining the failure in language. We introduce a counterfactual benchmark whose controlled synthetic component uses Mitsuba~3 to generate 5,500 images from 500 scene families. Each family contains one clean image and ten matched violations involving shadows, reflection, support, surface response, and occlusion. The renderer pipeline provides category labels, affected-region masks and boxes, scene metadata, and explanation targets. We use LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and InternVL3.5-8B as diagnostic baselines rather than proposed methods. On a 1,650-image synthetic test set, the adapted baselines reach 64.0--67.8\% category macro-F1 on standard held-out scenes. For LLaVA-1.5-7B, category macro-F1 falls from 64.0\% on the standard split to 40.8\% under intervention shift. This gap shows that high in-distribution accuracy partly reflects cues tied to rendering and counterfactual construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理合理性诊断任务与基于Mitsuba 3的反事实基准，用于检测图像编辑中的物理违规并给出类型、区域与语言解释。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑模型虽能遵循文本指令，却常破坏场景物理（如无阴影、镜面不反射、物体悬浮）。需要系统性地诊断编辑图像的物理合理性。
AI.method: 构建受控合成反事实基准：用Mitsuba 3从500个场景族生成5,500张图像，每族含1张干净图与10张匹配的违规图，覆盖阴影、反射、支撑、表面响应与遮挡五类；渲染管线提供类别标签、受影响区域掩码与框、场景元数据及解释目标。以LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3.5-8B作为诊断基线。
AI.result: 在1,650张合成测试集上，标准留出场景的类别macro-F1为64.0–67.8%；LLaVA-1.5-7B在干预偏移下从64.0%降至40.8%。
AI.conclusion: 分布内高准确率部分源于与渲染及反事实构造相关的线索，模型在干预偏移下的泛化能力显著下降。

title: Multi-Objective Aligned Small Language Model Framework for SUD Patient Dialogue Generation
summary: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) counseling requires patient responses that reflect underlying cognitive states such as beliefs, coping strategies, and readiness for change. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent text, they often fail to produce cognitively coherent and clinically realistic patient behavior, especially under ethical and data-scarce clinical settings. Moreover, deploying frontier-scale LLMs in healthcare applications presents practical challenges including high computational cost, latency, privacy concerns, and limited deployability in resource-constrained environments, motivating the need for cognitively aligned small language models (SLMs). We propose a cognitively grounded framework for SUD patient dialogue generation that explicitly models and aligns latent cognitive components with patient histories and counselor questions. Our pipeline consists of two stages: cognitive component detection and cognitive component-aligned dialogue generation. To enable effective learning with smaller models, we combine knowledge distillation from high-capacity teacher models, preference optimization from human-annotations, and attention-guided reward shaping. Extensive evaluations using automatic scores like BERTScore, ROUGE, METEOR and BLEU, and LLM-as-judge hit-metrics against both human and teacher-model references show that cognitively informed fine-tuning substantially improves cognitive realization and alignment over a generic instruction-tuned baselines and mental health domain specific SLMs, with particularly strong gains for open-ended cognitive components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个认知驱动的物质使用障碍（SUD）患者对话生成框架，通过认知成分检测与对齐生成两阶段，结合知识蒸馏、偏好优化与注意力引导奖励塑形，使小模型在认知一致性与临床真实性上超越通用微调基线及心理健康领域专用SLM。
AI.motivation: SUD咨询需要患者回复反映信念、应对策略、改变意愿等潜在认知状态。LLM虽能生成流畅文本，但难以产生认知连贯、临床真实的患者行为，且在伦理约束与数据稀缺的临床场景下效果受限。同时，前沿规模LLM部署面临算力成本高、延迟大、隐私风险与资源受限环境难部署等问题，因此需要认知对齐的小语言模型（SLM）。
AI.method: 提出认知驱动的SUD患者对话生成框架，显式建模潜在认知成分并与患者病史、咨询师提问对齐。流程分两阶段：认知成分检测、认知成分对齐的对话生成。为让小模型有效学习，结合三类技术：高容量教师模型的知识蒸馏、基于人工标注的偏好优化、注意力引导的奖励塑形。
AI.result: 使用BERTScore、ROUGE、METEOR、BLEU等自动指标，以及以人类与教师模型输出为参照的LLM-as-judge命中指标进行评估。结果显示，认知信息引导的微调在认知实现与对齐上显著优于通用指令微调基线和心理健康领域专用SLM，在开放式认知成分上增益尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 将认知结构显式引入小模型训练，可有效提升SUD患者对话生成的认知一致性与临床真实性，为资源受限的临床场景提供可部署的认知对齐SLM方案。

title: A Deterministic Evidence Layer for Vision-Language Autism Screening from Naturalistic Home Video
summary: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is diagnosed through specialist observation of a child's social behavior, and access to that expertise is the bottleneck for early identification. Vision-language models (VLMs) describe a child's behavior from video well; the verdict drawn from the description is unstable: at temperature~0, across eight pipeline configurations on one backbone, 16--37\% of clips change their predicted label between repeated runs, and the cause lies in the serving stack. We keep the VLM frozen and move the decision out of the model. Under our grounded perception constraints the VLM writes an event table of timestamped, glossary-labeled events that names the eliciting press and logs counter-evidence; a text-only stage age-calibrates the confidence of each row; a deterministic weight-of-evidence scorer sums it into an evidence total and stratifies it into a risk category, so every decision decomposes into named per-feature contributions and can be re-scored from the saved table. On 43 caregiver-recorded, protocol-free home free-play clips of preschool children, the pipeline reaches AUC $0.851 \pm 0.012$, 86.0\% accuracy, and F$_1$ 71.8 over three runs. It labels 74.4\% of clips correctly in every run (60.5\% for the zero-shot baseline) and flags no typically developing clip in every run (9 of 31 at zero-shot). An ablation on the same backbone attributes the gain to the grounded perception constraints read through the deterministic scorer.

AI.tldr: 将决策从VLM中移出：冻结VLM仅做"接地感知"事件表抽取，再由年龄校准+确定性证据加权打分器给出稳定、可分解的ASD风险判定。
AI.motivation: ASD诊断依赖专家观察儿童社会行为，专家资源是早期识别的瓶颈。VLM虽能较好描述视频行为，但由描述得出的结论不稳定：同一骨干网络、温度约0下，八种流水线配置中有16–37%的片段在重复运行间改变预测标签，问题出在服务栈（推理/解码的不确定性）。
AI.method: 保持VLM冻结，将决策移出模型。(1) 在"接地感知约束"下，VLM输出带时间戳、词汇表标签的事件表，标注诱发刺激并记录反证；(2) 纯文本阶段对每一行按年龄校准置信度；(3) 确定性证据加权打分器求证据总和并分层为风险类别，使每个判定可分解为具名的逐特征贡献，并可依据保存的事件表重打分。
AI.result: 在43段照护者自录、无协议约束的学龄前儿童居家自由玩耍片段上，三次运行取得AUC 0.851±0.012、准确率86.0%、F₁ 71.8；74.4%的片段在每次运行中均被正确标注（零样本基线为60.5%），且每次运行均未误标任何典型发育片段（零样本31段中有9段被误标）。同骨干消融表明增益来自经确定性打分器读取的接地感知约束。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结VLM并引入接地感知约束+年龄校准+确定性证据打分，可在无协议居家视频上获得稳定、可解释、可复现的ASD风险分层，显著提升跨运行一致性与特异性。

title: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
